chapterName: 4. Izinqubo Zokuziphendukela Kwemvelo | 18. Ukuziphendukela Kwemvelo kanye Nomsuka Wezinhlobo Zezilwane | 18.0 Isingeniso
chapterNameEnglish: 4. Evolutionary Processes | 18. Evolution and Origin of Species | 18.0 Introduction
chapterContent: Insimu yebhayoloji ihlukahlukene ehlanganisa ukutadisha izinto eziphilayo kusukela ezincane nezilula kuya ezinkulu neziyinkimbinkimbi. Kusukela kuma-molecule ebhayoloji kuya kuma-biomes, isihloko esisodwa esihlala sihambisana ukuziphendukela kwemvelo. Zonke izinhlobo zezinto eziphilayo zivela kukhokho oyedwa. Nakuba kungase kubonakale sengathi izinto eziphilayo namuhla zihlala zifana, akunjalo. Ukuziphendukela kwemvelo empeleni kuyinqubo eqhubekayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinhlobo ezintsha zitholakala njalo. Isibonelo, ososayensi basebenzise indlela ebizwa ngokuthi i-fluorescent in situ hybridization, esebenzisa ama-fluorescent probes ukuthola izakhi zofuzo ezithile kuma-chromosome, ukuthola i-green sea slug engenza i-photosynthesis njengesitshalo.1 I-slug ithola izakhi zofuzo ezihlobene ne-photosynthesis kusuka ku-algae eyidlayo ngenqubo ebizwa ngokuthi ukudluliselwa kwezakhi zofuzo okuvundlile. Kule nqubo, izakhi zofuzo zingadluliselwa ngqo kusuka kwelinye iseli ziye kwelinye. Ikhodi yezakhi zofuzo ze-algal yemikhiqizo elungisa futhi igcine ama-chloroplast adliwe yi-slug. Bheka Umfanekiso 18.1
question1: Iyini ingqikithi ehlanganisayo ehlala ifana kuzo zonke izinkambu zebhayoloji?
answer1: Ukuziphendukela kwemvelo
distractor1a: Ukwenziwa kwe-Photosynthesis
distractor1c: I-Homeostasis
question2: Ngokwemfundiso yokuziphendukela kwemvelo, zonke izinhlobo eziphilayo zivelaphi?
answer2: Ukhokho ovamile
question3: Yisiphi isisho esichaza kangcono ukuziphendukela kwemvelo?
answer3: Kuyinqubo eqhubekayo eqhubekayo ezintweni eziphilayo
distractor3c: Kwenzeka kuphela ngesikhathi semicimbi yokuqothulwa kwabantu abaningi
question4: Iyiphi indlela eyasetshenziswa ukusiza ukuthola i-green sea slug ekwazi ukwenza i-photosynthesis?
answer4: Ukuhlanganiswa kwe-Fluorescent in situ
distractor4a: Ukusabela kwe-polymerase chain
question5: I-green sea slug ikwazi kanjani ukwenza i-photosynthesis?
answer5: Yathola izakhi zofuzo ezihlobene ne-photosynthesis ezivela ku-algae ngokudluliselwa kwezakhi zofuzo okuvundlile
distractor5a: Yathuthukisa ama-chloroplast ngokuzimela ngaphandle kokuxhumana ne-algae
distractor5b: Ikhiqiza ama-chloroplast avela kumaseli ayo ezilwane
distractor5c: Ibamba ukukhanya kwelanga isebenzisa imibala ekhethekile etholakala ezilwaneni kuphela
question6: Kuyini ukudluliselwa kwezakhi zofuzo okuvundlile?
answer6: Ukudluliselwa okuqondile kwezakhi zofuzo kusuka kwelinye iseli kuya kwelinye
distractor6a: Ukuhamba kwezakhi zofuzo kusuka kubazali kuya enzalweni ngesikhathi sokuzala
distractor6c: Ukuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo okubangelwa ukukhanya kwe-ultraviolet
question7: Uyini umsebenzi wezakhi zofuzo ze-algal ezitholwa yi-sea slug?
answer7: Akhiqiza amaprotheni alungisa futhi alondoloze ama-chloroplast adliwa yi-slug
distractor7a: Zivumela i-slug ukuthi ikhiqize ama-chloroplast ayo ngamaseli ezilwane
distractor7b: Zenza i-slug ikwazi ukugaya ama-chloroplast ngokushesha

chapterName: 4. Izinqubo Zokuziphendukela Kwemvelo | 18. Ukuziphendukela Kwemvelo Nomsuka Wezinhlobo Zezilwane | 18.1 Ukuqonda Ukuziphendukela Kwemvelo | Ukuxhumana Nezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 4. Evolutionary Processes | 18. Evolution and Origin of Species | 18.1 Understanding Evolution | Connection for AP® Courses
chapterContent:
Izigidi zezinhlobo, kusukela kubhaktheriya kuya kuma-blueberry kuya kuma-baboon, okwamanje zibiza uMhlaba ngokuthi ikhaya lazo, kodwa lezi zinto eziphilayo zavela ezinhlotsheni ezahlukene. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ososayensi balinganisela ukuthi ezinye izinhlobo eziyizigidi eziningana zizoshabalala ngaphambi kokuba zihlukaniswe futhi zifundwe. Kodwa kungani amabhere ase-polar engahlali ngokwemvelo ezingwadule noma emahlathini emvula, ngaphandle, mhlawumbe, kumamuvi? Kungani abantu benezici, njengezithupha eziphikisanayo, ezihlukile ezinhlotsheni zezilwane kodwa hhayi kwezinye izilwane ezincelisayo? Ukubonwa kwama-finch nguCharles Darwin evakashela iziQhingi zaseGalapagos ngawo-1800 kwanikeza kanjani isisekelo sokuqonda kwethu kwanamuhla kokuziphendukela kwemvelo?

 Inkolelo-mbono yokuziphendukela kwemvelo njengoba iphakanyiswe nguDarwin iyinkolelo-mbono ehlanganisayo yebhayoloji. Imfundiso yokuthi konke ukuphila kuye kwavela futhi kwahlukahluka kusuka kukhokho ofanayo iyisisekelo lapho sibhekana khona nayo yonke imibuzo kubhayoloji. Njengoba sifundile ekuhloleni kwethu isakhiwo kanye nomsebenzi we-DNA, ukuhlukahluka kwabantu ngabanye ngaphakathi kwesizwe kwenzeka ngokuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo, okuvumela izici ezifiselekayo kakhulu ukuba zidluliselwe esizukulwaneni esilandelayo. Ngenxa yokuncintisana ngezinsiza kanye nezinye izingcindezi zemvelo, abantu abanezimpawu ezivumelana nezimo ezingcono banamathuba amaningi okusinda nokuzala, badlulisele lezo zimpawu esizukulwaneni esilandelayo ngokuvama okwandayo. Lapho izindawo zishintsha, lokho okwakuyisici esingathandeki kungaba yisici esihle. Izinto eziphilayo zingase ziguquke ngenxa yendawo yazo eshintshayo ngokuqongelela izici ezinhle ezizukulwaneni ezilandelayo. Ngakho-ke, ukuziphendukela kwemvelo ngokukhetha kwemvelo kuchaza kokubili ubunye kanye nokwehlukahluka kokuphila.

 Ukuziphendukela kwemvelo okuguquguqukayo kwenzeka lapho izici ezifanayo ezinomsebenzi ofanayo ziguquka ezinhlotsheni eziningi ezivezwe ekucindezelweni kokukhetha okufanayo, njengamaphiko amalulwane nezinambuzane. Ekuziphendukeleni kwemvelo okuhlukile, izinhlobo ezimbili ziguquka ngezindlela ezahlukene kusukela endaweni efanayo, njengemilenze yangaphambili yabantu, izinja, izinyoni, kanye nemikhomo. Nakuba inkolelo-mbono kaDarwin yayiyinto entsha ngesikhathi sayo ngoba yayiphikisana nemibono ehlala isikhathi eside (isibonelo, uLamarck waphakamisa ifa lezici ezitholiwe), ubufakazi obuthathwe emikhakheni eminingi yesayensi, kufaka phakathi irekhodi lezinsalela, ukuba khona kwezakhiwo ezifanayo nezingasebenzi, izibalo, kanye nokuhlaziywa kwe-DNA kusekela ukuziphendukela kwemvelo ngokukhetha kwemvelo. Kubalulekile futhi ukuqonda ukuthi ukuziphendukela kwemvelo kuyaqhubeka nokwenzeka; isibonelo, amabhaktheriya aguquka abe ukumelana nama-antibiotic noma izitshalo ezimelana nezibulala-zinambuzane anikeza ubufakazi bokushintsha okuqhubekayo.

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyiswe kulesi sigaba zisekela imiqondo echazwe ku-Big Idea 1 yoHlaka Lwekharikhulamu lwe-AP® Biology. Izinhloso Zokufunda ze-AP® ezibalwe kuHlaka Lwekharikhulamu zinikeza isisekelo esicacile senkambo ye-AP® Biology, ulwazi olusekelwe ebholeni lokucwaninga, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®. Inhloso yokufunda ihlanganisa okuqukethwe okudingekayo neyodwa noma ngaphezulu kwemikhuba yesayensi eyisikhombisa.

question1: Uyini umqondo oyinhloko wenkolelo-mbono kaDarwin yokuziphendukela kwemvelo?
answer1: Zonke izinto eziphilayo zavela futhi zahlukahluka kusukela kukhokho oyedwa ngokukhetha kwemvelo
distractor1a: Izinhlobo azishintshi ngemva kokudalwa kwazo
distractor1b: Izinto eziphilayo ziyathuthuka ngoba zikhetha ngamabomu izici ezizuzisayo
distractor1c: Ukuziphendukela kwemvelo kwenzeka kuphela lapho kuvela izinhlobo ezintsha ngokuzumayo
question2: Izinguquko ezintsha zivela kanjani emphakathini?
answer2: Ngokushintsha kwezakhi zofuzo okudala ukuhlukahluka kwezakhi zofuzo
distractor2a: Ngokuthola izinto eziphilayo izici ezizidingayo ngesikhathi sokuphila
distractor2b: Ngokuncintisana kuphela ngaphandle kokushintsha kwezakhi zofuzo
distractor2c: Ngokushintsha okungahleliwe kwemvelo okushintsha ngqo bonke abantu
question3: Kungani abantu abanezimo ezinhle benamathuba amaningi okuzala?
answer3: Banamathuba amaningi okusinda ezingcindezini zemvelo futhi badlulisele izici zabo ebantwaneni
distractor3a: Bahlala beveza inzalo eningi kungakhathaliseki ukuthi basinda kanjani
distractor3b: Zingadlulisela izici ngqo ezintweni eziphilayo ezingahlobene
question4: Kuyini ukuziphendukela kwemvelo okuguquguqukayo?
answer4: Ukuvela okuzimele kwezici ezifanayo ezinhlotsheni ezahlukene ezivezwe ekucindezelweni kokukhetha okufanayo
distractor4a: Ukuvela kwezici ezahlukene ezinhlotsheni ezihlobene eduze
distractor4b: Ukudluliswa kwezakhi zofuzo phakathi kwezinhlobo ezingahlobene
distractor4c: Ukulahlekelwa yizo zonke izici zokhokho ngokuhamba kwesikhathi
question5: Yisiphi isibonelo esichaza kangcono ukuvela kwezinto okuhlukile?
answer5: Imilenze yangaphambili yabantu, izinja, izinyoni, kanye nemikhomo eguquka kusukela esakhiweni esifanayo sasendulo
distractor5a: Amaphiko amalulwane nezinambuzane enza umsebenzi ofanayo
distractor5b: Amabhaktheriya ashintshana ngezakhi zofuzo ngokudluliswa kwezakhi zofuzo okuvundlile
distractor5c: Izimbali ezahlukene ziheha umthuthi wempova ofanayo
question6: Yiluphi uhlobo lobufakazi olusekela inkolelo-mbono yesimanje yokuziphendukela kwemvelo?
answer6: Ama-fossils, izakhiwo ezifanayo nezingasebenzi, izibalo, kanye nokuhlaziywa kwe-DNA
distractor6c: Ukufana kuphela ekuziphatheni
question7: Kungani ukumelana nama-antibiotic kumagciwane kubhekwa njengobufakazi bokuziphendukela kwemvelo?
answer7: Kubonisa ukuthi abantu bayaqhubeka nokukhula ngenxa yezingcindezi zemvelo
distractor7a: Kubonisa ukuthi amabhaktheriya azivumelanisa ngamabomu nama-antibiotic
distractor7b: Kufakazela ukuthi ama-antibiotic adala izinguquko ezizuzisayo
question8: Isici esibi ngaphambili singaba kanjani sihle?
answer8: Ushintsho endaweni ezungezile lungashintsha ukuthi yiziphi izici ezandisa ukusinda nokuzala
distractor8a: Lesi sici siba yinto evelele ngokuzenzakalelayo kubo bonke abantu
distractor8b: Abantu bashintsha leso sici ngamabomu uma kudingeka
distractor8c: Lesi sici sisakazeka ngaphandle kokuthinta impumelelo yokuzala

chapterName: 4. Izinqubo Zokuziphendukela Kwemvelo | 18. Ukuziphendukela Kwemvelo Nokuqala Kwezinhlobo Zezilwane | 18.1 Ukuqonda Ukuziphendukela Kwemvelo | Umsuka Wokuphila
chapterNameEnglish: 4. Evolutionary Processes | 18. Evolution and Origin of Species | 18.1 Understanding Evolution | The Origin of Life
chapterContent:
Abantu baye bamukela imibono eminingi mayelana nemvelaphi yokuphila phakathi nesikhathi sethu eMhlabeni. Imiphakathi yokuqala yayikholelwa ukuthi ukuphila kwadalwa ngamandla angaphezu kwawemvelo. Izinto eziphilayo zenziwe ngezandla” ukuze zivumelane ngokuphelele nendawo ezikuyo futhi, ngenxa yalokho, azizange zishintshe ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Abanye abacabangi bokuqala, njengesazi sefilosofi esingumGreki u-Aristotle, babekholelwa ukuthi izinto eziphilayo ziyingxenye yesigaba sobunzima obukhulayo. Ngokusekelwe kulokhu kuqonda, ososayensi abanjengoCarolus Linnaeus bazama ukuhlela zonke izinto eziphilayo zibe izinhlelo zokuhlukanisa ezazibonisa ubunzima obukhulayo bokuphila.

 Nokho, ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ososayensi baqonda ukuthi impilo yayishintsha njalo eMhlabeni. UGeorges Cuvier wathola ukuthi izinsalela noma izinto eziphilayo eziguqulwe njengoba ayemba ezingqimbeni zamadwala ezijulile (strata), okubonisa ukuthi izinto eziphilayo ezikhona endaweni zazishintshile ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Lokhu kuphawula kwaholela uJean-Baptiste de Lamarck ukuba acabange ukuthi izinto eziphilayo zazivumelanisa nendawo yazo ngokushintsha ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Njengoba izinto eziphilayo zazisebenzisa izingxenye ezahlukene zomzimba wazo, lezo zingxenye zathuthuka, futhi lezi zinguquko zadluliselwa enzalweni yazo. Ekugcineni, lezi zinkolelo-mbono zaphikiswa ososayensi, kodwa intuthuko yazo yaba negalelo embonweni wokuziphendukela kwemvelo owagcina usungulwe nguCharles Darwin.
question1: Imiphakathi eminingi yakuqala yayichaza kanjani imvelaphi yokuphila?
answer1: Babekholelwa ukuthi ukuphila kwadalwa ngamandla angaphezu kwawemvelo
distractor1a: Babekholelwa ukuthi ukuphila kwavela ngokukhetha kwemvelo
distractor1b: Babekholelwa ukuthi ukuphila kwaqala ezintweni ezincane eziphila olwandle
distractor1c: Babekholelwa ukuthi zonke izinhlobo zathuthuka ngokuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo
question2: Ngokwezinkolelo zakuqala, kungani izinto eziphilayo zahlala zingashintshi ngokuhamba kwesikhathi?
answer2: Kwakucatshangwa ukuthi zazivumelana ngokuphelele nendawo yazo lapho zadalwa
question3: Yini u-Aristotle ayiphakamisa ngezinto eziphilayo?
answer3: Zingahlelwa esitebhisini esiyinkimbinkimbi eyandayo
question4: Yayiyini inhloso yesistimu yokuhlela kaCarolus Linnaeuss?
answer4: Ukuhlela izinto eziphilayo zibe uhlelo olubonisa ubunzima obandayo
distractor4a: Ukufakazela ukukhethwa kwemvelo kwakuyindlela yokuziphendukela kwemvelo
distractor4b: Ukuhlukanisa izinto eziphilayo ngokusekelwe kuphela ku-DNA sequences
distractor4c: Ukukhombisa ukuthi izinhlobo azishintshi ngokuhamba kwesikhathi
question5: Yikuphi ukuqaphela okwenziwe nguGeorges Cuvier ngokutadisha izingqimba zamadwala?
answer5: Izinsalela ezisezingqimbeni ezijulile zihlukile kulezo ezisezingqimbeni eziphakeme, okubonisa ushintsho ngokuhamba kwesikhathi
distractor5a: Zonke izingqimba zamadwala zaziqukethe izinto eziphilayo ezifanayo
distractor5b: Izinto eziphilayo zanamuhla kuphela ezitholakale emafossil
distractor5c: Izinsalela zabonisa ukuthi izinto eziphilayo azikaze ziphele
question6: Yini uJean-Baptiste de Lamarck ayiphakamisayo ngokuziphendukela kwemvelo?
answer6: Izinto eziphilayo zashintsha ngokusebenzisa nokungasebenzisi izingxenye zomzimba futhi zadlulisela lezo zici ezitholwe ezinganeni zazo.
distractor6a: Ukukhetha kwemvelo kwasebenza ekushintsheni kwezakhi zofuzo okuzuzwe njengefa
distractor6b: Izinhlobo zavela ngezenzakalo ze-geological ezingahleliwe zodwa
distractor6c: Ukuziphendukela kwemvelo kwenzeka kuphela ngokuhlanganiswa kwezinhlobo zezilwane
question7: Imibono kaLamarcks yanikela kanjani ku-tBiology... naphezu kokuthi yayingalungile?
answer7: Basiza ekwakheni ukucabanga kwesayensi okwagcina kuholele embonweni kaDarwin wokuziphendukela kwemvelo
distractor7b: Bafakazele ukuthi izici ezitholwe zizuzwe njengefa

chapterName: 4. Izinqubo Zokuziphendukela Kwemvelo | 18. Ukuziphendukela Kwemvelo kanye Nomsuka Wezinhlobo | 18.1 Ukuqonda Ukuziphendukela Kwemvelo | UCharles Darwin Nokukhethwa Kwemvelo
chapterNameEnglish: 4. Evolutionary Processes | 18. Evolution and Origin of Species | 18.1 Understanding Evolution | Charles Darwin and Natural Selection
chapterContent:
Maphakathi nekhulu le-19, indlela yangempela yokuziphendukela kwemvelo yacatshangwa futhi yachazwa ngokuzimela yizazi zemvelo ezimbili: uCharles Darwin no-Alfred Russel Wallace. Okubalulekile, isazi zemvelo ngasinye sachitha isikhathi sihlola umhlaba wemvelo ohambweni oluya ezindaweni ezishisayo. Kusukela ngo-1831 kuya ku-1836, uDarwin wahamba umhlaba wonke nge-H.M.S. Beagle, okuhlanganisa nokuma eNingizimu Melika, e-Australia, kanye nengxenye eseningizimu ye-Afrika. UWallace waya eBrazil ukuyoqoqa izinambuzane emahlathini emvula ase-Amazon kusukela ngo-1848 kuya ku-1852 kanye naseMalay Archipelago kusukela ngo-1854 kuya ku-1862. Uhambo lukaDarwin, njengohambo lukaWallace lwakamuva oluya eMalay Archipelago, lwaluhlanganisa nokuma eziqhingini eziningana, okokugcina kwakuyiziqhingi zaseGalápagos entshonalanga ye-Ecuador. Kulezi ziqhingi, uDarwin wabona izinhlobo zezinto eziphilayo eziqhingini ezahlukene ezazifana ngokusobala, kodwa zazinomehluko ohlukile. Isibonelo, izintaka zomhlaba ezihlala eziQhingini zaseGalápagos zazinezinhlobo eziningana ezinesimo somlomo esiyingqayizivele (Isithombe 18.2). Lolu hlobo lwezinyoni eziqhingini lwalunochungechunge oluhlelwe ngokwezigaba lobukhulu bemilomo kanye nokwakheka okunomehluko omncane kakhulu phakathi kwezinhlobo ezifanayo kakhulu. Waphawula ukuthi lezi zinyoni zazifana kakhulu nolunye uhlobo lwezinyoni eziqhingini zaseNingizimu Melika. UDarwin wacabanga ukuthi lolu hlobo lwezinyoni lungase lube uhlobo oluguqulwe kolunye lohlobo lokuqala lwezinyoni eziqhingini. Ngemva kokufunda kabanzi, waqaphela ukuthi imilomo ehlukahlukene yezinyoni ngayinye yayisiza izinyoni ukuthola uhlobo oluthile lokudla. Isibonelo, izinyoni ezidla imbewu zazinemilomo eqinile, ebanzi yokuphula imbewu, kanti izinyoni ezidla izinambuzane zazinemilomo efana nomkhonto yokuhlaba izisulu zazo.

 UWallace noDarwin bobabili baphawula amaphethini afanayo kwezinye izinto eziphilayo futhi bathuthukisa ngokuzimela incazelo efanayo yokuthi izinguquko ezinjalo zingenzeka kanjani nokuthi kungani. UDarwin wabiza le ndlela ngokuthi ukukhetha kwemvelo. Ukukhethwa kwemvelo, okwaziwa nangokuthi ukusinda kwezilwane ezinamandla kakhulu,” ukuzalana okwandayo kwabantu abanezimpawu ezinhle ezisinda ekushintsheni kwemvelo ngenxa yalezo zimpawu; lokhu kuholela ekushintsheni kokuziphendukela kwemvelo.

 Isibonelo, inani lezimfudu ezinkulu ezitholakala eGalapagos Archipelago labonwa nguDarwin ukuthi zinezintamo ezinde kunalezo ezazihlala kwezinye iziqhingi ezinezindawo eziphansi ezomile. Lezi mfudu zakhethwa” ngoba zazikwazi ukufinyelela amaqabunga amaningi futhi zithole ukudla okuningi kunalezo ezinezintamo ezimfushane. Ngezikhathi zesomiso lapho amaqabunga ambalwa ayetholakala khona, lezo ezazingafinyelela amaqabunga amaningi zazinethuba elingcono lokudla nokusinda kunalezo ezazingakwazi ukufinyelela umthombo wokudla. Ngenxa yalokho, izimfudu ezinezintamo ezinde zazizoba nethuba elikhulu lokuzala futhi zidlulisele lesi sici esinezintamo ezinde ebantwaneni bazo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kwakuzoba khona izimfudu ezinezintamo ezinde kuphela kubantu.

 Ukukhethwa kwemvelo, uDarwin waphikisana, kwakuwumphumela ongenakugwenywa wezimiso ezintathu ezazisebenza emvelweni. Okokuqala, izici eziningi zezinto eziphilayo zizuzwe njengefa, noma zidluliselwa kumzali ziye enzalweni. Nakuba kungekho muntu, kuhlanganise noDarwin noWallace, owayazi ukuthi lokhu kwenzeka kanjani ngaleso sikhathi, kwakuwukuqonda okufanayo. Okwesibili, kukhiqizwa inzalo eningi kunaleyo ekwazi ukusinda, ngakho-ke izinsiza zokusinda nokuzala zilinganiselwe. Amandla okuzala kuzo zonke izinto eziphilayo adlula ukutholakala kwezinsiza zokusekela inani lazo. Ngakho-ke, kukhona ukuncintisana ngalezo zinsiza esizukulwaneni ngasinye. Ukuqonda kukaDarwin noWallace ngalesi simiso kwavela ekufundeni indatshana yesazi sezomnotho uThomas Malthus owaxoxa ngalesi simiso maqondana nabantu. Okwesithathu, inzalo iyahlukahlukana maqondana nezici zayo futhi lokho kuhlukahluka kuzuzwe njengefa. UDarwin noWallace bacabanga ukuthi inzalo enezici ezizuzwe njengefa ezivumela ukuthi incintisane kangcono nezinsiza ezilinganiselwe izosinda futhi ibe nenzalo eningi kunalabo bantu abanezinhlobo ezahlukene abangakwazi ukuncintisana. Ngenxa yokuthi izici zizuzwe njengefa, lezi zimfanelo zizomelwa kangcono esizukulwaneni esilandelayo. Lokhu kuzoholela ekushintsheni kwezibalo ezizukulwaneni ngezizukulwane enkambisweni uDarwin ayibiza ngokuthi ukwehla ngokuguqulwa. Ekugcineni, ukukhethwa kwemvelo kuholela ekuzivumelaniseni okukhulu kwesibalo sabantu nendawo yaso; yiyona ndlela kuphela eyaziwa ngokuziphendukela kwemvelo okuguquguqukayo.

 Amaphepha kaDarwin noWallace (Isithombe 18.3) aveza umqondo wokukhethwa kwemvelo afundwa ndawonye ngo-1858 ngaphambi kweLinnean Society eLondon. Ngonyaka olandelayo incwadi kaDarwin, ethi On the Origin of Species, yanyatheliswa. Incwadi yakhe yachaza ngokuningiliziwe izimpikiswano zakhe zokuziphendukela kwemvelo ngokukhethwa kwemvelo.

 Imiboniso yokuziphendukela kwemvelo ngokukhethwa kwemvelo idla isikhathi futhi kunzima ukuyithola. Esinye sezibonelo ezinhle kakhulu siboniswe ezinyonini ezasiza ekuphefumuleleni umbono kaDarwin: ama-finches aseGalápagos. UPeter noRosemary Grant kanye nozakwabo baye bafunda inani lama-finch aseGalápagos minyaka yonke kusukela ngo-1976 futhi banikeze imiboniso ebalulekile yokukhethwa kwemvelo. Ama-Grants athole izinguquko kusukela kwesinye isizukulwane kuya kwesinye ekusatshalalisweni kwezimo zomlomo ne-finch ephakathi nendawo esiqhingini saseGalápagos iDaphne Major. Izinyoni zizuze ukuhlukahluka kokwakheka komlomo ngezinye izinyoni ezinemilomo ejulile kanti ezinye zinemilomo emincane. Ngesikhathi lapho imvula yayiphezulu kunokuvamile ngenxa ye-El Niño, imbewu eqinile enkulu eyayidliwa yizinyoni ezinomlomo omkhulu yancipha ngenani; nokho, kwakukhona inala yembewu encane ethambile eyayidliwa yizinyoni ezinomlomo omncane. Ngakho-ke, ukusinda nokuzala kwaba ngcono kakhulu eminyakeni eyalandela yezinyoni ezinomlomo omncane. Eminyakeni eyalandela le El Niño, amaGrants alinganisa ubukhulu bemilomo yabantu futhi athola ukuthi usayizi webhili ojwayelekile wawumncane. Njengoba usayizi webhili uyisici esizuzwe njengefa, abazali abanebhili elincane babenezingane eziningi futhi usayizi webhili wawusushintshe waba mncane. Njengoba izimo zathuthuka ngo-1987 futhi imbewu enkulu yatholakala kakhulu, ukuthambekela kosayizi webhili ojwayelekile omncane kwaphela.
question1: Yikuphi ukubonwa kwezintaka zaseGalápagos okwasiza ekuphefumuleni inkolelo-mbono kaDarwin yokuziphendukela kwemvelo?
answer1: Izinhlobo ezahlukene ze-finch zazinemilomo ejwayele ukudla okuhlukahlukene
distractor1a: Zonke izinyoni ezihlala kuzo zonke iziqhingi zazinemilomo efanayo
distractor1b: Ama-Finches ashintshe imilomo yawo ngesikhathi sokuphila kwawo
distractor1c: Uhlobo olulodwa kuphela lwe-finch olwaluhlala eziQhingini zaseGalápagos
question2: Kuyini ukukhetha kwemvelo?
answer2: Inqubo lapho abantu abanezimfanelo ezinhle ezizuzwe njengefa besinda futhi bezalana ngempumelelo enkulu
distractor2a: Inqubo lapho izinto eziphilayo zithuthukisa khona ngamabomu izici eziwusizo
question3: Kungani izimfudu zaseGalápagos ezinentamo ende zavame kakhulu kwezinye iziqhingi?
answer3: Babengafinyelela ukudla okwengeziwe ngesikhathi sesomiso, okwandisa amathuba abo okusinda nokuzala
distractor3a: Belula izintamo zabo ngamabomu futhi badlulisela ushintshi kubantwana babo
distractor3c: Zazala ngokushesha kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ukudla kuyatholakala yini
question4: Yiziphi izimo ezintathu ezidingekayo ukuze kube nokukhethwa kwemvelo?
answer4: Izici ezizuzwe njengefa, ukukhiqiza ngokweqile inzalo, kanye nokwehlukahlukana kwefa phakathi kwabantu ngabanye
distractor4a: Ukufuduka, ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo, kanye nokushintsha kwezakhi zofuzo kuphela
distractor4b: Izici ezifanayo, izinsiza ezingenamkhawulo, kanye nokusinda okulinganayo
distractor4c: Izici ezitholiwe, ukwakheka kwe-cloning, kanye nokuzivumelanisa nezimo ngesikhathi sokuphila
question5: Wayesho ukuthini uDarwin ngokuzalela ngokuguqulwa?
answer5: Izibalo zabantu ziyashintsha ngokuhamba kwezizukulwane njengoba izici ezizuzwe njengefa ziba zivamile noma zingasavamile
distractor5a: Izinto eziphilayo ngazinye zishintsha izici zazo ngesikhathi sokuphila kwazo
distractor5b: Izinhlobo zihlala zifana ngokwezakhi zofuzo ngokuhamba kwesikhathi
distractor5c: Izinto eziphilayo eziphelile kuphela ezihlangabezana nokuziphendukela kwemvelo
question6: Kungani uDarwin noWallace baqaphela ukuncintisana njengento ebalulekile ekuziphendukeleni kwemvelo?
answer6: Kukhiqizwa inzalo eningi kunalokho izinsiza ezitholakalayo ezingakusekela
distractor6b: Ukuncintisana kwenzeka kuphela phakathi kwezinhlobo ezahlukene
distractor6c: Ukuncintisana kuvimbela ukuhlukahluka okuzuzwe njengefa
question7: UPeter noRosemary Grant bakubonisa kanjani ukukhetha kwemvelo ezintakeni zaseGalápagos?
answer7: Babhale ngezinguquko ezizuzwe njengefa ngobukhulu bomlomo obujwayelekile njengoba ukutholakala kokudla kushintsha phakathi nezizukulwane
distractor7a: Babonise ukuthi ama-finch ashintshe isimo somlomo esikhathini esisodwa sokuphila kwawo
distractor7b: Bathola izinhlobo ezintsha ngokuphelele ze-finch minyaka yonke
distractor7c: Bafakazele ukuthi wonke ama-finch ekugcineni akhula imilomo efanayo
question8: Kungani ama-finch anomlomo omncane aqala ukwanda ngemva kwesenzakalo sika-El Niño?
answer8: Imbewu encane, ethambile yanda kakhulu, yanikeza izinyoni ezinomlomo omncane ithuba lokusinda nokuzala
distractor8a: Izinyoni ezinomlomo omkhulu zayeka ukuzala ngokuphelele
distractor8b: Izinyoni ezinomlomo omncane zathola imilomo emikhulu ngaphambi kokuzala
distractor8c: Zonke izinhlobo zembewu zanyamalala ngaphandle kwembewu enkulu, eqinile

chapterName: 4. Izinqubo Zokuziphendukela Kwemvelo | 18. Ukuziphendukela Kwemvelo Nomsuka Wezinhlobo Zezilwane | 18.1 Ukuqonda Ukuziphendukela Kwemvelo | Ukuxhumana Komsebenzi | Isazi Sezinto Eziphilayo Sensimu
chapterNameEnglish: 4. Evolutionary Processes | 18. Evolution and Origin of Species | 18.1 Understanding Evolution | Career Connection | Field Biologist
chapterContent:
Abantu abaningi bahamba ngezinyawo, bahlola imihume, bacwila emanzini ashisayo, noma bakhuphuke izintaba ukuze bazijabulise. Abantu bavame ukuhlanganyela kule misebenzi benethemba lokubona izilwane zasendle. Ukuzwa indawo yangaphandle kungaba mnandi kakhulu futhi kuvuselele. Kuthiwani uma umsebenzi wakho bekuwukuba ngaphandle ehlane? Izazi zezinto eziphilayo zasensimini ngokwencazelo zisebenza ngaphandle ensimini.” Igama elithi insimu kulokhu libhekisela kunoma iyiphi indawo engaphandle, ngisho nangaphansi kwamanzi. Isazi sezinto eziphilayo zasensimini ngokuvamile sigxila ocwaningweni ngezinhlobo ezithile, iqembu lezinto eziphilayo, noma indawo yokuhlala eyodwa (Isithombe 18.4).

 Inhloso eyodwa yezazi eziningi zezinto eziphilayo zasensimini ihlanganisa ukuthola izinhlobo ezintsha ezingakaze zirekhodwe. Akukhona nje kuphela ukuthi okutholakele okunjalo kwandisa ukuqonda kwethu umhlaba wemvelo, kodwa futhi kuholela emisha ebalulekile emikhakheni efana nemithi kanye nezolimo. Izinhlobo zezitshalo nezinambuzane, ikakhulukazi, zingaveza ulwazi olusha lwezokwelapha nolokudla okunempilo. Ezinye izinto eziphilayo zingadlala indima ebalulekile ezindaweni zemvelo noma zibhekwe njengezingavamile futhi zidinga ukuvikelwa. Uma zitholakala, lezi zinhlobo ezibalulekile zingasetshenziswa njengobufakazi bemithetho nemithetho yemvelo.
question1: Lisho ukuthini igama elithi insimu emkhakheni wesayensi yezinto eziphilayo?
answer1: Noma iyiphi indawo yokucwaninga yangaphandle, kufaka phakathi izindawo ezingaphansi kwamanzi
distractor1a: Amahlathi namadlelo kuphela
distractor1c: Umhlaba wezolimo osetshenziselwa ukulima
question2: Yini isazi sezinto eziphilayo esivame ukuyifunda?
answer2: Uhlobo oluthile, iqembu lezinto eziphilayo, noma indawo yokuhlala
question3: Kungani kubalulekile ukuthola izinhlobo ezintsha?
answer3: Kwandisa ulwazi lwesayensi futhi kungaholela ekuthuthukisweni kwezokwelapha kanye nezolimo
distractor3c: Kunciphisa ukuhlukahluka kwezinto eziphilayo ezindaweni zemvelo
question4: Yiziphi izinhlobo zezinto eziphilayo ezibaluleke kakhulu ekwembuleni ulwazi olusha lwezokwelapha nolokudla okunempilo?
answer4: Izitshalo nama-microorganisms
distractor4a: Izinyoni nezilwane ezihuquzelayo
question5: Ukutholakala kwezinhlobo ezingavamile kungathinta kanjani inqubomgomo yezemvelo?
answer5: Inganikeza ubufakazi obusekela imithethonqubo yemvelo kanye nemithetho yokulondolozwa kwemvelo
distractor5a: Isusa ngokuzenzakalelayo zonke izivikelo ezisemthethweni zezindawo zokuhlala
distractor5b: Kuqinisekisa ukuthi lolu hlobo alusoze lwaba sengozini yokuqothulwa
question6: Ngaphandle kolwazi lwesayensi, iyiphi enye inzuzo yokufunda izinto eziphilayo ezindaweni zazo zemvelo?
answer6: Kusiza ososayensi baqonde indima edlalwa yizinhlobo zemvelo ezindaweni zemvelo
distractor6b: Kuqinisekisa ukuthi zonke izinhlobo zezilwane zingasinda ekushintsheni kwemvelo
distractor6c: Kuvimbela ukuvela kwezinhlobo ezintsha

chapterName: 4. Izinqubo Zokuziphendukela Kwemvelo | 18. Ukuziphendukela Kwemvelo kanye Nemvelaphi Yezinhlobo | 18.1 Ukuqonda Ukuziphendukela Kwemvelo | Izinqubo Namaphethini Okuziphendukela Kwemvelo
chapterNameEnglish: 4. Evolutionary Processes | 18. Evolution and Origin of Species | 18.1 Understanding Evolution | Processes and Patterns of Evolution
chapterContent:
Ukukhetha kwemvelo kungenzeka kuphela uma kukhona ukushintshashintsha, noma umehluko, phakathi kwabantu emphakathini. Okubalulekile, lokhu kungafani kumele kube nesisekelo sezakhi zofuzo; ngaphandle kwalokho, ukukhetha ngeke kuholele ekushintsheni esizukulwaneni esilandelayo. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba ukushintshashintsha phakathi kwabantu kungabangelwa yizizathu ezingezona izakhi zofuzo njengokuthi umuntu mude ngenxa yokudla okungcono kunezakhi zofuzo ezahlukene.

 Ukuhlukahluka kwezakhi zofuzo emphakathini kuvela ezindleleni ezimbili eziyinhloko: ukuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo kanye nokuzala ngokocansi. Ukuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo, ushintsho ku-DNA, luwumthombo wokugcina wama-allele amasha, noma ukushintshashintsha kwezakhi zofuzo okusha kunoma yimuphi umphakathi. Izinguquko zezakhi zofuzo ezibangelwa ukuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo zingaba nomphumela owodwa kwemithathu ku-phenotype. Ukuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo kungathinta i-phenotype yezinto eziphilayo ngendlela enikeza ukuqina okunciphile—amathuba aphansi okusinda noma inzalo encane. Ngaphandle kwalokho, ukuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo kungaveza i-phenotype enomphumela omuhle ekuqineni komzimba. Futhi, izinguquko eziningi ngeke zibe nomthelela ekuqineni kwe-phenotype; lezi zibizwa ngokuthi ukuguqulwa okungathathi hlangothi. Ukuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo kungase kube nobubanzi obuphelele bobukhulu bomphumela ekuqineni komzimba kwezinto eziphilayo eziziveza ku-phenotype yazo, kusukela kumphumela omncane kuya kumphumela omkhulu. Ukuzala ngokocansi kuholela nasekuhlukeni kwezakhi zofuzo: lapho abazali ababili bezalana, inhlanganisela eyingqayizivele yama-allele iyahlangana ukuze ikhiqize izinhlobo zofuzo ezihlukile kanye nezinhlobo ze-phenotypes kumntwana ngamunye.

 Isici esizuzwa njengefa esisiza ukusinda nokuzala kwento ephilayo endaweni yayo yamanje sibizwa ngokuthi i-adaptation. Ososayensi bachaza amaqembu ezinto eziphilayo ezijwayela indawo yazo lapho kwenzeka ushintsho ebangeni lokuguquguquka kwezakhi zofuzo ngokuhamba kwesikhathi olukhulisa noma olugcina ukulingana "kwesibalo sabantu nendawo yabo. Izinyawo ze-platypuses ezinamaphiko ziyindlela yokubhukuda. Uboya obukhulu bezingwe zeqhwa buyindlela yokuphila emakhazeni. Ijubane elisheshayo lezingwe liyindlela yokudoba inyamazane.

 Lokhu kuguquguquka kungenzeka ngokuhlelwa kabusha kwama-genome aphelele noma kungabangelwa ukuguqulwa kwesakhi sofuzo esisodwa. Isibonelo, izinja zinama-chromosome angu-78 kanti amakati anama-chromosome angu-38. Inani elikhulu lezici ezihlukanisa izinja namakati lavela ekuhlelweni kabusha kwama-chromosome okwenzeke kusukela womabili amaqembu ehlukane nokhokho wawo wokugcina. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, amagundane athile amhlophe kanti amanye amagundane amnyama. Umehluko embala woboya uvela ngokuguqulwa kwesakhi sofuzo esisodwa. Ngakho-ke, ngenxa yokuguqulwa okukodwa, inani lamagundane lingajwayela kakhulu ukusinda ezindaweni ezineqhwa uma kuqhathaniswa nephansi elimnyama, lehlathi.

 Kungakhathaliseki noma cha Isici esihle sincike ezimweni zemvelo ngaleso sikhathi. Izici ezifanayo azikhethwa njalo ngoba izimo zemvelo zingashintsha. Isibonelo, cabanga ngohlobo lwesitshalo olukhule endaweni enomswakama futhi olungadingi ukonga amanzi. Amaqabunga amakhulu akhethwa ngoba avumela isitshalo ukuthi sithole amandla engeziwe elangeni. Amaqabunga amakhulu adinga amanzi amaningi ukuze alondoloze kunamaqabunga amancane, futhi indawo enomswakama yanikeza izimo ezinhle zokusekela amaqabunga amakhulu. Ngemva kwezinkulungwane zeminyaka, isimo sezulu sashintsha, futhi indawo yayingasenamanzi amaningi. Isiqondiso sokukhetha kwemvelo sashintsha kangangokuthi izitshalo ezinamahlamvu amancane zakhethwa ngoba lawo maqembu akwazi ukonga amanzi ukuze asinde ezimweni ezintsha zemvelo.

 Ukuvela kwezinhlobo kuye kwaholela ekuhlukeni okukhulu ngesimo kanye nomsebenzi. Ngezinye izikhathi, ukuvela kwemvelo kudala amaqembu ezinto eziphilayo ahluke kakhulu komunye nomunye. Lapho izinhlobo ezimbili ziguquka ngezindlela ezahlukene zisuka endaweni efanayo, kubizwa ngokuthi ukuvela kwemvelo okuhlukile. Ukuvela okunjalo okuhlukile kungabonakala ezinhlotsheni zezitho zokuzala zezitshalo eziqhakazayo ezihlanganyela ama-anatomies ayisisekelo afanayo; noma kunjalo, zingabukeka zihluke kakhulu ngenxa yokukhethwa ezindaweni ezahlukene zomzimba kanye nokuzivumelanisa nezinhlobo ezahlukene ze izinambuzane (Isithombe 18.5).

 Kwezinye izimo, izinhlobo ezifanayo ziyavela ngokuzimela ezinhlotsheni ezihlobene kude. Isibonelo, ukundiza kuye kwavela kokubili kumalulwane nasezinambuzaneni, futhi womabili anezakhiwo esizibiza ngamaphiko, okuyizinto ezivumelana nokundiza. Kodwa-ke, amaphiko amalulwane nezinambuzane avele ezakhiweni zokuqala ezihlukene kakhulu. Lesi simo sibizwa ngokuthi ukuguquka okuguquguqukayo, lapho izici ezifanayo ziguquka ngokuzimela ezinhlotsheni ezingabelani nokhokho ofanayo muva nje. Lezi zinhlobo ezimbili zafika emsebenzini ofanayo, zindiza, kodwa zenze kanjalo ngokwehlukana.

 Lezi zinguquko zomzimba zenzeka ngezikhathi ezinkulu futhi zisiza ukuchaza ukuthi ukuguquka kwenzeka kanjani. Ukukhetha kwemvelo kusebenza ezintweni eziphilayo ngazinye, okungabumba uhlobo lonke. Nakuba ukukhethwa kwemvelo kungasebenza esizukulwaneni esisodwa kumuntu ngamunye, kungathatha izinkulungwane noma ngisho nezigidi zeminyaka ukuthi uhlobo lwe-genotype lohlobo lonke luguquke. Kuphakathi kwalezi zikhathi ezinkulu lapho impilo emhlabeni ishintshile futhi iyaqhubeka nokushintsha.
question1: Kungani ukuhlukahluka kwezakhi zofuzo kuyadingeka ekukhetheni kwemvelo?
answer1: Umehluko wezakhi zofuzo ozuzwa njengefa kuphela ongadluliselwa enzalweni futhi ushintshe inani labantu ngezizukulwane
distractor1a: Ukukhetha kwemvelo kusebenza kuphela ezicini ezitholwe
distractor1b: Umehluko wemvelo wodwa ushintsha unomphela inzalo
distractor1c: Bonke abantu emphakathini kumele bafane ngokwezakhi zofuzo
question2: Yiziphi izinhlobo ezimbili eziyinhloko zokwehlukahluka kwezakhi zofuzo kubantu?
answer2: Ukuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo kanye nokuzala ngokocansi
question3: Yisiphi isitatimende esichaza kangcono imiphumela yokuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo?
answer3: Ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo kungaba wusizo, kube yingozi, noma kungabi nomthelela ekufanelekeni komzimba
distractor3c: Ukuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo akukaze kuthinte izici ezizuzwe njengefa
question4: Kuyini ukuzivumelanisa nezimo?
answer4: Isici esizuzwa njengefa esithuthukisa ukusinda nokuzala kwezinto eziphilayo endaweni yazo
distractor4a: Impendulo yesikhashana ekushintsheni kwemvelo ngesikhathi sokuphila kwezinto eziphilayo
distractor4b: Noma yisiphi isici somzimba kungakhathalekile ukuthi umsebenzi unjani
distractor4c: Uguquko oluhlala luzuzisa kuyo yonke indawo
question5: Kungani isici esizuzisayo endaweni ethile singaba yingozi kwenye indawo?
answer5: Ukukhetha kwemvelo kuncike ezimweni zemvelo zamanje
distractor5a: Izici ezizuzisayo zihlala ziba yingozi ngokuhamba kwesikhathi
question6: Kuyini ukuziphendukela kwemvelo okuhlukile?
answer6: Ukuvela kwezici ezihluke kakhulu ezinhlotsheni ezihlanganyela ukhokho ofanayo
distractor6b: Ukudluliswa kwezakhi zofuzo phakathi kwezinhlobo ezahlukene
distractor6c: Ukuvela kwezici ezifanayo kuzo zonke izizukulwane
question7: Kuyini ukuziphendukela kwemvelo okuguquguqukayo?
answer7: Ukuvela okuzimele kwezici ezifanayo ezinhlotsheni ezihlobene kude
distractor7a: Ukuvela kwezici ezahlukene ezivela kukhokho ofanayo
question8: Kungani amaphiko amalulwane nezinambuzane emelela ukuziphendukela kwemvelo okuguquguqukayo?
answer8: Benza umsebenzi ofanayo kodwa bavela ngokuzimela ezakhiweni ezahlukene zokhokho
distractor8c: Zavela ngoba amalulwane nezinambuzane kuhlobene kakhulu
question9: Ukuziphendukela kwemvelo kuvame ukushintsha ukwakheka kwezakhi zofuzo zohlobo lonke phakathi nesikhathi esingakanani?

chapterName: 4. Izinqubo Zokuziphendukela Kwemvelo | 18. Ukuziphendukela Kwemvelo Nomsuka Wezinhlobo | 18.1 Ukuqonda Ukuziphendukela Kwemvelo | Ubufakazi Bokuziphendukela Kwemvelo | Izinsalela Zasendulo
chapterNameEnglish: 4. Evolutionary Processes | 18. Evolution and Origin of Species | 18.1 Understanding Evolution | Evidence of Evolution | Fossils
chapterContent:
Ubufakazi bokuziphendukela kwemvelo buyakhanga futhi bubanzi. Uma sibheka wonke amazinga okuhlela ezinhlelweni eziphilayo, izazi zezinto eziphilayo zibona uphawu lokuziphendukela kwemvelo kwesikhathi esidlule nesamanje. UDarwin wanikela ingxenye enkulu yencwadi yakhe, ethi On the Origin of Species, ekuboneni amaphethini emvelo ahambisana nokuziphendukela kwemvelo, futhi kusukela kuDarwin, ukuqonda kwethu kuye kwacaca futhi kwaba banzi.

 Izinsalela
Izinsalela zinikeza ubufakazi obuqinile bokuthi izinto eziphilayo zesikhathi esidlule azifani nalezo ezitholakala namuhla, futhi izinsalela zikhombisa izinguquko zokuziphendukela kwemvelo kancane kancane ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Ososayensi banquma ubudala bezinsalela futhi bazihlukanise emhlabeni wonke ukuze banqume ukuthi izinto eziphilayo zaziphila nini ngokuqondene nomunye nomunye. Irekhodi lezinsalela elivelayo lilandisa indaba yesikhathi esidlule futhi likhombisa ukuvela kwesimo eminyakeni eyizigidi (Isithombe 18.6). Isibonelo, ososayensi bathole amarekhodi anemininingwane eminingi abonisa ukuvela kwabantu namahhashi
question1: Kungani izinsalela zibhekwa njengobufakazi obuqinile bokuziphendukela kwemvelo?
answer1: Zibhala izinguquko ezintweni eziphilayo ngokuhamba kwesikhathi futhi zibonisa ukuthi izinhlobo zesikhathi esidlule zihlukile kwezanamuhla
distractor1a: Zifakazela ukuthi zonke izinhlobo zavela ngesikhathi esisodwa
distractor1b: Zibonisa ukuthi izinto eziphilayo azikaze zishintshe kulo lonke umlando
distractor1c: Zibonisa ukuthi ukuziphendukela kwemvelo kwenzeka ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esisodwa sokuphila
question2: Yiluphi ulwazi olunikezwa yirekhodi lezinsalela?
answer2: Umlando wokuvela kokuphila eminyakeni eyizigidi
distractor2a: Irekhodi eliphelele lazo zonke izinto eziphilayo ezake zaphila
distractor2c: Ubufakazi bokuthi izinhlobo eziphelile zisekhona nanamuhla
question3: Ososayensi banquma kanjani ukulandelana kwezinguquko zokuziphendukela kwemvelo besebenzisa izinsalela?
answer3: Ngokunquma ubudala bezinsalela zasendulo nokuqhathanisa izinsalela zezikhathi ezahlukene
question4: Umlando wezinsalela wembulani ngezinto eziphilayo zesikhathi esidlule?
answer4: Kancane kancane bashintsha ngokuhamba kwesikhathi ngokuziphendukela kwemvelo
distractor4a: Zazifana nezinto eziphilayo zanamuhla
question5: Yimaphi amaqembu okukhulunywa ngawo njenganemibhalo yasendulo enemininingwane ekhethekile?
answer5: Abantu namahhashi
distractor5a: Ama-dinosaur nemikhomo
question6: Kungani uDarwin afaka ubufakazi obuvela emvelweni encwadini ethi On the Origin of Species?
answer6: Ukukhombisa amaphethini ahambisana nokuziphendukela kwemvelo
distractor6b: Ukufakazela ukuthi izinsalela zamathambo azihlobene nezinto eziphilayo
distractor6c: Ukukhombisa ukuthi ukuziphendukela kwemvelo kwenzeka ngaphandle kofuzo

chapterName: 4. Izinqubo Zokuziphendukela Kwemvelo | 18. Ukuziphendukela Kwemvelo Nomsuka Wezinhlobo | 18.1 Ukuqonda Ukuziphendukela Kwemvelo | Ubufakazi Bokuziphendukela Kwemvelo | I-Anatomy kanye ne-Embryology
chapterNameEnglish: 4. Evolutionary Processes | 18. Evolution and Origin of Species | 18.1 Understanding Evolution | Evidence of Evolution | Anatomy and Embryology
chapterContent:
Ubufakazi bokuziphendukela kwemvelo buyakhanga futhi bubanzi. Uma sibheka wonke amazinga okuhlela ezinhlelweni eziphilayo, izazi zezinto eziphilayo zibona uphawu lokuziphendukela kwemvelo kwesikhathi esidlule nesamanje. UDarwin wanikela ingxenye enkulu yencwadi yakhe, ethi On the Origin of Species, ekuboneni amaphethini emvelo ahambisana nokuziphendukela kwemvelo, futhi kusukela kuDarwin, ukuqonda kwethu kuye kwacaca futhi kwanda.

 Olunye uhlobo lobufakazi bokuziphendukela kwemvelo ukuba khona kwezakhiwo ezintweni eziphilayo ezabelana ngesimo esifanayo esiyisisekelo. Isibonelo, amathambo ezihlotsheni zomuntu, inja, inyoni, kanye nomkhomo wonke abelana ngokwakhiwa okufanayo (Isithombe 18.7) okuvela emvelaphi yawo ezihlotsheni zokhokho ovamile. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ukuziphendukela kwemvelo kwaholela ekushintsheni kwezimo nobukhulu bamathambo ezinhlotsheni ezahlukene, kodwa agcine ukwakheka okufanayo. Ososayensi babiza lezi zingxenye ezifanayo ngokuthi izakhiwo ezifanayo.
Ezinye izakhiwo zikhona ezintweni eziphilayo ezingenawo umsebenzi obonakalayo nhlobo, futhi zibonakala ziyizingxenye ezisele ezivela kukhokho ovamile odlule. Lezi zakhiwo ezingasetshenziswanga ezingenawo umsebenzi zibizwa ngokuthi izakhiwo ezingasebenzi. Izibonelo zezakhiwo ezingasebenzi zihlanganisa amaphiko ezinyonini ezingenakubaleka, amaqabunga kwezinye izinhlobo ze-cacti, namathambo emilenze yangemuva emikhomeni.
Olunye ubufakazi bokuziphendukela kwemvelo ukuhlangana kwesimo ezintweni eziphilayo ezihlanganyela izindawo ezifanayo. Isibonelo, izinhlobo zezilwane ezingahlobene, njengempungushe yase-arctic kanye ne-ptarmigan, ezihlala esifundeni sase-arctic zikhethiwe ukuze zihambisane nezinhlobo ezimhlophe zesizini ebusika ukuze zihlangane neqhwa neqhwa (Isithombe 18.8ab). Lokhu kufana akwenzeki ngenxa yozalo olufanayo, kodwa ngenxa yezingcindezi zokukhetha ezifanayo—izinzuzo zokungabonwa yizilwane ezidla ezinye.
I-Embryology, isifundo sokuthuthukiswa komzimba wento ephilayo esimweni sayo somuntu omdala, nayo inikeza ubufakazi bokuhlobana phakathi kwamaqembu ezinto eziphilayo ahlukene kakhulu manje. Ukuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo ku-embryo kungaba nemiphumela emikhulu kakhulu kumuntu omdala kangangokuthi ukwakheka kwe-embryo kuvame ukulondolozwa. Ngenxa yalokho, izakhiwo ezingekho kwamanye amaqembu zivame ukuvela ezimweni zazo zombungu futhi zinyamalale ngesikhathi kufinyelelwa isimo somuntu omdala noma somntwana. Isibonelo, zonke izibungu ezinezinhlungu, okuhlanganisa nabantu, zibonisa imifantu kanye nemisila ngesikhathi esithile ekukhuleni kwazo kokuqala. Lokhu kuyanyamalala kubantu abadala bamaqembu asemhlabeni kodwa kugcinwa ezinhlotsheni ezindala zamaqembu asemanzini njengezinhlanzi kanye nezinye izilwane eziphila emanzini. Izibungu ezinkulu ze-ape, okuhlanganisa nabantu, zinesakhiwo somsila ngesikhathi sokukhula kwazo esilahleka ngesikhathi sokuzalwa.
question1: Ziyini izakhiwo ezifanayo?
answer1: Izakhiwo ezabelana ngephethini efanayo eyisisekelo yokwakheka komzimba ngenxa yozalo olufanayo
distractor1a: Izakhiwo ezavela ngokuzimela ukuze zenze imisebenzi efanayo
distractor1c: Izakhiwo ezitholakala kuma-embryo kuphela
question2: Yisiphi isibonelo esibonisa kangcono izakhiwo ezifanayo?
answer2: Imilenze yangaphambili yabantu, izinja, izinyoni kanye nemikhomo
question3: Iyini isakhiwo esingenalutho?
answer3: Isakhiwo esinomsebenzi omncane noma esingenawo nhlobo okwamanje kodwa esizuzwe njengefa kukhokho ovamile
distractor3a: Isakhiwo esisha esithuthukisiwe esithuthukisa ukuqina komzimba
question4: Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okuyisibonelo sesakhiwo esingenalutho?
answer4: Amathambo omlenze wangemuva emikhomeni
distractor4a: Amaphiko ezinyoni ezindizayo
question5: Kungani izinhlobo ezingahlobene njengezimpungushe zase-arctic kanye nama-ptarmigan zombili zikhula zibe nombala omhlophe ebusika?
answer5: Izingcindezi ezifanayo zokukhetha indawo ezizungezile zaholela ekuguqukeni okuhlangene
distractor5a: Bazuze lesi sici kokhokho wabo bonke muva nje
distractor5c: Imvelo ishintsha ngqo i-DNA yayo njalo ebusika
question6: I-embryology ibunikeza kanjani ubufakazi bokuziphendukela kwemvelo?
answer6: Ama-embryo ezinto eziphilayo ezihlobene abelana ngezici zokukhula ezizuzwe kokhokho abafanayo
distractor6a: Ama-embryo azo zonke izinhlobo akhula ngendlela efanayo
distractor6b: Ukuthuthukiswa kwe-embryonic kuvimbela ushintsho lokuziphendukela kwemvelo
distractor6c: I-Embryology ikhombisa ukuthi ukuziphendukela kwemvelo kwenzeka ngaphambi kokuzalwa kuphela
question7: Yiziphi izici zombungu ezitholakala kuzo zonke izimbungu ezinezinhlungu?
answer7: Izimbobo kanye nemisila ye-gill
question8: Kungani izinguquko zokukhula ngesikhathi sezigaba zombungu zivame ukulondolozwa ngokuziphendukela kwemvelo?
answer8: Izinguquko ezincane kuma-embryo zingaba nemiphumela emikhulu emzimbeni omdala

chapterName: 4. Izinqubo Zokuziphendukela Kwemvelo | 18. Ukuziphendukela Kwemvelo Nomsuka Wezinhlobo | 18.1 Ukuqonda Ukuziphendukela Kwemvelo | Ubufakazi Bokuziphendukela Kwemvelo | I-Biogeography
chapterNameEnglish: 4. Evolutionary Processes | 18. Evolution and Origin of Species | 18.1 Understanding Evolution | Evidence of Evolution | Biogeography
chapterContent:
Ubufakazi bokuziphendukela kwemvelo buyakhanga futhi bubanzi. Uma sibheka wonke amazinga okuhlela ezinhlelweni zokuphila, izazi zezinto eziphilayo zibona uphawu lokuziphendukela kwemvelo kwesikhathi esidlule nesamanje. UDarwin wanikela ingxenye enkulu yencwadi yakhe, ethi On the Origin of Species, ekuboneni amaphethini emvelo ahambisana nokuziphendukela kwemvelo, futhi kusukela kuDarwin, ukuqonda kwethu kuye kwacaca futhi kwanda.

 I-Biogeography
Ukusatshalaliswa kwezindawo zezinto eziphilayo emhlabeni kulandela amaphethini achazwa kangcono ngokuziphendukela kwemvelo kanye nokuhamba kwamapuleti e-tectonic ngokuhamba kwesikhathi se-geological. Amaqembu abanzi aguquke ngaphambi kokuhlukana kwe-supercontinent Pangea (cishe eminyakeni eyizigidi ezingu-200 edlule) asatshalaliswa emhlabeni wonke. Amaqembu aguquke kusukela ekuhlukaneni avela ngokuhlukile ezindaweni zeplanethi, njengezitshalo nezilwane ezihlukile zamazwekazi asenyakatho ezakheka kusukela e-supercontinent Laurasia kanye namazwekazi aseningizimu akhiwe kusukela e-supercontinent Gondwana. Ukuba khona kwamalungu omndeni wezitshalo i-Proteaceae e-Australia, eningizimu ye-Afrika, naseNingizimu Melika, isibonelo, kuchazwa kangcono ngokuba khona kwawo ngaphambi kokuba i-supercontinent yaseningizimu iGondwana ihlukane.

 Ukuhlukahluka okukhulu kwezilwane ezincelisayo e-Australia kanye nokungabikho kwezinye izilwane ezincelisayo kubonisa ukuhlukaniswa isikhathi eside kwe-Australia. I-Australia inezinhlobo eziningi ezitholakala kalula—izinhlobo ezingatholakali kwenye indawo—okuyinto evamile eziqhingini lapho ukuhlukaniswa kwazo ngamanzi amaningi kuvimbela izinhlobo ukuba zifuduke. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, lezi zinhlobo ziyahlukahluka ngokuziphendukela kwemvelo zibe izinhlobo ezintsha ezibukeka zihluke kakhulu kokhokho bazo ezingase zibe khona ezwenikazi. Izilwane ezincelisayo zase-Australia, izinyoni ezihlala eGalápagos, kanye nezinhlobo eziningi eziQhingini zaseHawaii zonke zihlukile endaweni yazo eyodwa, kodwa zibonisa ubudlelwano obude nezinhlobo zokhokho ezihlala ezwenikazi.
question1: Yini efundwa yi-biogeography?
answer1: Ukusatshalaliswa kwezindawo zezinto eziphilayo kanye nendlela okuhlobene ngayo nokuziphendukela kwemvelo
distractor1a: Ukwakheka kwamakhemikhali kwezinto eziphilayo
distractor1c: Ukuziphatha kwezinto eziphilayo ezindaweni zelebhu
question2: Kungani amaqembu amaningi amakhulu ezinto eziphilayo esakazeke emhlabeni wonke?
answer2: Zavela ngaphambi kokuhlukana kwezwekazi elikhulu iPangaea
question3: Ukusabalala komndeni wezitshalo zeProteaceae kusekela kanjani ukuvela kwemvelo?
answer3: Ukuba khona kwayo emazwenikazi aseningizimu kuchazwa ukuziphendukela kwemvelo ngaphambi kokuba iGondwana ihlukane
distractor3a: Yavela ngokuzimela kuwo wonke amazwekazi ngesikhathi esifanayo
distractor3b: Imbewu yayo ingawela kalula lonke ulwandle
distractor3c: Kwaqala kuphela ngemva kokuba uGondwana ehlukene
question4: Kungani i-Australia inezinhlobo eziningi kangaka zezilwane ezitholakala endaweni eyodwa?
answer4: Ukuhlukaniswa kwayo isikhathi eside ngokwezindawo kunciphisa ukufuduka futhi kwakhuthaza ukuziphendukela kwemvelo okuzimele
distractor4a: I-Australia ayikaze ibhekane nokukhethwa kwemvelo
distractor4b: Izinhlobo zezilwane zisanda kwethulwa zivela kuwo wonke amazwekazi
distractor4c: I-Australia inezindawo ezifanayo nazo zonke ezinye amazwekazi
question5: Luyini uhlobo olutholakala kalula?
answer5: Uhlobo olutholakala ngokwemvelo endaweni eyodwa kuphela
distractor5a: Uhlobo olutholakala kuwo wonke amazwekazi
question6: Kungani ama-marsupial ase-Australia ehlukahlukene kangaka uma eqhathaniswa nezinye izilwane ezincelisayo?
answer6: Ukuzihlukanisa isikhathi eside e-Australia kwenze ama-marsupial ahlukahluka ngokuncintisana okuncane nezinye izilwane ezincelisayo
distractor6a: Ama-Marsupial avele kuphela ngemva kokufika kwabantu
distractor6b: Ama-Marsupial ajwayeleke kangcono kuzo zonke izindawo ezisemhlabeni
distractor6c: Ezinye izilwane ezincelisayo azikaze zivele kwenye indawo
question7: Yiziphi izinto eziphilayo zaseziqhingini ezibalwe njengezibonelo zokuhlukahluka kokuziphendukela kwemvelo kokhokho basezwenikazi?
answer7: Izinyoni zaseGalápagos kanye nezinhlobo eziningi eziQhingini zaseHawaii

chapterName: 4. Izinqubo Zokuziphendukela Kwemvelo | 18. Ukuziphendukela Kwemvelo Nomsuka Wezinhlobo | 18.1 Ukuqonda Ukuziphendukela Kwemvelo | Ubufakazi Bokuziphendukela Kwemvelo | I-Molecular Biology | Ukubuka Okuqondile, Ukuguqulwa Kwe-homeostasis
chapterNameEnglish: 4. Evolutionary Processes | 18. Evolution and Origin of Species | 18.1 Understanding Evolution | Evidence of Evolution | Molecular Biology | Direct Observations, Adaptations for homeostasis
chapterContent:
Ubufakazi bokuziphendukela kwemvelo buyathandeka futhi bubanzi. Uma sibheka wonke amazinga okuhlela ezinhlelweni eziphilayo, izazi zezinto eziphilayo zibona uphawu lokuziphendukela kwemvelo kwesikhathi esidlule nesamanje. UDarwin wanikela ingxenye enkulu yencwadi yakhe, ethi On the Origin of Species, ekuboneni amaphethini emvelo ayehambisana nokuziphendukela kwemvelo, futhi kusukela kuDarwin, ukuqonda kwethu kuye kwacaca futhi kwanda.

 Njengezakhiwo zomzimba, izakhiwo zama-molecule okuphila zibonisa ukwehla ngokuguqulwa. Ubufakazi bokhokho ofanayo wabo bonke ukuphila bubonakala ekwandeni kwe-DNA njengezinto zofuzo kanye nasekwandeni okuseduze kwekhodi yofuzo kanye nomshini wokuphindaphindwa nokubonakaliswa kwe-DNA. Ukuhlukana okuyisisekelo empilweni phakathi kwalezi zindawo ezintathu kubonakala ekwahlukeni okukhulu kwesakhiwo ezakhiweni ezilondolozayo njengezingxenye ze-ribosomes kanye nezakhiwo ze-membranes. Ngokuvamile, ukuhlobana kwamaqembu ezinto eziphilayo kubonakala ekufaneni kokulandelana kwazo kwe-DNA—iphethini elilindeleke ekuzalweni nasekuhlukahlukeni okuvela kukhokho ofanayo.

 Ukulandelana kwe-DNA nakho kukhanyise ezinye zezindlela zokuziphendukela kwemvelo. Isibonelo, kusobala ukuthi ukuvela kwemisebenzi emisha yamaprotheni kuvame ukwenzeka ngemva kwezehlakalo zokuphindaphindwa kwezakhi zofuzo ezivumela ukuguqulwa kwamahhala kwekhophi eyodwa ngokuguqulwa, ukukhethwa, noma ukuzulazula (izinguquko echibini lezakhi zofuzo labantu ezibangelwa yingozi), kuyilapho ikhophi yesibili iqhubeka nokukhiqiza iphrotheni esebenzayo.

 Ukuqaphelwa Okuqondile
Ososayensi nabo babone ukuvela kwenzeka kokubili elabhorethri nasendle. Isibonelo esivamile salokhu ukusabalala kwezakhi zofuzo ezingamelana namagciwane kubantu abaningi bamagciwane. Lapho amabhaktheriya evezwa kuma-antibiotic, ama-allele asiza umzimba ukuba usinde ayanda ngokuvama Umfanekiso 18.9. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi abantu abangakwazi ukumelana namagciwane bayafa, okushiya abantu abanezakhi zofuzo ezingamelana nokumelana kuphela.

 Ukuzivumelanisa ne-homeostasis
Esinye isizathu esikhulu sokuthi izinto eziphilayo zivumelane nomzimba ukugcina i-homeostasis, esinye sezici eziyinhloko zokuphila. Zonke izinto eziphilayo cishe zivela kukhokho oyedwa, yingakho izinto eziningi kangaka zabelana ngezici ze-anatomical, morphological, kanye nama-molecule. Kodwa-ke, into ngayinye ephilayo iye yashintsha lezi zici ezifanayo ukuze zivumelane nendawo yayo futhi izivumelanise nezinguquko zemvelo ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Isibonelo, zonke izinto eziphilayo zisebenzisa i-DNA polymerase ukuphinda ama-genome azo. Kodwa-ke, kuyilapho izinto eziphilayo ezine-genome encane zingasinda nge-molecule eyodwa ye-polymerase esebenza endaweni eyodwa ku-genome ngesikhathi, izinto eziphilayo ezine-genome ezinkulu ziphinda amaphuzu amaningi e-genome ngesikhathi esisodwa. Ezinye izinto eziphilayo ezihlala ezindaweni ezishisa kakhulu, njengezindawo zokushisa ezijulile zolwandle, zinama-molecule akhethekile e-polymerase angamelana nokushisa okungawaqeda ngokushesha ama-polymerase ezilwaneni ezisemhlabeni. Nakuba isisekelo sale molecule ngayinye ehlukene ye-DNA polymerase sifana, ngayinye iye yashintshaniswa ukuze isebenze endaweni yemvelo yento ephilayo.
question1: Ibhayoloji yama-molecule ibunikeza kanjani ubufakazi bokuziphendukela kwemvelo?
answer1: Izinto eziphilayo ezihlobene eduze zinezigcawu ze-DNA ezifanayo kakhulu ngoba zihlanganyela ukhokho ofanayo
distractor1a: Zonke izinto eziphilayo zinekhodi yezakhi zofuzo ehluke ngokuphelele
distractor1b: Ukulandelana kwe-DNA akuhlobene nomlando wokuziphendukela kwemvelo
distractor1c: Izinsalela zasendulo kuphela ezinikeza ubufakazi bokuziphendukela kwemvelo
question2: Yisiphi isici sokuphila esinikeza ubufakazi bokuthi zonke izinto eziphilayo zinokhokho ofanayo?
answer2: Ukufana okuseduze kwe-DNA njengezinto zofuzo kanye nekhodi yofuzo
distractor2a: Zonke izinto eziphilayo zinezakhiwo zomzimba ezifanayo
distractor2b: Zonke izinto eziphilayo zizalana ngendlela efanayo
distractor2c: Zonke izinto eziphilayo zinenani elifanayo lama-chromosome
question3: Ukuphindaphindwa kwezakhi zofuzo kungaba nomthelela kanjani ekuziphendukeleni kwemvelo?
answer3: Ikhophi eyodwa yezakhi zofuzo ingaqoqa izinguquko futhi ithuthukise imisebenzi emisha kanti enye igcina umsebenzi wayo wokuqala
distractor3a: Womabili amakhophi ezakhi zofuzo ahlala engasebenzi
distractor3b: Ukuphindaphindwa kwezakhi zofuzo kudala uhlobo olusha ngokushesha
distractor3c: Ukuphindaphindwa kwezakhi zofuzo kuvimbela ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo ukuthi kungenzeki
question4: Kungani ukumelana nama-antibiotic kusakazeka ngokushesha emiphakathini yamagciwane?
answer4: Amabhaktheriya ane-alleles yokumelana ayasinda ekwelashweni ngama-antibiotic futhi akhiqize inzalo eyengeziwe
distractor4a: Ama-antibiotic abangela ukuthi wonke amabhaktheriya akhule ukumelana nawo
distractor4c: Ama-antibiotic andisa amazinga okuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo ngokulinganayo kuwo wonke amabhaktheriya
question5: Kuyini ukukhukhuleka kwezakhi zofuzo?
answer5: Izinguquko echibini lezakhi zofuzo zabantu ezibangelwa yingozi
distractor5a: Ukunyakaza ngamabomu kwezinto eziphilayo ziye ezindaweni ezintsha zokuhlala
question6: Kungani izinto eziphilayo zishintsha ukuzivumelanisa nezimo okusiza ekugcineni i-homeostasis?
answer6: Ukuze basebenze kahle futhi baphile ngaphansi kwezimo zabo ezithile zemvelo
distractor6c: Ukuvimbela ushintsho lokuziphendukela kwemvelo
question7: Kungani izinto eziphilayo ezihlala ezindaweni ezishisa kakhulu zine-DNA polymerases ekhethekile?
answer7: Ama-polymerase awo aguqulwa ukuze asebenze emazingeni okushisa angalimaza amanye ama-enzyme.
distractor7b: Ukushisa kwandisa unomphela isivinini sokuphindaphinda kwe-DNA kuzo zonke izinto eziphilayo
question8: Kungani izinto eziphilayo ezinezakhi zofuzo ezinkulu ngokuvamile zidinga ama-polymerase amaningi e-DNA asebenza ngesikhathi esisodwa?
answer8: Ukuphindaphinda izindawo eziningi ngesikhathi esisodwa kuvumela lonke i-genome ukuthi likopishwe kahle
distractor8c: Ama-genome amancane kuphela adinga ukuphindaphindwa kwe-DNA

chapterName: 4. Izinqubo Zokuziphendukela Kwemvelo | 18. Ukuziphendukela Kwemvelo Nomsuka Wezinhlobo | 18.1 Ukuqonda Ukuziphendukela Kwemvelo | Imibono Engafanele Ngokuziphendukela Kwemvelo | Ukuziphendukela Kwemvelo Kuyinkolelo-mbono Nje
chapterNameEnglish: 4. Evolutionary Processes | 18. Evolution and Origin of Species | 18.1 Understanding Evolution | Misconceptions of Evolution | Evolution Is Just a Theory
chapterContent:
Nakuba inkolelo-mbono yokuziphendukela kwemvelo yabangela impikiswano ethile lapho iphakanyiswa okokuqala, yamukelwa cishe yibo bonke ososayensi bezinto eziphilayo, ikakhulukazi ososayensi bezinto eziphilayo abasebasha, eminyakeni engama-20 ngemva kokushicilelwa kwencwadi ethi On the Origin of Species. Noma kunjalo, inkolelo-mbono yokuziphendukela kwemvelo ingumqondo onzima futhi imibono eyiphutha mayelana nendlela esebenza ngayo iyanda.

 Ukuziphendukela Kwemvelo Kuyinkolelo-mbono Nje
Abagxeki benkolelo-mbono yokuziphendukela kwemvelo bayayilahla ukubaluleka kwayo ngokudidanisa ngamabomu ukusetshenziswa kwansuku zonke kwegama elithi ithiyori "nendlela ososayensi abasebenzisa ngayo leli gama. Esayensini, ithiyori"iqondwa njengomzimba wezincazelo ezivivinywe kahle neziqinisekisiwe zesethi yokubuka komhlaba wemvelo. Ososayensi banombono we-athomu, inkolelo-mbono yamandla adonsela phansi, kanye nenkolelo-mbono yokuhlobana, ngayinye echaza amaqiniso aqondakalayo ngomhlaba. Ngendlela efanayo, inkolelo-mbono yokuziphendukela kwemvelo ichaza amaqiniso ngomhlaba ophilayo. Ngakho-ke, inkolelo-mbono kwisayensi isindile emizamweni emikhulu yokuyilahla ngososayensi. Ngokuphambene nalokho, inkolelo-mbono "ngolimi oluvamile igama elisho ukuqagela noma incazelo ephakanyisiwe; le ncazelo ifana kakhulu nomqondo wesayensi we-hypothesis."Lapho abagxeki bokuziphendukela kwemvelo bethi ukuziphendukela kwemvelo kumane kuyinkolelo-mbono,” basho ukuthi kunobufakazi obuncane obusekela lokhu nokuthi kusasenqubo yokuhlolwa kanzima. Lokhu kuwukuhlanekezelwa kwencazelo.
question1: Lisho ukuthini igama elithi theory kwisayensi?
answer1: Incazelo evivinywe kahle futhi esekelwa kahle yeqoqo elibanzi lokubona
distractor1a: Umbono womuntu siqu ongakahlolwa
distractor1c: Iqiniso elingenakuphikiswa
question2: Kungani inkulumo ethi ukuziphendukela kwemvelo kumane kuyimfundiso ekhohlisayo?
answer2: Ngoba inkolelo-mbono yesayensi isekelwa ubufakazi obuningi kanye nokuhlolwa okuqinile
distractor2a: Ngoba ukuziphendukela kwemvelo akukaze kuhlolwe ngokwesayensi
distractor2b: Ngoba imibono ihlala ingathembeki kakhulu kunemibono
question3: Yiliphi igama lesayensi elifana kakhulu nencazelo yansuku zonke yegama elithi theory?
answer3: I-hypothesis
question4: Yisiphi isibonelo salokhu okulandelayo esingesinye sezibonelo zenkolelo-mbono yesayensi?
answer4: Umbono wokuhlobana kwezinto
distractor4a: Ithebula lezikhathi
question5: Yini okufanele inkolelo-mbono yesayensi imelane nayo ngaphambi kokuba yamukelwe kabanzi?
answer5: Ukuhlolwa okubanzi kanye nemizamo ephindaphindwayo yokukuphikisa
distractor5a: Ukuvunyelwa yivoti leningi lososayensi
question6: Izazi eziningi zezinto eziphilayo zabheka kanjani inkolelo-mbono yokuziphendukela kwemvelo eminyakeni engaba ngu-20 ngemva kokunyatheliswa kwencwadi ethi On the Origin of Species?
answer6: Kwakwamukelwa cishe kuwo wonke umuntu, ikakhulukazi ososayensi bezinto eziphilayo abasebasha
distractor6a: Kwalahlwa cishe yibo bonke ososayensi bezinto eziphilayo
distractor6c: Kwahlala kungaziwa nhlobo emphakathini wesayensi
question7: Ichaza ukuthini imfundiso yokuziphendukela kwemvelo?
answer7: Amaqiniso aqashelwe kanye namaphethini mayelana nomhlaba ophilayo

Nakuba inkolelo-mbono yokuziphendukela kwemvelo yabangela impikiswano ethile lapho iphakanyiswa okokuqala, yamukelwa cishe yibo bonke ososayensi bezinto eziphilayo, ikakhulukazi ososayensi bezinto eziphilayo abasebasha, eminyakeni engama-20 ngemuva kokushicilelwa kwe-On the Origin of Species. Noma kunjalo, inkolelo-mbono yokuziphendukela kwemvelo ingumqondo onzima futhi imibono eyiphutha mayelana nendlela esebenza ngayo iyanda.

 Abantu Bashintsha
Ukuziphendukela kwemvelo ushintsho ekwakhiweni kwezakhi zofuzo zabantu ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ikakhulukazi ezizukulwaneni ngezizukulwane, okubangelwa ukuzala okuhlukile kwabantu abane-alleles ethile. Abantu bayashintsha phakathi nesikhathi sabo sokuphila, ngokusobala, kodwa lokhu kubizwa ngokuthi intuthuko futhi kuhilela izinguquko ezihlelwe yiqoqo lezakhi zofuzo umuntu azitholile ekuzalweni ngokubambisana nendawo yomuntu. Uma ucabanga ngokuvela kwesici, mhlawumbe kungcono ukucabanga ngoshintsho lwenani elimaphakathi lesici kubantu ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Isibonelo, lapho ukukhetha kwemvelo kuholela ekushintsheni kosayizi wezinhlamvu kuma-finch aphakathi nendawo eGalápagos, lokhu akusho ukuthi izinhlamvu zomuntu ngamunye kuma-finch ziyashintsha. Uma umuntu elinganisa usayizi webhili ojwayelekile phakathi kwabo bonke abantu emphakathini ngesikhathi esisodwa bese elinganisa usayizi webhili ojwayelekile kubantu eminyakeni eminingana kamuva, leli nani elijwayelekile lizohluka ngenxa yokuziphendukela kwemvelo. Nakuba abanye abantu bangase basinde kusukela okokuqala kuya kwesesibili, bazobe besenosayizi webhili ofanayo; noma kunjalo, kuzoba nabantu abaningi abasha abafaka isandla ekushintsheni kosayizi webhili ojwayelekile.
question1: Yini eguqukayo ngokuhamba kwesikhathi ngokwemfundiso yokuziphendukela kwemvelo?
answer1: Ukwakheka kwezakhi zofuzo zabantu ezizukulwaneni ngezizukulwane
distractor1a: I-DNA yezinto eziphilayo ngazinye ngesikhathi sokuphila kwazo
distractor1c: Amalungu amadala kakhulu kuphela emphakathini
question2: Kungani abantu bengaguquki ngesikhathi sokuphila kwabo?
answer2: Izinguquko ngaphakathi komuntu ziyingxenye yentuthuko, hhayi ushintsho lokuziphendukela kwemvelo
distractor2a: Abantu abakwazi ukubhekana nanoma yiziphi izinguquko zebhayoloji
distractor2b: Ukukhetha kwemvelo kushintsha izakhi zofuzo zomuntu ngamunye ngokuqondile
question3: Kuyini intuthuko?
answer3: Izinguquko kumuntu ngesikhathi sokuphila kwakhe ziqondiswa izakhi zofuzo kanye nendawo akuyo
distractor3c: Ukudluliswa kwezakhi zofuzo phakathi kwezinto eziphilayo ezingahlobene
question4: Kungalinganiswa kanjani ukuvela kwesici esithile kubantu?
answer4: Ngokulandela izinguquko enanini elimaphakathi lesici kuzo zonke izizukulwane
distractor4a: Ngokubona izici zomuntu oyedwa kukho konke ukuphila kwakhe
question5: Kwenzekani ngobukhulu obujwayelekile bezinyoni zaseGalápagos ezisemaphakathi nezwe ngenxa yokuziphendukela kwemvelo?
answer5: Usayizi webhili ojwayelekile ushintshile ngoba abantu abanosayizi abathile bebhili bakhiqize kabusha ngempumelelo enkulu
distractor5a: I-finch ngayinye ishintshe usayizi womlomo wayo ngesikhathi sokuphila kwayo
distractor5b: Zonke izintaka zakha usayizi ofanayo wezinzipho
distractor5c: Usayizi webhili ushintshile kuphela ngenxa yokudla okunempilo okuthuthukisiwe
question6: Kungani inani elimaphakathi lesici lingashintsha yize abantu abasindile bengashintshi?
answer6: Izizukulwane ezintsha ezinezimpawu ezahlukene ezizuzwe njengefa zishintsha isilinganiso sabantu
distractor6a: Abantu abasindayo bashintsha kancane kancane izakhi zabo zofuzo
distractor6b: Izimo zemvelo zishintsha ngqo i-DNA ezuzwe njengefa kubantu abadala
distractor6c: Ukukhetha kwemvelo kususa bonke abantu asebekhulile ngokushesha
question7: Yisiphi isisho esichaza kangcono ukuziphendukela kwemvelo?
answer7: Ukuziphendukela kwemvelo ukushintsha kwabantu ezizukulwaneni ngezizukulwane kunokuba kube izinguquko ngaphakathi kwezinto eziphilayo ngazinye
distractor7a: Ukuziphendukela kwemvelo kwenzeka noma nini lapho umuntu ekhula
distractor7c: Ukuziphendukela kwemvelo kushintsha wonke umuntu ngokulinganayo

chapterName: 4. Izinqubo Zokuziphendukela Kwemvelo | 18. Ukuziphendukela Kwemvelo Nomsuka Wezinhlobo | 18.1 Ukuqonda Ukuziphendukela Kwemvelo | Imibono Engafanele Ngokuziphendukela Kwemvelo | Ukuziphendukela Kwemvelo Kuchaza Umsuka Wokuphila
chapterNameEnglish: 4. Evolutionary Processes | 18. Evolution and Origin of Species | 18.1 Understanding Evolution | Misconceptions of Evolution | Evolution Explains the Origin of Life
chapterContent:
Nakuba inkolelo-mbono yokuziphendukela kwemvelo yabangela impikiswano ethile lapho iphakanyiswa okokuqala, yamukelwa cishe yizazi zezinto eziphilayo, ikakhulukazi izazi zezinto eziphilayo ezisencane, zingakapheli iminyaka engama-20 ngemva kokushicilelwa kwencwadi ethi On the Origin of Species. Noma kunjalo, inkolelo-mbono yokuziphendukela kwemvelo ingumqondo onzima futhi imibono eyiphutha mayelana nendlela esebenza ngayo iyanda.

 Ukuziphendukela Kwemvelo Kuchaza Imvelaphi Yokuphila
Kuyiphutha elivamile ukuthi ukuziphendukela kwemvelo kuhlanganisa incazelo yemvelaphi yokuphila. Abanye babagxeki bale nkolelo-mbono bakholelwa ukuthi ayikwazi ukuchaza imvelaphi yokuphila. Le nkolelo-mbono ayizami ukuchaza imvelaphi yokuphila. Inkolelo-mbono yokuziphendukela kwemvelo ichaza ukuthi abantu bashintsha kanjani ngokuhamba kwesikhathi nokuthi impilo ihlukanisa kanjani imvelaphi yezinhlobo. Ayikhanyisi ekuqaleni kokuphila okuhlanganisa imvelaphi yamaseli okuqala, okuyindlela yokuphila echazwa ngayo. Izindlela zokuvela kokuphila eMhlabeni ziyinkinga enzima kakhulu ngoba zenzeka kudala kakhulu, futhi kungenzeka ukuthi zenzeka kanye nje. Okubalulekile, izazi zezinto eziphilayo zikholelwa ukuthi ukuba khona kokuphila eMhlabeni kuvimbela ukuthi izehlakalo ezaholela ekuphileni eMhlabeni zingaphindwa ngoba izigaba eziphakathi zaziyoba ukudla kwezinto eziphilayo ezikhona ngokushesha.

 Kodwa-ke, uma indlela yokuzuza ilifa isivele isendaweni ngesimo se-molecule efana ne-DNA noma ngaphakathi kweseli noma iseli langaphambi kweseli, lezi zidalwa zazizolandela isimiso sokukhetha kwemvelo. Izidalwa ezikhiqizayo eziphumelela kakhulu zinganda ngokuvama kwazo ngezindleko zezidalwa ezikhiqizayo ezingasebenzi kahle. Ngakho-ke nakuba ukuziphendukela kwemvelo kungachazi imvelaphi yokuphila, kungase kube nokuthile okushoyo ngezinye zezinqubo ezisebenza lapho izidalwa zangaphambi kokuphila zithola izakhiwo ezithile.
question1: Ingabe inkolelo-mbono yokuziphendukela kwemvelo iyachaza ukuthi ukuphila kwaqala kanjani eMhlabeni?
answer1: Cha, kuchaza ukuthi inani labantu lishintsha kanjani ngokuhamba kwesikhathi nokuthi izinhlobo zezilwane ziyahlukahluka kanjani ngemva kokuba impilo isivele ikhona
distractor1a: Yebo, ichaza ngokugcwele indlela iseli lokuqala eliphilayo elakheka ngayo
distractor1c: Cha, ngoba ukuziphendukela kwemvelo kusebenza kuphela ezintweni eziphilayo eziphelile
question2: Ichazani ngokuyinhloko imfundiso yokuziphendukela kwemvelo?
answer2: Indlela inani labantu elishintsha ngayo izizukulwane ngezizukulwane nokuthi izinhlobo ezintsha zivela kanjani
distractor2c: Indlela izinto eziphilayo ezithuthukisa ngayo ngamabomu izici eziwusizo
question3: Kungani imvelaphi yokuphila ibhekwa njengenzima ukuyihlola?
answer3: Kwenzeka eminyakeni eyizigidigidi edlule futhi cishe kwenzeka kanye kuphela
distractor3b: Ososayensi sebevele bakudala kabusha izikhathi eziningi
question4: Kungani izazi zezinto eziphilayo zicabanga ukuthi izenzakalo eziholela ekusungulweni kokuphila cishe ngeke zenzeke namuhla?
answer4: Izinhlobo eziphakathi cishe zingadliwa yizinto eziphilayo ezikhona
distractor4a: Umhlaba Wanamuhla awunawo amanzi
question5: Ukukhetha kwemvelo kungaqala nini ukusebenza ngokwesigaba?
answer5: Lapho izinhlangano eziziphindaphindayo ezinendlela yokuzuza ifa sezikhona
distractor5a: Ngaphambi kokuba kube khona noma yimaphi ama-molecule akwazi ukuzuza ifa
distractor5b: Kuphela ngemva kokuba izinto eziphilayo ezinamaseli amaningi zavela
question6: Kuzokwenzekani kubakhiqizi abaphumelelayo uma sekukhona ifa?
answer6: Zizovame kakhulu kubantu ngokuhamba kwesikhathi
distractor6c: Babezolahlekelwa izici zabo abazizuze njengefa
question7: Yisiphi isisho esifingqa kangcono ubudlelwano phakathi kokuziphendukela kwemvelo kanye nemvelaphi yokuphila?
answer7: Ukuziphendukela kwemvelo akuchazi ukuthi impilo yaqala kanjani, kodwa kuchaza ukuthi abantu abaphilayo bashintsha kanjani ngemva kokuba khona kwefa
distractor7a: Ukuziphendukela kwemvelo kanye nemvelaphi yokuphila kungumqondo ofanayo ncamashi
distractor7b: Ukuziphendukela kwemvelo kuchaza kuphela imvelaphi yeseli lokuqala
distractor7c: Ukuziphendukela kwemvelo akukwazi ukuchaza noma yiziphi izinguquko eziphilayo

chapterName: 4. Izinqubo Zokuziphendukela Kwemvelo | 18. Ukuziphendukela Kwemvelo Nomsuka Wezinhlobo Zezinto | 18.1 Ukuqonda Ukuziphendukela Kwemvelo | Imibono Engafanele Ngokuziphendukela Kwemvelo | Izinto Eziphilayo Ziziphendukela Ngenhloso
chapterNameEnglish: 4. Evolutionary Processes | 18. Evolution and Origin of Species | 18.1 Understanding Evolution | Misconceptions of Evolution | Organisms Evolve on Purpose
chapterContent:
Nakuba inkolelo-mbono yokuziphendukela kwemvelo idale impikiswano ethile lapho iphakanyiswa okokuqala, yamukelwa cishe yibo bonke ososayensi bezinto eziphilayo, ikakhulukazi ososayensi bezinto eziphilayo abasebasha, eminyakeni engama-20 ngemuva kokushicilelwa kwe-On the Origin of Species. Noma kunjalo, inkolelo-mbono yokuziphendukela kwemvelo ingumqondo onzima futhi imibono eyiphutha mayelana nendlela esebenza ngayo iyanda.

 Izinto eziphilayo Ziguquka Ngenhloso
Izitatimende ezifana nezinto eziphilayo ziyaguquka ngenxa yoshintsho endaweni ethile” zivamile kakhulu, kodwa izitatimende ezinjalo zingaholela ezinhlotsheni ezimbili zokungaqondani. Okokuqala, lesi sitatimende akumelwe siqondwe njengesisho ukuthi izinto eziphilayo ngazinye ziyaguquka. Lesi sitatimende sifushane ngokuthi inani labantu liyaguquka ngenxa yokushintsha kwendawo.” Kodwa-ke, ukungaqondi kwesibili kungavela ngokuhumusha lesi sitatimende njengokusho ukuthi ukuziphendukela kwemvelo ngandlela thile kuyinhloso. Indawo eshintshile ibangela ukuthi abanye abantu emphakathini, labo abanezinhlobo ezithile ze-phenotype, bazuze futhi ngaleyo ndlela bakhiqize inzalo eningi ngokulinganayo kunezinye izinhlobo ze-phenotype. Lokhu kuphumela ekushintsheni kwabantu uma izici zinqunywa ngokwezakhi zofuzo.

 Kubalulekile futhi ukuqonda ukuthi ukwehluka okusebenza kukho ukukhethwa kwemvelo sekuvele kunabantu abaningi futhi akuveli ngenxa yoshintsho lwemvelo. Isibonelo, ukusebenzisa ama-antibiotic eqenjini lamabhaktheriya, ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kuzokhetha inani lamabhaktheriya amelana nama-antibiotic. Ukumelana, okubangelwa yi-gene, akuzange kuvele ngokuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo ngenxa yokusetshenziswa kwe-antibiotic. I-gene yokumelana yayisivele ikhona echibini lezakhi zofuzo lamabhaktheriya, cishe ngesivinini esiphansi. I-antibiotic, ebulala amangqamuzana ebhaktheriya ngaphandle kwe-gene yokumelana, ikhetha kakhulu abantu abamelana nayo, njengoba laba kuphela abasinda futhi bahlukana. Ukuhlolwa kubonise ukuthi ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo ukumelana nama-antibiotic akuveli ngenxa yokusetshenziswa kwe-antibiotic.

 Ngomqondo omkhulu, ukuziphendukela kwemvelo akuqondiswanga emigomweni. Izinhlobo azibi ngcono” ngokuhamba kwesikhathi; zimane zilandelele indawo yazo eshintshayo ngezimo ezikhulisa ukuzala kwazo endaweni ethile ngesikhathi esithile. Ukuziphendukela kwemvelo akunawo umgomo wokwenza izinhlobo ezisheshayo, ezinkulu, eziyinkimbinkimbi, noma ezihlakaniphe kakhulu, naphezu kokujwayelekile kwalolu hlobo lolimi enkulumweni ethandwayo. Yiziphi izici eziguqukayo kolunye uhlobo ziwumsebenzi wokwehluka okukhona kanye nendawo ezungezile, zombili ezishintsha njalo ngendlela engaqondile. Ukuthi yisiphi isici esifanele endaweni eyodwa ngesikhathi esisodwa kungase kube yingozi ngesikhathi esithile esizayo. Lokhu kusebenza kahle kolunye uhlobo lwezinambuzane njengoba kwenza kolunye uhlobo lwabantu.
question1: Kungani kungalungile ukusho ukuthi izinto eziphilayo ngazinye ziyavela ngenxa yokushintsha kwesimo sendawo?
answer1: Ukuziphendukela kwemvelo kwenzeka kubantu ngezizukulwane, hhayi ezintweni eziphilayo ngazinye ngesikhathi sokuphila kwazo
distractor1a: Abantu abakaze bashintshe ngesikhathi sokuphila kwabo
distractor1c: Ukuziphendukela kwemvelo kwenzeka kuphela ezinhlotsheni eziphelile
question2: Indawo eshintshayo ikuthinta kanjani ukuziphendukela kwemvelo?
answer2: Kusiza abantu abanezimfanelo ezizuzwa njengefa ezithuthukisa ukusinda nokuzala
distractor2a: Kubangela ukuthi izinto eziphilayo zithuthukise ngamabomu izici ezizuzisayo
distractor2b: Ishintsha ngqo i-DNA yazo zonke izinto eziphilayo
question3: Ukushintshashintsha kwezakhi zofuzo okubangelwa ukukhetha kwemvelo kuvelaphi?
answer3: Sekuvele kukhona ngaphakathi kwabantu ngaphambi kokuba kwenzeke ushintsho lwemvelo
question4: Kungani amabhaktheriya amelana nama-antibiotic eba maningi ngemva kokwelashwa ngama-antibiotic?
answer4: Amabhaktheriya amelana nezifo kakade anezakhi zofuzo zokumelana futhi ayasinda ukuze azale kabusha
distractor4a: Ama-antibiotic abangela amabhaktheriya ukuthi akhe izakhi zofuzo zokumelana
distractor4c: Ama-antibiotic andisa ukuzala kuphela kuma-bacteria angamelani nemithi
question5: Yini eye yaboniswa ucwaningo mayelana nokuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo ukuze kutholakale ukumelana nama-antibiotic?
answer5: Aziveli ngoba kusetshenziswa ama-antibiotic
distractor5a: Zikhiqizwa ngamabomu ngamagciwane
question6: Ingabe ukuziphendukela kwemvelo kuqondiswe ekwenzeni izinto eziphilayo zithuthuke kakhulu noma zibe yinkimbinkimbi?
answer6: Cha, ukuziphendukela kwemvelo akunawo umgomo onqunyiwe kusengaphambili futhi kuncike ekuguqukeni okukhona kanye nezimo zemvelo.
distractor6a: Yebo, ukuziphendukela kwemvelo kuhlala kukhiqiza izinto eziphilayo ezihlakaniphe kakhulu
distractor6b: Yebo, ukuziphendukela kwemvelo kuhlala kuholela ekubeni nomzimba omkhulu
distractor6c: Yebo, ukuziphendukela kwemvelo kuhlale kwandisa ubunzima bezinto eziphilayo
question7: Kungani isici esiwusizo namuhla singaba yingozi esikhathini esizayo?
answer7: Izimo zemvelo ziyashintsha, zishintsha ukuthi yiziphi izici ezithuthukisa impumelelo yokuzala
distractor7a: Izici ezizuzisayo ziba yingozi ngokuzenzakalelayo ngemva kwesizukulwane esisodwa
distractor7b: Ukukhetha kwemvelo kusiza unomphela zonke izici eziphumelelayo
distractor7c: Izakhi zofuzo zilahlekelwa ukusebenza kwazo ngokuhamba kwesikhathi kungakhathaliseki ukuthi imvelo injani

chapterName: 4. Izinqubo Zokuziphendukela Kwemvelo | 18. Ukuziphendukela Kwemvelo Nomsuka Wezinhlobo | 18.2 Ukwakheka Kwezinhlobo Ezintsha | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 4. Evolutionary Processes | 18. Evolution and Origin of Species | 18.2 Formation of New Species | Connection for AP® Courses
chapterContent:
I-Speciation ichaza ukuhlukahluka kwezinto eziphilayo ezihlala eMhlabeni. Nakuba zonke izinto eziphilayo zifana ngezindlela ezahlukene zofuzo, izinto eziphilayo ezithile kuphela ezihlanganisa ulwazi lwezakhi zofuzo ngokuzala ngokocansi futhi zikhiqize inzalo ephilayo nevundile, ekwazi ukuzala ngempumelelo. Ososayensi babiza lezo zinto eziphilayo ngamalungu ohlobo lwezinto eziphilayo. Njengoba sizofunda kamuva, izinguquko kuma-allele frequency ngaphakathi kwesibalo sabantu ezizukulwaneni ngezizukulwane zibangela ukuguquka okuncane. Kodwa-ke, ukuguquka okukhulu kuholela ekuguqukeni kwezinhlobo ezintsha lapho izinhlobo zihluka kukhokho ofanayo futhi, ngesizathu esisodwa noma esinye, zihlukaniswa ngokokuzala nesibalo sokuqala.

 I-Speciation yenzeka ngezindlela ezimbili eziyinhloko: ukuhlukaniswa kwendawo (i-allopatric speciation) kanye nezindlela ezenzeka ngaphakathi kwendawo ehlanganyelwe (i-sympatric speciation). Kuzo zombili izimo, izinhlobo zihlukaniswa ngokokuzala. Lapho izinhlobo zihlukaniswa ngokwendawo, ukugeleza ngokukhululeka kwama-allele kuyavinjelwa. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi—nangenxa yezingcindezi ezahlukene ezikhethiwe—izinhlobo ziyahlukana futhi zibe izinhlobo ezizimele ngokofuzo. Izithiyo ze-Prezygotic zivimba ukuzala ngaphambi kokwakheka kwe-zygote, kanti izithiyo ze-postzygotic zivimba ukuzala ngemva kokukhulelwa. Ngokusobala, uma amaqembu amabili ehlukaniswa ulwandle olukhulu, ngeke ahlangane ukuze azalane. Kodwa-ke, uma kuye kwaba khona ukuhlukahlukana, ngisho noma sekuhlanganiswe ndawonye, azogcina ubunjalo bawo bohlobo. Kunezibonelo eziningi zalokhu ngokwemvelo, okuhlanganisa ama-Darwin’s finch, ama-northern and Mexico spotted owls, kanye ne-Hawaiian honeycreeper. Imisebe eguquguqukayo yenzeka lapho uhlobo olulodwa lwakudala luveza izinhlobo eziningi ezintsha. Lokhu kungenzeka, isibonelo, lapho kutholakala izindawo ezintsha zokuhlala. Kungabonakala futhi ngokomlando ekukhuleni kwezilwane ezincelisayo ngemva kokuphela kwama-dinosaur. Ezinye izibonelo zezindlela zokuhlukanisa i-prezygotic zifaka phakathi izinkathi zokuzalana kanye nokuziphatha okuhlukile kokuthandana. Ngezinye izikhathi ukuhlangana kwenzeka phakathi kwezinhlobo ezimbili ezahlukene, okuholela ku-hybrid njenge-mule, okuyisiphambano phakathi kwehhashi nembongolo. Kodwa-ke, ama-hybrid amaningi awakwazi ukuthandwa noma awayinyumba.

 Ukuhlukahlukana kwe-sympatric akudingi isithiyo sendawo futhi kuchaza ukuthi zingaki izinhlobo ezahlukene ezingahlala endaweni efanayo. Olunye uhlobo lokuhlukahlukana kwe-sympatric luqala ngephutha elikhulu le-chromosome ngesikhathi sokuhlukaniswa kwamaseli. Njengoba ukhumbula ekuhloleni kwethu i-meiosis, ngezinye izikhathi amaphutha ayenzeka ekuhlukanisweni kwama-chromosome noma ama-chromatids, okuholela kuma-gametes anama-chromosome engeziwe (i-polyploidy). Lolu hlobo lwe-speciation luvame kakhulu ezitshalweni kunasezilwaneni, yize kunezibonelo ezithile ezilwaneni. Isibonelo, amaqembu amabili ezinhlanzi ze-cichlid eLake Victoria yase-Afrika, ane-morphology ehlukile kanye nokudla, angase abe sesigabeni sokuqala se-sympatric speciation ngaphandle kwe-polyploidy, njengoba kuvela umehluko wezakhi zofuzo phakathi kwamaqembu amabili.

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyiswe kulesi sigaba zisekela imiqondo echazwe ku-Big Idea 1 kanye no-Big Idea 3 wohlaka lwe-AP® Biology Curriculum. Izinhloso Zokufunda ze-AP® ezibalwe kuhlaka lwe-Curriculum zinikeza isisekelo esicacile senkambo ye-AP® Biology, ulwazi lwelabhorethri olusekelwe ekuphenyweni, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®. Inhloso yokufunda ihlanganisa okuqukethwe okudingekayo neyodwa noma ngaphezulu kwemikhuba yesayensi eyisikhombisa.
