question1: Luyini uhlobo lwezinto eziphilayo?
answer1: Iqembu lezinto eziphilayo ezingazalana futhi zikhiqize inzalo ephilayo nevundile
distractor1a: Iqembu lezinto eziphilayo ezibukeka zifana kodwa ezingakwazi ukuzala
distractor1b: Noma yiziphi izinto eziphilayo ezihlala endaweni efanayo
distractor1c: Noma yiziphi izinto eziphilayo ezingaphansi kombuso ofanayo
question2: Ukuguquka okukhulu kuhluke kanjani ekuguqukeni okuncane?
answer2: Ukuguquka okukhulu kuphumela ekwakhekeni kwezinhlobo ezintsha, kanti ukuguquka okuncane kushintsha imvamisa ye-allele ngaphakathi kwesibalo sabantu
distractor2a: Ukuguquka okukhulu kwenzeka ngaphakathi kwabantu ngabanye, kanti ukuguquka okuncane kwenzeka kubantu abaningi
distractor2b: Ukuguquka okukhulu kwesimo sezulu kuthinta kuphela izinhlobo eziphelile
question3: Yiziphi izindlela ezimbili eziyinhloko lapho ukuhlukaniswa kwenzeka khona?
answer3: Ukuhlukaniswa kwe-allopatric kanye nokuhlukaniswa kwe-sympatric
distractor3b: Ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo kanye nokukhukhuleka kwezakhi zofuzo
distractor3c: Ukuziphendukela kwemvelo okuguquguqukayo kanye nokuziphendukela kwemvelo okuhlukahlukene
question4: Yini ebangela ukuthi imiphakathi ihlukane ngesikhathi sokuhlolwa kwe-allopatric?
answer4: Ukuhlukaniswa kwezindawo kuvimbela ukugeleza kwezakhi zofuzo phakathi kwabantu
distractor4a: Abantu bagwema ngamabomu ukuhlangana
question5: Uyini umehluko phakathi kwezithiyo zokuzala ze-prezygotic kanye ne-postzygotic?
answer5: Izithiyo ze-Prezygotic zivimbela ukukhulelwa, kanti izithiyo ze-postzygotic zisebenza ngemva kokukhulelwa
distractor5a: Izithiyo ze-Prezygotic zenzeka ezitshalweni kuphela
question6: Iyini imisebe eguquguqukayo?
answer6: Ukuvela kwezinhlobo eziningi ezintsha ezivela kohlobo olulodwa lwakudala
distractor6c: Ukuphela kwazo zonke izinhlobo endaweni yokuhlala
question7: Kungani iminyuzi ngokuvamile ingenazo izinhlayiya?
answer7: Ziyizinhlobo ezixubile phakathi kwezinhlobo ezahlukene futhi iningi lezinhlobo ezixubile alinamagciwane noma alinakwenzeka
question8: I-sympatric speciation ingenzeka kanjani ngaphandle kokuhlukaniswa kwezindawo?
answer8: Ukwehluka kwezakhi zofuzo kuvela endaweni efanayo, ngezinye izikhathi nge-polyploidy noma ezinye izithiyo zokuzala

chapterName: 4. Izinqubo Zokuziphendukela Kwemvelo | 18. Ukuziphendukela Kwemvelo Nomsuka Wezinhlobo | 18.2 Ukwakheka Kwezinhlobo Ezintsha | Izinhlobo Nekhono Lokuzala
chapterNameEnglish: 4. Evolutionary Processes | 18. Evolution and Origin of Species | 18.2 Formation of New Species | Species and the Ability to Reproduce
chapterContent:
Uhlobo luyiqembu lezinto eziphilayo ezizalanayo futhi zikhiqize inzalo evundile nephilayo. Ngokwale ncazelo, uhlobo olulodwa luhlukaniswa kolunye lapho, ngokwemvelo, kungenzeki ukuthi ukuhlangana phakathi kwabantu abavela kolunye uhlobo kukhiqize inzalo evundile.

 Amalungu ohlobo olufanayo abelana ngezici zangaphandle nezangaphakathi, ezikhula kwi-DNA yawo. Ubudlelwano obuseduze phakathi kwezinto eziphilayo ezimbili, kulapho zine-DNA efanayo khona, njengabantu nemindeni yabo. I-DNA yabantu cishe ifana kakhulu ne-DNA kayise noma kamama wabo kune-DNA yomzala wabo noma kagogo nomkhulu. Izinto eziphilayo zohlobo olufanayo zinezinga eliphakeme kakhulu lokuhambisana kwe-DNA ngakho-ke zabelana ngezici nokuziphatha okuholela ekuzaleni okuphumelelayo.

 Ukubukeka kohlobo kungadukisa ekuphakamiseni ikhono noma ukungakwazi ukuhlangana. Isibonelo, yize izinja zasekhaya (i-Canis lupus familiaris) zibonisa umehluko we-phenotypic, njengosayizi, ukwakheka, kanye noboya, izinja eziningi zingazalana futhi zikhiqize izinjana eziphilayo ezingakhula futhi zizalane ngokocansi (Isithombe 18.10).

 Kwezinye izimo, abantu ngabanye bangase babonakale befana nakuba bengewona amalungu ohlobo olufanayo. Isibonelo, noma ngabe izinkozi ezimpunga (Haliaeetus leucocephalus) kanye nezinkozi zase-Afrika (Haliaeetus vocifer) ziyizinyoni nezinkozi, ngayinye ingeqembu lohlobo oluhlukile (Isithombe 18.11). Uma abantu bebengangenelela ngokwenziwa futhi bavundise iqanda lenkozi empunga ngesidoda senkozi yase-Afrika bese inkukhu iphuma, leyo nzalo, ebizwa ngokuthi i-hybrid (inhlanganisela phakathi kwezinhlobo ezimbili), cishe ibingaba yinyumba—ingakwazi ukuzala ngempumelelo ngemva kokufika ekuvuthweni. Izinhlobo ezahlukene zingase zibe nezakhi zofuzo ezahlukene ezisebenzayo ekukhuleni; ngakho-ke, kungase kungenzeki ukuthuthukisa inzalo ephilayo eneziqondiso ezimbili ezahlukene. Ngakho-ke, noma ngabe ukuhlanganiswa kungase kwenzeke, lezi zinhlobo ezimbili zisalokhu zihlukene.

 Izinhlobo zezinhlobo zabelana nge-gene pool: iqoqo lazo zonke izinhlobo zezakhi zofuzo kulolu hlobo. Futhi, isisekelo sanoma yiziphi izinguquko eqenjini noma kubantu bezinto eziphilayo kumele sibe yizakhi zofuzo ngoba lokhu kuyindlela kuphela yokwabelana nokudlulisela izici. Uma kwenzeka ukwehluka phakathi kohlobo, kungadluliselwa kuphela esizukulwaneni esilandelayo ngezindlela ezimbili eziyinhloko: ukuzala okungenabo ubulili noma ukuzala ngokocansi. Ushintsho luzodluliselwa ngaphandle kobulili uma nje iseli elizalayo linesici esishintshile. Ukuze isici esishintshile sidluliselwe ngokuzala ngokocansi, i-gamete, njengesidoda noma iseli leqanda, kumele ibe nesici esishintshile. Ngamanye amazwi, izinto eziphilayo ezizala ngokocansi zingabhekana nezinguquko eziningana zofuzo emaseli azo omzimba, kodwa uma lezi zinguquko zingenzeki esidodaneni noma eqandeni, isici esishintshile ngeke sifinyelele esizukulwaneni esilandelayo. Izici ezizuzwa njengefa kuphela ezingaguquka. Ngakho-ke, ukuzala kudlala indima ebalulekile ekushintsheni kwezakhi zofuzo ukuthi kumile kubantu noma enhlotsheni. Ngamafuphi, izinto eziphilayo kumele zikwazi ukuzalana ukuze zidlulisele izici ezintsha enzalweni.
question1: Ngokomqondo wezinhlobo zezinto eziphilayo, yini echaza uhlobo?
answer1: Iqembu lezinto eziphilayo ezingazalana futhi zikhiqize inzalo evundile nephilayo
distractor1a: Iqembu lezinto eziphilayo ezifana
distractor1b: Iqembu lezinto eziphilayo ezihlala endaweni efanayo
distractor1c: Iqembu lezinto eziphilayo ezinenombolo efanayo ye-chromosome
question2: Kungani amalungu ohlobo olufanayo evame ukuba nezici ezifanayo kanye nokuziphatha okufanayo?
answer2: Zinezinga eliphakeme kakhulu lokufana kwe-DNA kanye nezici ezizuzwe njengefa
question3: Kungani izinja zasekhaya ezibukeka ngendlela ehluke kakhulu zingase zibe ezohlobo olufanayo?
answer3: Zingazalana futhi zikhiqize inzalo evundile
question4: Iyini i-hybrid?
answer4: Inzalo ekhiqizwa ukuhlangana kwabantu abavela ezinhlotsheni ezimbili ezahlukene
distractor4a: Isidalwa esikhiqizwa ngokuzala okungenabo ubulili
question5: Kungani izinhlobo eziningi ezixubile zingazali?
answer5: Umehluko wezakhi zofuzo phakathi kohlobo lwabazali uvimbela ukuzala okuvamile
distractor5a: Abakwazi ukusinda ngemva kokuzalwa
question6: Iyini i-gene pool?
answer6: Iqoqo eliphelele lazo zonke izinhlobo zezakhi zofuzo kubantu noma ohlotsheni oluthile
distractor6a: Iqembu lezakhi zofuzo elitholakala kumuntu oyedwa kuphela
distractor6c: Zonke izinguquko ezenzeka phakathi nesizukulwane esisodwa
question7: Kungani izici ezizuzwa njengefa kuphela ezingavela?
answer7: Izici ezingadluliselwa enzalweni kuphela ezithinta izizukulwane ezizayo
question8: Ukuze ushintsho olusha lwezakhi zofuzo ludluliselwe enzalweni ngokuzala ngokocansi, kumelwe lwenzeke kuphi?
answer8: Ku-gamete efana nesidoda noma iqanda

chapterName: 4. Izinqubo Zokuziphendukela Kwemvelo | 18. Ukuziphendukela Kwemvelo Nomsuka Wezinhlobo | 18.2 Ukwakheka Kwezinhlobo Ezintsha | Uhlobo Olukhethekile
chapterNameEnglish: 4. Evolutionary Processes | 18. Evolution and Origin of Species | 18.2 Formation of New Species | Speciation
chapterContent:
Incazelo yezinto eziphilayo yezinhlobo, esebenza ezintweni eziphilayo ezizalanayo ngokocansi, iyiqembu lezinhlobo ezizalanayo ngempela noma ezingase zizalane. Kunezimo ezihlukile kulo mthetho. Izinhlobo eziningi ziyafana ngokwanele ukuthi inzalo exubile ingenzeka futhi ingase ivele emvelweni, kodwa ezinhlobonhlobo zezinhlobo lo mthetho uvame ukuba khona. Eqinisweni, ukuba khona emvelweni kwezinhlobo ezifanayo ezixubile kusikisela ukuthi kungenzeka ukuthi zivela ohlotsheni olulodwa oluzalanayo, futhi inqubo yokuhlukanisa ingase ingakaqedi.

 Njengoba kunikezwe ukuhlukahluka okungavamile kokuphila emhlabeni kumele kube nezindlela zokuhlukanisa: ukwakheka kwezinhlobo ezimbili ezivela kohlobo olulodwa lokuqala. UDarwin wacabanga ngale nqubo njengomcimbi wokuhlukanisa amagatsha futhi wadweba inqubo emfanekisweni owodwa otholakala ku-On the Origin of Species (Isithombe 18.13a). Qhathanisa lo mfanekiso nomdwebo wokuziphendukela kwemvelo kwendlovu (Isithombe 18.13b), okubonisa ukuthi njengoba uhlobo olulodwa lushintsha ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, lukhula lube izinhlobo ezintsha ezingaphezu kweyodwa, ngokuphindaphindiwe, uma nje inani labantu lisinda noma kuze kube yilapho into ephilayo iphela.

 Ukuze kube nokwakheka kwezinhlobo ezimbili ezintsha, kumele kwakhiwe izinhlobo ezimbili ezintsha kusukela kubantu bokuqala futhi kumele ziguquke ngendlela yokuthi kube nzima ngabantu abavela kulezi zinhlobo ezimbili ezintsha ukuba bazalane. Izazi zezinto eziphilayo ziphakamise izindlela okungenzeka ngazo lokhu eziwela ezigabeni ezimbili ezibanzi. Ukwakheka kwezinhlobo ezimbili (allo- = okunye; -patric = izwe lakubo) kuhilela ukuhlukaniswa kwezindawo zabantu nohlobo olulodwa oluzalayo kanye nokuziphendukela kwemvelo okulandelayo. Ukwakheka kwezinhlobo ezimbili (sympatric speciation) kuhilela ukwakheka kwezinhlobo ezimbili ezizalayo ezisele endaweni eyodwa.

 Izazi zezinto eziphilayo zicabanga ngemicimbi yokwakheka kwezinhlobo njengokuhlukaniswa kohlobo olulodwa oluzalayo lube izinhlobo ezimbili zenzalo. Akukho sizathu sokuthi kungani kungase kungabi nezinhlobo ezingaphezu kwezimbili ezakhiwe ngesikhathi esisodwa ngaphandle kokuthi mancane amathuba futhi imicimbi eminingi ingacatshangwa njengokuhlukana okukodwa okwenzeka eduze kwesikhathi.

answer3: Uhlobo olulodwa lokhokho lukhula lube izinhlobo ezimbili noma ngaphezulu zenzalo ngokuhamba kwesikhathi

chapterName: 4. Izinqubo Zokuziphendukela Kwemvelo | 18. Ukuziphendukela Kwemvelo Nomsuka Wezinhlobo | 18.2 Ukwakheka Kwezinhlobo Ezintsha | I-Allopatric Speciation
chapterNameEnglish: 4. Evolutionary Processes | 18. Evolution and Origin of Species | 18.2 Formation of New Species | Allopatric Speciation
chapterContent:
Isibalo sabantu esiqhubekayo ngokwendawo sineqoqo lezakhi zofuzo elifana kakhulu. Ukugeleza kwezakhi zofuzo, ukuhamba kwama-allele kulo lonke uhlobo lwezinhlobo, kukhululekile ngoba abantu bangahamba bese behlangana nabantu endaweni yabo entsha. Ngakho-ke, ukuvama kwe-allele kolunye uhlangothi lokusatshalaliswa kuzofana nokuvama kwe-allele kolunye uhlangothi. Lapho abantu behlukana ngokwendawo, lokho kugeleza kwe-allele ngokukhululeka kuyavinjelwa. Uma lokho kuhlukana kuhlala isikhathi esithile, lezi zinhlobo ezimbili ziyakwazi ukuguquka ngezindlela ezahlukene. Ngakho-ke, ukuvama kwazo kwe-allele ezindaweni eziningi zezakhi zofuzo kancane kancane kuyahluka njengoba ama-allele amasha evela ngokuzimela ngokuguquka kwesimo sabantu ngasinye. Ngokuvamile, izimo zemvelo, njengesimo sezulu, izinsiza, izilwane ezidla ezinye, kanye nabancintisani balezi zinhlobo ezimbili zizohluka okubangela ukukhethwa kwemvelo ukuthi kuthande ukuzivumelanisa okuhlukahlukene eqenjini ngalinye.

 Ukuhlukaniswa kwezinhlobo zezilwane okuholela ekuhlukaniseni i-allopatric kungenzeka ngezindlela ezahlukene: umfula owakha igatsha elisha, ukuguguleka okwakha isigodi esisha, iqembu lezinto eziphilayo ezihamba ziye endaweni entsha ngaphandle kokubuya, noma imbewu entanta phezu kolwandle iye esiqhingini. Uhlobo lokuhlukaniswa kwendawo oludingekayo ukuze kuhlukaniswe izinhlobo zezilwane luncike ngokuphelele kubhayoloji yesidalwa kanye namathuba aso okusabalala. Uma izinhlobo ezimbili zezinambuzane ezindizayo zihlala ezigodini ezihlukene eziseduze, kungenzeka ukuthi abantu abavela kumuntu ngamunye bazondiza beya phambili naphambili beqhubeka nokugeleza kwezakhi zofuzo. Kodwa-ke, uma izinhlobo ezimbili zegundane zihlukaniswa ngokwakhiwa kwechibi elisha, ukugeleza kwezakhi zofuzo okuqhubekayo bekungeke kwenzeke; ngakho-ke, ukuhlukaniswa kungaba amathuba amaningi.

 Izazi zezinto eziphilayo zihlukanisa izinqubo ze-allopatric zibe yizigaba ezimbili: ukuhlakazeka kanye nokwahlukanisa. Ukuhlakazeka yilapho amalungu ambalwa ezinhlobo ezithile ethuthela endaweni entsha, kanti ukuhlukaniswa yilapho kuvela isimo semvelo ukuze kuhlukaniswe izinto eziphilayo ngokomzimba.

 Ososayensi babhale amacala amaningi okuhlukaniswa kwe-allopatric okwenzekayo. Isibonelo, ogwini olusentshonalanga ye-United States, kunezinhlobo ezimbili ezihlukene zezikhova ezinamabala. Isikhova esinamabala asenyakatho sinomehluko wezakhi zofuzo kanye nowe-phenotypic kusuka esihlotsheni saso esiseduze: isikhova esinamabala saseMexico, esihlala eningizimu (Isithombe 18.14).

 Ngaphezu kwalokho, ososayensi bathole ukuthi lapho ibanga phakathi kwamaqembu amabili ayekade eyizinhlobo ezifanayo, kulapho kungenzeka khona ukuthi i-speciation ivele khona. Lokhu kubonakala kunengqondo ngoba njengoba ibanga likhula, izici ezahlukahlukene zemvelo cishe azifani kakhulu kunezindawo eziseduze. Cabanga ngezikhova ezimbili: enyakatho, isimo sezulu sipholile kunaseningizimu; izinhlobo zezinto eziphilayo endaweni ngayinye ziyahlukahluka, njengoba nokuziphatha kwazo kanye nemikhuba yazo; futhi, imikhuba yokuzingela kanye nokukhetha ukudla kwezikhova zaseningizimu kuyahlukahluka kwezikhova zasenyakatho. Lokhu kuhlukahluka kungaholela ekwehlukeni okuguqukile kwezikhova, futhi i-speciation kungenzeka ivele.

answer7: Babhekana nezimo ezahlukene kanye nokuncipha kokugeleza kwezakhi zofuzo, okukhuthaza ukwehluka kwezakhi zofuzo

distractor7c: Amabanga amakhulu andisa ukugeleza kwezakhi zofuzo phakathi kwabantu

answer8: Isikhova esinamabala asenyakatho kanye nesikhova esinamabala aseMexico

chapterName: 4. Izinqubo Zokuziphendukela Kwemvelo | 18. Ukuziphendukela Kwemvelo Nomsuka Wezinhlobo | 18.2 Ukwakheka Kwezinhlobo Ezintsha | I-Allopatric Speciation | I-Adaptive Radiation
chapterNameEnglish: 4. Evolutionary Processes | 18. Evolution and Origin of Species | 18.2 Formation of New Species | Allopatric Speciation | Adaptive Radiation
chapterContent:
Kwezinye izimo, inani labantu bohlobo olulodwa lisakazeka endaweni ethile, futhi inani ngalinye lithola indawo ehlukile noma indawo yokuhlala ehlukanisiwe. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izidingo ezahlukahlukene zendlela yabo yokuphila entsha ziholela ezenzakalweni eziningi zohlobo oluvela ohlotsheni olulodwa. Lokhu kubizwa ngokuthi imisebe eguquguqukayo ngoba ukuzivumelanisa nezimo eziningi kuvela endaweni eyodwa; ngaleyo ndlela, okubangela ukuthi lolu hlobo luqhume lube yizinhlobo eziningana ezintsha. Iziqhingi zaseziqhingini ezifana neziQhingi zaseHawaii zinikeza umongo ofanele wemicimbi yemisebe eguquguqukayo ngoba amanzi azungeze isiqhingi ngasinye okuholela ekuhlukanisweni kwendawo kwezinto eziphilayo eziningi. I-honeycreeper yaseHawaii ibonisa isibonelo esisodwa semisebe eguquguqukayo. Kusukela ohlotsheni olulodwa, olubizwa ngokuthi uhlobo lomsunguli, izinhlobo eziningi ziye zavela, kufaka phakathi eziyisithupha eziboniswe kuMfanekiso 18.15.

 Phawula umehluko emilonyeni yezinhlobo kuMfanekiso 18.15. Ukuziphendukela kwemvelo ekukhetheni kwemvelo okusekelwe emithonjeni ethile yokudla endaweni ngayinye entsha yokuhlala kuholele ekuziphendukeleni komlomo ohlukile ofanele umthombo othile wokudla. Inyoni edla imbewu inomlomo omkhulu, oqinile ofanele ukuphula amantongomane aqinile. Izinyoni ezidla umpe zinemilomo emide yokucwilisa ezimbalini ukuze zifinyelele umpe. Izinyoni ezidla izinambuzane zinemilomo efana nezinkemba, ezifanele ukugwaza nokuhlaba izinambuzane. Izinyoni ezidla umpe ziyisibonelo semisebe eguquguqukayo esiqhingini.

distractor1b: Ukuphela kwezinhlobo zezilwane okubangelwa ushintsho lwemvelo

distractor2a: Ukugeleza kwezakhi zofuzo kukhulu phakathi kweziqhingi kunasemazwekazini

distractor3c: Uhlobo lokugcina olukhiqizwa ngesikhathi sokukhanya okuguquguqukayo

answer4: Izinyoni zaseHawaii

distractor5b: Zonke izinhlobo zomlomo zibangelwa ukulimala okungahleliwe

answer6: Umlomo oqinile, oqinile

answer7: Zivumela izinyoni ukuthi zifinyelele umpe ngaphakathi kwezimbali

question8: Yiliphi iqembu lezinyoni elidumile eliyisibonelo semisebe eguquguqukayo esiqhingini?
answer8: Izinyoni zaseDarwin

chapterName: 4. Izinqubo Zokuziphendukela Kwemvelo | 18. Ukuziphendukela Kwemvelo Nomsuka Wezinhlobo | 18.2 Ukwakheka Kwezinhlobo Ezintsha | Ukuhlukahlukana Kwezimo Ezihambisanayo
chapterNameEnglish: 4. Evolutionary Processes | 18. Evolution and Origin of Species | 18.2 Formation of New Species | Sympatric Speciation
chapterContent:
Ingabe ukwehlukana kungenzeka uma kungekho zithiyo ezibonakalayo ezikhona zokuhlukanisa abantu abaqhubeka bephila futhi bezalana endaweni efanayo? Impendulo inguyebo. Inqubo yokuhlukanisa ngaphakathi kwendawo efanayo ibizwa ngokuthi i-sympatric speciation; isiqalo esithi "sympatric"sisho okufanayo, ngakho-ke i-sympatric"isho izwe elifanayo"ngokungafani ne-allopatric "esho elinye izwe."Kuye kwaphakanyiswa futhi kwafundwa izindlela eziningana zokwakheka kwe-sympatric.

 Uhlobo olulodwa lokwakheka kwe-sympatric lungaqala ngephutha elikhulu le-chromosome ngesikhathi sokuhlukaniswa kweseli. Esimweni sokuhlukaniswa kweseli esivamile, ama-chromosome ayaphindaphindeka, ahlangane, bese ehlukana ukuze iseli ngalinye elisha libe nenani elifanayo lama-chromosome. Kodwa-ke, ngezinye izikhathi amabhangqa ayahlukana futhi umkhiqizo weseli lokugcina unesethi eyengeziwe yama-chromosome esimweni esisibiza ngokuthi i-polyploidy (Isithombe 18.16).

 I-Polyploidy yisimo lapho iseli noma into ephilayo inesethi eyengeziwe, noma amasethi, ama-chromosome. Ososayensi bathole izinhlobo ezimbili eziyinhloko ze-polyploidy ezingaholela ekuhlukanisweni kokuzala komuntu esimweni se-polyploidy. Ukuhlukaniswa kokuzala ukungakwazi ukuzalanisa. Kwezinye izimo, umuntu we-polyploid uzoba namasethi amabili noma ngaphezulu aphelele ama-chromosome avela ezinhlotsheni zakhe esimweni esibizwa ngokuthi i-autopolyploidy (Isithombe 18.17). Isiqalo esithi auto-”sisho ukuzenzela,” ngakho-ke leli gama lisho ama-chromosome amaningi avela kowakho izinhlobo. I-Polyploidy ibangelwa iphutha ku-meiosis lapho wonke ama-chromosome ethuthela khona esitokisini esisodwa esikhundleni sokuhlukanisa.

 Isibonelo, uma uhlobo lwesitshalo olune-2n = 6 lukhiqiza ama-gametes e-autopolyploid nawo angama-diploid (2n = 6, lapho kufanele abe ngu-n = 3), ama-gametes manje anama-chromosome amaningi kabili kunalawo okufanele abe nawo. Lawa ma-gametes amasha ngeke ahambisane nama-gametes ajwayelekile akhiqizwa yilezi zinhlobo zezitshalo. Kodwa-ke, angazivundisa ngokwawo noma azale nezinye izitshalo ze-autopolyploid ezinama-gametes anenombolo efanayo ye-diploid. Ngale ndlela, ukuhlukaniswa kwe-sympatric kungenzeka ngokushesha ngokwakha inzalo ene-4n ebizwa ngokuthi i-tetraploid. Laba bantu bazokwazi ukuzala ngokushesha kuphela ngalabo balolu hlobo olusha hhayi labo bezinhlobo zokhokho.

 Olunye uhlobo lwe-polyploidy lwenzeka lapho abantu bezinhlobo ezimbili ezahlukene bezala ukuze bakhe inzalo ephilayo ebizwa ngokuthi i-allopolyploid. Isiqalo esithi allo-”sisho okunye” (khumbula kusuka ku-allopatric): Ngakho-ke, i-allopolyploid yenzeka lapho ama-gametes avela ezinhlotsheni ezimbili ezahlukene ehlangana. Isithombe 18.18 sibonisa indlela eyodwa engenzeka i-allopolyploid engakheka ngayo. Qaphela ukuthi kuthatha izizukulwane ezimbili, noma izenzo ezimbili zokuzala, ngaphambi kokuba kube nemiphumela emihle ye-hybrid evundile.

 Izinhlobo ezitshaliwe zezitshalo zikakolweni, ukotini, kanye nogwayi zonke ziyi-allopolyploids. Nakuba i-polyploidy yenzeka ngezikhathi ezithile ezilwaneni, yenzeka kakhulu ezitshalweni. (Izilwane ezinanoma yiluphi uhlobo lwe-chromosome aberrations ezichazwe lapha cishe azikwazi ukusinda futhi zikhiqize inzalo evamile.) Ososayensi bathole ukuthi ngaphezu kwengxenye yazo zonke izinhlobo zezitshalo ezifundwe zihlobene nohlobo oluguqulwe nge-polyploidy. Njengoba kunesilinganiso esiphakeme kangaka se-polyploidy ezitshalweni, abanye ososayensi bacabanga ukuthi le ndlela yenzeka kakhulu njengokuzivumelanisa nezimo kunokuba kube yiphutha.
question1: Kuyini i-sympatric speciation?
answer1: Ukwakheka kwezinhlobo ezintsha endaweni efanayo ngaphandle kokuhlukaniswa ngokomzimba
distractor1a: Ukwakheka kwezinhlobo ezintsha ngemva kokuhlukaniswa ngokwezindawo
distractor1b: Ukuphela kohlobo oluthile okubangelwa ushintsho lwemvelo
distractor1c: Ukufuduka kwabantu baye endaweni entsha yokuhlala
question2: Kuyini i-polyploidy?
answer2: Isimo lapho into ephilayo inesethi eyodwa noma ngaphezulu yama-chromosome
distractor2c: Ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo okuthinta i-chromosome eyodwa kuphela
question3: I-polyploidy ingaba kanjani negalelo ekukhetheni kwe-sympatric?
answer3: Abantu abane-polyploid bahlukaniswa ngokuzala nabantu bokuqala.
distractor3a: I-Polyploidy ihlala ikhulisa ukugeleza kwezakhi zofuzo
distractor3b: Abantu abane-polyploid bazalana kahle ngokulinganayo nabantu basendulo
question4: Kuyini i-autopolyploidy?
answer4: Isimo se-polyploid lapho amasethi e-chromosome engeziwe avela ohlotsheni olufanayo
distractor4a: Isimo se-polyploid esibangelwa ukuhlanganiswa kwezinhlobo ezahlukene
distractor4b: Isimo lapho ama-chromosome engekho khona ngokuphelele
question5: Kuyini i-allopolyploid?
answer5: Isidalwa esine-polyploid esakhiwe ngama-chromosome ezinhlobo ezimbili ezahlukene
distractor5a: Isidalwa esinama-chromosome aphindaphindiwe avela ohlotsheni olulodwa kuphela
question6: Kungani izitshalo ze-tetraploid zingazalana kodwa zingazalani nenani lama-diploid okhokho?
answer6: Izinombolo zama-chromosome azo ziyahambisana kodwa azihambisani nezinhlobo ze-diploid
distractor6c: Ziba zifana ngokwezakhi zofuzo nenani labantu basendulo
question7: Kukuliphi iqembu lezinto eziphilayo lapho i-polyploidy ivame kakhulu khona?
answer7: Izitshalo
question8: Yiziphi izitshalo zezitshalo okukhulunywe ngazo endimeni eziyizibonelo zama-allopolyploids?
answer8: Ukolweni, ukotini, nogwayi
answer9: I-Aneuploidy yisimo sokuba nama-chromosome amaningi kakhulu noma ambalwa kakhulu ngenxa yephutha ngesikhathi sokuhlukaniswa kweseli.
distractor9a: I-Aneuploidy iwukuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo okubangela ukuthi i-genome yeseli iqhekeke.
distractor9b: I-Aneuploidy yisimo sokuba yonke i-chromosome ingasebenzi, okuholela ekubeni umbungu ongenakunqotshwa.
distractor9c: I-Aneuploidy iyisithiyo esivimbela ukukhula kwezitshalo lapho ama-gametes ezinhlobo ezimbili ezihlukene engeke avundiselane khona.

chapterName: 4. Izinqubo Zokuziphendukela Kwemvelo | 18. Ukuziphendukela Kwemvelo Nomsuka Wezinhlobo | 18.2 Ukwakheka Kwezinhlobo Ezintsha | Ukuhlukaniswa Kokuzala | Ithonya Lendawo Yokuhlala Ku-Speciation
chapterNameEnglish: 4. Evolutionary Processes | 18. Evolution and Origin of Species | 18.2 Formation of New Species | Reproductive Isolation | Habitat Influence on Speciation
chapterContent:
Uma isikhathi sinikezwe, ukwehlukana kwezakhi zofuzo kanye nokwe-phenotypic phakathi kwezinhlobo kuzothinta izinhlamvu ezithinta ukuzala: uma abantu bezinhlobo ezimbili bezohlanganiswa, ukuzalana bekungeke kube lula, kodwa uma kwenzeka ukuzalana, inzalo ibingeke iphile noma ingabi nanzalo. Izinhlobo eziningi zezinhlamvu ezihlukene zingathinta ukuhlukaniswa kokuzala (ukungakwazi ukuzalanisa) kwezinhlobo ezimbili.

 Ukuhlukaniswa kokuzalana kungenzeka ngezindlela ezahlukene. Ososayensi bazihlela ngamaqembu amabili: izithiyo ze-prezygotic kanye nezithiyo ze-postzygotic. Khumbula ukuthi i-zygote iyiqanda elivundisiwe: iseli lokuqala lokukhula kwento ephilayo ezala ngokocansi. Ngakho-ke, isithiyo se-prezygotic siyindlela evimba ukuzalana; lokhu kufaka phakathi izithiyo ezivimbela ukukhulelwa lapho izinto eziphilayo zizama ukuzala. Isithiyo se-postzygotic senzeka ngemva kokwakheka kwe-zygote; lokhu kufaka phakathi izinto eziphilayo ezingasindi esigabeni sombungu kanye nalezo ezizalwa zingenanzalo.

 Ezinye izinhlobo zezithiyo ze-prezygotic zivimbela ukuzala ngokuphelele. Izinto eziphilayo eziningi zizalana ngezikhathi ezithile zonyaka, ngokuvamile minyaka yonke. Umehluko kumashejuli okuzala, okubizwa ngokuthi ukuhlukaniswa kwesikhathi, ungasebenza njengohlobo lokuhlukaniswa kokuzala. Isibonelo, izinhlobo ezimbili zamaxoxo zihlala endaweni efanayo, kodwa enye izalana kusukela ngoJanuwari kuya kuMashi, kanti enye izalana kusukela ngoMashi kuya kuMeyi (Isithombe 18.19).

 Kwezinye izimo, izinhlobo zezinhlobo ziyathutha noma zithuthelwe endaweni entsha bese zihlala endaweni engasahlangani nezinye izinhlobo zezinhlobo ezifanayo. Lesi simo sibizwa ngokuthi ukuhlukaniswa kwendawo. Ukuzalana nohlobo lwabazali kuyaphela, futhi kukhona iqembu elisha manje elizimele ngokokuzala nangokofuzo. Isibonelo, inani lekhilikithi elahlukaniswa ngemva kwesikhukhula alikwazanga ukuxhumana. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, amandla okukhetha kwemvelo, ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo, kanye nokuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo cishe kuzoholela ekwehlukaneni kwamaqembu amabili (Isithombe 18.20).

 Ukuhlukaniswa kokuziphatha kwenzeka lapho ukuba khona noma ukungabikho kokuziphatha okuthile kuvimbela ukuzala. Isibonelo, izimpukane zesilisa zisebenzisa amaphethini athile okukhanya ukuheha abesifazane. Izinhlobo ezahlukene zezimpukane zibonisa izibani zazo ngendlela ehlukile. Uma owesilisa wohlobo oluthile ezama ukuheha owesifazane wolunye uhlobo, ubengeke ayiqaphele indlela yokukhanya futhi ubengeke ahehe nowesilisa.

 Ezinye izithiyo ze-prezygotic zisebenza lapho umehluko kumaseli azo e-gamete (amaqanda nesidoda) uvimbela ukukhulelwa ukuba kwenzeke; lokhu kubizwa ngokuthi isithiyo se-gametic. Ngokufanayo, kwezinye izimo izinto eziphilayo ezihlobene eduze zizama uhehe, kodwa izakhiwo zazo zokuzala azihambelani. Isibonelo, abesilisa nabesifazane bezinhlobo ezahlukene banezitho zokuzala ezime ngendlela ehlukile. Uma uhlobo olulodwa luzama uhehe nolunye, izingxenye zomzimba wabo azihambelani. (Isithombe 18.21).

 Ezitshalweni, izakhiwo ezithile ezihlose ukuheha uhlobo olulodwa lwe-pollinator ngesikhathi esisodwa zivimbela i-pollinator ehlukile ukuthi ifinyelele impova. Umhubhe lapho isilwane kufanele sifinyelele khona i-nectar ungahluka kakhulu ngobude nangobubanzi, okuvimbela isitshalo ukuthi sihlanganiswe nempova nohlobo oluhlukile (Isithombe 18.22).

 Uma kwenzeka ukukhulelwa futhi kwakheka i-zygote, izithiyo ze-postzygotic zingavimbela ukuzala. Ezimweni eziningi, izinhlobo ze-hybrid azikwazi ukwakheka ngendlela evamile esibelethweni futhi azigcini nje zidlule ezigabeni zombungu. Lokhu kubizwa ngokuthi ukungaphili kwe-hybrid ngoba izinto eziphilayo ze-hybrid azikwazi ukusebenza. Kwesinye isimo se-postzygotic, ukuzala kuholela ekuzalweni nasekukhuleni kwe-hybrid engenazinzalo futhi engakwazi ukuzala inzalo yazo; lokhu kubizwa ngokuthi i-hybrid sterility.

 Ithonya Lendawo Yokuhlala Ekukhetheni
Ukuhlukaniswa kwe-sympatric kungase kwenzeke ngezindlela ezingezona i-polyploidy. Isibonelo, cabanga ngohlobo lwezinhlanzi ezihlala echibini. Njengoba inani labantu likhula, ukuncintisana kokudla nakho kuyakhula. Ngaphansi kwengcindezi yokuthola ukudla, ake sithi iqembu lalezi zinhlanzi lalinokuguquguquka kwezakhi zofuzo kokuthola nokondla enye imithombo engasetshenziswanga ezinye izinhlanzi. Kuthiwani uma lo mthombo wokudla omusha utholakala ekujuleni okuhlukile kwechibi? Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, labo abadla umthombo wokudla wesibili babezosebenzisana kakhulu kunezinye izinhlanzi; ngakho-ke, nabo babezozalana ndawonye. Inzalo yalezi zinhlanzi cishe izoziphatha njengabazali bazo: ukudla nokuhlala endaweni efanayo nokuhlala ihlukile kubantu bokuqala. Uma leli qembu lezinhlanzi liqhubeka lihlukile kubantu bokuqala, ekugcineni ukuhlukaniswa kwezinhlobo zezinhlanzi kungase kwenzeke njengoba umehluko omkhulu wezakhi zofuzo uqongelela phakathi kwazo.

 Lesi simo siyenzeka ngokwemvelo, njengoba kwenza ezinye eziholela ekuhlukanisweni kokuzala. Enye indawo enjalo yiLake Victoria e-Afrika, edume ngokuhlukaniswa kwayo kwezinhlobo zezinhlanzi ze-cichlid. Abacwaningi bathole amakhulu emicimbi yokuhlukaniswa kwezinhlobo zezinhlanzi kulezi zinhlanzi, ezenzeke hhayi ngobuningi kuphela, kodwa futhi nangesikhathi esifushane. Isithombe 18.23 sibonisa lolu hlobo lokuhlukaniswa phakathi kwabantu bezinhlanzi ze-cichlid eNicaragua. Kule ndawo, izinhlobo ezimbili zama-cichlid zihlala endaweni efanayo kodwa ziye zaba nezinhlobo ezahlukene ezizivumela ukuthi zidle imithombo yokudla ehlukahlukene.
question1: Kuyini ukuhlukaniswa kokuzala?
answer1: Ukungakwazi kwezinhlobo ezimbili noma izinhlobo ukuzalanisa nokukhiqiza inzalo evundile
distractor1a: Ukungakwazi kwezinto eziphilayo ukusinda endaweni efanayo
distractor1c: Ukukhiqizwa kwenzalo efana nezakhi zofuzo
question2: Uyini umehluko phakathi kwezithiyo ze-prezygotic kanye ne-postzygotic?
answer2: Izithiyo ze-Prezygotic zivimbela ukukhulelwa, kanti izithiyo ze-postzygotic zisebenza ngemva kokuba i-zygote yakheke
distractor2a: Izithiyo ze-Prezygotic zenzeka ezitshalweni kuphela, kanti izithiyo ze-postzygotic zenzeka ezilwaneni kuphela.
distractor2b: Izithiyo ze-Prezygotic zivimbela ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo, kanti izithiyo ze-postzygotic zivimbela i-meiosis
question3: Kuyini ukuhlukaniswa okwesikhashana?
answer3: Isithiyo esingaphambi kwe-zygotic lapho izinhlobo zizala khona ngezikhathi ezahlukene
question4: Kuyini ukuhlukaniswa kwezindawo zokuhlala?
answer4: Isithiyo esiyingozi lapho izilwane zihlala ezindaweni ezahlukene zokuhlala futhi zingasasebenzisani ukuze zizalane
distractor4a: Isithiyo se-postzygotic esibangelwa ukungazali kwe-hybrid
question5: Yisiphi isibonelo esichaza kangcono ukuzihlukanisa nokuziphatha?
answer5: Izinhlobo ezahlukene zezimpukane zisebenzisa amaphethini okukhanya ahlukile adonsela amalungu ezinhlobo zazo kuphela
distractor5a: Izinhlobo ezimbili zamaxoxo zizalana ngezikhathi ezahlukene zonyaka
question6: Iyini isithiyo semidlalo?
answer6: Isithiyo esivimbela i-zygotic lapho isidoda neqanda kungakwazi ukuhlangana khona nokufeza ukukhulelwa
distractor6c: Isithiyo esibangelwa ukuhlukaniswa kwezindawo
question7: Kuyini ukungazali okuxubile?
answer7: Isithiyo se-postzygotic lapho inzalo exubile isinda khona kodwa ayikwazi ukuzala
distractor7c: Isimo lapho abazali bengakwazi ukukhiqiza ama-gametes
question8: I-sympatric speciation ingenzeka kanjani ezinhlanzini ezihlala echibini elifanayo?
answer8: Amaqembu ahlukene aqala ukusebenzisa izinsiza zokudla ezahlukene kanye nezindawo zokuhlala, okuholela ekuhlukaniseni ukuzala ngokuhamba kwesikhathi
distractor8c: Zonke izinhlanzi zithuthukisa ukuziphatha okufanayo kokudla
question9: Yiliphi iqembu lezinhlanzi eliqokonyiswa njengesibonelo sokuhluzwa okusheshayo kwe-sympatric?

chapterName: 4. Izinqubo Zokuziphendukela Kwemvelo | 18. Ukuziphendukela Kwemvelo Nomsuka Wezinhlobo | 18.3 Ukuxhumana Kabusha Namazinga Okukhethekile | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 4. Evolutionary Processes | 18. Evolution and Origin of Species | 18.3 Reconnection and Rates of Speciation | Connection for AP® Courses
chapterContent:
I-Speciation ingenzeka kancane kancane ngokuhamba kwesikhathi ngezinyathelo ezincane noma ngokuqhuma koshintsho olwaziwa ngokuthi i-punctuated equilibrium. Ngokulingana kwe-punctuated, uhlobo lungahlala lungashintshi isikhathi eside. Isici esiyinhloko esithonya izinguquko ezingeni le-speciation ushintsho lwezemvelo.

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyiswe esigabeni zisekela imiqondo echazwe ku-Big Idea 1 yoHlaka lweKharikhulamu lwe-AP® Biology. Izinhloso Zokufunda ze-AP® ezibalwe kuHlaka lweKharikhulamu zinikeza isisekelo esicacile senkambo ye-AP® Biology, ulwazi lwelabhorethri olusekelwe ekuphenyweni, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®. Inhloso yokufunda ihlanganisa okuqukethwe okudingekayo neyodwa noma ngaphezulu kwemikhuba yesayensi eyisikhombisa.

 I-Big Idea 1
Inqubo yokuziphendukela kwemvelo iqhuba ukuhlukahluka nobunye bokuphila.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 1.C
Ukuphila kuyaqhubeka nokuguquka ngaphakathi kwendawo eshintshayo.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
1.C.1 I-Speciation nokuphela kwayo kwenzeke kuwo wonke umlando woMhlaba.

 Umkhuba Wesayensi
5.1 Umfundi angahlaziya idatha ukuze abone amaphethini noma ubudlelwano.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
1.20 Umfundi uyakwazi ukuhlaziya idatha ehlobene nemibuzo yokuzikhethela kanye nokuqothulwa kuwo wonke umlando woMhlaba.

 I-Speciation yenzeka esikhathini sokuziphendukela kwemvelo, ngakho-ke lapho kuvela uhlobo olusha, kuba nesikhathi sokuguquka lapho izinhlobo ezihlobene eduze ziqhubeka nokusebenzisana
question1: Yiziphi izindlela ezimbili ezijwayelekile lapho ukuhlukaniswa kwezinhlobo ezahlukene kwenzeka khona ngokuhamba kwesikhathi?
answer1: Ushintsho oluhamba kancane kancane kanye nokulingana okuphawuliwe
distractor1a: Ukukhetha kwemvelo kanye nokuguquguquka kwezakhi zofuzo
distractor1c: Ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo kanye nokugeleza kwazo
question2: Kuyini ukulingana okuphawuliwe?
answer2: Iphethini lapho izinhlobo zihlala zingashintshi khona isikhathi eside ziphazanyiswa yizinkathi ezimfushane zoshintsho olusheshayo lokuziphendukela kwemvelo
distractor2a: Iphethini lapho ukuziphendukela kwemvelo kwenzeka khona njalo ngesivinini esingaguquki
distractor2b: Inqubo lapho izinhlobo zezilwane ziyeka ukuguquka unomphela
distractor2c: Ukuqongelela kancane kancane kwezinguquko esizukulwaneni esisodwa
question3: Ngokusho kwendima, yini into eyinhloko ethonya izinga lokuzikhethela?
answer3: Ushintsho lwemvelo
question4: Ngokusho kwe-AP Biology Big Idea 1, iyiphi inqubo eqhuba kokubili ukuhlukahluka kanye nobunye bokuphila?
answer4: Ukuziphendukela kwemvelo
distractor4a: Ukuhlukaniswa kweseli
question5: Kungani kuvame ukuba nesikhathi sokuguquka lapho kwakheka uhlobo olusha?
answer5: Imiphakathi ehlobene eduze ingaqhubeka nokuxhumana ngenkathi ukuhlukaniswa kokuzala sekuphelele
distractor5a: Izinhlobo ezintsha zivela ngokushesha ngaphandle kwezigaba eziphakathi
question6: Yimuphi umgomo wokufunda i-AP Biology ohlotshaniswa nokuhlaziya idatha ehlobene nokuhlukaniswa kanye nokuqothulwa kuwo wonke umlando woMhlaba?
answer6: Inhloso Yokufunda 1.20
distractor6c: Inhloso Yokufunda 2.3

chapterName: 4. Izinqubo Zokuziphendukela Kwemvelo | 18. Ukuziphendukela Kwemvelo Nomsuka Wezinhlobo | 18.3 Ukuxhumana Kabusha kanye Namazinga Okukhethekile | Ukuxhumana Kabusha
chapterNameEnglish: 4. Evolutionary Processes | 18. Evolution and Origin of Species | 18.3 Reconnection and Rates of Speciation | Reconnection
chapterContent:
Ngemva kokuhlukanisa, izinhlobo ezimbili zingaqhubeka nokusebenzisana unomphela noma ziphinde zihlangane. Izinto eziphilayo ngazinye zizohlangana nanoma yimuphi umuntu oseduze ongakwazi ukuzala naye. Indawo lapho izinhlobo ezimbili ezihlobene eduze ziqhubeka nokusebenzisana futhi zizalana khona, zakha izinhlobo ezixubile, ibizwa ngokuthi indawo exubile. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, indawo exubile ingashintsha kuye ngokufaneleka kwama-hybrid kanye nezithiyo zokuzala (Isithombe 18.24). Uma ama-hybrid engafaneleki kangako kunabazali, ukuqina kwe-speciation kwenzeka, futhi izinhlobo ziyaqhubeka nokuhlukana kuze kube yilapho zingasakwazi ukuhlangana futhi zikhiqize inzalo ephilayo. Uma izithiyo zokuzala ziba buthaka, ukuhlangana kwenzeka futhi izinhlobo ezimbili ziba yinto eyodwa. Izithiyo zihlala zifana uma ama-hybrid efanelekile futhi ezala: ukuzinza kungase kwenzeke futhi ukuhlanganiswa kuyaqhubeka.

 Ama-hybrid angafaneleka kangako kunabazali, afaneleke kakhulu, noma cishe afanayo. Ngokuvamile ama-hybrid avame ukungafaneleki kahle; ngakho-ke, ukuzala okunjalo kuncipha ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kushukumisela izinhlobo ezimbili ukuthi zihlukane kakhulu enqubweni ebizwa ngokuthi ukuqinisa. Leli gama lisetshenziswa ngoba impumelelo ephansi yama-hybrid iqinisa i-speciation yokuqala. Uma izinhlobo ezixubile zilingana noma zilingana kakhulu nabazali bazo, izinhlobo ezimbili zingase zihlangane zibe uhlobo olulodwa (Isithombe 18.25). Ososayensi baphinde baphawula ukuthi ngezinye izikhathi izinhlobo ezimbili zizohlala zihlukene kodwa futhi ziqhubeke nokusebenzisana ukuze zikhiqize ezinye izinhlobo ezixubile; lokhu kuhlukaniswa njengokuzinza ngoba akukho shintsho lwangempela olukhona.
question1: Iyini indawo exubile?
answer1: Isifunda lapho izinhlobo ezimbili ezihlobene eduze zihlangana khona, zizalane, futhi zikhiqize inzalo exubile
distractor1a: Indawo lapho uhlobo olulodwa kuphela luzala khona
distractor1b: Indawo yokuhlala lapho izinguquko zenzeka khona kaningi
distractor1c: Isifunda lapho ukuhlukanisa kungenzeki khona
question2: Kuyini ukuqinisa ekukhetheni?
answer2: Ukuqiniswa kwezithiyo zokuzala ngoba izinhlobo ezixubile azinampilo kangako kunezinhlobo zabazali bazo
question3: Kuyini ukuhlanganiswa komongo we-speciation?
answer3: Ukuhlanganiswa kwezinhlobo ezimbili zibe yinye ngoba izinhlobo ezixubile zilingana noma zilingana nabazali bazo.
question4: Kusho ukuthini ukuzinza endaweni exubile?
answer4: Lezi zinhlobo ezimbili zihlala zihlukene ngenkathi ziqhubeka nokukhiqiza inzalo ethile exubile
distractor4a: Inani labantu abaxubile lithatha indawo ngokuphelele yomibili izinhlobo zabazali
distractor4b: Lezi zinhlobo ezimbili ziyeka ukusebenzisana ngokuphelele
distractor4c: Inzalo exubile ihlala iba uhlobo olusha
question5: Ukufaneleka kwezinhlobo ezixubile kuthinta kanjani umphumela wendawo exubile?
answer5: Inquma ukuthi ukuqinisa, ukuhlangana, noma ukuzinza kungenzeka kakhulu
distractor5a: Akunamthelela ekusaseni labantu
distractor5b: Inquma kuphela izinga lokuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo
distractor5c: Ishintsha izinombolo ze-chromosome kuzo zombili izinhlobo zabazali
question6: Kungani ukuqinisa ngokuvamile kwenzeka lapho ama-hybrid engafaneleki kahle?
answer6: Ukukhetha kwemvelo kusiza abantu abagwema ukukhiqiza inzalo exubile enempilo ephansi
distractor6b: Inzalo ehlanganisiwe izala ngempumelelo kakhulu kunomzali ngamunye
distractor6c: Ukugeleza kwezakhi zofuzo kuyanda phakathi kwezinhlobo ezimbili
question7: Yimuphi umphumela ongaba khona uma izinhlobo ezixubile zilingana noma zilingana nezinhlobo zazo zabazali?
answer7: Ukuhlanganiswa kwezinhlobo ezimbili zibe uhlobo olulodwa
question8: Bheka uMfanekiso 18.24. Yiziphi izindlela ezintathu ezahlukene ezingasetshenziswa ukuziphendukela kwemvelo kwezinhlobo ezindaweni ezixubile?
answer8: Ukuzinza, ukuhlanganiswa, ukuqinisa
distractor8b: Ukuziphendukela kwemvelo okuhlangene, ukuziphendukela kwemvelo okuhlukile, akukho ukuziphendukela kwemvelo
distractor8c: Ukukhetha kwemvelo, ukuzulazula kwezakhi zofuzo, ukugeleza kwezakhi zofuzo

chapterName: 4. Izinqubo Zokuziphendukela Kwemvelo | 18. Ukuziphendukela Kwemvelo Nomsuka Wezinhlobo | 18.3 Ukuxhumana Kabusha Namazinga Okukhethekile | Amazinga Ahlukahlukene Okukhethekile
chapterNameEnglish: 4. Evolutionary Processes | 18. Evolution and Origin of Species | 18.3 Reconnection and Rates of Speciation | Varying Rates of Speciation
chapterContent:
Ososayensi emhlabeni wonke bafunda i-speciation, babhala phansi okubonwe yizinto eziphilayo kanye nalokho okutholakala kurekhodi lamathambo. Njengoba imibono yabo iqala ukuma futhi njengoba ucwaningo lwembula imininingwane emisha mayelana nendlela impilo eguquka ngayo, bakha amamodeli ukusiza ukuchaza amazinga e-speciation. Ngokuphathelene nokuthi i-speciation yenzeka ngokushesha kangakanani, kubhekwe amaphethini amabili okwamanje: imodeli ye-speciation ehamba kancane kancane kanye nemodeli ye-equilibrium ephawuliwe.

 Kumodeli ye-speciation ehamba kancane kancane, izinhlobo ziyahlukahluka kancane ngokuhamba kwesikhathi ngezinyathelo ezincane. Kumodeli ye-equilibrium ephawuliwe, uhlobo olusha lushintsha ngokushesha kusuka kohlobo lwabazali, bese luhlala lungashintshi isikhathi eside ngemva kwalokho (Isithombe 18.25). Le modeli yokushintsha kokuqala ibizwa ngokuthi i-punctuated equilibrium, ngoba iqala ngoshintsho lwe-punctuated noma oluqhubekayo bese ihlala ibhalansi ngemva kwalokho. Ngenkathi i-punctuated equilibrium isikisela ijubane elisheshayo, ayikukhiphi ngempela i-gradualism.

 Isici esiyinhloko esithonya izinguquko ezingeni le-speciation yizimo zemvelo. Ngaphansi kwezinye izimo, ukukhetha kwenzeka ngokushesha noma ngokugqamile. Cabanga ngohlobo lweminenke olwaluhlala nesakhiwo esifanayo esiyisisekelo iminyaka eyizinkulungwane eziningi. Izingqimba zezinsalela zazo zazizobonakala zifana isikhathi eside. Lapho kwenzeka ushintsho endaweni ezungezile—njengokwehla kwezinga lamanzi—inani elincane lezinto eziphilayo lihlukaniswa nezinye ngesikhathi esifushane, empeleni lakha inani elikhulu nelincane. Inani elincane labantu libhekene nezimo ezintsha zemvelo. Ngenxa yokuthi i-gene pool yalo yaba ncane kakhulu ngokushesha, noma yikuphi ukuhlukahluka okuvelayo nokusiza ekusindeni ezimweni ezintsha kuba uhlobo oluvelele.
question1: Yiziphi izinhlobo ezimbili ezinkulu ezichaza izinga lokuhlolwa kwekhwalithi?
answer1: Imodeli ye-speciation ehamba kancane kancane kanye nemodeli ye-equilibrium ehlanganisiwe
distractor1a: Ukuhlukaniswa kwe-allopatric kanye nokuhlukaniswa kwe-sympatric
distractor1b: Ukukhetha kwemvelo kanye nokuguquguquka kwezakhi zofuzo
distractor1c: Ukuziphendukela kwemvelo okuguquguqukayo kanye nokuziphendukela kwemvelo okuhlukahlukene

answer2: Izinhlobo ziguquka kancane kancane ngokuqongelela kwezinguquko ezincane ngokuhamba kwesikhathi eside
distractor2a: Izinhlobo zivela ngokuzumayo ngaphandle kwezinhlobo eziphakathi
distractor2b: Izinhlobo zihlala zingashintshi kuze kube phakade
question3: Iyini isici esiyinhloko semodeli yokulingana enezimpawu?
answer3: Ushintsho olusheshayo lokuziphendukela kwemvelo lulandelwa yizinkathi ezinde zoshintsho oluncane noma olungenalo nhlobo
distractor3a: Ukuziphendukela kwemvelo kuqhubeka ngesivinini esingaguquki phakathi nesikhathi
question4: Ingabe ukulingana okuphawuliwe akubandakanyi ukuvela kancane kancane?
answer4: Cha, ukulingana okuphawuliwe kusikisela ijubane elihlukile kodwa akukuvimbeli ukuqhubekela phambili
distractor4a: Yebo, ukuziphendukela kwemvelo kancane kancane akwenzeki
distractor4b: Yebo, womabili amamodeli awakwazi ukuba khona ku-biology
distractor4c: Cha, ngoba ukulingana okuphawuliwe kufana nokukhula kancane kancane
question5: Yini isici esiyinhloko esithonya izinga lokuzikhethela?
answer5: Izimo zemvelo
distractor5a: Usayizi womzimba
question6: Kungani inani elincane labantu elihlukanisiwe lingathuthuka ngokushesha ngemva kokushintsha kwemvelo?
answer6: Iqoqo layo elincane lezakhi zofuzo livumela ukuhlukahluka kwezakhi zofuzo okuzuzisayo ukuthi kuvame ngokushesha
distractor6a: Ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo kuyayeka ukwenzeka kubantu abancane
distractor6b: Imiphakathi emincane ihlala inezinhlobonhlobo ezinkulu zezakhi zofuzo
distractor6c: Ukukhetha kwemvelo akusasebenzi kubantu abancane
question7: Bheka uMfanekiso 18.25. Chaza isimo lapho ukulingana okuphawuliwe kungenzeka khona kakhulu
answer7: Kukhona ushintsho oluzumayo nolubalulekile endaweni ezungezile, njengokuqhuma kwentaba-mlilo okuhlukanisa abantu ababehlala ndawonye
distractor7a: Kukhona ushintsho olukhulu endaweni ezungezile ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, njengokuqhekeka kwezwekazi elikhulu ngenxa yomsebenzi we-tectonic
distractor7b: Uhlobo olunomncintiswano luyidlula futhi luyiqhubele ekuqothulweni, lukhulule izinsiza ezengeziwe
distractor7c: Kukhona indawo ezinzile nengashintshi lapho uhlobo oluthile lungachuma khona

chapterName: 4. Izinqubo Zokuziphendukela Kwemvelo | 18. Ukuziphendukela Kwemvelo kanye Nemvelaphi Yezinhlobo | 18.5 Isifinyezo Sesahluko
chapterNameEnglish: 4. Evolutionary Processes | 18. Evolution and Origin of Species | 18.5 Chapter Summary
chapterContent:
18.1 Ukuqonda Ukuziphendukela Kwemvelo
Ukuziphendukela kwemvelo kuyinqubo yokuzivumelanisa nezimo ngokuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo okuvumela izici ezifiselekayo ezengeziwe ukuba zidluliselwe esizukulwaneni esilandelayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinto eziphilayo zithuthukisa izici eziningi ezizuzisayo ekusindeni kwazo. Ukuze izinto eziphilayo zivumelane futhi zishintshele ekucindezelweni kwemvelo, ukuhlukahluka kwezakhi zofuzo kumele kube khona. Ngokuhlukahluka kwezakhi zofuzo, abantu banomehluko ngesimo kanye nomsebenzi ovumela abanye ukuba basinde ezimweni ezithile kangcono kunezinye. Lezi zinto eziphilayo zidlulisela izici zazo ezinhle enzalweni yazo. Ekugcineni, izindawo ziyashintsha, futhi lokho okwakuyisici esifiselekayo nesizuzisayo kungaba yisici esingathandeki futhi izinto eziphilayo zingase zithuthuke kakhulu. Ukuziphendukela kwemvelo kungahambisana nezici ezifanayo eziguquka ezinhlotsheni eziningi noma zihluke ngezici ezahlukahlukene eziguquka ezinhlotsheni eziningi ezivela kukhokho ofanayo. Ubufakazi bokuziphendukela kwemvelo bungabonakala ngokusebenzisa ikhodi ye-DNA kanye nerekhodi lezinsalela, kanye nokuba khona kwezakhiwo ezifanayo nezingenamsebenzi.

 18.2 Ukwakheka Kwezinhlobo Ezintsha
Ukuhlukahluka kwenzeka ngezindlela ezimbili eziyinhloko: ukuhlukaniswa kwezwe (ukuhlukaniswa kwe-allopatric) kanye nangezindlela ezenzeka ngaphakathi kwendawo yokuhlala ehlanganyelwe (ukuhlukaniswa kwe-sympatric). Zombili izindlela zihlukanisa inani labantu ngendlela yokuzala ngandlela thile. Izindlela zokuhlukaniswa kokuzala zisebenza njengezithiyo phakathi kwezinhlobo ezihlobene eduze, ezizivumela ukuthi zihlukane futhi zibe khona njengezinhlobo ezizimele ngokwezakhi zofuzo. Izithiyo ze-Prezygotic zivimba ukuzala ngaphambi kokwakheka kwe-zygote, kanti izithiyo ze-postzygotic zivimba ukuzala ngemva kokukhulelwa. Ukuze uhlobo olusha lukhule, kufanele kube khona okubangela ukwephulwa kwezithiyo zokuzala. Ukuhlukaniswa kwe-sympatric kungenzeka ngamaphutha ku-meiosis akha ama-gametes ngama-chromosome engeziwe (i-polyploidy). I-Autopolyploidy yenzeka ngaphakathi kohlobo olulodwa, kanti i-allopolyploidy yenzeka phakathi kwezinhlobo ezihlobene eduze.

 18.3 Ukuxhumana kabusha kanye namazinga e-Speciation
I-Speciation akuyona ukuhlukaniswa okuqondile: ukugqagqana phakathi kwezinhlobo ezihlobene eduze kungenzeka ezindaweni ezibizwa ngokuthi izindawo ezixubile. Izinto eziphilayo zizalana nezinye izinto eziphilayo ezifanayo. Ukufaneleka kwalezi zinhlobo ezixubile kungathinta indlela yokuziphendukela kwemvelo yalezi zinhlobo ezimbili. Ososayensi baphakamisa amamodeli amabili esilinganiso se-speciation: enye imodeli ibonisa ukuthi uhlobo lungashintsha kanjani kancane ngokuhamba kwesikhathi; enye imodeli ibonisa ukuthi ushintsho lungenzeka kanjani ngokushesha kusuka esizukulwaneni somzali kuya kolunye uhlobo. Zombili izinhlobo ziyaqhubeka nokulandela amaphethini okukhethwa kwemvelo

distractor5c: Uhlobo luyashintsha lapho amalungu ambalwa ethutha aye endaweni entsha
question6: Yisiphi isimo okungenzeka kakhulu sibe yisibonelo sokuziphendukela kwemvelo okuguquguqukayo?
answer6: Izimpethu nezinyoka zombili zihamba ngaphandle kwemilenze
distractor6a: Ezinye izinhlanzi ezihlala ebumnyameni obuphelele zinamehlo
distractor6c: Izimbali ezibukeka zihluke kakhulu zinezitho zokuzala ezifanayo
question7: Ziyini izakhiwo ezifanayo?
answer7: Izakhiwo ezifanayo ezintweni eziphilayo kanye nokhokho abafanayo
distractor7b: Izakhiwo zomzimba ezisetshenziswa ngezikhathi ezithile kuphela
distractor7c: Izakhiwo ezifanayo ezintweni eziphilayo ngaphandle komlando wokuziphendukela kwemvelo ohlanganyelwe
question8: Yiziphi kulezi zibonelo ezimbili zezakhiwo ezingasebenzi kahle?
answer8: Amathambo omlenze wangemuva emikhomeni namaqabunga e-cactus
question9: Yisiphi isitatimende esichaza kangcono ubudlelwano phakathi kwenkolelo-mbono yokuziphendukela kwemvelo kanye nemvelaphi yokuphila?
answer9: Le nkolelo-mbono ayizami ukuchaza imvelaphi yokuphila
distractor9a: Le mbono ihlanganisa incazelo yemvelaphi yokuphila
distractor9b: Le mbono ayikwazi ukuchaza imvelaphi yokuphila
distractor9c: Le nkolelo-mbono ayinikezi ukuqonda ezinqubweni zangaphambi kokuphila
question10: Yikuphi okuchaza kangcono okwenzekayo uma kusetshenziswa umuthi wokulwa namagciwane eqenjini lamagciwane?
answer10: I-gene yokumelana, esevele ikhona kubantu, iyanda ngokuphindaphindiwe
distractor10a: Amabhaktheriya aqala ukumelana nemithi elwa namagciwane ngokuphendula ngqo ekusetshenzisweni kwawo
distractor10b: Izinto zofuzo zamagciwane ziyashintshashintsha ngenxa yemithi elwa namagciwane, okuholela ekumelaneni
distractor10c: I-gene yokumelana, esevele ikhona kubantu, iyancipha ngobuningi bayo
answer11: Iqembu lezinto eziphilayo ezizalanayo futhi zikhiqize inzalo ephilayo nevundile
distractor11a: Iqembu lezinto eziphilayo ngazinye ezinokufana okuphawulekayo kwezakhi zofuzo
distractor11b: Iqembu lezinto eziphilayo ngazinye ezinokufana okuphawulekayo kwezakhi zofuzo ezinezici zangaphandle nezangaphakathi
question12: Yini ososayensi abagxila kuyo ukuze bahlukanise phakathi kwezinhlobo?
question13: Yimiphi imithombo emibili eyinhloko yokwehlukahluka kwezakhi zofuzo?
answer13: Ukuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo kanye nokuzala ngokocansi
distractor13b: Ukuzala ngokocansi kanye nokuzala okungenabo ucansi
question14: Yisiphi isitatimende esichaza kangcono ubudlelwano phakathi kokwehluka kwezakhi zofuzo kanye nokwakheka kwezakhi zofuzo?
answer14: Ngaphandle kokushintshashintsha kwezakhi zofuzo, ukuhluza ngezinhlobo ezithile bekungeke kwenzeke
distractor14a: Ngaphandle kokushintshashintsha kwezakhi zofuzo, ukuhlukaniswa kwezakhi zofuzo kuzokwenzeka kancane kakhulu
distractor14b: Ukwehlukahluka kwezakhi zofuzo kuthonya ukuhlukaniswa kwe-sympatric, kodwa hhayi ukuhlukaniswa kwe-allopatric
distractor14c: Akukho buhlobo phakathi kokwehluka kwezakhi zofuzo nanoma yiluphi uhlobo lwe-speciation
question15: Yisiphi isitatimende mayelana nezithiyo ze-postzygotic esingamanga?
distractor15c: Zihlanganisa izinto eziphilayo ezixubile ezingasindi esigabeni sokuzalwa
answer16: Izinhlobo ezimbili zezimbali ziheha izinambuzane ezahlukene
distractor16a: Izinhlobo ezimbili zezinhlanzi zikhiqiza inzalo engenamagciwane
distractor16b: Izinhlobo ezimbili zezinambuzane ziyazalana, kodwa i-zygote ayihlali
distractor16c: Izinhlobo ezimbili zezibankwa ziyahlangana, kodwa inzalo iyafa ngaphambi kokuba zizalane
distractor17a: Isiphepho sibangela ukuba izihlahla eziningana ezinkulu ziwe phansi
distractor17b: Ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo kubangela ukuba kuvele isici esisha
distractor17c: Ukulimala kubangela ukuthi umzimba ufune umthombo omusha wokudla
question18: Uyini umehluko omkhulu phakathi komuntu oyedwa osebenzisa i-autopolyploid nomuntu oyedwa osebenzisa i-allopolyploid?
question19: Yini ehlukile nge-speciation ngenxa yemisebe eguquguqukayo?
answer19: Kuholela ekubunjweni kwezinhlobo eziningi ezivela kohlobo olulodwa lomzali
distractor19a: Kwenzeka kuphela eziqhingini noma eduze kwazo
distractor19b: Kudinga ukuthi inani labantu lihlakazeke lisuke ezinhlotsheni zalo ezizalayo
question20: Yikuphi okungenzeka kakhulu ukuthi kube yisici esandisa amathuba okuba yi-speciation ngemisebe eguquguqukayo?
question21: Endaweni exubile, ngaphezu kokuxhumana, yini enye eyenziwa yizinhlobo ezimbili ezihlobene eduze?
question22: Yisiphi isimo esisho ukuthi ukuqina kungenzeka kakhulu endaweni ehlanganisiwe?
distractor22a: Inzalo exubile ifaneleka kakhulu kunezinhlobo zabazali
distractor22c: Inzalo exubile ilingana kahle nohlobo lwabazali bayo
answer23: Ukulingana kwezimpawu kungenzeka kakhulu kubantu abaningi endaweni ezinzile
distractor23a: Ukuhluzwa kancane kancane kanye nokulingana okuphawuliwe kokubili kuphumela ekwehlukeni kwezinhlobo
distractor23b: Kumodeli yokulingana okuphawuliwe, ukuqhubekela phambili akukhishwe ngaphandle
distractor23c: Kumodeli yokukhetha kancane kancane, izici ziyashintsha kancane kancane
question24: Yisiphi isici se-speciation esingaba yingxenye yokulingana okuphawuliwe?
question25: Yiziphi iziphetho ongazithola mayelana nobudlelwano phakathi kwendlela inkolelo-mbono yanamuhla yokuziphendukela kwemvelo eyathuthuka ngayo kanye nokwethembeka kwale nkolelo-mbono? Chaza ukucabanga kwakho
answer25: Kunengqondo ukuthi izazi zemvelo ezimbili ezisebenza ngokuzimela komunye nomunye zinikeze incazelo efanayo yesethi efanayo yezenzakalo. Lapho abantu ababili bebheka ubufakazi obufanayo ngokuzimela futhi befinyelela esiphethweni esifanayo, lokhu kuqinisa ukwethembeka kwaleso siphetho.
distractor25a: Lapho inkolelo-mbono yokuziphendukela kwemvelo iqala ukuphakanyiswa, yabhekana nokugxekwa okuningi nokungakholwa, kodwa isekelwa kabanzi namuhla. Imibono eye yamelana nokugxekwa okukhulu ithembekile kakhulu kunaleyo eyamukelwa kalula.
distractor25b: Inkolelo-mbono yokuziphendukela kwemvelo isekelwe kokubili ekubonweni kwezinto eziphilayo kanye nokwezemvelo, okwenza kube yinkolelo-mbono ethembeke kakhulu ngoba ingachaza kabanzi ngezwe
distractor25c: Inkolelo-mbono yokuziphendukela kwemvelo incike ekutheni izici zifuze kanjani, kodwa indlela esetshenziswa ngayo le nkolelo-mbono ayizange iqondwe lapho kuthuthukiswa le nkolelo-mbono. Lokhu kunciphisa ukwethembeka kwale nkolelo-mbono ngoba abantu abayidalile babengaqondi ukuthi isebenza kanjani.
question26: Chaza ukuthi ukuzivumelanisa nezimo, njengesivinini esingcono sokugijima, kuhlobana kanjani nokukhethwa kwemvelo
answer26: Uma ukuzivumelanisa nesivinini esingcono sokugijima kulawulwa yizakhi zofuzo futhi kuwusizo ekusindeni nasekuzaleni, ukuziphendukela kwemvelo kuzoyisiza
distractor26a: Uma ukuzivumelanisa nesivinini esingcono sokugijima kukuhle endaweni ethile, kuzolawulwa yizakhi zofuzo futhi ukuziphendukela kwemvelo kuzokwandisa
distractor26b: Uma ukuzivumelanisa nesivinini esingcono sokusebenza kuzuzisa ekusindeni nasekuzaleni, ukuguquka okungahleliwe kuzokukhetha ngokwemvelo
distractor26c: Uma ukuzivumelanisa nesivinini esingcono sokugijima kuthanda ukukhethwa kwemvelo, umzimba uzokhetha ngokwemvelo indawo lapho ungagijima khona kude kakhulu.
question27: Nikeza isibonelo sokuziphendukela kwemvelo okuguquguqukayo bese uchaza ukuthi kusekela kanjani inkolelo-mbono yokuziphendukela kwemvelo ngokukhetha kwemvelo
answer27: Isibonelo sokuziphendukela kwemvelo okuguquguqukayo ukuthuthukiswa komsebenzi ofanayo, ukundiza, ezintweni eziphilayo ezingenalo uhlu lozalo olufanayo lwamuva, njengezinambuzane nezinyoni. Iqiniso lokuthi amaphiko avumela ukundiza athuthukile kusuka ezakhiweni zokuqala ezihlukene kakhulu lisikisela ukuthi inqubo yokukhetha kwemvelo ingaveza ukuzivumelanisa okufanayo ezinhlotsheni ezimbili ezihlukene kakhulu zezinto eziphilayo ezihlanganyela indawo efanayo.
distractor27a: Isibonelo sokuziphendukela kwemvelo okuguquguqukayo ukuthuthukiswa komsebenzi ofanayo, ukubhukuda, ezintweni eziphilayo ezihlala ezingxenyeni ezahlukene zomhlaba, njengemikhomo yase-Arctic beluga kanye nemikhomo yesokudla yase-Antarctic. Iqiniso lokuthi izinto eziphilayo ezingathintani ziye zakha izici ezifanayo lisikisela ukuthi ukukhethwa kwemvelo kungaveza ukuzivumelanisa okufanayo ezintweni eziphilayo ezihlanganyela indawo efanayo.
distractor27b: Isibonelo sokuziphendukela kwemvelo okuguquguqukayo yisethi yezimo eziguquguqukayo, njengesivinini esingcono sokugijima noma ukuzingela okuphumelelayo, okwakhiwa uhlobo oluthile ngenxa yokuncintisana nohlobo olusha oluthuthela esifundeni esifanayo. Iqiniso lokuthi uhlobo luzivumelanisa nezimo ngemva kokuba luhlangane nomncintiswano lisikisela ukuthi ukukhetha kwemvelo kusebenza ngokushesha kakhulu ngezingcindezi eziphezulu zokukhetha.
distractor27c: Isibonelo sokuziphendukela kwemvelo okuhlangene ukuthuthukiswa kwesakhiwo sasendulo, igatsha, sibe izakhiwo ezimbili zesimanje ezahlukene, njengesandla nephiko. Iqiniso lokuthi ukukhethwa kwemvelo kungabangela isakhiwo ukuba sikhule ngezindlela ezimbili ezahlukene ngenxa yezimo zemvelo ezahlukene lisekela inkolelo-mbono yokuziphendukela kwemvelo.
question28: Kungani ososayensi bebheka izakhiwo ezingasebenzi njengobufakazi bokuziphendukela kwemvelo?
answer28: Izakhiwo ze-vestigial ziwumphumela wozalo olufanayo, ngakho-ke ziwubufakazi obuhle bokuthi izinhlobo ezahlukene zezinto eziphilayo zavela endaweni efanayo.
distractor28a: Izakhiwo ze-vestigial ziwumphumela wokuziphendukela kwemvelo okuhlangene, ngakho-ke ziwubufakazi obuhle bokuthi ukukhetha kwemvelo kusebenza ngendlela efanayo ezimweni zemvelo ezifanayo.
distractor28b: Izakhiwo ze-vestigial ziwumphumela wokuziphendukela kwemvelo okuhlangene, ngakho-ke ziwubufakazi obuhle bomgomo wokugcina wokuziphendukela kwemvelo
distractor28c: Izakhiwo ze-vestigial ziwumphumela wozalo olufanayo, ngakho-ke ziwubufakazi obuhle bomsuka ofanayo wazo zonke izinto eziphilayo.
question29: Ukuzalana kwezinto eziphilayo ezizalanayo ngokocansi kwenzeka lapho amangqamuzana amabili ocansi, noma ama-gametes, ehlangana. Ezinhlanzini, lokhu kwenzeka lapho isidoda sibhukuda emanzini ukuze sithole iqanda. Ezimbalini, impova isakazwa emoyeni bese ithwalwa iye kwenye imbali. Chaza ukuthi yiziphi izinguquko zokuziphendukela kwemvelo zokuzalana ezenzeka kubantu, ngokusekelwe eqinisweni lokuthi siyizilwane ezisemhlabeni
answer29: Abantu bazala ngomanyolo wangaphakathi, okuwuhlobo oluvikela ama-gametes ekomeni futhi kwandisa amathuba omanyolo ophumelelayo endaweni esemhlabeni.
distractor29a: Abantu bakhipha isidoda namaqanda emanzini lapho ukukhulelwa kwenzeka khona ngaphandle
distractor29b: Abantu bathembele emoyeni ukuze bathuthe isidoda phakathi kwabantu ngabanye
distractor29c: Abantu bazalana ngokwakha ama-spores athwalwa emoyeni
question30: Ngesikhathi uhlola i-genome yomuntu, uthola i-gene engahambisani nanoma yiziphi ezinye izinto eziphilayo ezaziwa ngumuntu. Uphetha ngokuthi le gene kumele ukuthi ihlukile kohlobo lwabantu futhi ayinakuvela kwenye into eziphilayo. Ingabe lokhu okutholiwe kungasho ukuthi abantu abanakho ukhokho ofanayo nazo zonke ezinye izinto eziphilayo eMhlabeni? Chaza impendulo yakho
answer30: Cha. Izakhi zofuzo eziyingqayizivele azisoze zadlula ubufakazi obuqand’ ikhanda bama-molecule nobesimo somzimba bokuthi abantu babelana ngozalo olufanayo nezinye izinto eziphilayo.
distractor30a: Yebo. Izakhi zofuzo ezihlukile zifakazela ukuthi abantu bavela ngokuzimela kuzo zonke ezinye izinto eziphilayo
distractor30b: Yebo. Noma yiluphi uhlobo lwezakhi zofuzo oluhlukile luyaphikisana nenkolelo-mbono yokuziphendukela kwemvelo
distractor30c: Cha. Zonke izakhi zofuzo kubantu kumele zifane nezazo zonke ezinye izinto eziphilayo
question31: Ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo ze-glucose 6-phosphate dehydrogenase (G6PD) kungabangela i-anemia engavamile uma izuzwe njengefa. Kodwa-ke, ama-homozygotes analolu guquko awathambekele kakhulu ekuthelelekeni nge-malaria, isifo esasiyisifo esibulalayo kakhulu emlandweni phakathi kwabantu. Qagela ukuthi lolu guquko luzothinta kanjani impilo yabantu abahlala emazweni lapho i-malaria isakazeke khona.
answer31: Ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo kungenzeka kwandise impilo ngoba ukuvikelwa kuma-malaria kunikeza ithuba lokusinda nokuzala ezindaweni lapho umalaleveva uvame khona.
distractor31a: Ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo kuzohlala kunciphisa ukuqina komzimba ngoba noma yikuphi ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo okubangela isifo kuyingozi
distractor31b: Ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo bekungeke kube namphumela ngoba ukukhetha kwemvelo akusebenzi kubantu
distractor31c: Ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo kuzonyamalala ngokushesha ngoba i-anemia ivimbela ufuzo
question32: Incazelo yesayensi yethiyori ihluke kanjani encazelweni evamile yolimi lwendabuko?
answer32: Ithiyori yesayensi iyisethi yezincazelo ezivivinywe kahle zeqoqo lezinto ezibonwe ngokwemvelo, kuyilapho abantu bevame ukuyisebenzisela ukusho ukuqagela noma ukuqagela
distractor32a: Ithiyori yesayensi iyinkolelo-mbono edinga ukuhlolwa, kanti abantu bavame ukusebenzisa ithiyori ukusho ukuqagela okulula
distractor32b: Ithiyori yesayensi inezingxenye eziningi kanye nezimo ezihlukile, kuyilapho abantu bevame ukuyisebenzisa ukusho isitatimende esiwumthetho wendawo yonke
distractor32c: Ithiyori yesayensi iwukuhlolwa komcabango ocatshangelwayo, kuyilapho abantu bevame ukuyisebenzisa ukusho isitatimende esisekelwe eqinisweni ngandlela-thile
question33: Kungani ukuba nendlela yokuchaza izinhlobo nokuhlukanisa phakathi kwazo kubalulekile ekutadisheni ukuziphendukela kwemvelo?
answer33: Esifundweni sokuziphendukela kwemvelo, uhlobo luyiyunithi lapho kulinganiswa khona ushintsho
distractor33a: Umehluko phakathi kwezinhlobo uvumela ososayensi ukuqonda imvelaphi efanayo yazo zonke izinhlobo
distractor33b: Incazelo evamile yezinhlobo ivumela ososayensi ukuba bavumelane ngazo zonke izici zombono wokuziphendukela kwemvelo
distractor33c: Ukwehlukana kungenzeka kuphela ezingeni lezinhlobo: akwenzeki ezinhlotsheni ezinkulu. Ngakho-ke kubalulekile ukwazi ukuthi yimaphi amaqembu ayizinhlobo ezihlukile
question34: Bheka uMfanekiso 18.26. Ingabe ukuguquka okufanayo kungathinta le nzalo yezinja?
answer34: Cha, ukuguquka koboya ngeke kuthinte amangqamuzana egciwane enja futhi ngeke kudlulele enzalweni yayo.
distractor34a: Yebo, izinguquko zizuzwa njengefa futhi zidluliselwa ebantwaneni
distractor34b: Kukhona amathuba angu-50% okuthi i-offpsring ithole ukuguqulwa, ngokusekelwe ekutheni iyiphi i-chromosome ethola kumzali
distractor34c: Ngaphandle kokuba omunye umzali ene-mutation efanayo, inzalo ngeke ithole i-mutation
question35: Iyiphi indima edlalwa yizithiyo ze-prezygotic kanye ne-postzygotic ku-speciation?
answer35: Izithiyo ze-Prezygotic kanye ne-postzygotic zivimbela ukuhlukana kwezinhlobo ukuze kungabikho ukugeleza kwezakhi zofuzo phakathi kwazo.
distractor35a: Izithiyo ze-Prezygotic kanye ne-postzygotic zivumela ukwakheka kwezinhlobo ezingafani kahle eziqinisa i-speciation
distractor35b: Izithiyo ze-Prezygotic kanye ne-postzygotic zivimbela ukufuduka kwalezi zinhlobo ezimbili, okubangela ukuthi zihlale zixhumana futhi ziqale ukuzalana.
distractor35c: Izithiyo ze-Prezygotic kanye ne-postzygotic zikhona kuphela ezinhlotsheni ezisanda kwakheka, okuvumela ososayensi ukuthi babone isikhathi sokwehlukana kwalezi zinhlobo.
question36: Yiluphi uhlobo lwe-speciation, i-allopatric noma i-sympatric, oluvame kakhulu? Kungani?
answer36: Ukuhlukaniswa kwe-allopatric kuvame kakhulu ngoba kuvimbela ukugeleza kwezakhi zofuzo phakathi kohlobo
distractor36a: I-Allopatric speciation ivame kakhulu ngoba ihilela izithiyo ezinamandla ze-prezygotic
distractor36b: Ukuhlukaniswa kwe-sympatric kuvame kakhulu ngoba kuvimbela ukugeleza kwezakhi zofuzo phakathi kohlobo
distractor36c: Ukuhlukaniswa kwe-Sympatric kuvame kakhulu ngoba kuhilela izithiyo ezinamandla ze-prezygotic
question37: Sebenzisa imisebe eguquguqukayo ukuchaza ukuhlukahluka kwama-finches uDarwin awabona eGalapagos
answer37: Kungenzeka ukuthi ama-finch ahlakazekile kusuka kohlobo olulodwa lomzali, futhi ukukhethwa kwemvelo okusekelwe emithonjeni yokudla ehlukene ezindaweni zokuhlala ezahlukene kwaholela ezinguqukweni eziguquguqukayo, okubonakala ezimweni ezahlukene zomlomo wezinhlobo ezahlukene - ngayinye ifanele uhlobo lokudla oluhlukile.
distractor37a: Cishe lezi zinkumbi zazinokhokho ofanayo lapho zifika esiqhingini, kodwa zabonisa izici ezahlukene. Uhlobo ngalunye lwezinkumbi lwahlalisa isiqhingi lapho izici zaso ezithile zizoba khona ezivumelana nezimo kakhulu.
distractor37b: Kungenzeka ukuthi lezi zinhlobo ze-finch zavela njengohlobo olulodwa lomzali, kodwa ngokuhamba kwesikhathi izinguquko zabangela ukuthi zikhule izithiyo zokuzala futhi zahlukana zibe izinhlobo ezahlukene. Ukuze kuncishiswe ukuncintisana, lolu hlobo lwabe seluphuma luyohlala eziqhingini ezahlukene.
distractor37c: Kungenzeka ukuthi uchungechunge lwezehlakalo ezinkulu lwabangela ukuthi uhlobo lwe-finch lokuqala luhlukane lube yizinhlobo eziningi ze-finch ezazihlala eziqhingini lapho uDarwin ezibona. Lezi zinhlobo ezahlukene zabe sezisakazeka eziqhingini ezahlukene futhi zajwayela izimo ezahlukene kuzo zonke
question38: Chaza isimo lapho ukuzalana okuxubile kungabangela ukuthi izinhlobo ezimbili zihlangane zibe yinye
answer38: Uma inzalo exubile iphilile kakhulu kunabazali, ukuzala cishe kuzoqhubeka phakathi kwezinhlobo zombili kanye nezinhlobo ezixubile, ekugcineni kufake zonke izinto eziphilayo ngaphansi kwesambulela sohlobo olulodwa.
distractor38a: Izinhlobo ezihlukene azikwazi ukuzalana, ngakho-ke ukuzalana okuxubile akwenzeki emvelweni
distractor38b: Izinhlobo ezimbili ezisanda kuhlukana zingazalana, zidale izinhlobo ezixubile ezingohlobo lokhokho wabazali bazo.
distractor38c: Uma izinhlobo ezimbili zihlala endaweni efanayo endaweni efanayo, zingancintisana noma zingabambisana futhi zizalane, ekugcineni zihlangane zibe uhlobo olulodwa.
question39:
Bheka uMfanekiso 18.27. Isithombe sibonisa inani lezinhlobo zamaxoxo ase-Asia. I-x-axis yisikhathi ngezigidi zeminyaka. Isithombe esiphezulu sibonisa uhlu oluyinhloko lwamaxoxo, kanti igrafu ikhombisa inani lezinhlobo zamaxoxo.

 Yisiphi isitatimende esichaza kangcono ukucaciswa kulesi sibonelo?
answer39: Lesi yisibonelo sokulingana okuphawuliwe, ngokuqhuma kwamuva kwe-speciation kunokuba kube yisilinganiso esiqhubekayo ngokuhamba kwesikhathi
distractor39a: Lesi yisibonelo sokuhlushwa kancane kancane, okwenzeka ngesivinini esicishe sihambisane nesikhathi
distractor39b: Lesi yisibonelo se-slowly speciation enesilinganiso esiphakeme kancane kunalokho obekulindelwe
distractor39c: Lesi yisibonelo sokulingana okunezimbobo futhi izinhlobo zamaxoxo zibhekana nokugxuma okungazelelwe
question40: Chaza isimo lapho ukuzalana okuxubile kungabangela ukuthi izinhlobo ezimbili ziqhubeke nokuhlukana
answer40: Uma izinhlobo ezimbili ezihlobene eduze ziqhubeka nokukhiqiza izinhlobo ezixubile ezingafaneleki kahle kunezinhlobo zabazali, kuzoba nokuqina kokwehluka
distractor40a: Uma izinhlobo ezimbili ezihlobene eduze ziqhubeka nokukhiqiza izinhlobo ezixubile, izinhlobo ezixubile zizoncintisana nazo zombili izinhlobo, okuzobangela ukuthi zithole izindawo ezintsha ezizothuthukisa ukwehlukana kwazo.
distractor40b: Uma izinhlobo ezimbili ezihlobene eduze ziqhubeka nokukhiqiza izinhlobo ezixubile, zizokwakha izithiyo zokuzala ukuze zivimbele ukukhiqizwa kwezinhlobo ezixubile, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi zihlala zihlukile.
distractor40c: Uma izinhlobo ezimbili ezihlobene eduze ziqhubeka nokukhiqiza izinhlobo ezixubile, zizohlala zihlangana zibe uhlobo olulodwa
question41:
Ngaphambi kuka-1800 eNgilandi, i-moth ejwayelekile yohlobo lwe-Biston betularia (i-peppered moth) yayinephethini yokukhanya. I-moths ezinombala omnyama zazingavamile. Ngasekupheleni kwekhulu le-19, i-moths ezinombala okhanyayo zazingavamile, kanti i-moths ezinephethini emnyama zaziningi.

 Imbangela yalolu shintsho kwakucatshangwa ukuthi kwakuwukudla kwezinyoni okukhethiwe (J.W. Tutt, 1896). Ngesikhathi senguquko yezimboni, i-soot kanye neminye imfucuza evela ezinqubweni zezimboni yabulala ama-lichen ezihlahla kanye neziqu zezihlahla ezimnyama. Ngakho-ke, ngaphambi kokungcola kwenguquko yezimboni, i-moths ezimnyama zavelela ezihlahleni ezinombala okhanyayo futhi zazisengozini yezilwane ezidla ezinye. Nokho, ngokukhuphuka kokungcola, umbala we-moths ezisengozini yezilwane ezidla ezinye washintsha waba ukukhanya.

 Yisiphi sezici ezilandelayo zombono kaDarwin wokuziphendukela kwemvelo esiboniswa ngokucacile indaba ye-moth enephepele?
answer41: Kukhona ukukhiqizwa okuhlukile kwabantu abanezimfanelo ezinhle

distractor41b: Kukhona ukwehluka okukhulu phakathi kwamalungu eqembu labantu
distractor41c: Iningi lezici zezinto eziphilayo lizuzwe njengefa

answer42: Ukwanda kwenani lamabhungane akhanyayo kanye nokwehla kwenani lamabhungane amnyama

question43:
Ngaphambi kuka-1800 eNgilandi, i-moth ejwayelekile yohlobo lwe-Biston betularia (i-peppered moth) yayinephethini yokukhanya. I-moth emnyama yayingavamile. Ngasekupheleni kwekhulu le-19, i-moth enombala okhanyayo yayingavamile, kanti i-moth enephethini emnyama yayiningi.

 Imbangela yalolu shintsho kwakucatshangwa ukuthi kwakuwukudla kwezinyoni okukhethiwe (J.W. Tutt, 1896). Ngesikhathi senguquko yezimboni, i-soot kanye neminye imfucuza evela ezinqubweni zezimboni yabulala ama-lichen ezihlahla kanye neziqu zezihlahla ezimnyama. Ngakho-ke, ngaphambi kokungcola kwenguquko yezimboni, i-moth emnyama yavelela ezihlahleni ezinombala okhanyayo futhi yayisengozini yezilwane ezidla ezinye. Nokho, ngokukhuphuka kokungcola, umbala we-moth esengozini yezilwane ezidla ezinye washintsha waba ukukhanya.

 Ngokuvamile isetshenziswa ezincwadini zebhayoloji, i-moth enephepper iyisibonelo esivamile soshintsho lokuziphendukela kwemvelo olusebenzayo. Isibonelo sichaza izinguquko kumaza e-allele eningi labantu - ushintsho oluncane, uma sikhuluma ngokuziphendukela kwemvelo. Ukuba khona kokubili kwezinhlobo zokukhanya nezimnyama ngaphakathi kwe-gene pool kuboniswa yindaba, kodwa i-peppered moth ihlala iyi-peppered moth.

 Yisiphi isimo, uma singase senzeke, esingaba yisibonelo soshintsho olukhulu lokuziphendukela kwemvelo?
answer43: Izimo ziyashintsha kangangokuthi uhlobo olumnyama lwenundu luyathandwa futhi uhlobo lokukhanya luyasuswa kubantu ngenxa yokudliwa. Izimo ziyashintsha futhi, uhlobo olumnyama luyathinteka. Luthuthukisa ukuzivumelanisa nezimo oluvikela ekudliweni
distractor43a: Izimo ziyashintsha ngendlela yokuthi uhlobo olumnyama lwenundu luyathandwa futhi uhlobo lokukhanya luyancipha kubantu ngenxa yokuzingelwa. Izimo ziyashintsha futhi, uhlobo olumnyama luyathinteka, futhi uhlobo lokukhanya lubuyela ekusabalaleni.
distractor43b: Izimo ziyashintsha ngendlela yokuthi uhlobo olumnyama lwenundu luyathandwa futhi uhlobo lokukhanya luyasuswa kubantu ngenxa yokuzingelwa. Izimo ziyashintsha futhi, uhlobo olumnyama lusengozini, futhi uhlobo olumnyama luyasuswa ngenxa yokuzingelwa.
distractor43c: Izimo ziyashintsha kangangokuthi uhlobo olumnyama lwenundu luyathandwa futhi uhlobo lokukhanya luyancipha kubantu ngenxa yokuzingelwa. Izimo ziyashintsha futhi, futhi zombili izinhlobo zinokwanda okufanayo.
question44: Bheka uMfanekiso 18.28. Yisiphi isiphetho esingasithola kulokhu kuqhathanisa?

question45: Ngayinye yalezi zinto ezilandelayo ivela emkhakheni wesayensi ohlukile. Yikuphi ukusekela okungcono kakhulu komqondo kaDarwin wokwehla ngokuguqulwa?
answer45: Izazi zezitshalo zinikeza ubufakazi bokuthi izitshalo zaseSouth America ezinesimo sezulu esipholile zifana kakhulu nezitshalo zasezindaweni ezishisayo zaseNingizimu Melika kunezitshalo zase-Europe ezinesimo sezulu esipholile
distractor45a: Izazi ze-geology zinikeza ubufakazi bokuthi ukuzamazama komhlaba kushintsha impilo ngokubangela ukuqothulwa okukhulu kwezilwane
distractor45b: Izazi zezilwane zinikeza ubufakazi bokuthi zimbalwa izinhlobo zezilwane ezihlala eziqhingini kunasezindaweni eziseduze.
distractor45c: Izazi zemvelo zinikeza ubufakazi bokuthi ukuhlukahluka kwezinhlobo kuyanda eduze kwenkabazwe
question46: Izazi ze-paleontologists zithole insalela yezinto eziphilayo okuthiwa i-Archeopteryx. Inezici eziningi ezifanayo nezilwane ezihuquzelayo, kodwa, njengezinyoni, ikhombisa ubufakazi bezimpaphe. Lobu bufakazi busekela siphi isici senkolelo-mbono yokuziphendukela kwemvelo?
question47: Yibuphi ubufakazi obulandelayo obubonisa ukuziphendukela kwemvelo njengenqubo eqhubekayo?
answer47: Ngawo-1940, ukutheleleka yibhaktheriya i-Staphylococcus aureus kwakungelashwa nge-penicillin; namuhla kukhona imiphakathi emelana ngokuphelele negciwane.
distractor47a: Ezinye izakhi zofuzo ezivela kubhaktheriya i-E. coli zinezinhla zofuzo ezifana nezakhi zofuzo ezitholakala kubantu
distractor47b: Izilwane ezincelisayo ze-Marsupial zihlala ezindaweni ezimbalwa emhlabeni namuhla - e-Australia, eNingizimu Melika, kanye nengxenye yeNyakatho Melika
distractor47c: Umlando wezinsalela ubonisa ukuthi uRodhocetus, isilwane esincelisayo sasemanzini esihlobene nemikhomo, wayenohlobo lwethambo leqakala elihlukile eqenjini lezilwane zasemhlabeni.
question48: Bheka uMfanekiso 18.29. Yenza umbono osekelwe kulesi sithombe

distractor48b: Kulezi zinkawu ezintathu ezinkulu, abantu bahlobene kakhulu nama-gorilla
distractor48c: Kulezi zinkawu ezintathu ezinkulu, abantu bahlobene kakhulu nama-orangutan
question49: Bheka uMfanekiso 18.30. Yenza umbono osekelwe kulesi sithombe

question50: Izakhi zofuzo ezibalulekile ekukhuleni kwezilwane ezisanda kuzalwa zilondolozwe kahle ngesikhathi sokuziphendukela kwemvelo. Lokhu kusho ukuthi zifana kakhulu phakathi kwezinhlobo ezahlukene kunezinye izakhi zofuzo eziningi. Yini echaza lokhu kulondolozwa kwezakhi zofuzo kuzo zonke izinhlobo zezilwane?
answer50: Izinguquko ezakhiweni zofuzo ezibalulekile ekuthuthukisweni kombungu bezincane kakhulu ngoba ukuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo kumbungu kuye kwakhulisa imiphumela kumuntu omdala.
distractor50a: Izinguquko ezakhiweni zofuzo ezibalulekile ekukhuleni kombungu bezincane kakhulu ngoba azikho izingcindezi ezikhethiwe kumuntu ngaphambi kokuba azalwe.
distractor50b: Izinguquko ezakhiweni zofuzo ezibalulekile ekuthuthukisweni kombungu bezincane kakhulu ngoba akukadluli isikhathi esiningi kusukela kwavela ukwehlukana kwezinhlobo ezahlukene zezilwane.
distractor50c: Izinguquko ezakhiweni zofuzo ezibalulekile ekukhuleni kombungu bezincane kakhulu ngoba imibungu yokuqala ibuthakathaka kakhulu futhi ngisho nokuguqulwa okuncane kungaholela ekufeni.
question51: Imilenze yangaphambili engaphezulu yabantu namakati inezakhiwo ezifanayo. Ngokuphambene nalokho, imilenze yangaphambili engaphezulu yemikhomo (amaphiko ayo) inamathambo anesimo nesilinganiso esihlukile kumakati nakubantu. Ngokuthakazelisayo, idatha yezakhi zofuzo isikisela ukuthi zonke izinto eziphilayo ezintathu zinokhokho ofanayo kusukela cishe esikhathini esifanayo. Iyiphi incazelo engaba khona yale mininingwane?
answer51: Iphiko lomkhomo liyisici esivumelana nezimo esiyingqayizivele endaweni yalo emanzini
distractor51a: Amakati nabantu bahlobene kakhulu kunanoma yimikhomo.
distractor51b: Ukuma kwemilenze yangaphambili yomkhomo kwavela ngenxa yokuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo okungekuhle
question52: I-Biogeography iwucwaningo lwezinhlobo zezinto eziphilayo njengoba zihlobene nendawo kanye nesikhathi se-geological. Umlando wezinsalela ubonisa ukuthi izinsalela zama-dinosaur zaqala eminyakeni engaba yizigidi ezingu-200 kuya kwezingu-250 edlule. Ungalindela yini ukuthi ukusatshalaliswa kwezinsalela zama-dinosaur okuqala kube kubanzi (emazwekazini amaningi) noma kube mncane (ezwekazini elilodwa noma ambalwa)? Chaza
answer52: Ububanzi ngoba ama-dinosaur aqala ngaphambi kokuhlukana kwePangaea
distractor52a: Ububanzi ngoba amanye ama-dinosaur ayekwazi ukundiza phakathi kwamazwekazi
distractor52b: Zincane ngoba zaphela ngokushesha kakhulu ukuba zingahlakazeka kude kakhulu
distractor52c: Zincane ngoba zaphila kudala kangangokuthi izinsalela zemfuyo seziphukile noma zinyamalale kakhulu
question53:
Igama elithi microevolution lichaza ukuziphendukela kwemvelo ngezinga layo elincane kakhulu: ushintsho kumaza e-allele kubantu abaningi ezizukulwaneni ngezizukulwane. I-DDT iyisibulala-zinambuzane esasisetshenziswa kabanzi e-United States kusukela ngawo-1940 kuya ku-1972. Ithebula elingezansi lifingqa imvamisa ethile ye-allele ezinhlotsheni zelebhu zempukane evamile yezithelo, i-Drosophila melanogaster.

 Izinhlobo eziqoqwe ezimpukaneni zasendle ngawo-1930 | Izinhlobo eziqoqwe ezimpukaneni zasendle ngawo-1960
Imvamisa ye-allele enikeza ukumelana kwe-DDT | 0% | 40%

 Usebenzisa lolu lwazi, chaza imodeli lapho ukukhetha kwemvelo kwathuthukisa khona ukufana phakathi kwe-D. mealanogaster nendawo yayo ngokusebenzisa i-microevolution
answer53: Ukusetshenziswa kabanzi kwe-DDT kusho ukuthi izimpukane zezithelo ezimelana ne-DDT zazilingana kakhulu ngokwezimo kunezinye ezingenayo i-DDT.
distractor53a: I-DDT yabulala ingxenye enkulu yabantu, futhi ama-allele akhona ezimpukaneni zezithelo ezisindile ayehlukile kulawo ayesebantwini bokuqala.
distractor53b: Ukuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo ngenxa yokusetshenziswa kwe-DDT kubangele ukuthi i-allele iveze ukumelana kwe-DDT kubantu.
distractor53c: Omiyane besifazane bakhetha ukuhlangana nomiyane besilisa ababene-allele ebangela ukumelana ne-DDT ngoba kwakuzokwenza inzalo yabo ilingane kangcono.
question54: Bheka uMfanekiso 18.31. Yisiphi isiphetho esingasithola kulezi zithombe?
answer54: Izilwane ezincelisayo eziboniswe lapha kanye nabantu babelana ngokhokho oyedwa owayene-ulna
distractor54a: Eziningi zezilwane ezincelisayo, i-ulna iyisakhiwo esingenalutho
distractor54b: Kumalulwane kanye nenyathi, ukujikeleziswa kwengalo kwenziwa ngezinye izindlela
distractor54c: Izilwane ezincelisayo ezihambayo, esikhundleni sokundiza, zine-ulna engeyona eyesikhashana
question55: Igciwane le-human immunodeficiency (HIV) lizalela ngokushesha okukhulu. Igciwane elilodwa lingaziphindaphinda izikhathi eziyizigidigidi esikhathini esisodwa samahora angama-24. Esimweni sokwelashwa okucatshangelwayo, inani le-HIV lesiguli liqukethe amagciwane amelana nemithi kuphela ngemva kwamasonto ambalwa nje okwelashwa. Lo mphumela wokwelashwa ungachazwa kanjani kangcono? Le ncazelo ibonisa kanjani ukuthi ukuvela kwemvelo kuyinqubo eqhubekayo?
answer55: Amagciwane angamelani namagciwane afa, kwathi lawo angamelani namagciwane asinda futhi aphinde azale ngokushesha. Lokhu kubonisa ukuvela kwento entsha njengenqubo eqhubekayo ngoba ushintsho kubantu abane-HIV luwumphumela wokukhetha kwemvelo.
distractor55a: Amagciwane amelana namagciwane adlulisela izakhi zawo zofuzo kumagciwane amelana namagciwane ukuze i-100% yamagciwane ibe namandla okumelana namagciwane. Lokhu kubonisa ukuvela kwemvelo njengenqubo eqhubekayo ngoba izakhi zofuzo zabantu zashintsha ngesikhathi sangempela.
distractor55b: Amagciwane aqala ukumelana nomuthi ngemva kokuchayeka kuwo ngokuphindaphindiwe. Lokhu kubonisa ukuvela kwesimo njengenqubo eqhubekayo ngoba amagciwane akwazi ukuzivumelanisa nezimo ezishintshayo.
distractor55c: Amagciwane angazweli emithini ayengcono kakhulu kunalawo angazweli emithini ekuqaleni, futhi ngokuhamba kwesikhathi abusa abantu abaningi. Lokhu kubonisa ukuvela kwemvelo njengenqubo eqhubekayo ngoba ukukhetha kwemvelo kwakuthanda uhlobo oluthile kunolunye.
question56:
Umngane uthi: Ukukhetha kwemvelo kumayelana nokusinda kwabantu abanamandla kakhulu emphakathini. Abanamandla kakhulu yilabo abanamandla kakhulu, abakhulu kakhulu, nabashesha kakhulu.”

 Ungavumelana nalelo gama? Chaza. Yibuphi ubufakazi obuvela emikhakheni yesayensi ongabunikeza ukusekela isivumelwano sakho noma ukungavumelani kwakho?
answer56: Okushiwo yi-fittest” akusho ukuthi kunamandla, kukhulu, futhi kuyashesha. Ukufaneleka, njengoba kuchazwe ngokwemibono yokuziphendukela kwemvelo, kuhlobene nokusinda kanye nokuzala kabusha kwezinto zofuzo. Isibonelo, inyoni yesilisa encane kodwa ekhangayo ingakhethwa yizinyoni zesifazane ukuze izalane, kanti enkulu kodwa enemibala engemihle ayiyona
distractor56a: Lesi sitatimende siyiqiniso. Uma into ephilayo ingenawo amandla futhi ishesha, ngeke iphile isikhathi eside ngokwanele ukuba izale futhi idlulisele izakhi zofuzo zayo, futhi uma ingenkulu futhi ingenawo amandla kunezinye izilwane ezizungezile ngeke ikwazi ukuncintisana ngomlingani. Izinhlobo eziningi zezilwane zasolwandle, isibonelo, zinendoda eyodwa kuphela ekwazi ukukhwelana. Kumelwe ibe yisilwane sasolwandle esinamandla kakhulu ukuze iwine zonke izinsikazi.
distractor56b: Izinto eziphilayo ezinamandla kakhulu akuzona ngempela ezisindayo. Ngezinye izikhathi yizinto eziphilayo ezingafaneleki kahle ezisindayo futhi zizalane. Isibonelo, esizukulwaneni esisodwa amagundane angakwazi ukufuna imbewu angazala kakhulu futhi alawule amagundane amahle okufuna imbewu. Kulesi simo, ukukhetha kwemvelo kuzokhetha uhlobo olungafaneleki kahle futhi kusakaze kubantu.
distractor56c: Incazelo yokufaneleka ayilungile. Izidalwa eziqinile nezisheshayo ziphilile kakhulu kunezibuthakathaka nezihamba kancane, kodwa izilwane ezinkulu zivame ukuba sengozini kunezincane ngoba zibonwa kalula yizilwane ezizingelayo. Isibonelo, unogwaja omkhulu uzohlala ensimini ngaphezu koncane futhi uzodliwa uklebe.
question57: Bheka uMfanekiso 18.32. Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okusekela kangcono umbono wokuthi umehluko embala wamaqabunga ulawulwa ngokwezakhi zofuzo?
answer57: Ukuba khona kwezithombo ezinamahlamvu aphuzi kanye nezinamaqabunga aluhlaza ngosuku lwe-14 esitsheni B
