distractor57b: Inani lembewu ehlume esitsheni A ngosuku lwesikhombisa nolweshumi nane
distractor57c: Ukufa kwazo zonke izithombo ezinamahlamvu aphuzi
question58: Sebenzisa idatha evela kuMfanekiso 18.32 ukuphendula lo mbuzo. Yikuphi okuchaza kangcono ukusebenza kwe-phenotype enamaqabunga aphuzi njengokwehluka okuncike ekukhetheni kwemvelo?
answer58: Uhlobo olunamaqabunga aphuzi alunambitheki ngoba, nakuba luhluma, izithombo azikwazi ukusinda lapho kukhona ukukhanya.

distractor58b: Ukuhluma kwe-phenotype enamaqabunga aphuzi kuyasheshiswa uma kuqhathaniswa ne-phenotype enamaqabunga aluhlaza.
distractor58c: Uhlobo olunamaqabunga aphuzi alukwazi ukumila ezindaweni ezinokukhanya
question59: Sebenzisa idatha evela kuMfanekiso 18.32 ukuphendula lo mbuzo. Izithombo ezinamahlamvu aphuzi azikwazi ukuguqula amandla okukhanya abe amandla amakhemikhali. Yikuphi ukuqaphela okungenzeka kwenziwe ngosuku lwama-21?
answer59: Azikho izithombo ezinamahlamvu aphuzi ezisaphila esitsheni A noma esitsheni B
distractor59a: Izithombo ezimbalwa ezinamahlamvu aphuzi ziphila esitsheni A, kodwa azikho esitsheni B
distractor59b: Izithombo ezimbalwa ezinamahlamvu aphuzi ziphila esitsheni B, kodwa azikho esitsheni A
distractor59c: Izithombo ezimbalwa ezinamahlamvu aphuzi ziphila esitsheni A nasesitsheni B
question60: Izinhlobo zexoxo lasebusuku zihlala eceleni komfula omude. Ngakolunye uhlangothi lwendawo engaba amakhilogremu ayi-10 ububanzi, kunezinhlobo zexoxo ezibonakala zifana. Yimuphi kule mininingwane elandelayo onganikeza ubufakazi obuqand’ ikhanda bokuthi lezi zinhlobo ezimbili zimelela izinhlobo ezahlukene?
answer60: Kubonakala sengathi kukhona amaxoxo axubile phakathi kwalezi zinhlobo ezimbili, kodwa ambalwa futhi abuthakathaka.
distractor60a: Izinhlobo zamaxoxo ngakolunye uhlangothi lwendawo enezinti azihlali ubusuku bonke.
distractor60b: Izinhlobo zezinyoni ezixubile ezivundile zitholakala phakathi kwezinye izinhlobo ezimbili
distractor60c: Izinhlobo ezimbili zamaxoxo ziziphatha ngendlela ehluke kakhulu ekuzaleni
question61: Bheka uMfanekiso 18.33. Ngokusekelwe eshadini, yiluphi uhlelo olufanele kakhulu abafundi abangalulandela?
answer61: Ukusebenzisa ukuqoqwa kwedatha okuhlobene ukuhlonza izingqimba zamadwala ezibekwe ngaphambi nangemva kokuqothulwa okukhulu, bese kuqoqa futhi kuqhathaniswe izinsalela zamathambo kulezo zingqimba
distractor61a: Ukusesha izingqimba zamadwala ezivundlile kunoma yiluphi uhlobo lwedwala bese uzama ukuthola lezo eziqukethe inani elikhulu kakhulu lezinsalela zasendulo
distractor61b: Uma ubheka kuphela ezingqimbeni ze-sedimentary eduze kwamanzi anamuhla ukuthola izinsalela zasolwandle zama-bivalves nama-trilobites
distractor61c: Ukuqoqa izinsalela zamatshe kuphela ezingqimbeni zamatshe ezibekwe ngaphambi kwesikhathi samaPermian eziqukethe amathambo ezilwane ezinomgogodla zakuqala
question62:
Kutholakale ukuthi izinhlobo zezitshalo zikhula ezintabeni eziphakeme ngaphezu kwama-2,500 amamitha . Izinhlobo zezitshalo ezibonakala zifana, ezinomehluko omncane, zitholakale ezintabeni ezifanayo eziphakeme ngaphansi kwama-2,300 amamitha .

 Chaza uhlelo lokuqoqa izinhlobo ezimbili zedatha ezinganikeza impendulo eqondile yombuzo: ingabe izinhlobo ezikhula ngaphezu kwama-2,500 amamitha kanye nezinhlobo ezikhula ngaphansi kwama-2,300 amamitha zimelela uhlobo olulodwa?
answer62: Ososayensi bangaqoqa imbewu futhi bahlole ukuthi ingabe ingavundiswa ukuze ikhiqize inzalo evundile. Bangahlola nendawo ephakathi kuka-2,500 amamitha no-2,300 amamitha ukuze babone ukuthi ngabe imiphakathi evundile exubile ingatholakala yini ihlala phakathi kwezinye imiphakathi emibili yezitshalo.
distractor62a: Ososayensi bangathatha ikhodi yezakhi zofuzo zesitshalo kusuka endaweni ngayinye ephakeme bese benquma ukuthi amasethi amabili e-DNA afana yini. Bangaphinde bafake izakhi zofuzo zesitshalo esisodwa emaseli avela kwesinye bese bebona ukuthi amaseli ayasinda yini.
distractor62b: Ososayensi bangabheka emlandweni wezinsalela ukuthola ukhokho wakamuva wezitshalo. Bangahlola nezintaba ezizungezile ukuze bathole ukuthi ukhokho wakamuva usaphila yini.
distractor62c: Ososayensi bangazalanisa la maqembu amabili endaweni efanayo futhi babone ukuthi, ezizukulwaneni eziningana, aqala yini ukubukeka afana kakhulu. Bangaphinde bashintshe amaqembu, bakhulise izitshalo eziphakeme kakhulu endaweni ephakeme kanye nezitshalo eziphakeme kakhulu endaweni ephakeme, futhi babone ukuthi ezokuqala ziqala yini ukubukeka njengezitshalo eziphakeme kakhulu kanti ezokugcina ziqala ukubukeka njengezitshalo eziphakeme kakhulu.
question63:
Kutholakale izinhlobo zezitshalo ezikhula ezintabeni eziphakeme ngaphezu kwama-2,500 amamitha. Izinhlobo zezitshalo ezibonakala zifana, ezinomehluko omncane, zitholakale ezintabeni ezifanayo eziphakeme ngaphansi kwama-2,300 amamitha.

 Ungahlola kanjani ukuthi ngabe i-speciation yenzekile?
answer63: Uma imbewu evela ezitshalweni ingahlanganiswa ibe yinzalo evundile, lezi zinhlobo ezimbili azikahlukaniswa ngokokuzala futhi zihlala ziyizinhlobo ezilodwa.
distractor63a: Hlola ukuthi umehluko omncane ku-phenotype uyasuswa yini lapho izitshalo ezimbili zikhuliswa endaweni efanayo
distractor63b: Uma izakhi zofuzo ezitshalwe phakathi kwezitshalo zisebenza kahle, khona-ke izitshalo kumele zifane ngokwanele ukuze zibe zezinhlobo ezifanayo.
distractor63c: Uma ososayensi bekwazi ukuthola ukhokho ofanayo wamaqembu amabili emlandweni wezinsalela noma emiphakathini engomakhelwane, khona-ke bangakwazi ukunquma ukuthi izitshalo zihlukanisiwe zaba izinhlobo ezahlukene noma zihlala ziyizinhlobo ezilodwa.
question64: Uma sicabanga ukuthi inani labantu linokwehluka kwezakhi zofuzo futhi lingaphansi kwethonya lokukhethwa kwemvelo, beka lezi zenzakalo ezilandelayo ngokulandelana kwazo:
answer64:
Ushintsho lwenzeka endaweni yabantu.
Abantu abangavumelani kahle nezimo abaphili ngesilinganiso esifanayo nabantu abavumelani kahle nezimo.
Abantu abavumelani kahle nezimo bashiya inzalo eningi kunabantu abangavumelani kahle nezimo.
Imvamisa yezakhi zofuzo ngaphakathi kwenani labantu iyashintsha.
Ukushintsha kwezinhlobo zezakhi zofuzo

Ukushintshashintsha kwe-phenotypic kuyashintsha.

question65: Isazi sezinto eziphilayo sifunda inani lama-voles iminyaka engama-20. Cishe phakathi nesikhathi sonke socwaningo, inani labantu lihlala phakathi kwabantu abangama-50 no-75. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ngaphansi kwengxenye yama-voles azalwa awaphili ukuze azale, ngenxa yokudliwa kanye nokuncintisana ngokudla. Bese kuthi, esizukulwaneni esisodwa, ama-80% ama-voles azalwa aphile ukuze azale. Inani labantu liyanda lifinyelele kubantu abayi-110. Yikuphi ukuphetha ngokudla kanye nokudliwa ongakukwenza ngesizukulwane esisodwa lapho ama-80% enzalo asinda khona? Yisiphi isibikezelo ongasenza mayelana nokwehluka kwezakhi zofuzo kanye ne-phenotypic kwenani labantu besikhathi esizayo kuleli qembu lama-voles?
answer65: Kungaba ukuthi kwakukhona ukudla okwengeziwe okutholakalayo noma izinga lokudla kwezilwane liyehla. Izizukulwane ezizayo zaleli qembu lama-voles kufanele zibonise ukuhlukahluka okukhulu kwezakhi zofuzo.
distractor65a: Kungaba ukudla okuncane okutholakalayo noma izinga lokudla landa. Izizukulwane ezizayo zaleli qembu lama-voles kufanele zibonise ukuhlukahluka okuncane kwezakhi zofuzo.
distractor65b: Kungaba ukudla okuncane okutholakalayo noma izinga lokudla landa. Izizukulwane ezizayo zaleli qembu lama-voles kufanele zibonise ukuhlukahluka okukhulu kwezakhi zofuzo.
distractor65c: Kungaba ukuthi kwakukhona ukudla okwengeziwe okutholakalayo noma izinga lokudla kwezilwane liyehla. Izizukulwane ezizayo zaleli qembu lama-voles kufanele zibonise ukuhlukahluka okuncane kwezakhi zofuzo.
question66: Kuneminyaka yesomiso emphakathini omncane, ohlukanisiwe. Ngesikhathi sesomiso, imbewu encane enamagobolondo amancane iba yivelakancane. Imbewu enkulu enamabhokisi aqinile iba yinto evamile. Imbewu enkulu, eqinile idliwa ngempumelelo yizinyoni ezinemilomo emikhulu nebanzi. Uma isomiso siqhubeka futhi inani lezinyoni emphakathini lihlala lihlukanisiwe, yiziphi izibikezelo zenani ongazenza ngaphansi kwethonya lokukhetha kwemvelo?
answer66: Kuzoba nezinyoni eziningi ezinemilomo emincane, emincane efayo kanye nezinyoni eziningi ezinemilomo emikhulu, ebanzi ezisindayo. Ukuzala okuhlukile kwezinyoni ezinemilomo emikhulu, ebanzi kuzoholela ezizukulwaneni ezilandelayo ekubeni nephesenti eliphezulu lezinyoni ezinemilomo emikhulu, ebanzi
distractor66a: Izinyoni ezinemilomo emincane, emincane zizokhula zibe nemilomo emikhulu, ebanzi ukuze zikwazi ukudla imbewu emikhulu. Lokhu kuzoholela ezizukulwaneni ezilandelayo ekubeni nephesenti eliphezulu lezinyoni ezinemilomo emikhulu, ebanzi.
distractor66b: Lolu hlobo luzohlukana lube izinhlobo ezimbili, olunye olunemilomo emincane, emincane kanye nolunye olunemilomo emikhulu, ebanzi. Lolu hlobo luzobe seluncintisana ngezinsizakusebenza
distractor66c: Ngeke kube khona izinguquko ze-phenotypic noma ze-genotypic kubantu
question67: Ngesinye isikhathi, abacwaningi bezinyoni esifundeni saseSulawesi e-Indonesia bachaze izinhlobo ze-Flowerpecker ezwenikazi kanye naseziqhingini zaseWakatobi njengohlobo olulodwa. Ukuhlolwa kabusha kwamuva nje kwezinhlobo ze-Wakatobi kwaholela ekuhlukanisweni kabusha kwalezi zinhlobo njengohlobo oluhlukile, i-Wakatobi Flowerpecker. Yibuphi ubufakazi obulandelayo, uma buyiqiniso, obungaba imbangela yalokhu kuhlelwa kabusha?
answer67: Imiphakathi isihlukanisiwe ngendlela yokuzala nezinhlobo zasezwenikazi
distractor67b: Izinhlobo zezilwane sezihluke ngokwesimo sazo ezinhlotsheni zasezwenikazi
question68: Yiliphi iphethini kurekhodi lezinsalela ongalindela ukulibona ukuze lisekele imodeli ye-slowly speciation? Ungalindela kanjani ukuthi leli phethini lihluke kuphethini kurekhodi lezinsalela elisekela imodeli yokulingana okuphawuliwe? Chaza
answer68: Uma kwenzeka ukuhlukahluka kancane kancane, irekhodi lezinsalela lizobonisa izinhlobo eziningi eziphakathi. Uma kwenzeka ukulingana okuphawuliwe, irekhodi lezinsalela lizobonisa izinhlobo ezintsha eziqhubeka zingashintshi ngokuphelele ezingqimbeni eziningana ze-geological, bese zinyamalala njengoba nje kuvela ifomu elisha.
distractor68a: Endabeni yokwakheka kwezinto ezincane kancane kancane, irekhodi lezinsalela lizobonisa izinhlobo ezimbalwa ezixubile, kulandelwe izinhlobo ezimbili ezihlukene. Endabeni yokulingana okuphawuliwe, irekhodi lezinsalela lizobonisa izinhlobo eziningi ezixubile eziqhubeka ngezingqimba eziningana ze-geological.
distractor68b: Uma kwenzeka ukuhlukahluka kancane kancane, irekhodi lezinsalela lizobonisa uhlobo lwabazali endaweni eyodwa, kangangokuthi uhlobo olusha oluhlukanisiwe luhlale luxhumana. Endabeni yokulingana okuphawuliwe, irekhodi lezinsalela lizobonisa ukuhlukana kwendawo ngaphakathi kohlobo lwabazali okwabangela ukuthi luhlukane lube izinhlobo eziningi ezintsha.
distractor68c: Ukuhluzwa kancane kancane bekungeke kubonakale kurekhodi lezinsalela. Endabeni yokulingana okuphawuliwe, irekhodi lezinsalela lizobonisa ukuqhubeka okuqhubekayo kwezinhlobo ezihlukile.
question69: Bheka uMfanekiso 18.12. Kuze kube muva nje, izinhlobo ezintathu ze-python ezinemisila emifushane, i-Python curtus, i-Python brongersmai, kanye ne-Python breitensteini zazibhekwa njengohlobo olulodwa. Kodwa-ke, ngenxa yezindawo ezahlukene lapho zitholakala khona, sezibe izinhlobo ezintathu ezihlukile. Iyini lesi isibonelo salokhu?
question70: Cabanga ngezinhlobo ezimbili zezinyoni ezahlukana ngenkathi zihlukene ngokwendawo kodwa zaqala ukuxhumana kwazo ngaphambi kokuba ukuhlukaniswa kokuzala kuphele. Yikuphi okuchaza isinyathelo sokuqala salokho okwakuzokwenzeka ngokuhamba kwesikhathi uma lezi zinhlobo ezimbili zihlangana kakhulu futhi inzalo yazo exubile isinda futhi yazala kabi kunenzalo evela ekuzalweni kwezinhlobo zangaphakathi?
answer70: Ukukhetha kwemvelo kungabangela ukuthi izithiyo ezivimbela ukuzala phakathi kohlobo lwabazali ziqine ngokuhamba kwesikhathi
distractor70a: Ukukhiqizwa kwezinhlobo ezingafani ezingafanele kuzokwanda futhi inqubo yokukhetha izophela
distractor70b: Ukuhlangana okubanzi phakathi kwalezi zinhlobo kuzoqhubeka nokukhiqiza inani elikhulu lezinhlobo ezixubile
distractor70c: Amaqoqo ezakhi zofuzo zohlobo lwabazali azohlangana ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, aguqule inqubo yokukhetha

chapterName: 4. Izinqubo Zokuziphendukela Kwemvelo | 19. Ukuziphendukela Kwemvelo Kwabantu | 19.0 Isingeniso
chapterNameEnglish: 4. Evolutionary Processes | 19. The Evolution of Populations | 19.0 Introduction
chapterContent: Imithi yokuziphendukela kwemvelo iyinsimu esanda kuvela esebenzisa inkolelo-mbono yokuziphendukela kwemvelo kwezokwelapha zanamuhla. Esikhundleni sokufuna nje izimpendulo zendlela ukugula okwenzeka ngayo, imithi yokuziphendukela kwemvelo ibuza nokuthi kungani ukugula kwenzeka. Le ndlela yezokwelapha iholele ekuthuthukisweni okuningi okubalulekile. Isibonelo, ama-retrovirus angokwemvelo (ama-ERV) ayizingcezu zama-retrovirus aqala ukuhlasela ama-genome ezincelisayo eminyakeni engaphezu kwezigidi eziyi-100 edlule. Ngesikhathi befunda ukuthi kungani izilwane ezincane ezincelisayo zivame ukuba nomdlavuza kaningi kunezilwane ezinkulu ezincelisayo, ososayensi bathole ukuthi izilwane ezinkulu ezincelisayo ziye zaba nama-ERV ambalwa ahlasela i-genome yazo. Ngenxa yokuthi ukuhlanganiswa kwe-retroviral kuhlotshaniswa nomdlavuza, imiphumela yalolu cwaningo iphakamisa ukuthi kungenzeka ukuthi izilwane ezinkulu ezincelisayo ziyakwazi ukulawula ukuphindaphindeka kwe-EVR kuze kube yilapho zifika eminyakeni yokuzala ngemva kokuzala.
question1: Iyini inhloso eyinhloko yezokwelapha ngokuziphendukela kwemvelo?
answer1: Ukuqonda kokubili ukuthi izifo zenzeka kanjani nokuthi kungani kusetshenziswa inkolelo-mbono yokuziphendukela kwemvelo
distractor1a: Ukufaka esikhundleni semithi yesimanje ngebhayoloji yokuziphendukela kwemvelo
distractor1b: Ukutadisha izifo zofuzo ezizuzwe njengefa kuphela
distractor1c: Ukuqeda zonke izifo ezithathelwanayo ngokugoma
question2: Ayini ama-retrovirus angokwemvelo (ama-ERV)?
answer2: Izingcezu zama-retrovirus ezahlanganiswa nama-genome ezilwane ezincelisayo eminyakeni eyizigidi edlule
distractor2b: Amaprotheni akhiqizwa isimiso somzimba sokuzivikela somuntu
question3: Cishe nini lapho ama-retrovirus angokwemvelo aqala khona ukuhlasela ama-genome ezilwane ezincelisayo?
answer3: Eminyakeni engaphezu kwezigidi eziyi-100 edlule
question4: Yibuphi ubudlelwano phakathi kobukhulu bezilwane ezincelisayo kanye nama-ERV atholwe ososayensi?
answer4: Izilwane ezincelisayo ezinkulu ngokuvamile zibe nama-ERV ambalwa ahlasela izakhi zofuzo zazo kunezilwane ezincelisayo ezincane.
distractor4a: Izilwane ezincelisayo ezinkulu zine-ERV eziningi kakhulu kunezilwane ezincelisayo ezincane
distractor4b: Zonke izilwane ezincelisayo zinenani elifanayo lama-ERV
distractor4c: Izilwane ezincelisayo zasolwandle kuphela eziqukethe ama-ERV
question5: Kungani ama-retrovirus angokwemvelo ebalulekile ocwaningweni lomdlavuza?
answer5: Ukuhlanganiswa kwe-retroviral kuhlotshaniswa nomdlavuza
distractor5a: Ama-ERV avimbela ngokuphelele umdlavuza ukuthi ungakhuli
question6: Yimuphi umbono ososayensi abawuphakamisile mayelana nezilwane ezincelisayo ezinkulu ngokusekelwe ocwaningweni lwe-ERV?
answer6: Bangase bacindezele ukuphindaphindeka kwe-ERV kuze kube yilapho sebeneminyaka yokuzala.
distractor6a: Ziqeda ngokuphelele wonke ama-retrovirus ngaphambi kokuzalwa
distractor6c: Zizala ngokushesha ukuze zigweme umdlavuza
question7: Bheka uMfanekiso 19.1. Ucwaningo ngama-retrovirus angokwemvelo lusikiselani ngokuvela kwezifo?
answer7: Umlando wokuziphendukela kwemvelo ungathonya ingozi yezifo zanamuhla kanye nokumelana nazo
distractor7a: Izifo zanamuhla azihlobene nomlando wokuziphendukela kwemvelo
distractor7b: Izifo ezithelelanayo kuphela ezithonywa ukuziphendukela kwemvelo

chapterName: 4. Izinqubo Zokuziphendukela Kwemvelo | 19. Ukuziphendukela Kwemvelo Kwabantu | 19.1 Ukuziphendukela Kwemvelo Kwabantu
chapterNameEnglish: 4. Evolutionary Processes | 19. The Evolution of Populations | 19.1 Population Evolution
chapterContent: Izindlela zofuzo, noma izakhi zofuzo, azizange ziqondwe ngesikhathi uCharles Darwin no-Alfred Russel Wallace bethuthukisa umqondo wabo wokukhetha kwemvelo. Lokhu kuntuleka kokuqonda kwakuyisikhubekiso ekuqondeni izici eziningi zokuziphendukela kwemvelo. Eqinisweni, inkolelo-mbono yezakhi zofuzo eyayivelele (neyayingalungile) yangaleso sikhathi, ukuxuba ifa, kwenza kwaba nzima ukuqonda ukuthi ukukhetha kwemvelo kungasebenza kanjani. UDarwin noWallace babengazi ngomsebenzi wezakhi zofuzo wendela yase-Austria uGregor Mendel, owanyatheliswa ngo-1866, ngemva nje kokushicilelwa kwencwadi kaDarwin, ethi On the Origin of Species. Umsebenzi kaMendel waphinde watholakala ekuqaleni kwekhulu lama-20 lapho izazi zezakhi zofuzo zazishesha ukuqonda izisekelo zefa. Ekuqaleni, uhlobo olusha lwezakhi zofuzo olutholakale lwenza kwaba nzima ngososayensi bezinto eziphilayo ukuqonda ukuthi ukuziphendukela kwemvelo kungenzeka kanjani kancane kancane. Kodwa eminyakeni embalwa eyalandela izakhi zofuzo nokuziphendukela kwemvelo kwahlanganiswa kulokho okwaziwa ngokuthi ukuhlanganiswa kwesimanje—ukuqonda okuhlangene kobudlelwano phakathi kokukhethwa kwemvelo nezakhi zofuzo okwaqala ngawo-1940 futhi okwamukelwa kabanzi namuhla. Ngamafuphi, ukuhlanganiswa kwesimanje kuchaza indlela izinqubo zokuziphendukela kwemvelo, njengokukhethwa kwemvelo, ezingathinta ngayo ukwakheka kwezakhi zofuzo zabantu, futhi, lokhu kungaholela ekuguqukeni kancane kancane kwabantu nezinhlobo. Le mbono iphinde ixhumanise lolu shintsho lwabantu ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, olubizwa ngokuthi ukuguquka okuncane, nezinqubo ezadala izinhlobo ezintsha namaqembu aphezulu e-taxonomic anezinhlamvu ezihlukene kakhulu, ezibizwa ngokuthi ukuguquka okukhulu.
question1: Yikuphi ukulinganiselwa okukhulu okwathinta ukuqonda kukaDarwin noWallaces ngokuziphendukela kwemvelo?
answer1: Babengaziqondi izindlela zofuzo zofuzo
distractor1a: Babengakholelwa ukuthi izinhlobo zezilwane ziyashintsha ngokuhamba kwesikhathi
distractor1b: Benqaba ukukhethwa kwemvelo njengendlela yokuziphendukela kwemvelo
distractor1c: Babekholelwa ukuthi ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo kwakuwukuphela komthombo wokuziphendukela kwemvelo
question2: Yimuphi umbono ongalungile wefa okwenza kwaba nzima ukuchaza ukukhethwa kwemvelo ngesikhathi sikaDarwin?
answer2: Ifa lokuxuba
question3: Umsebenzi kabani ngefa owawungaziwa uDarwin noWallace lapho bethuthukisa inkolelo-mbono yokukhetha kwemvelo?
answer3: UGregor Mendel
question4: Kuyini ukuhlanganiswa kwesimanje?
answer4: Ukuhlanganiswa kwezakhi zofuzo kanye nenkolelo-mbono yokuziphendukela kwemvelo echaza indlela ukukhetha kwemvelo okushintsha ngayo inani labantu ngokuhamba kwesikhathi

chapterName: 4. Izinqubo Zokuziphendukela Kwemvelo | 19. Ukuziphendukela Kwemvelo | 19.1 Ukuziphendukela Kwemvelo | Ukuxhumana Nezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 4. Evolutionary Processes | 19. The Evolution of Populations | 19.1 Population Evolution | Connection for AP® Courses
chapterContent:
Izakhi zofuzo zabantu zifunda ngokuguquguquka okuncane ngokulinganisa izinguquko kumaza e-allele abantu ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. (Khumbula ukuthi safunda izinhlobo zezakhi zofuzo kanye namaza e-allele lapho sihlola amaphethini efa ahlongozwe nguMendel.) Isibonelo, ososayensi abahlola amaza e-allele ku-gene yokumelana nezibulala-zinambuzane komiyane e-Equatorial Guinea bathole ukuthi imvamisa ye-allele eyodwa yokumelana yayingu-6.3%, kanti imvamisa ye-allele yesibili yokumelana yayingu-74.6%, kanti imvamisa ye-allele yokungamelani yayingu-19.0%. Lawa maza amathathu afinyelela ku-100%.2 Iqoqo lezakhi zofuzo zabantu liyisamba sazo zonke i-allele. Uma lawa maza angashintshi ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, abantu kuthiwa basesimisweni se-Hardy-Weinberg sokulingana—isimo esizinzile, esingaguquki. Kodwa-ke, uma i-phenotype ithandwa ukukhethwa kwemvelo, amaza e-allele angashintsha. Uma kunjalo, abantu bayashintsha. Ngezinye izikhathi amaza e-allele kubantu ayashintsha ngokungahleliwe ngaphandle kwenzuzo kubantu ngaphezu kwamaza e-allele akhona. Lesi simo sibizwa ngokuthi i-genetic drift. Isenzakalo esiqala ushintsho lwemvamisa ye-allele engxenyeni ehlukanisiwe yabantu, okungavamile kubantu bokuqala, sibizwa ngokuthi umphumela womsunguli. Ku-Population Genetics, sizohlola ukuthi ukukhethwa kwemvelo, ukuzulazula okungahleliwe, kanye nemiphumela yomsunguli kungaholela kanjani ezinguqukweni ezibalulekile ku-genome yabantu.

 Ukulingana kwe-Hardy-Weinberg kubonisa isimo sokuhlala njalo echibini lezakhi zofuzo zabantu. Ngamanye amazwi, amaza e-allele ahlala eqinile kusukela esizukulwaneni kuya kwesinye uma izimo ezithile zihlangatshezwa: akukho zinguquko, akukho ukugeleza kwezakhi zofuzo, ukuhlangana okungahleliwe, akukho ukuzulazula kwezakhi zofuzo, kanye nokukhethwa. Ngenxa yokuthi lezi zimo azihlangatshezwa njalo, amaza e-allele avame ukushintsha, abonisa ukuziphendukela kwemvelo. Isimiso se-Hardy-Weinberg simelelwa yi-equation yezibalo p2 + 2pq + q2 = 1, lapho u-p emele imvamisa ye-allele eyinhloko kanye no-q emele imvamisa ye-allele ephindaphindayo. Ukuphambuka ku-Hardy-Weinberg equilibrium kusenza sikwazi ukukala ukushintshashintsha kwe-microevolutionary kubantu lapho enye noma ngaphezulu kwe-Hardy-Weinberg para amamitha ishintsha. Isibonelo, uma sibuyela emuva esifundweni sama-frequency ama-allele ku-gene yokumelana nezibulala-zinambuzane, ngemva kokuba indawo iphathwe ngezibulala-zinambuzane iminyaka emibili, ama-allele okumelana akhuphuke afika ku-11.1% kanye no-83.3%, ngokulandelana, kuyilapho i-allele yokungamelani yehle yafika ku-5.6%. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi ukuguquka okuncane kwakwenzeka.

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyiswe esigabeni zisekela imiqondo echazwe ku-Big Idea 1 yoHlaka Lwekharikhulamu lwe-AP® Biology. Izinhloso Zokufunda ze-AP® ezibalwe kuHlaka Lwekharikhulamu zinikeza isisekelo esicacile senkambo ye-AP® Biology, ulwazi lwelabhorethri olusekelwe ekuphenyweni, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®. Inhloso yokufunda ihlanganisa okuqukethwe okudingekayo nenye noma ngaphezulu kwemikhuba yesayensi eyisikhombisa.

chapterName: 4. Izinqubo Zokuziphendukela Kwemvelo | 19. Ukuziphendukela Kwemvelo | 19.1 Ukuziphendukela Kwemvelo | Ukuziphendukela Kwemvelo kanye Nemithi Yokugomela Umkhuhlane
chapterNameEnglish: 4. Evolutionary Processes | 19. The Evolution of Populations | 19.1 Population Evolution | Evolution and Flu Vaccines
chapterContent:
Njalo ekwindla, abezindaba baqala ukubika ngokugonywa komkhuhlane kanye nokuqubuka okungenzeka. Ososayensi, ochwepheshe bezempilo, kanye nezikhungo banquma izincomo zezingxenye ezahlukene zabantu, babikezela ukukhiqizwa okuhle kakhulu kanye namashejuli okugonywa, badale imijovo, futhi bamise imitholampilo ukuze bahlinzeke ngemijovo. Ungase ucabange ngomjovo womkhuhlane waminyaka yonke njengodumo oluningi lwabezindaba, isivikelo esibalulekile sempilo, noma nje ukuhlatshwa okungakhululekile engalweni yakho. Kodwa ingabe ucabanga ngakho ngokwezimo zokuziphendukela kwemvelo?

 I-hype yabezindaba yemijovo yomkhuhlane waminyaka yonke isekelwe ngokwesayensi ekuqondeni kwethu ukuziphendukela kwemvelo. Unyaka ngamunye, ososayensi emhlabeni wonke balwela ukubikezela izinhlobo zomkhuhlane abalindele ukuthi zisakazeke kakhulu futhi zibe yingozi ngonyaka ozayo. Lolu lwazi lusekelwe endleleni izinhlobo zomkhuhlane eziye zavela ngayo ngokuhamba kwesikhathi kanye nasezinkathini ezimbalwa ezedlule zomkhuhlane. Ososayensi basebenza ukudala umjovo osebenza kahle kakhulu wokulwa nalezo zinhlobo ezikhethiwe. Amakhulu ezigidi zemithamo akhiqizwa ngesikhathi esifushane ukuze kuhlinzekwe imijovo kubantu ababalulekile ngesikhathi esifanele.

 Ngenxa yokuthi amagciwane, njengomkhuhlane, ashintsha ngokushesha kakhulu (ikakhulukazi ngesikhathi sokuziphendukela kwemvelo), lokhu kuletha inselele enkulu. Amagciwane ayashintshashintsha futhi azalane ngesivinini esikhulu, ngakho-ke umuthi wokugomela owakhelwe ukuvikela uhlobo lomkhuhlane lwangonyaka odlule ungase unganikezi isivikelo esidingekayo kulolu hlobo lonyaka ozayo. Ukuvela kwala magciwane kusho ukuqhubeka nokuzivumelanisa nezimo ukuqinisekisa ukusinda, okuhlanganisa nokuzivumelanisa nezimo ukuze usinde emithini yokugomela yangaphambilini.
question1: Kungani kufanele kuthuthukiswe umuthi omusha wokugomela umkhuhlane minyaka yonke?
answer1: Ngoba amagciwane omkhuhlane ashintsha ngokushesha ngokuguqulwa okuvamile, okubangela ukuba kuvele izinhlobo ezintsha
distractor1a: Ngoba amasosha omzimba womuntu akhohlwa ukutheleleka kwangaphambilini minyaka yonke
distractor1b: Ngoba imijovo ihlala isebenza inyanga eyodwa kuphela
distractor1c: Ngoba amagciwane omkhuhlane azalana kanye kuphela ngonyaka
question2: Ososayensi banquma kanjani ukuthi yiziphi izinhlobo zomkhuhlane okufanele zifakwe emgomeni waminyaka yonke?
answer2: Ngokubikezela ukuthi yiziphi izinhlobo zomkhuhlane okungenzeka ukuthi zisakazeke kakhulu futhi zibe yingozi ngokusekelwe ekuguqukeni kwamuva
distractor2a: Ngokukhetha izinhlobo zomkhuhlane ezindala kakhulu ezaziwayo
question3: Kungani amagciwane omkhuhlane eshintsha ngokushesha kangaka?
answer3: Ziyashintsha futhi ziphindaphindeke ngesivinini esikhulu kakhulu
distractor3c: Bane-DNA eqinile ngendlela engavamile engashintshi kakhulu
question4: Kungani umuthi wokugomela umkhuhlane wonyaka odlule ungase unikeze isivikelo esincane kulo nyaka?
answer4: Igciwane kungenzeka ukuthi seliphenduke izinhlobo ezintsha ezihlukile kulezo eziqondiswe emgomeni wangaphambilini.
distractor4a: Umuthi wokugoma uba buthaka unomphela ngemva konyaka owodwa
distractor4b: Abantu baba sengozini yokumelana nezakhi zofuzo emithini yokugoma
distractor4c: Amasosha omzimba awakwazi ukubona amagciwane kabili
question5: Ukuziphendukela kwemvelo kusiza kanjani amagciwane ukuba asinde?
answer5: Ukuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo kungadala ukuzivumelanisa nezimo okusiza amagciwane ukuba agweme ukuzivikela komzimba kanye nemithi yokugoma yangaphambilini
distractor5a: Amagciwane ashintsha ngamabomu ukuze agweme imijovo yokugoma
distractor5b: Amagciwane ayayeka ukuzala lapho kufakwa imijovo
distractor5c: Amagciwane athola ifa lokuzivikela komzimba elitholwe kubasingathi abathelelekile
question6: Izakhi zofuzo zabantu ziwucwaningo lwani?
answer6: Indlela amandla akhethayo ashintsha ngayo imvamisa ye-allele kubantu ngokuhamba kwesikhathi
distractor6a: Isisekelo sezakhi zofuzo sezimpawu zofuzo ngaphakathi kwabantu ngabanye
distractor6c: Izinga lokuzalelana kwezilwane ezizalwa ndawonye emphakathini

chapterName: 4. Izinqubo Zokuziphendukela Kwemvelo | 19. Ukuziphendukela Kwemvelo | 19.1 Ukuziphendukela Kwemvelo | Ufuzo Lwemvelo
chapterNameEnglish: 4. Evolutionary Processes | 19. The Evolution of Populations | 19.1 Population Evolution | Population Genetics
chapterContent:
Khumbula ukuthi i-gene yomlingiswa othile ingaba nama-allele amaningana, noma izinhlobo, ezibonisa izici ezahlukene ezihlobene nalowo mlingiswa. Isibonelo, ohlelweni lwe-ABO lohlobo lwegazi kubantu, ama-allele amathathu anquma i-carbohydrate yohlobo lwegazi ethile ebusweni bamaseli abomvu egazi. Umuntu ngamunye eqenjini lezinto eziphilayo ze-diploid angathwala ama-allele amabili kuphela gene ethile, kodwa angaphezu kwamabili angaba khona kubantu abakha iqembu labantu. UMendel walandela ama-allele njengoba azuzwe njengomzali kuya enzalweni. Ekuqaleni kwekhulu lama-20, izazi zezinto eziphilayo emkhakheni wocwaningo owaziwa ngokuthi i-population genetics zaqala ukutadisha ukuthi amandla akhethayo ashintsha kanjani iqembu labantu ngokushintsha kwama-allele kanye nama-genotypic frequency.

 I-allele frequency (noma i-gene frequency) iyisilinganiso se-allele ethile ngaphakathi kweqembu labantu, uma kuqhathaniswa nazo zonke ezinye i-allele zalowo mlingiswa ezikhona kubantu. Kuze kube manje sixoxe ngokuziphendukela kwemvelo njengoshintsho ezicini zeqembu lezinto eziphilayo, kodwa ngemuva kwalolo shintsho lwe-phenotypic kukhona ushintsho lwezakhi zofuzo. Ku-population genetics, igama elithi ukuziphendukela kwemvelo lichazwa njengoshintsho ekuvameni kwe-allele kubantu. Kusetshenziswa uhlelo lwegazi lwe-ABO njengesibonelo, imvamisa yenye yama-allele, i-IA, inani lamakhophi aleyo allele ehlukaniswe yiwo wonke amakhophi e-ABO gene kubantu. Isibonelo, ucwaningo olwenziwe eJordan3 luthole ukuthi imvamisa ye-IA ingu-26.1%. Ama-allele e-IB kanye ne-I0 akha amaphesenti angu-13.4 kanye namaphesenti angu-60.5 ama-allele ngokulandelana, futhi wonke ama-frequency angeziwe afinyelela ku-100%. Ushintsho kulesi mvamisa ngokuhamba kwesikhathi luzokwakha ukuvela kwabantu.

 Imvamisa ye-allele ngaphakathi kwabantu abanikiwe ingashintsha kuye ngezici zemvelo; ngakho-ke, ama-allele athile asakazeka kakhulu kunezinye ngesikhathi senqubo yokukhetha kwemvelo. Ukukhetha kwemvelo kungashintsha ukwakheka kwezakhi zofuzo zabantu; isibonelo, uma i-allele ethile inikeza uhlobo oluvumela umuntu ukuthi aphile kangcono noma abe nabantwana abaningi. Ngenxa yokuthi iningi lalabo bantwana lizophinde lithwale i-allele ezuzisayo, futhi ngokuvamile i-phenotype ehambisanayo, bazoba nenzalo yabo eyengeziwe ethwala i-allele, ngaleyo ndlela, kuqhubeke umjikelezo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, i-allele izosabalala kulo lonke inani labantu. Amanye ama-allele azohlala ezinzile ngale ndlela, okusho ukuthi wonke umuntu emphakathini uzothwala i-allele, kuyilapho izinguquko ezilimazayo zingasuswa ngokushesha uma zitholakala ku-allele evelele evela echibini lezakhi zofuzo. I-gene pool iyisamba sazo zonke ama-allele kubantu.

 Ngezinye izikhathi, ama-allele amaningi ngaphakathi kwabantu ashintsha ngokungahleliwe ngaphandle kwenzuzo kubantu ngaphezu kwama-allele akhona. Lesi simo sibizwa ngokuthi i-genetic drift. Ukukhethwa kwemvelo kanye ne-genetic drift ngokuvamile kwenzeka ngesikhathi esisodwa kubantu futhi akuzona izehlakalo ezizimele. Kunzima ukunquma ukuthi iyiphi inqubo ebusayo ngoba ngokuvamile akunakwenzeka ukunquma imbangela yoshintsho kuma-allele frequency lapho kwenzeka khona. Umcimbi oqala ushintsho lwemvamisa ye-allele engxenyeni ehlukanisiwe yabantu, okungavamile kubantu bokuqala, ubizwa ngokuthi umphumela womsunguli. Ukukhetha kwemvelo, ukuzulazula okungahleliwe, kanye nemiphumela yomsunguli kungaholela ezinguqukweni ezibalulekile ku-genome yabantu.

answer6: Ushintsho kuma-allele frequency okwenzeka lapho iqembu elincane elihlukanisiwe lisungula inani elisha labantu

chapterName: 4. Izinqubo Zokuziphendukela Kwemvelo | 19. Ukuziphendukela Kwemvelo | 19.1 Ukuziphendukela Kwemvelo | Isimiso Sokulingana SaseHardy–Weinberg
chapterNameEnglish: 4. Evolutionary Processes | 19. The Evolution of Populations | 19.1 Population Evolution | Hardy–Weinberg Principle of Equilibrium
chapterContent:
Ekuqaleni kwekhulu lama-20, isazi sezibalo saseNgilandi uGodfrey Hardy kanye nodokotela waseJalimane uWilhelm Weinberg basho isimiso sokulingana ukuchaza ukwakheka kwezakhi zofuzo zabantu. Le nkolelo-mbono, kamuva eyaziwa ngokuthi isimiso se-Hardy-Weinberg sokulingana, ithi amaza e-allele kanye ne-genotype yabantu aziguquki ngokwemvelo—ngaphandle kokuthi uhlobo oluthile lwamandla okuziphendukela kwemvelo lusebenza kubantu, i-allele noma amaza e-genotypic ngeke ashintshe. Isimiso se-Hardy-Weinberg sithatha izimo ezingenazo izinguquko, ukufuduka, ukufuduka, noma ingcindezi ekhethiwe yohlobo noma ngokumelene nohlobo, kanye nabantu abangenamkhawulo; ngenkathi kungekho bantu abangahlangabezana nalezo zimo, isimiso sinikeza imodeli ewusizo yokuqhathanisa izinguquko zangempela zabantu.

 Sisebenza ngaphansi kwale nkolelo-mbono, izazi zezakhi zofuzo zabantu zimelela ama-allele ahlukene njengeziguquguquko ezahlukene kumamodeli azo ezibalo. I-variable p, isibonelo, ivame ukumelela imvamisa ye-allele ebusayo, yithi Y ngesici sophuzi kuma-peas kaMendels. I-variable q imelela imvamisa ye-allele ephindaphindayo, kulokhu u-y, enikeza umbala oluhlaza. Uma lezi kuyizona kuphela izinhlobo ezimbili ezingenzeka zendawo ethile kubantu, u-p + q = 1. Ngamanye amazwi, wonke ama-allele ka-p nawo wonke ama-allele ka-q akha wonke ama-allele aleyo ndawo atholakala kubantu.

 Kodwa okuthakazelisa kakhulu izazi zebhayoloji akuzona izinhlobo eziningi zama-allele, kodwa izinhlobo eziningi zama-genotypes atholakalayo, aziwa ngokuthi isakhiwo sezakhi zofuzo sabantu, lapho ososayensi bangaqagela khona ukusatshalaliswa kwama-phenotypes. Uma i-phenotype ibonwa, uhlobo lwe-genotype lwama-alleles aphindaphindayo e-homozygous kuphela olungaziwa; izibalo zinikeza isilinganiso sama-genotypes asele. Njengoba umuntu ngamunye ephethe ama-alleles amabili ngesakhi sofuzo, uma imvamisa yama-allele (p no-q) aziwa, ukubikezela imvamisa yalezi zinhlobo zama-genotypes kubalwa okulula kwezibalo ukuze kunqunywe amathuba okuthola la ma-genotypes uma ama-alleles amabili edonswa ngokungahleliwe echibini lezakhi zofuzo. Ngakho-ke kulesi simo esingenhla, isitshalo se-pea ngasinye singaba yi-pp (YY), ngaleyo ndlela sikhiqize uphizi ophuzi; i-pq (Yy), futhi iphuzi; noma i-qq (yy), ngaleyo ndlela sikhiqize uphizi oluhlaza (Isithombe 19.2). Ngamanye amazwi, imvamisa yabantu be-pp imane nje iyi-p2; imvamisa yabantu be-pq ingu-2pq; kanti imvamisa yabantu be-qq ingu-q2. Futhi, futhi, uma u-p no-q kuyizinto ezimbili kuphela ezingenzeka zesici esithile kubantu, lezi zikhathi ze-genotypes zizohlangana zibe yinye: p2 + 2pq + q2 = 1.

 Ngokwethiyori, uma abantu besesimweni sokulingana—okungukuthi, awekho amandla okuziphendukela kwemvelo asebenzayo—isizukulwane ngesizukulwane sizoba ne-gene pool efanayo kanye nesakhiwo sezakhi zofuzo, futhi lezi zilinganiso zizohlala ziyiqiniso ngaso sonke isikhathi. Vele, ngisho noHardy noWeinberg baqaphela ukuthi awekho amalungu emvelo avikelekile ekuziphendukeleni kwemvelo. Amaqembu emvelo ahlala eshintsha ekwakheni izakhi zofuzo ngenxa yokuguquguquka, ukuguquka, mhlawumbe ukufuduka, kanye nokukhetha. Ngenxa yalokho, okuwukuphela kwendlela yokuthola ukusatshalaliswa okuqondile kwezinhlobo ze-phenotypes kubantu ukuphuma uzibale. Kodwa isimiso se-Hardy-Weinberg sinikeza ososayensi isisekelo sezibalo sabantu abangaguquki abangaqhathanisa nabo abantu abaguqukile bese bephetha ngokuthi yimaphi amandla okuziphendukela kwemvelo angase abe nomthelela. Uma imvamisa yama-allele noma ama-genotype iphambuka enanini elilindelwe ku-Hardy-Weinberg equation, khona-ke abantu bayashintsha.

chapterContent:
Bheka ofunda nabo ekilasini. Abantu beqembu elithile bavame ukubonisa ama-phenotype ahlukene, noma baveze ama-allele ahlukene esakhi esithile sofuzo. Lokhu kwehluka kubizwa ngokuthi ama-polymorphism. Ukusatshalaliswa kwama-phenotype phakathi kwabantu, okwaziwa ngokuthi ukuhlukahluka kwabantu, kuthonywa izici eziningana, okuhlanganisa isakhiwo sofuzo sabantu kanye nendawo ezungezile (Isithombe 19.3). Ukuqonda imithombo yokuhlukahluka kwe-phenotypic kubalulekile ekunqumeni ukuthi inani labantu lizothuthuka kanjani ekuphenduleni izingcindezi ezahlukene zokuziphendukela kwemvelo. Yilezo zinguquko kuphela ezifakwe ku-gene yomuntu ngamunye ezingadluliselwa enzalweni yakhe futhi zibe yisisulu sokukhethwa kwemvelo.

 Njengoba ufunda esahlukweni esixoxa ngokuziphendukela kwemvelo kanye nemvelaphi yezinhlobo, ukukhetha kwemvelo kusebenza ngokukhetha ama-phenotype—kanye nama-allele azinqumayo—anikeza izici noma ukuziphatha okuzuzisayo. Izimfanelo ezimbi zikhethwa ngokumelene nazo. Ukukhukhuleka kwezakhi zofuzo kuvela ekuveleni kwengozi yokuthi abanye abantu banezingane eziningi kunabanye futhi, ngaleyo ndlela, bazodlulisela izakhi zofuzo eziningi esizukulwaneni esilandelayo. Imiphakathi emincane nehlukanisiwe isengozini enkulu yokukhukhuleka kwezakhi zofuzo. Izenzakalo zemvelo, njengemililo yasendle noma iziphepho, zingakhulisa ukukhukhuleka kwezakhi zofuzo lapho ingxenye enkulu yabantu ibulawa. Ngenxa yokuthi umlilo awuhlukanisi phakathi kwezinhlobo zezakhi zofuzo zezinto eziphilayo ezahlukahlukene, akukho uhlobo oluthile lwezakhi zofuzo olusinda emlilweni kangcono kunolunye. Ngakho-ke, isakhiwo sezakhi zofuzo sabantu abasindile singase sihluke kakhulu esakhiweni sezakhi zofuzo sabantu bokuqala. Lokhu kubizwa ngokuthi umphumela we-bottleneck. Esinye isimo lapho abantu bangase babe nethonya elinamandla lokukhukhuleka kwezakhi zofuzo kwenzeka lapho ingxenye ethile yabantu ishiya ukuyoqala inani elisha labantu endaweni entsha noma ihlukaniswa yisithiyo esingokomzimba sohlobo oluthile. Kulesi simo, labo bantu cishe abamele bonke abantu, into ebizwa ngokuthi umphumela womsunguli. Kokubili umphumela we-bottleneck kanye nomphumela womsunguli kunciphisa ukuhlukahluka kwezakhi zofuzo ngaphakathi kwabantu—futhi ukuhlukahluka kwezakhi zofuzo kuyisisekelo sokukhethwa kwemvelo. Lapho abantu beshiya noma bejoyina inani, baphatha ama-allele abo, okuholela ekushintsheni kwama-allele abantu. Ama-allele frequencies nawo angashintsha ngenxa yokuguquka kwe-DNA nalapho abantu bengahlangani ngokungahleliwe nabanye; lapho umuntu ekhetha umlingani ngokusekelwe ku-phenotype, uhlobo lwezakhi zofuzo nalo luyakhethwa. Ngamafuphi, noma yiziphi zalezi zimo zingaholela ekuphambukeni ekulinganisweni kweHardy-Weinberg—futhi ziholele ekuguqukeni okuncane kwabantu.

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyiswe esigabeni zisekela imiqondo echazwe ku-Big Idea 1 yoHlaka lweKharikhulamu ye-AP® Biology. Izinhloso Zokufunda ze-AP® ezibalwe kuHlaka lweKharikhulamu zinikeza isisekelo esicacile senkambo ye-AP® Biology, ulwazi lwelabhorethri olusekelwe ekuphenyweni, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®. question1: Ziyini i-polymorphism?
answer1: Umehluko kuma-phenotypes phakathi kwabantu ababangelwa ama-allele ahlukene esakhi sofuzo

answer2: Izinguquko kuphela ezifakwe ku-gene yomuntu ngamunye
distractor2b: Noma yisiphi isici esidalwa yisidalwa ngesikhathi sokuphila kwaso
question3: Uyini umphumela we-bottleneck?
answer3: Ukuncipha kokwehluka kwezakhi zofuzo okubangelwa lapho ingxenye enkulu yabantu iqedwa ngengozi
distractor3a: Ukwakhiwa kwenani labantu abasha ngabantu abambalwa
question4: Uyini umphumela womsunguli?
answer4: Ushintsho kuma-allele frequencies lapho iqembu elincane lisungula inani elisha labantu elingameleli inani lokuqala labantu
distractor4a: Ukwehla kosayizi wabantu ngenxa yenhlekelele yemvelo
distractor4c: Ukuvela kwama-allele amasha ngokuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo
question5: Kungani kokubili umphumela we-bottleneck kanye nomphumela womsunguli kunciphisa ukuhlukahluka kwezakhi zofuzo?
answer5: Ngoba yiqembu elincane kuphela lama-alleles abantu bokuqala elimelelwayo
distractor5a: Ngoba zandisa amazinga okuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo
question6: Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okungabangela ukuphambuka ekulinganisweni kweHardy-Weinberg?

distractor6a: Ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo kanye ne-meiosis kuphela
distractor6c: Ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo kanye nokuhlanganiswa kabusha kuphela
question7: Ukuhlangana okungahleliwe kungathonya kanjani ukuziphendukela kwemvelo?
answer7: Ukukhetha ozakwethu ngokusekelwe ku-phenotype kukhetha nezinhlobo ezithile ze-genotype, kushintsha imvamisa ye-allele ngokuhamba kwesikhathi
distractor7c: Kuvimbela ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo ukuthi kungenzeki

chapterName: 4. Izinqubo Zokuziphendukela Kwemvelo | 19. Ukuziphendukela Kwemvelo | 19.2 Izakhi Zofuzo Zabantu | Ukuguquguquka Kwezakhi Zofuzo
chapterNameEnglish: 4. Evolutionary Processes | 19. The Evolution of Populations | 19.2 Population Genetics | Genetic Variability
chapterContent:
Ukukhetha kwemvelo kanye namanye amandla okuziphendukela kwemvelo kungasebenza kuphela ezicini ezizuzwa njengefa, okungukuthi ikhodi yezakhi zofuzo yesidalwa. Ngenxa yokuthi ama-allele adluliselwa kusuka kumzali kuya enzalweni, lawo anikeza izici noma ukuziphatha okuzuzisayo angakhethwa, kuyilapho ama-allele ayingozi angakhethwa ngokumelene nawo. Izici ezitholwayo, ikakhulukazi, azizuzwa njengefa. Isibonelo, uma umdlali ejimini nsuku zonke, akha amandla emisipha, inzalo yomdlali ngeke ikhule ibe ngumakhi womzimba. Uma kunesisekelo sezakhi zofuzo sekhono lokugijima ngokushesha, ngakolunye uhlangothi, lokhu kungadluliselwa enganeni.

 Ufuzo luyingxenye yokwehluka kwe-phenotype okungabangelwa ukwehluka kwezakhi zofuzo, noma ukwehluka kwezakhi zofuzo, phakathi kwabantu emphakathini. Lapho ukwehluka kwezakhi zofuzo kwabantu kukhulu, kulapho kutholakala khona amandla okuziphendukela kwemvelo asebenza ngokwehluka kwezakhi zofuzo.

 Ukuhlukahluka kwama-allele kanye nezinhlobo zezakhi zofuzo ngaphakathi kwabantu kubizwa ngokuthi ukwehluka kwezakhi zofuzo. Lapho ososayensi behileleke ekuzaleni uhlobo oluthile, njengasezilwaneni ezikhungweni zezilwane nasezindaweni zemvelo, bazama ukwandisa ukuguquguquka kwezakhi zofuzo zabantu ukuze balondoloze ukuhlukahluka okuningi ngangokunokwenzeka. Lokhu kusiza futhi ukunciphisa izingozi ezihambisana nokuzalana, ukuhlangana kwezinhlobo ezihlobene eduze, okungaba nomphumela ongathandeki wokuhlanganisa izinguquko ezibulalayo ezingabangela ukukhubazeka kanye nokuthambekela ezifweni. Isibonelo, isifo esibangelwa i-allele engavamile, ephindaphindayo singase sibe khona kubantu, kodwa sizozibonakalisa kuphela lapho umuntu ephethe amakhophi amabili e-allele. Ngenxa yokuthi i-allele ayivamile kubantu abavamile, abanempilo abanendawo yokuhlala engavinjelwe, ithuba lokuthi abantu ababili abathwalayo bazozalana liphansi, futhi noma kunjalo, amaphesenti angama-25 kuphela enzalo yabo azozuza i-allele yesifo kubo bobabili abazali. Nakuba kungenzeka ukuthi kwenzeke ngesikhathi esithile, ngeke kwenzeke kaningi ngokwanele ukuthi ukukhetha kwemvelo kukwazi ukuqeda i-allele ngokushesha kubantu, futhi ngenxa yalokho, i-allele izogcinwa emazingeni aphansi echibini lezakhi zofuzo. Kodwa-ke, uma umndeni wabathwali bezilwane uqala ukuzalana, lokhu kuzokwandisa kakhulu amathuba okuba abathwali ababili bahlangane futhi ekugcineni kukhiqize inzalo enesifo, into eyaziwa ngokuthi ukucindezeleka kokuzalana.

 Izinguquko kuma-allele frequency ezitholakala kubantu zingakhanyisa indlela ezishintsha ngayo. Ngaphezu kokukhetha kwemvelo, kunezinye izinto ezingaba nomthelela: ukukhukhuleka kwezakhi zofuzo, ukugeleza kwezakhi zofuzo, ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo, ukuzalana okungahleliwe, kanye nokwehluka kwemvelo.
question1: Yiziphi izinhlobo zezici ezingasebenza ekukhetheni kwemvelo?
answer1: Izici ezizuzwa njengefa ezifakwe ku-genes yezinto eziphilayo
distractor1a: Izici kuphela ezitholakala ngesikhathi sokuphila kwezinto eziphilayo
distractor1c: Noma yisiphi isici kungakhathaliseki ukuthi sizuzwe njengefa
question2: Kuyini ukuzuza ifa?
answer2: Ingxenye yokwehluka kwe-phenotypic okubangelwa ukwehluka kwezakhi zofuzo phakathi kwabantu emphakathini
distractor2a: Amathuba okuthi i-allele ebusayo izozuzwa njengefa
distractor2b: Izinga lapho izinguquko zenzeka khona kubantu
distractor2c: Iphesenti lenzalo elisindayo lize libe mdala
question3: Kuyini ukuhlukahluka kwezakhi zofuzo?
answer3: Ukuhlukahluka kwama-allele kanye nama-genotype ngaphakathi kwesibalo sabantu
question4: Kungani ama-zoo kanye nezinhlelo zokulondolozwa kwemvelo amagremu bezama ukwandisa ukuhlukahluka kwezakhi zofuzo?
answer4: Ukulondoloza ukuhlukahluka kwezinhlobo zezilwane kanye nokunciphisa izingozi ezihlobene nokuzalanisa izilwane ezifuywayo
distractor4a: Ukuqeda zonke izinhlobo ze-allele eziphindaphindayo
distractor4c: Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi bonke abantu bafana ngokwezakhi zofuzo
question5: Kuyini ukucindezeleka kokuzalana kwabazali?
answer5: Ukwanda kokuvela kwezimpawu eziyingozi ezibangelwa ukuhlangana kwabantu abahlobene eduze
distractor5a: Ukwehla kobukhulu benani labantu okubangelwa ukudla izilwane
distractor5c: Ukwehla kwamazinga okuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo ngenxa yokukhethwa kwemvelo
question6: Kungani ama-allele ayingozi avame ukugcinwa ngezikhathi eziphansi kubantu abaningi?
answer6: Ngenxa yokuthi abantu ababili abathwala izifo abavamile ukuhlangana, okwenza inzalo ethintekile ingavamile.
distractor6a: Ngoba ukukhetha kwemvelo kuthanda ama-allele ayingozi aphindaphindayo
distractor6b: Ngoba ama-allele aphindaphindayo ayashintsha abe ama-allele abusayo
distractor6c: Ngoba zonke izinhlobo ze-allele eziphindaphindayo ziyazuzisa
question7: Yimaphi amandla okuziphendukela kwemvelo ngaphandle kokukhetha kwemvelo angashintsha amaza e-allele kubantu?
answer7: Ukuzulazula kwezakhi zofuzo, ukugeleza kwezakhi zofuzo, ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo, ukuhlangana okungahleliwe, kanye nokwehluka kwemvelo
distractor7a: Ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo kanye ne-meiosis kuphela
distractor7b: Ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo kanye nokuhlanganiswa kabusha kuphela
distractor7c: Ukugeleza kwezakhi zofuzo kanye nokukhethwa kwemvelo kuphela

chapterName: 4. Izinqubo Zokuziphendukela Kwemvelo | 19. Ukuziphendukela Kwemvelo Kwabantu | 19.2 Ufuzo Lwabantu | Ukuguquka Kwemvelo
chapterNameEnglish: 4. Evolutionary Processes | 19. The Evolution of Populations | 19.2 Population Genetics | Genetic Drift
chapterContent:
Inkolelo-mbono yokukhethwa kwemvelo ivela ekubonweni kokuthi abanye abantu emphakathini banamathuba amaningi okuphila isikhathi eside futhi babe nabantwana abaningi kunabanye; ngakho-ke, bazodlulisela izakhi zabo zofuzo esizukulwaneni esilandelayo. I-gorilla yeduna enkulu, enamandla, isibonelo, inamathuba amaningi kakhulu kune-gorilla encane, ebuthakathaka yokuba yi-silverback yabantu, umholi weqembu ohlangana kakhulu kunabanye abesilisa beqembu. Umholi weqembu uzoba nabantwana abaningi, ababelana ngengxenye yezakhi zofuzo zakhe, futhi kungenzeka bakhule babe bakhulu futhi babe namandla njengoyise. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izakhi zofuzo zobukhulu obukhulu zizokwanda ngokuvama kwabantu, futhi ngenxa yalokho, zikhule zibe zinkulu ngokwesilinganiso. Okusho ukuthi, lokhu bekuzokwenzeka uma lokhu kucindezela kokukhetha okuthile, noma amandla okukhetha aqhubayo, bekuwukuphela kwento ethinta abantu. Kwezinye izibonelo, ukufihla okungcono noma ukumelana okunamandla nesomiso kungabangela ingcindezi yokukhetha.

 Enye indlela amaza e-allele kanye ne-genotype yabantu angashintsha ngayo ukugeleza kwezakhi zofuzo (Isithombe 19.4), okuwumphumela nje wengozi. Ngengozi, abanye abantu bazoba nabantwana abaningi kunabanye—hhayi ngenxa yenzuzo enikezwa yisici esithile esifakwe ku-genetic, kodwa ngoba nje owesilisa oyedwa ube sendaweni efanele ngesikhathi esifanele (lapho owesifazane osabelayo edlula) noma ngoba omunye ube sendaweni engafanele ngesikhathi esingafanele (lapho impungushe izingela).

 Imiphakathi emincane isengozini enkulu yokukhukhuleka kwezakhi zofuzo. Imiphakathi emikhulu, ngakolunye uhlangothi, ivikelwe emiphumeleni yengozi. Uma umuntu oyedwa kubantu abayi-10 efa esemncane ngaphambi kokuba ashiye noma iyiphi inzalo esizukulwaneni esilandelayo, zonke izakhi zofuzo zayo—1/10 yeqoqo lezakhi zofuzo zabantu—zizolahleka ngokuzumayo. Emphakathini wabantu abayi-100, lokho kuyiphesenti elilodwa kuphela leqoqo lezakhi zofuzo lilonke; ngakho-ke, akunamthelela omkhulu esakhiweni sezakhi zofuzo sabantu.

 Ukukhukhuleka kwezakhi zofuzo kungakhuliswa futhi yizenzakalo zemvelo, njengenhlekelele yemvelo ebulala—ngokungahleliwe—ingxenye enkulu yabantu. Eyaziwa ngokuthi umphumela we-bottleneck, iholela ekutheni ingxenye enkulu ye-gene pool ishabalale ngokuzumayo (Isithombe 19.5). Ngesinye isikhathi, isakhiwo sezakhi zofuzo sabasindile siba isakhiwo sezakhi zofuzo sabo bonke abantu, okungase kuhluke kakhulu kubantu bangaphambi kwenhlekelele.

 Esinye isimo lapho abantu bangase babe nethonya elinamandla lokukhukhuleka kwezakhi zofuzo uma ingxenye ethile yabantu ishiya ukuyoqala abantu abasha endaweni entsha noma uma abantu behlukaniswa yisithiyo esingokomzimba sohlobo oluthile. Kulesi simo, labo bantu cishe abamele bonke abantu, okuholela kumphumela womsunguli. Umphumela womsunguli uvela lapho isakhiwo sezakhi zofuzo sishintsha ukuze sifane nobaba nomama abasungula abantu abasha. Umphumela womsunguli kukholakala ukuthi ube yisici esibalulekile emlandweni wezakhi zofuzo wabantu base-Afrikaner babahlali baseDashi eNingizimu Afrika, njengoba kufakazelwa izinguquko ezivamile kubantu base-Afrikaner kodwa ezingavamile kwabanye abantu abaningi. Lokhu kungenzeka ngenxa yokuthi ingxenye ephezulu kakhulu kunejwayelekile yabahlali abasungula i-colonies bathwala lezi zinguquko. Ngenxa yalokho, abantu baveza ukwanda okukhulu kwesifo sikaHuntington (HD) kanye ne-Fanconi anemia (FA), isifo sofuzo esaziwa ngokubangela umongo wegazi kanye nokukhubazeka kokuzalwa.
question1: Kuyini ukukhukhuleka kwezakhi zofuzo?
answer1: Ushintsho olungahleliwe kuma-allele frequency olubangelwa yingozi kunokukhethwa kwemvelo
distractor1a: Ukuhamba kwama-allele phakathi kwabantu
distractor1c: Ukudalwa kwama-allele amasha ngokuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo
question2: Kungani amaqembu amancane ethinteka kakhulu ukukhukhuleka kwezakhi zofuzo?
answer2: Ngoba izehlakalo ezingahleliwe zinomthelela omkhulu echibini lezakhi zofuzo labantu abambalwa
distractor2a: Ngoba izinguquko zenzeka kaningi kubantu abancane
distractor2b: Ngoba imiphakathi emincane ihlala ihlangabezana nokukhethwa kwemvelo okunamandla
distractor2c: Ngoba ukugeleza kwezakhi zofuzo akunakwenzeka kubantu abancane
question3: Uyini umphumela we-bottleneck?
answer3: Uhlobo lokuzulazula kwezakhi zofuzo lapho isenzakalo esingahleliwe sinciphisa kakhulu usayizi wabantu kanye nokuhlukahluka kwezakhi zofuzo
distractor3a: Ukwakhiwa kwenani labantu abasha ngabantu abambalwa
question4: Uyini umphumela womsunguli?
answer4: Uhlobo lokuzulazula kwezakhi zofuzo okwenzeka lapho iqembu elincane lisungula inani elisha labantu abanemvamisa ye-allele ehlukile kwenani lokuqala labantu
distractor4a: Ukwehla kobukhulu babantu okubangelwa yinhlekelele yemvelo
distractor4c: Izinguquko ezingahleliwe ezikhulisa ukuhlukahluka kwezakhi zofuzo
question5: Kungani imiphakathi emikhulu ingathinteki kakhulu ekuguqukeni kwezakhi zofuzo?
answer5: Ngoba ukulahlekelwa noma ukuzuzwa kwabantu abambalwa kunomthelela omncane kuphela echibini lezakhi zofuzo lilonke
distractor5a: Ngoba izinguquko azikaze zenzeke kubantu abaningi
distractor5b: Ngoba inani elikhulu labantu lihlala lilingana neHardy-Weinberg
distractor5c: Ngoba ukukhetha kwemvelo akusebenzi kubantu abaningi
question6: Kungani amaBhunu enezinga eliphezulu kakhulu lezifo ezithile zofuzo njengesifo sikaHuntington kanye ne-Fanconi anemia?
answer6: Ngenxa yomphumela womsunguli, lapho abantu abasungula bathwala khona lezi zinguquko ezingavamile
distractor6a: Ngoba ukukhukhuleka kwezakhi zofuzo kuthinta abantu kuphela
distractor6b: Ngoba lezi zinguquko zavela ngemva kokuxazulula ngokukhetha kwemvelo
distractor6c: Ngoba zonke izakhamuzi ezihlukanisiwe zilahlekelwa yi-alleles eyingozi
