chapterName: 4. Izinqubo Zokuziphendukela Kwemvelo | 19. Ukuziphendukela Kwemvelo Kwabantu | 19.2 Izakhi Zofuzo Zabantu | Ukugeleza Kwezakhi Zofuzo
chapterNameEnglish: 4. Evolutionary Processes | 19. The Evolution of Populations | 19.2 Population Genetics | Gene Flow
chapterContent: Elinye amandla abalulekile okuziphendukela kwemvelo ukugeleza kwezakhi zofuzo: ukugeleza kwama-allele angena futhi aphume kubantu ngenxa yokufuduka kwabantu noma ama-gametes (Isithombe 19.6). Ngenkathi ezinye izinhlobo zizinzile, ezinye zithola ukuguquguquka okukhulu. Izitshalo eziningi, isibonelo, zithumela impova yazo kude nakude, ngomoya noma ngezinyoni, ukuze zithuthe ezinye izinhlobo zezinhlobo ezifanayo kude. Ngisho nenani labantu elingase libonakale lizinzile ekuqaleni, njengeqembu lamabhubesi, lingabhekana nesabelo salo esifanele sokufuduka nokufuduka njengoba abesilisa abasathuthuka beshiya omama babo ukuze bafune ukuziqhenya okusha ngabesifazane abangahlobene nezakhi zofuzo. Lokhu kugeleza okuguquguqukayo kwabantu abangaphakathi nabangaphandle kweqembu akugcini nje ngokushintsha isakhiwo sezakhi zofuzo sabantu, kodwa futhi kungaletha ukuhlukahluka okusha kwezakhi zofuzo kubantu ezindaweni ezahlukene ze-geological kanye nezindawo zokuhlala.
question1: Kuyini ukugeleza kwezakhi zofuzo?
answer1: Ukuhamba kwama-allele angena futhi aphume kubantu ngenxa yokufuduka kwabantu ngabanye noma ama-gametes
distractor1a: Ukulahlekelwa okungahleliwe kwama-allele ngenxa yezehlakalo zengozi
distractor1b: Ukudalwa kwama-allele amasha ngokuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo
distractor1c: Ukukhethwa kwama-allele azuzisayo ngokukhetha kwemvelo
question2: Ukugeleza kwezakhi zofuzo kungabathinta kanjani abantu?
answer2: Kungashintsha imvamisa ye-allele futhi kwethule ukuhlukahluka okusha kwezakhi zofuzo
question3: Yisiphi isibonelo sokugeleza kwezakhi zofuzo?
answer3: Umoya uthwala impova kusuka kwesinye isitshalo uye kwesinye
distractor3a: Ukuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo okudala i-allele entsha
question4: Kungani izingonyama zibhekana nokugeleza kwezakhi zofuzo?
answer4: Amaduna amancane avame ukushiya ukuziqhenya kwawo ngokuzalwa futhi azale ngokuziqhenya okusha
distractor4a: Amabhubesi azalana kuphela nezihlobo eziseduze
distractor4c: Amabhubesi esifazane ahamba phakathi kwezilwane ezihlala ndawonye njalo ngesikhathi sokuzala
question5: Yiziphi izinto eziphilayo ezivame ukuzwa ukugeleza kwezakhi zofuzo ngokusabalala kwempova?
answer5: Izitshalo
distractor5a: Isikhunta kuphela
question6: Iyiphi inqubo engase ikhulise ukwehluka kwezakhi zofuzo kubantu ngokwethula ama-allele amasha?
answer6: Ukugeleza kwezakhi zofuzo
distractor6c: Umphumela we-Bottleneck
question7: Yini engenzeka uma abantu befuduka phakathi kwemiphakathi futhi bezalana?
answer7: Iqoqo lezakhi zofuzo lenani labantu abamukelayo liyashintsha njengoba kungeniswa ama-allele amasha
distractor7a: Izinhlobo zabantu ziba izinhlobo ezihlukene ngokushesha

chapterName: 4. Izinqubo Zokuziphendukela Kwemvelo | 19. Ukuziphendukela Kwemvelo Kwabantu | 19.2 Ufuzo Lwabantu | Ukuguquka Kwemvelo
chapterNameEnglish: 4. Evolutionary Processes | 19. The Evolution of Populations | 19.2 Population Genetics | Mutation
chapterContent: Ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo kuyizinguquko ku-DNA yesidalwa futhi kuyimbangela ebalulekile yokwehlukahlukana kwabantu. Izinhlobo ziyavela ngenxa yokuqongelela kokuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo okwenzeka ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Ukuvela kokuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo okusha kuyindlela evame kakhulu yokwethula ukuguquguquka okusha kwezakhi zofuzo kanye ne-phenotypic. Ezinye izinguquko azilungile noma ziyingozi futhi zisuswa ngokushesha kubantu ngokukhethwa kwemvelo. Ezinye ziwusizo futhi zizosabalala kubantu. Ukuthi ukuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo kuyazuzisa noma kuyalimaza noma cha kunqunywa ukuthi kuyasiza yini isidalwa ukuthi sisinde size sivuthwe ngokocansi futhi sizale. Ezinye izinguquko azenzi lutho futhi zingahlala isikhathi eside, zingathintwa ukukhethwa kwemvelo, ku-genome. Ezinye zingaba nomthelela omkhulu ku-gene kanye ne-phenotype ephumelayo.
question1: Kuyini ukuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo?
answer1: Izinguquko ku-DNA yezinto eziphilayo ezethula ukuhlukahluka okusha kwezakhi zofuzo
distractor1a: Ukuhamba kwama-allele phakathi kwabantu
distractor1c: Ukuhlanganiswa kwama-chromosomes e-homologous ngesikhathi se-meiosis
question2: Kungani ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo kubalulekile ekuziphendukeleni kwemvelo?
answer2: Zethula ukuhlukahluka okusha kwezakhi zofuzo kanye ne-phenotypic kubantu
distractor2c: Baqinisekisa ukuthi zonke inzalo ziyafana ngokwezakhi zofuzo
question3: Kwenzekani ngokuvamile ezinguqukweni eziyingozi?
answer3: Zivame ukususwa kubantu ngokukhetha kwemvelo
question4: Kwenzekani ngokuvamile ezinguqukweni ezizuzisayo?
answer4: Zivame ukusabalala kubantu abaningi ngoba zandisa ukuqina komzimba
distractor4a: Zisuswa ngokushesha ngokukhukhuleka kwezakhi zofuzo
question5: Umphumela wokuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo unqunywa kanjani?
answer5: Ngokuthi kuyasiza yini ukuthi isilwane sisinde kuze kube sezingeni lokuzala nokuzala kabusha
distractor5a: Ngokuthi ishintsha i-allele ebusayo ibe yi-allele ephindaphindayo yini
question6: Kuyini ukuguqulwa okungathathi hlangothi?
answer6: Ukuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo okungenawo umthelela empilweni yomzimba futhi okungase kuqhubeke ku-genome
distractor6c: Ukuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo okwenzeka kuphela kumaseli angazali
question7: Yisiphi isitatimende mayelana nokuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo esinembile?
answer7: Ezinye izinguquko azinawo umphumela omkhulu, kanti ezinye zingashintsha kakhulu isakhi sofuzo kanye nohlobo lwaso
distractor7c: Uguquko ngalunye luveza uhlobo olusha ngokushesha

chapterName: 4. Izinqubo Zokuziphendukela Kwemvelo | 19. Ukuziphendukela Kwemvelo | 19.2 Ufuzo Lomphakathi | Ukuhlangana Okungahleliwe
chapterNameEnglish: 4. Evolutionary Processes | 19. The Evolution of Populations | 19.2 Population Genetics | Nonrandom Mating
chapterContent:
Uma abantu behlangana ngokungahleliwe nontanga yabo, umphumela ungaba inani elishintshayo. Kunezizathu eziningi ezenza kube nokuhlangana okungahleliwe. Esinye isizathu ukukhetha okulula kokuhlangana; isibonelo, ama-peahen ezinsikazi angase athande ama-peacock anemisila emikhulu nekhanyayo. Izici eziholela ekuhlanganeni okuningi komuntu ngamunye zikhethwa ngokukhetha kwemvelo. Uhlobo olulodwa oluvamile lokukhetha ukuhlangana, olubizwa ngokuthi ukuhlangana okuhlukahlukene, ukukhetha komuntu ukuhlangana nabalingani abafana nabo ngendlela exakile.

 Esinye isizathu sokuhlangana okungahleliwe indawo ebonakalayo. Lokhu kuyiqiniso ikakhulukazi ezixukwini ezinkulu ezisakazeke emabangeni amakhulu lapho kungebona bonke abantu abazokwazi ukufinyelelana ngokulinganayo. Amanye angase aqhelelane ngamamayela emahlathini noma ezindaweni ezinzima, kanti amanye angase ahlale eduze.
question1: Kuyini ukuhlangana okungahleliwe?
answer1: Ukuhlangana lapho abantu bengakhethi khona abalingani ngokungahleliwe, okubangela izinguquko ekubunjweni kwezakhi zofuzo zabantu
distractor1a: Ukuhlangana kwezinhlobo ezahlukene kuphela phakathi kwamalungu ezinhlobo ezahlukene
distractor1c: Ukuhlangana okuvimbela ukuvela kwemvelo ukuthi kwenzeke
question2: Iyiphi imbangela eyodwa evamile yokuhlangana okungahleliwe?
answer2: Ukukhetha umlingani ngokusekelwe ezicini ozikhethayo
question3: Kuyini ukuhlangana kwezinhlobo ezahlukene?
answer3: Ukukhetha ukuhlangana nabantu abafana ngendlela efanayo
distractor3a: Ukukhetha ukuhlangana nabantu abavela ezinhlotsheni ezahlukene
question4: Kungani ama-peahen esifazane engase athande ama-peacock anemisila emikhulu nekhanyayo?
answer4: Ngoba ukukhetha umngane womshado kungakhuthaza izici ezandisa impumelelo yokuzala
distractor4a: Ngoba imisila emikhulu ihlala ithuthukisa ukusinda
distractor4b: Ngoba imisila ekhanyayo ivimbela ukuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo
distractor4c: Ngoba usayizi womsila unquma inombolo ye-chromosome
question5: Indawo yangempela ingaba kanjani nomthelela ekuzaleni okungahleliwe?
answer5: Abantu banamathuba amaningi okuhlangana nabantu abaseduze kunalabo abahlala kude
distractor5a: Kuvimbela konke ukuzalana phakathi kwabantu abaseduze
distractor5b: Kuqinisekisa amathuba okulingana kokuhlangana kwabantu bonke
question6: Iyini imiphumela yokuziphendukela kwemvelo okungenzeka kube khona ngenxa yokuhlangana okungahleliwe?
answer6: Imvamisa ye-allele kanye ne-genotype kubantu ingashintsha ngokuhamba kwesikhathi
distractor6c: Inani labantu lifinyelela ngokushesha ekubalweni kweHardy-Weinberg
question7: Yisiphi isimo esiyisibonelo sokuhlangana okungahleliwe?
answer7: Izinyoni zihlala zikhetha ozakwabo abanezimpaphe ezikhanyayo
distractor7b: Umoya othwala impova phakathi kwezitshalo ezikude
distractor7c: Ukuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo okudala i-allele entsha

chapterName: 4. Izinqubo Zokuziphendukela Kwemvelo | 19. Ukuziphendukela Kwemvelo | 19.2 Ufuzo Lomphakathi | Ukwehluka Kwemvelo
chapterNameEnglish: 4. Evolutionary Processes | 19. The Evolution of Populations | 19.2 Population Genetics | Environmental Variation
chapterContent:
Izakhi zofuzo akuzona zodwa abadlali ababandakanyekayo ekunqumeni ukwehluka kwenani labantu. Izinhlobo ze-phenotypes nazo zithonywa ezinye izici, njengendawo ezungezile (Isithombe 19.7). Isibonelo, ukuchayeka elangeni kuyisici sendawo ezungezile, njengoba umuntu ochitha isikhathi esiningi elangeni cishe uzoba nesikhumba esimnyama kunomuntu ochitha isikhathi sakhe esiningi endlini (uma sicabanga ukuthi bobabili abantu babenesikhumba esinombala ofanayo ekuqaleni). Ezinye izici ezinkulu, njengobulili, zinqunywa indawo ezungezile yezinhlobo ezithile. Isibonelo, ezinye izimfudu nezinye izilwane ezihuquzelayo zinokunqunywa kobulili obuxhomeke ekushiseni (TSD). I-TSD isho ukuthi abantu ngabanye bakhula babe ngabesilisa uma amaqanda abo efakwe ngaphakathi kwebanga elithile lokushisa, noma abesifazane ebangeni elihlukile lokushisa. Ngenxa yokuthi lokhu kwehluka kwe-phenotypic kungenxa yokwehluka kwendawo esikhundleni sokwehluka kwezakhi zofuzo, azikwazi ukutholwa njengefa futhi aziholeli ekuziphendukeleni kwemvelo. Kodwa-ke, ukwehluka kwemvelo kungathinta ukuziphendukela kwemvelo ngokukhetha kwemvelo okukhetha ama-allele ahlukene nokwakha ama-phenotype ahlukene ezindaweni ezahlukene.

 Ukuhlukaniswa kwezindawo phakathi kwabantu kungaholela ekwehlukeni kokuhlukahluka kwe-phenotypic phakathi kwalabo bantu. Ukwehluka okunjalo kwendawo kubonakala phakathi kweningi labantu futhi kungaba yinto ebalulekile. Uhlobo olulodwa lokwehluka kwendawo, olubizwa ngokuthi i-cline, lungabonakala njengoba inqwaba yezinhlobo ezithile ihlukahluka kancane kancane ngokwezinga lemvelo. Izinhlobo zezilwane ezinegazi elifudumele, isibonelo, zivame ukuba nemizimba emikhulu ezindaweni ezipholile eduze kwezinsika zomhlaba, okuvumela ukuthi zilondoloze ukushisa kangcono. Lokhu kubhekwa njenge-latitudinal cline. Ngaphandle kwalokho, izitshalo eziqhakazayo zivame ukuqhakaza ngezikhathi ezahlukene kuye ngokuthi zikuphi eceleni komthambeka wentaba, owaziwa ngokuthi i-altitudinal cline.

 Uma kukhona ukugeleza kwezakhi zofuzo phakathi kwezinhlobo, lezi zinhlobo cishe zizobonisa ukwehluka kancane kancane ku-phenotype eceleni kwe-cline. Ukugeleza kwezakhi zofuzo okulinganiselwe, ngakolunye uhlangothi, kungaholela ekwehlukeni okungazelelwe, ngisho nasekukhetheni
question1: Kuyini ukuhlukahluka kwemvelo?
answer1: Umehluko ku-phenotype obangelwa yizici zemvelo kunomehluko wezakhi zofuzo
distractor1a: Umehluko obangelwa yizinguquko kuphela
distractor1b: Umehluko obangelwa ukukhukhuleka kwezakhi zofuzo kuphela
distractor1c: Umehluko obangelwa ukugeleza kwezakhi zofuzo kuphela
question2: Kungani umehluko we-phenotypic obangelwa imvelo ungaholeli ngqo ekuziphendukeleni kwemvelo?
answer2: Ngoba azizuzwa njengefa ngokwezakhi zofuzo
question3: Kuyini ukunqunywa kobulili obuxhomeke ekushiseni (TSD)?
answer3: Inqubo lapho izinga lokushisa lokufukamela kwamaqanda linquma ukuthi inzalo ikhula njengeyabesilisa noma eyesifazane
distractor3b: Isifo sofuzo esibangelwa amazinga okushisa aphezulu kakhulu
distractor3c: Uhlobo lokukhetha kwemvelo oluthanda ubulili obubodwa
question4: Ukwehlukahluka kwemvelo kungakuthinta kanjani ukuziphendukela kwemvelo?
answer4: Ngokubangela ukukhethwa kwemvelo ukuthi kuthande ama-allele ahlukene ezindaweni ezahlukene
distractor4a: Ngokudala ama-allele amasha ngqo
question5: Kuyini i-cline?
answer5: Ushintsho oluhamba kancane kancane kuhlobo lwezinhlobo kulo lonke uhlobo lwemvelo
distractor5a: Ukuguquka okungazelelwe okuthinta lonke inani labantu
question6: Iyini isibonelo se-latitudinal cline?
answer6: Izilwane ezinegazi elifudumele ezivame ukuba nemizimba emikhulu ezindaweni ezibandayo eduze kwezinsika
distractor6b: Izinhlanzi ezikhula ngobulili obuhlukene ngokusekelwe ekushiseni kwamanzi
distractor6c: Izinyoni ezifuduka ziye eningizimu njalo ebusika
question7: Yimuphi umphumela ongaba khona phakathi kwabantu abageleza izakhi zofuzo ezivinjelwe?
answer7: Kungaholela ekwehlukeni okungazelelwe kwe-phenotypic ngisho nokuhlukaniswa

chapterName: 4. Izinqubo Zokuziphendukela Kwemvelo | 19. Ukuziphendukela Kwemvelo Kwabantu | 19.3 Ukuziphendukela Kwemvelo Okuzivumelanisa Nezimo | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 4. Evolutionary Processes | 19. The Evolution of Populations | 19.3 Adaptive Evolution | Connections for AP® Courses
chapterContent:
Njengoba sesifundile, ukukhetha kwemvelo kusebenza ezingeni lomuntu ngamunye, kukhetha labo abanokuqina okuphezulu (impumelelo yokuzala) uma kuqhathaniswa nabanye abantu. Ngamanye amazwi, ukukhetha kwemvelo kuthanda ukushintshashintsha okuguquguqukayo kakhulu endaweni ethile. Uma izinhlobo ze-phenotype ezifanelana zishintsha endaweni ezinzile, ukukhetha kwemvelo kuholela ekuzinzeni kokukhetha, okuholela ekunciphiseni ukuhlukahluka kwabantu. Kodwa-ke, uma izimo zemvelo zishintsha, ukukhetha okuqondiswayo kushintsha ukuhlukahluka kwabantu kube uhlobo olusha noluhle kakhulu. Ukukhetha okuhlukahlukene kuholela ekuhlukeni okukhulu ngokukhetha izinhlobo ezimbili noma ngaphezulu ezihlukile.

 Ukukhetha ngokocansi kuphumela lapho ubulili obubodwa buphumelela kakhulu ekuzaleni kunobunye; ngenxa yalokho, abesilisa nabesifazane babhekana nezingcindezi ezihlukile zokukhetha, okuvame ukuholela ekwehlukeni okuhlukile kwe-phenotypic, noma ukungafani ngokocansi, phakathi kwalezi ezimbili. Isibonelo, izinyoni zesilisa zivame ukubonisa izimpaphe ezimibalabala kakhulu kunezinyoni zesifazane zohlobo olufanayo.

 Okubaluleke kakhulu ukuqaphela ukuthi ayikho into ephilayo ephelele. Ukukhetha kwemvelo kusebenza ekuhlukeni okukhona kubantu; Akudali lutho kusukela ekuqaleni. Nakuba ukukhetha kwemvelo kukhetha abantu abanamandla kakhulu, amanye amandla okuziphendukela kwemvelo, okuhlanganisa ukukhukhuleka kwezakhi zofuzo kanye nokugeleza kwezakhi zofuzo, avame ukwethula ama-allele ayingozi echibini lezakhi zofuzo labantu. Ukuziphendukela kwemvelo akunanjongo; kumane kuyisamba samandla ahlukahlukene athonya ukuhlukahluka kwezakhi zofuzo kanye ne-phenotypic yabantu.

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyiswe esigabeni zisekela imiqondo echazwe ku-Big Idea 1 yoHlaka Lwekharikhulamu lwe-AP® Biology. Izinhloso Zokufunda ze-AP® ezibalwe kuHlaka Lwekharikhulamu zinikeza isisekelo esicacile senkambo ye-AP® Biology, ulwazi lwelabhorethri olusekelwe ekuphenyweni, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®. Inhloso yokufunda ihlanganisa okuqukethwe okudingekayo nomunye noma ngaphezulu kwemikhuba yesayensi eyisikhombisa.

 I-Big Idea 1
Inqubo yokuziphendukela kwemvelo iqhuba ukuhlukahluka kanye nobunye bokuphila.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 1.A
Ushintsho ekwakhekeni kwezakhi zofuzo zabantu ngokuhamba kwesikhathi ukuvela kwemvelo.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
1.A.1 Ukukhetha kwemvelo kuyindlela enkulu yokuziphendukela kwemvelo.

 Ukuzijwayeza Kwesayensi
2.2 Umfundi angasebenzisa izindlela zezibalo emananini achaza izenzakalo zemvelo.

 Ukuzijwayeza Kwesayensi
5.3 Umfundi angahlola ubufakazi obunikezwa yisethi yedatha maqondana nombuzo othile wesayensi.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
1.2 Umfundi uyakwazi ukuhlola ubufakazi obunikezwa yidatha ukuze aphenye ngekhwalithi nangobuningi indima yokukhetha kwemvelo ekuziphendukeleni kwemvelo.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
1.A.2 Ukukhetha kwemvelo kusebenza ekushintsheni kwe-phenotypic kubantu.

 Ukuzijwayeza Kwesayensi
7.1 Umfundi angaxhumanisa izenzakalo namamodeli kuzo zonke izikali zendawo nezesikhathi.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
1.5 Umfundi uyakwazi ukuxhumanisa izinguquko zokuziphendukela kwemvelo kubantu ngokuhamba kwesikhathi noshintsho endaweni ezungezile.

 Ukukhetha kwemvelo kusebenza kuphela ezicini ezizuzwa ngabantu: ukukhetha ama-allele azuzisayo ngaleyo ndlela kwandisa ukuvama kwawo kubantu, ngenkathi kukhethwa ngokumelene nama-allele ayingozi futhi ngaleyo ndlela kunciphisa ukuvama kwawo—inqubo eyaziwa ngokuthi ukuziphendukela kwemvelo okuguquguqukayo. Ukukhetha kwemvelo akusebenzi kuma-allele ngamanye, nokho, kodwa ezintweni eziphilayo zonke. Umuntu angase abe ne-genotype ezuzisayo kakhulu ene-phenotype ephumela kuyo, isibonelo, ekhulisa ikhono lokuzala (i-fecundity), kodwa uma lowo muntu ofanayo ephethe i-allele eholela esifweni esibulalayo sobuntwana, leyo phenotype ye-fecundity ngeke idluliselwe esizukulwaneni esilandelayo ngoba umuntu ngeke aphile aze afinyelele eminyakeni yokuzala. Ukukhetha kwemvelo kusebenza ezingeni lomuntu ngamunye; kukhetha abantu abaneqhaza elikhulu echibini lezakhi zofuzo lesizukulwane esilandelayo, elaziwa ngokuthi ukufaneleka kwemvelo (Darwinian) kwezinto eziphilayo.

 Ukufaneleka kuvame ukubalwa futhi kulinganiswa ososayensi kulo mkhakha. Kodwa-ke, akuyona impilo ephelele yomuntu ebaluleke kakhulu, kodwa kunalokho ukuthi iqhathaniswa kanjani nezinye izinto eziphilayo emphakathini. Lo mqondo, obizwa ngokuthi impilo ehlobene, uvumela abacwaningi ukuthi banqume ukuthi yibaphi abantu abanikela ngenzalo eyengeziwe esizukulwaneni esilandelayo, futhi ngaleyo ndlela, ukuthi umphakathi ungathuthuka kanjani.

 Kunezindlela eziningana ukukhetha okungathinta ngazo ukuhlukahluka kwabantu: ukuzinzisa ukukhetha, ukukhetha okuqondisiwe, ukukhetha okuhlukahlukene, ukukhetha okuncike emvamisa, kanye nokukhetha ngokocansi. Njengoba ukukhetha kwemvelo kuthonya amaza e-allele emphakathini, abantu bangaba ngokufana kakhulu ngokwezakhi zofuzo futhi ama-phenotypes aboniswayo angafana kakhulu noma ahluke kakhulu.
question1: Kuyini ukuziphendukela kwemvelo okuguquguqukayo?
answer1: Inqubo lapho ama-allele anenzuzo anda khona ngobuningi kanye nama-allele alimazayo ehla ngobuningi ngenxa yokukhethwa kwemvelo
distractor1a: Ukudalwa kwama-allele amasha ngokuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo
distractor1b: Izinguquko ezingahleliwe kuma-allele frequency ezibangelwa yingozi
distractor1c: Ukuhamba kwama-allele phakathi kwabantu
question2: Uhlobo luni lokukhetha olunciphisa ukwehluka kwabantu abahlala endaweni ezinzile?
answer2: Ukuqinisa ukukhetha
question3: Kwenzekani ngesikhathi sokukhetha indlela?
answer3: Ukwehlukahluka kwabantu kuya kuhlobo olusha nolungcono njengoba izimo zemvelo zishintsha
distractor3b: Izinhlobo ezimbili noma ngaphezulu ze-phenotypes ezidlulele zithandwa ngokulinganayo
distractor3c: Ukushintshashintsha kwezakhi zofuzo okungahleliwe kuphela okushintsha amaza e-allele
question4: Kuyini ukukhetha okuhlukahlukene?
answer4: Ukukhetha okukhetha izinhlobo ezimbili noma ngaphezulu ezihlukile, okwandisa ukwehluka phakathi kwabantu
distractor4a: Ukukhetha okukhetha ama-phenotype aphakathi nendawo
question5: Kuyini ukufaneleka kukaDarwin (ukuziphendukela kwemvelo)?
answer5: Umnikelo womuntu ngamunye wenzalo esizukulwaneni esilandelayo uma kuqhathaniswa nabanye abantu emphakathini
distractor5a: Amandla angokomzimba ezinto eziphilayo
question6: Kungani ukuqina komzimba kubaluleke kakhulu kunokuqina komzimba okuphelele?
answer6: Ngoba ukuziphendukela kwemvelo kuncike ekutheni umuntu uzala kanjani ngempumelelo uma kuqhathaniswa nabanye abantu emphakathini
distractor6a: Ngoba ukuqina komzimba okuphelele kulinganisa kuphela isikhathi sokuphila
distractor6b: Ngoba ukuqina komzimba okuhlobene akunaki ukuzala
distractor6c: Ngoba ukuqina komzimba okuphelele akunakulinganiswa
question7: Kuyini ukukhetha ngokocansi?
answer7: Uhlobo lokukhetha lapho ubulili obubodwa buphumelela kakhulu ekuzaleni, okuvame ukuholela ekuhlukeni kobulili
distractor7b: Ukukhetha okukhetha ama-phenotype afanayo kubo bobabili ubulili

chapterName: 4. Izinqubo Zokuziphendukela Kwemvelo | 19. Ukuziphendukela Kwemvelo Kwabantu | 19.3 Ukuziphendukela Kwemvelo Okuzivumelanisa Nezimo | Ukuqinisa Ukukhetha
chapterNameEnglish: 4. Evolutionary Processes | 19. The Evolution of Populations | 19.3 Adaptive Evolution | Stabilizing Selection
chapterContent: Uma ukukhetha kwemvelo kuthanda uhlobo olujwayelekile, kukhetha ngokumelene nokwehluka okukhulu, inani labantu lizobhekana nokukhethwa okuzinzile (Isithombe 19.9). Ebantwini bamagundane ahlala emahlathini, isibonelo, ukukhetha kwemvelo cishe kuzothanda izilwane ezifanelana kahle nephansi lehlathi futhi cishe azibonakali yizilwane ezidla ezinye. Uma umhlabathi unombala onsundu ohambisanayo, lawo magundane anoboya obufana kakhulu nalowo mbala cishe azosinda futhi azale, adlulisele izakhi zofuzo zawo eboyeni bawo onsundu. Amagundane aphethe ama-allele awenza abe lula noma abe mnyama kancane azobonakala enhlabathini futhi abe sengozini enkulu yokuba yisisulu sokudliwa yizilwane. Ngenxa yalokhu kukhetha, ukwehluka kwezakhi zofuzo zabantu kuzoncipha.
question1: Kuyini ukuzinzisa ukukhetha?
answer1: Ukukhetha kwemvelo okuthanda i-phenotype evamile ngenkathi kukhethwa ngokumelene nokwehluka okukhulu
distractor1a: Ukukhetha kwemvelo okukhetha uhlobo olulodwa olubi kakhulu
distractor1b: Ukukhetha kwemvelo okuthanda izinhlobo eziningi ezingavamile
distractor1c: Izinguquko ezingahleliwe kuma-allele frequency ezibangelwa yingozi
question2: Ukuzimisela ukukhetha kuthinta kanjani ukuhlukahluka kwezakhi zofuzo?
answer2: Kunciphisa ukuhlukahluka kwezakhi zofuzo phakathi kwabantu
distractor2c: Idala ama-allele amasha ngokuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo
question3: Kungani amagundane ansundu aphakathi nendawo ethandwa kakhulu ehlathini elinephansi lehlathi elinsundu?
answer3: Ngoba ziyahlangana nendawo ezikuyo futhi azivamile ukubonakala yizilwane ezidla ezinye izilwane
distractor3a: Ngoba zizala ngokushesha kunawo wonke amanye amagundane
question4: Yimaphi amagundane okungenzeka kakhulu ukuthi akhethwe ngokumelene nawo esibonelweni sehlathi?
answer4: Amagundane anoboya obukhanyayo noma obumnyama kakhulu kunephansi lehlathi
distractor4a: Amagundane anoboya obunsundu obuhambisana nendawo ezungezile
question5: Kungaphansi kwaziphi izimo zemvelo lapho ukukhetha okuzinzile kungenzeka khona kakhulu?
answer5: Endaweni ezinzile lapho i-phenotype evamile ilungiswa khona kangcono
distractor5a: Lapho indawo ishintsha ngokushesha
distractor5b: Uma izinhlobo ezimbili ezingavamile zithandwa ngokulinganayo
distractor5c: Uma izinguquko zenzeka ngamanani aphezulu kakhulu
question6: Uyini umphumela wesikhathi eside wokuzinzisa ukukhetha kubantu?
answer6: Abantu bafana kakhulu ngoba izimo ezingavamile ziba zincane kakhulu
distractor6a: Isibalo sabantu sihlukaniswe ngamaqembu amabili ahlukene
distractor6b: Wonke umuntu uthuthukisa uhlobo olusha lwe-phenotype
distractor6c: Imvamisa ye-allele ayishintshi
question7: Yiluphi uhlobo lwe-phenotype oluthandwa ngesikhathi sokukhetha okuzinzile?
answer7: I-phenotype ephakathi noma ephakathi

chapterName: 4. Izinqubo Zokuziphendukela Kwemvelo | 19. Ukuziphendukela Kwemvelo Kwabantu | 19.3 Ukuziphendukela Kwemvelo Okuzivumelanisa Nezimo | Ukukhetha Okuqondiswayo
chapterNameEnglish: 4. Evolutionary Processes | 19. The Evolution of Populations | 19.3 Adaptive Evolution | Directional Selection
chapterContent:
Uma indawo ishintsha, imiphakathi ivame ukukhethwa ngendlela eqondiswayo (Isithombe 19.9), ekhetha izinhlobo zezinhlobo ezithile ekugcineni kobubanzi bokuhlukahluka okukhona. Isibonelo esivelele salolu hlobo lokukhetha ukuvela kwe-peppered moth eNgilandi yekhulu le-18 nele-19. Ngaphambi kweNguquko Yezimboni, imiphakathi yayinombala okhanyayo kakhulu, okwayivumela ukuthi ihlangane nezihlahla ezinombala okhanyayo kanye nama-lichen endaweni yazo. Kodwa njengoba i-soot iqala ukuphuma ezimbonini, izihlahla zaba mnyama, futhi imiphakathi enombala okhanyayo yaba lula ngezinyoni ezidla ezinye izilwane ukuyibona. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, imvamisa yesimo se-melanic se-moth yanda ngoba yayinesilinganiso esiphezulu sokusinda ezindaweni zokuhlala ezithintekile ukungcola komoya ngoba umbala wazo omnyama uxubene nezihlahla ezinombala okhanyayo.

 Usosayensi angabona ukukhetha ngendlela eqondiswayo. Ake sithi imiphakathi yemivundla edla izimbali ifakwa endaweni enezitshalo eziqhakazayo. Uma izimbali sezidliwe, izitshalo azikwazi ukuzala. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ukuphakama kwezimbali kuzoshintsha kube phezulu ukuze onogwaja bangakwazi ukuzifinyelela Isithombe 19.8
question1: Kuyini ukukhetha okuqondiswayo?
answer1: Ukukhetha kwemvelo okuthanda ama-phenotypes kolunye uhlangothi lobubanzi bokuhlukahluka
distractor1a: Ukukhetha kwemvelo okuthanda i-phenotype evamile
distractor1b: Ukukhetha kwemvelo okuthanda zombili izinhlobo ezingavamile ngokulinganayo
distractor1c: Izinguquko ezingahleliwe kuma-allele frequency ezibangelwa yingozi
question2: Yini evame ukubangela ukuthi kube nokukhethwa kwendlela?
answer2: Ushintsho ezimweni zemvelo
question3: Kungani amabhu anombala ophuzi omnyama aqala ukwanda ngesikhathi seNguquko Yezimboni?
answer3: Umbala wazo omnyama wanikeza ukufihla okungcono ezihlahleni ezimbozwe umlotha, okwandisa ukusinda kwazo
distractor3a: Zazala ngokushesha kakhulu kunezinundu ezinombala okhanyayo
distractor3b: Ukungcola kwezimboni kwabangela ukuthi amabhu anombala okhanyayo aguquke abe amabhu amnyama
distractor3c: Izilwane ezidla ezinye izilwane zakhetha ukudla amabhu anombala omnyama
question4: Kwenzekani ngokuvama kwesimo se-melanic se-peppered moth ngesikhathi se-Industrial Revolution?
answer4: Kwanda ngoba amabhungane amnyama ayenenzuzo yokusinda
distractor4a: Kwancipha ngoba amabhungane amnyama kwakulula ukuwabona
question5: Esibonelweni sikanogwaja nesitshalo esiqhakazayo, yisiphi isici esithandwa ukukhetha okuqondiswayo?
answer5: Izimbali ezinde ezingafinyelelwa kalula onogwaja
distractor5a: Izimbali ezimfushane eziqhakaza kusenesikhathi
question6: Ukukhetha okuqondiswayo kuyithinta kanjani indlela ejwayelekile yokuphila kwabantu?
answer6: Ishintsha i-phenotype evamile iye kokunye okudlulele
distractor6c: Kubangela ukuba kukhule izinhlobo ezimbili ezivamile ze-phenotypes
question7: Yisiphi isimo esichaza kangcono ukukhetha okuqondiswayo?
answer7: Iqembu labantu liba nombala omnyama ngemva kokuba indawo yalo iba mnyama
distractor7a: Abantu abanezimfanelo ezijwayelekile banempilo enhle kakhulu endaweni ezinzile
distractor7b: Izinhlobo ezimbili ezingavamile zithandwa kakhulu kunezinhlobo eziphakathi
distractor7c: Amaza e-allele ashintsha kuphela ngenxa yengozi engahleliwe

chapterName: 4. Izinqubo Zokuziphendukela Kwemvelo | 19. Ukuziphendukela Kwemvelo | 19.3 Ukuziphendukela Kwemvelo Okuzivumelanisa Nezimo | Ukukhetha Okuxhomeke Ezikhathini Ezivamile
chapterNameEnglish: 4. Evolutionary Processes | 19. The Evolution of Populations | 19.3 Adaptive Evolution | Frequency-dependent Selection
chapterContent:
Olunye uhlobo lokukhetha, olubizwa ngokuthi ukukhetha okuncike kuma-frequency, luthanda izinhlobo ezivamile (ukukhetha okuncike kuma-frequency okuhle) noma okungajwayelekile (ukukhetha okuncike kuma-frequency okubi). Isibonelo esithakazelisayo salolu hlobo lokukhetha sibonakala eqenjini elihlukile lama-lizard asePacific Northwest. Ama-lizard avamile angama-side-blotted abesilisa afika ngamaphethini amathathu ombala womphimbo: i-orenji, i-blue, kanye nephuzi. Ngayinye yalezi zinhlobo inesu elihlukile lokuzala: amaduna ama-orange yiwona anamandla kakhulu futhi angalwa namanye amaduna ukuze afinyelele kwabesifazane bawo; amaduna aluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka anobukhulu obuphakathi futhi akha izibopho eziqinile nabalingani bawo; kanti amaduna aphuzi (Isithombe 19.10) amancane kakhulu, futhi abukeka njengezinsikazi, okuzivumela ukuthi zikwazi ukufihla ukuhlangana. Njengomdlalo we-rock-paper-scissors, i-orenji ishaya okuluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, okuluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka ishaya okuphuzi, kanye nokuphuzi ishaya okuluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka emncintiswaneni wabesifazane. Okusho ukuthi, amaduna amakhulu, aqinile anombala ophuzi angalwa namaduna aluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka ukuze ahlangane nabesifazane abanombala oluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, amaduna aluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka ayaphumelela ekuvikeleni ozakwabo kumaduna aphuzi anezithende, kanti amaduna aphuzi angabamba ama-copulations kubangane abangaba khona bamaduna amakhulu, ane-polygynous orange.

 Kulesi simo, amaduna aluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka azothandwa ngokukhethwa kwemvelo lapho inani labantu libuswa ngabesilisa abaluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, amaduna aluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka azochuma lapho inani labantu liyiduna eliphuzi kakhulu, kanti amaduna aphuzi azokhethwa lapho amaduna aluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka enabantu abaningi kakhulu. Ngenxa yalokho, inani lama-lizard ane-side-blot lijikeleza ekusatshalalisweni kwalezi zinhlobo—esizukulwaneni esisodwa, i-orange ingaba nkulu, bese amaduna aphuzi azoqala ukwanda ngokuphindaphindiwe. Uma amaduna aphuzi akha iningi labantu, amaduna aluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka azokhethwa. Ekugcineni, lapho amaduna aluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka eba yinto evamile, amaduna aluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka azophinde athandwe. Njengoba kuboniswe ngenhla, uma ukukhetha kuphambene nokuvamile, kukhetha okungajwayelekile, ngakho-ke esimweni se-lizard kukhona ukukhetha okuncike kuma-frequency angemihle.

 Ukukhetha okuncike emvamisa engalungile kusiza ukwandisa ukuguquguquka kwezakhi zofuzo zabantu ngokukhetha izinhlobo ezingavamile zezakhi zofuzo, kuyilapho ukukhetha okuncike emvamisa okuhle kuvame ukunciphisa ukuguquguquka kwezakhi zofuzo ngokukhetha izinhlobo ezivamile zezakhi zofuzo.
question1: Kuyini ukukhetha okuncike emvamisa?
answer1: Uhlobo lokukhetha kwemvelo lapho ukufaneleka kwe-phenotype kuncike ekutheni kuvame noma kungavamile kangakanani kubantu
distractor1a: Ukukhetha kwemvelo okuhlala kuthanda ama-phenotype aphakathi
distractor1b: Izinguquko ezingahleliwe kuma-allele frequencies ngenxa yengozi
distractor1c: Ukukhetha okuthanda ama-allele abusayo kuphela
question2: Kuyini ukukhetha okuncike emvamisani engemihle?
answer2: Ukukhetha okukhetha izinhlobo ezingavamile ze-phenotypes
distractor2c: Ukukhetha okususa zonke izinhlobo ze-allele ezingavamile
question3: Kuyini ukukhetha okuncike emvamisani enhle?
answer3: Ukukhetha okukhetha izinhlobo ezivamile ze-phenotypes
question4: Yimuphi umdwebo wombala womphimbo ezinhlotsheni ezivamile ezinamabala ohlangothini ohlotshaniswa nokuziphatha kokukhwelana kwezicathulo?
answer4: Abesilisa abaphuzi
distractor4a: Abesilisa abawolintshi
question5: Ukukhetha okuncike ekuvameni okungekuhle kuthinta kanjani ukuguquguquka kwezakhi zofuzo?
answer5: Kwandisa ukuhlukahluka kwezakhi zofuzo ngokukhetha izinhlobo ezingavamile ze-phenotypes
distractor5a: Kunciphisa ukuhlukahluka kwezakhi zofuzo ngokuqeda izinhlobo ezingavamile ze-phenotypes
question6: Ukukhetha okuhle okuncike ezikhathini eziningi kuvame ukuthinta kanjani ukuguquguquka kwezakhi zofuzo?
answer6: Kunciphisa ukuhlukahluka kwezakhi zofuzo ngokukhetha izinhlobo ezivamile ze-phenotypes
distractor6a: Kwandisa ukuhlukahluka kwezakhi zofuzo ngokukhetha izinhlobo ezingavamile ze-phenotypes
distractor6c: Idala ama-allele amasha ngokuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo
question7: Kungani ukuphindaphindeka kombala womphimbo ezinhlotsheni ezivamile zezibankwa ezinamabala ohlangothini kujikeleza ngokuhamba kwesikhathi?
answer7: Ngoba isu ngalinye lokuzalela linenzuzo lapho elinye isu livamile, okubangela ukuthi kuthandwe izinhlobo ezahlukene ze-phenotypes ngokuhamba kwesikhathi.
distractor7a: Ngoba izinguquko zofuzo zishintsha umbala womphimbo njalo esizukulwaneni ngasinye
distractor7b: Ngoba yonke imibala emithathu yomphimbo inempumelelo efanayo yokuzala
distractor7c: Ngoba ukukhetha kwemvelo kuhlala kuthanda abesilisa abakhulu kunabo bonke

chapterName: 4. Izinqubo Zokuziphendukela Kwemvelo | 19. Ukuziphendukela Kwemvelo Kwabantu | 19.3 Ukuziphendukela Kwemvelo Okuzivumelanisa Nezimo | Ukukhetha Ngocansi
chapterNameEnglish: 4. Evolutionary Processes | 19. The Evolution of Populations | 19.3 Adaptive Evolution | Sexual Selection
chapterContent:
Abesilisa nabesifazane bezinhlobo ezithile bavame ukuhluka kakhulu komunye nomunye ngezindlela ezingaphandle kwezitho zokuzala. Abesilisa bavame ukuba bakhulu, isibonelo, futhi babonisa imibala eminingi eyinkimbinkimbi kanye nemihlobiso, njengomsila wepigogo, kuyilapho abesifazane bevame ukuba bancane futhi bangabi mnandi ngokuhlobisa. Umehluko onjalo waziwa ngokuthi ama-dimorphisms ocansi (Isithombe 19.11), okuvela eqinisweni lokuthi ezinhlotsheni eziningi, ikakhulukazi izilwane, kunokwehluka okukhulu empumelelweni yokuzala yabesilisa kunabesifazane. Okusho ukuthi, amanye abesilisa—ngokuvamile abesilisa abakhulu, abanamandla, noma abahlotshiswe kakhulu—athola iningi elikhulu lokuhlangana okuphelele, kanti amanye awatholi lutho. Lokhu kungenzeka ngoba abesilisa bangcono ekulweni namanye abesilisa, noma ngoba abesilisa bazokhetha ukuhlangana nabesilisa abakhulu noma abahlotshiswe kakhulu. Kunoma yikuphi, lokhu kwehluka empumelelweni yokuzala kudala ingcindezi enkulu yokukhetha phakathi kwabesilisa ukuthola lokho kuhlangana, okuholela ekuguqukeni kobukhulu bomzimba obukhulu kanye nemihlobiso eyinkimbinkimbi ukuze kudonswe ukunaka kwabesifazane. Abesifazane, ngakolunye uhlangothi, bavame ukuthola ukuhlangana okumbalwa okukhethiwe; ngakho-ke, banamathuba amaningi okukhetha abesilisa abafiseleka kakhulu.

 Ukwehluka kobulili kuyahlukahluka kakhulu phakathi kwezinhlobo, vele, futhi ezinye izinhlobo zibuye ziguqulwe zibe yindima yobulili. Ezimweni ezinjalo, abesifazane bavame ukuba nokwehluka okukhulu empumelelweni yabo yokuzala kunabesilisa futhi bakhethwa ngokufanayo ngenxa yobukhulu bomzimba obukhulu kanye nezici eziyinkimbinkimbi ezivame ukuba yizimpawu zabesilisa.

 Izingcindezi zokukhetha kwabesilisa nabesifazane ukuze bathole ukuhlangana kwaziwa ngokuthi ukukhetha ngokocansi; kungabangela ukuthuthukiswa kwezici zobulili zesibili ezingazuzisi amathuba omuntu okusinda kodwa ezisiza ekwandiseni impumelelo yakhe yokuzala. Ukukhetha ngokocansi kungaba namandla kangangokuthi kukhetha izici ezilimaza ngempela ukusinda komuntu. Cabanga futhi, ngomsila wepigogo. Nakuba muhle futhi owesilisa onomsila omkhulu nonemibala kakhulu cishe uzowina owesifazane, awuyona into ewusizo kakhulu. Ngaphezu kokuba sobala kakhulu ezitheni, kwenza abesilisa bahambe kancane ekuzameni kwabo ukubaleka. Kukhona ubufakazi bokuthi le ngozi, empeleni, yingakho abesifazane bethanda imisila emikhulu kwasekuqaleni. Ukuqagela ukuthi imisila emikhulu inengozi, futhi amaduna amahle kakhulu kuphela asinda kuleyo ngozi: uma umsila mkhulu, kulapho amaduna efanelana khona. Lo mbono waziwa ngokuthi isimiso sokukhubazeka.

 I-hypothesis yezakhi zofuzo ezinhle ithi abesilisa bathuthukisa lezi zihlobiso ezihlaba umxhwele ukuze babonise ukusebenza kahle kwe-metabolism noma ikhono labo lokulwa nezifo. Abesifazane bese bekhetha abesilisa abanezimpawu ezihlaba umxhwele kakhulu ngoba kubonisa ukuphakama kwabo kwezakhi zofuzo, okuzobe sekudluliselwa kubantwana babo. Nakuba kungase kuphakanyiswe ukuthi abesifazane akufanele bakhethe ngoba cishe kuzonciphisa inani labo labantwana, uma abesilisa abangcono bezala abantwana abanempilo, kungaba wusizo. Inzalo encane, enempilo ingandisa amathuba okusinda ngaphezu kweningi, elibuthakathaka.

 Kokubili isimiso sokukhubazeka kanye ne-hypothesis yezakhi zofuzo ezinhle, lesi sici kuthiwa siyisibonakaliso esiqotho sekhwalithi yamadoda, ngaleyo ndlela sinikeza abesifazane indlela yokuthola abalingani abanempilo kakhulu—abesilisa abazodlulisela izakhi zofuzo ezinhle kakhulu kubantwana babo.
question1: Kuyini ukukhetha ngokocansi?
answer1: Uhlobo lokukhetha kwemvelo oluthanda izici ezandisa impumelelo yokuzala kunokusinda
distractor1a: Uhlobo lokukhetha oluthanda ama-allele abusayo kuphela
distractor1b: Izinguquko ezingahleliwe kuma-allele frequency ezibangelwa yingozi
distractor1c: Ukukhetha okwenzeka ezitshalweni kuphela
question2: Kuyini ukungafani kobulili?
answer2: Umehluko ngokubukeka phakathi kwabesilisa nabesifazane bohlobo olufanayo ngaphandle kwezitho zabo zokuzala
distractor2a: Umehluko ngenombolo yama-chromosome phakathi kwabesilisa nabesifazane
question3: Kungani izici zesilisa eziyinkimbinkimbi njengomsila we-peacocks zishintsha?
answer3: Ngoba zandisa impumelelo yokuzala ngokuheha abalingani, noma ngabe zinciphisa ukusinda
distractor3b: Ngoba zenza abesilisa babe ngcono ekutholeni ukudla
question4: Iyini isimiso sokukhubazeka?
answer4: Umqondo wokuthi izici ezibizayo zisho ngempela ukuthi umuntu uphilile kahle ngoba abantu abanamandla kuphela abangasinda naphezu kwazo
distractor4a: Umbono wokuthi yonke imihlobiso emikhulu inciphisa impumelelo yokuzala
distractor4b: Umqondo wokuthi abesifazane bahlala bekhetha abesilisa abakhulu kunabo bonke kungakhathaliseki ukuthi baphilile yini
distractor4c: Umbono wokuthi ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo okukhiqiza imihlobiso kuhlale kuyingozi
question5: Iyini i-hypothesis yezakhi zofuzo ezinhle?
answer5: Abesifazane bakhetha abesilisa abanezimpawu ezihlaba umxhwele ngoba lezo zimpawu zibonisa ikhwalithi ephezulu yezakhi zofuzo
distractor5a: Abesifazane bakhetha abesilisa ngokungahleliwe ukuze bandise ukuhlukahluka kwezakhi zofuzo
distractor5b: Abesilisa bakha imihlobiso ukuze bagweme izilwane ezidla ezinye
distractor5c: Imihlobiso emikhulu iyathuthuka ngoba ithuthukisa ukuqoqwa kokudla
question6: Kusho ukuthini isignali eqotho ekukhetheni ngokocansi?
answer6: Isici esibonisa ngokuthembekile ikhwalithi noma ukufaneleka kwezakhi zofuzo zomuntu
distractor6a: Isici esiqinisekisa ukusinda kuyo yonke indawo
distractor6c: Ukuguquka kwesimo okwenzeka kubantu abaphilile kuphela
question7: Kungani izinsikazi zingase zizale izingane ezimbalwa kodwa ezinempilo ngokukhetha abalingani abasezingeni eliphezulu?
answer7: Ngoba inzalo ezuza izakhi zofuzo ezinhle ingaba nethuba elikhulu lokusinda nokuzala
distractor7a: Ngoba abesifazane bangazala kanye kuphela empilweni yabo
distractor7b: Ngoba abesilisa abakhulu bahlala bezala abantwana abaningi kungakhathaliseki ukuthi izakhi zofuzo zinjani
distractor7c: Ngoba ukukhetha kwemvelo kusiza ekukhiqizeni inani elikhulu kakhulu lenzalo

chapterName: 4. Izinqubo Zokuziphendukela Kwemvelo | 19. Ukuziphendukela Kwemvelo | 19.3 Ukuziphendukela Kwemvelo Okuzivumelanisa Nezimo | Akukho Okuphilayo Okuphelele
chapterNameEnglish: 4. Evolutionary Processes | 19. The Evolution of Populations | 19.3 Adaptive Evolution | No Perfect Organism
chapterContent:
Ukukhetha kwemvelo kungamandla ashukumisayo ekuziphendukeleni kwemvelo futhi kungadala imiphakathi ekwazi ukuzivumelanisa kangcono nokuphila nokuzala ngempumelelo ezindaweni zayo. Kodwa ukukhetha kwemvelo akukwazi ukukhiqiza imvelo ephelele. Ukukhetha kwemvelo kungakhetha kuphela ukuhlukahluka okukhona kubantu; akudali lutho kusukela ekuqaleni. Ngakho-ke, kunqunyelwe ukuhlukahluka kwezakhi zofuzo zabantu kanye nanoma yiziphi izidalwa ezintsha ezivela ngokuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo kanye nokugeleza kwezakhi zofuzo.

 Ukukhetha kwemvelo nakho kunqunyelwe ngoba kusebenza ezingeni labantu, hhayi ama-allele, futhi amanye ama-allele axhumene ngenxa yokusondela kwawo ngokomzimba ku-genome, okwenza kube lula ukuthi adluliselwe ndawonye (ukungalingani kokuxhumana). Noma yimuphi umuntu angase abe nama-allele athile awusizo kanye nama-allele athile angathandeki. Kungumphumela walezi zi-allele, noma ukufaneleka komzimba, lapho ukukhetha kwemvelo kungasebenza khona. Ngenxa yalokho, ama-allele amahle angalahleka uma ethwalwa ngabantu abanama-allele amaningi amabi kakhulu; ngokufanayo, ama-allele amabi angagcinwa uma ethwalwa ngabantu abanama-allele amahle anele ukuholela enzuzweni yokufaneleka komzimba iyonke.

 Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukukhetha kwemvelo kungavinjelwa ubudlelwano phakathi kwama-polymorphism ahlukene. I-morph eyodwa ingase inikeze ukuqina okuphezulu kunenye, kodwa ingase ingandi ngokuvama ngenxa yokuthi ukusuka kokungazuzisi kakhulu kuya kokuzuzisa kakhulu kungadinga ukudlula ku-phenotype engazuzisi kakhulu. Cabanga ngamagundane ahlala ogwini lolwandle. Amanye anombala okhanyayo futhi ahlangana nesihlabathi, kanti amanye amnyama futhi ahlangana neziqeshana zotshani. Amagundane anombala omnyama, ngokujwayelekile, angase afaneleke kakhulu kunamagundane anombala okhanyayo, futhi ekuqaleni, umuntu angalindela ukuthi amagundane anombala okhanyayo akhethwe ukuze abe nombala omnyama. Kodwa khumbula ukuthi i-phenotype ephakathi, uboya obuphakathi nendawo, bubi kakhulu kumagundane—awakwazi ukuhlangana nesihlabathi noma utshani futhi angase adliwe yizilwane ezidla ezinye. Ngenxa yalokho, amagundane anombala okhanyayo ngeke akhethwe ukuze abe nombala omnyama ngoba lawo aqale ukuhamba ngaleyo ndlela (aqale ukukhethwa ukuze abe nombala omnyama) ngeke afaneleke kangako kunalawo ahlala elula.

 Okokugcina, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi akuzona zonke izinto eziziphendukela kwemvelo ezivumelana nezimo. Nakuba ukukhetha kwemvelo kukhetha abantu abanamandla kakhulu futhi kuvame ukuphumela kubantu abafaneleka kakhulu, amanye amandla okuziphendukela kwemvelo, okuhlanganisa ukukhukhuleka kwezakhi zofuzo kanye nokugeleza kwezakhi zofuzo, avame ukwenza okuphambene nalokho: ukwethula ama-allele ayingozi echibini lezakhi zofuzo labantu. Ukuziphendukela kwemvelo akunanjongo—akuguquli abantu babe yinto ecatshangelwe kusengaphambili. Kumane kuyisamba samandla ahlukahlukene achazwe kulesi sahluko nokuthi athonya kanjani ukuguquguquka kwezakhi zofuzo kanye ne-phenotypic kwabantu.
question1: Kungani ukukhethwa kwemvelo kungakwazi ukukhiqiza into ephilayo ephelele?
answer1: Ngoba ingasebenza kuphela ekuguqukeni kwezakhi zofuzo okukhona kanye nokwehluka okusha okulethwe ukuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo kanye nokugeleza kwezakhi zofuzo.
distractor1a: Ngoba ukukhethwa kwemvelo kudala izakhi zofuzo ezintsha ngokuphelele noma nini lapho zidingeka
distractor1b: Ngoba yonke into ephilayo kakade ine-genotype efanele kakhulu
distractor1c: Ngoba ukuziphendukela kwemvelo kuhlala kuyama uma uhlobo oluthile seluphumelele
question2: Kungani ama-allele anenzuzo ngezinye izikhathi angalahleka kubantu?
answer2: Ngoba zingase zihlotshaniswe nama-allele ayingozi kubantu abanempilo ephansi
distractor2a: Ngoba ama-allele anenzuzo ahlala eguquka abe ama-allele ayingozi
distractor2b: Ngoba ukukhethwa kwemvelo kusebenza kuphela kuma-allele aphindaphindayo
distractor2c: Ngoba ama-allele anenzuzo awakwazi ukutholwa njengefa
question3: Kuyini ukungalingani kwezixhumanisi?
answer3: Ukuthambekela kwama-allele aseduze ku-chromosome ukuthi azuzwe njengefa ndawonye
distractor3a: Ukusatshalaliswa okulinganayo kwama-allele kuzo zonke izizukulwane
distractor3c: Ukulahleka okungahleliwe kwama-allele ngenxa yokuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo
question4: Kungani i-phenotype enenzuzo kakhulu ingase ihluleke ukuba yinto evamile kubantu abaningi?
answer4: Ngoba ukuguqukela kukho kungadinga ukudlula ku-phenotype ephakathi engafaneleki kahle
distractor4a: Ngoba izici ezizuzisayo azizuzi njengefa
distractor4b: Ngoba ukuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo kuhlala kususa izici ezizuzisayo
distractor4c: Ngoba ukukhetha kwemvelo kusiza kuphela ama-phenotype aphakathi nendawo
question5: Isibonelo segundane lasebhishi sibonisani?
answer5: Ukuthi izinhlobo ze-phenotype eziphakathi zingakhethwa ngokumelene nazo, kuvimbele inani labantu ukuthi lifinyelele isici esingcono.
distractor5a: Ukuthi zonke izinguquko ziyingozi
distractor5b: Ukuthi ukuzulazula kwezakhi zofuzo kuhlala kukhiqiza ukuzivumelanisa nezimo
distractor5c: Lokho amagundane anombala okhanyayo ahlala encintisana namagundane anombala omnyama
question6: Kungani konke ukuziphendukela kwemvelo kungaguquguquki?
answer6: Ngoba amandla anjengokukhukhuleka kwezakhi zofuzo kanye nokugeleza kwezakhi zofuzo angaletha noma agcine ama-allele ayingozi
distractor6a: Ngoba ukukhetha kwemvelo kuhlala kunciphisa ukuqina komzimba
distractor6c: Ngoba izici ezizivumelanisa nezimo kuphela ezizuzwa njengefa
question7: Yisiphi isisho esichaza kangcono ukuziphendukela kwemvelo?
answer7: Ukuziphendukela kwemvelo akunanhloso enqunyiwe kusengaphambili; kubonisa imiphumela ehlangene yamandla asebenza ekuguqukeni kwezakhi zofuzo kanye ne-phenotypic
distractor7a: Ukuziphendukela kwemvelo kuhlala kukhiqiza izinto eziphilayo eziphelele ngokwengeziwe
distractor7b: Ukuziphendukela kwemvelo kuhlala kushukumisela izinhlobo zezinto eziphilayo ekubunkimbinkimbi obukhulu
distractor7c: Ukuziphendukela kwemvelo kwenzeka kuphela ngokukhetha kwemvelo

question1: Kuyini ukuziphendukela kwemvelo okuguquguqukayo?
answer1: Ukwanda kokuvama kwama-allele azuzisayo kanye nokwehla kwama-allele ayingozi ngenxa yokukhethwa

answer3: Lapho abantu bevame ukuhlangana nalabo abafana nabo ngokwe-phenotypically

answer4: Ukwandiswa kokuguquguquka kwezakhi zofuzo ngenxa yezehlakalo zemvelo noma izinhlekelele

answer17: Ingxenye yohlobo oluthile lwe-genotype kubantu uma kuqhathaniswa nazo zonke ezinye izinhlobo ze-genotype
answer18: Umehluko ekuhlukeni kwe-phenotypic phakathi kwabantu abahlukaniswe ngokwezindawo

answer19: Inkolelo-mbono yokuthi imihlobiso ehlaba umxhwele ibonisa ukusebenza kahle kwe-metabolism noma ukumelana nezifo

answer34: Isici semvelo esenza enye i-phenotype ibe ngcono kunenye
answer35: Umehluko we-phenotypic phakathi kwabesilisa nabesifazane besibalo sabantu
distractor35c: Umehluko obangelwa ukuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo kuphela

distractor36c: Ukukhetha okukhetha izinhlobo ezimbili ezihlukile kakhulu

chapterName: 4. Izinqubo Zokuziphendukela Kwemvelo | 19. Ukuziphendukela Kwemvelo Kwabantu | 19.5 Isifinyezo Sesahluko
chapterNameEnglish: 4. Evolutionary Processes | 19. The Evolution of Populations | 19.5 Chapter Summary
chapterContent:
19.1 Ukuziphendukela Komphakathi
Ukuhlanganiswa kwesimanje kwenkolelo-mbono yokuziphendukela kwemvelo kwavela ekuhlanganiseni kwemicabango kaDarwin, uWallace, noMendel ngokuziphendukela kwemvelo kanye nofuzo, kanye nesifundo sesimanje sezakhi zofuzo zabantu. Kuchaza ukuvela kwezinhlobo nezinhlobo, kusukela ezinguqukweni ezincane phakathi kwabantu kuya ezinguqukweni ezinkulu ngezikhathi ze-paleontological. Ukuze baqonde ukuthi izinto eziphilayo ziguquka kanjani, ososayensi bangakwazi ukulandelela amaza e-allele abantu ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Uma zihluka ezizukulwaneni ngezizukulwane, ososayensi bangaphetha ngokuthi inani labantu alikho ekubalweni kweHardy-Weinberg, futhi ngaleyo ndlela liyashintsha.

 19.2 Izakhi Zofuzo Zabantu
Zombili izici zofuzo kanye nezemvelo zingabangela ukuhlukahluka kwe-phenotypic kubantu. Ama-allele ahlukene anganikeza ama-phenotype ahlukene, futhi izindawo ezahlukene zingabangela abantu ukuba babukeke noma benze ngendlela ehlukile. Nokho, lawo mehluko kuphela obhalwe kuzakhi zofuzo zomuntu ngamunye, ungadluliselwa enzalweni yakhe futhi, ngaleyo ndlela, ube yisisulu sokukhethwa kwemvelo. Ukukhetha kwemvelo kusebenza ngokukhetha ama-allele anikeza izici noma ukuziphatha okuzuzisayo, kuyilapho kukhethwa ngokumelene nalawo anezimfanelo ezimbi. Ukukhukhuleka kwezakhi zofuzo kuvela ekuveleni kwengozi kokuthi abanye abantu abasohlwini lwezakhi zofuzo banenzalo eningi kunabanye. Lapho abantu beshiya noma bejoyina inani labantu, imvamisa ye-allele ingashintsha ngenxa yokugeleza kwezakhi zofuzo. Ukuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo kungabangela ukuhlukahluka okusha kubantu. Imvamisa ye-allele ingashintshwa nalapho abantu bengahlangani ngokungahleliwe nabanye eqenjini.

 19.3 Ukuziphendukela Kwemvelo Okuguquguqukayo
Ngoba ukukhetha kwemvelo kusebenza ukwandisa imvamisa yama-allele azuzisayo kanye nezici ngenkathi kunciphisa imvamisa yezimfanelo ezimbi, kuyinguquko eguquguqukayo. Ukukhetha kwemvelo kusebenza ezingeni lomuntu ngamunye, kukhetha labo abanokufaneleka okuphezulu uma kuqhathaniswa nabanye abantu. Uma ama-phenotype afanele yilawo afanayo, ukukhetha kwemvelo kuzoholela ekuzinziseni ukukhetha, kanye nokwehla okuphelele kokuhlukahluka kwabantu. Ukukhetha okuqondisiwe kusebenza ukushintsha ukuhlukahluka kwabantu kuye ku-phenotype entsha, efanelekile, njengoba izimo zemvelo zishintsha. Ngokuphambene nalokho, ukukhetha okuhlukahlukene kuholela ekwandeni kokuguquguquka kwezakhi zofuzo ngokukhetha izinhlobo ezimbili noma ngaphezulu ezihlukile.

 Ezinye izinhlobo zokukhetha zifaka phakathi ukukhetha okuncike emvamisa, lapho abantu abanokukhetha okuvamile (ukukhetha okuncike emvamisa okuhle) noma okungajwayelekile (ukukhetha okuncike emvamisa okubi) bakhethwa khona. Okokugcina, ukukhetha ngokocansi kubangelwa ukuthi ubulili obubodwa bunokuguquguquka okukhulu empumelelweni yokuzala kunobunye. Ngenxa yalokho, abesilisa nabesifazane babhekana nezingcindezi ezihlukile zokukhetha, okuvame ukuholela ekuguqukeni komehluko we-phenotypic, noma ukungafani kobulili, phakathi kwalezi zinto ezimbili.
question1: Uyini umthombo omkhulu wazo zonke izinhlobo zabantu phakathi kwabantu naphakathi kwabo?
answer1: Ukuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo okuholela ekuzalweni okusebenzayo
distractor1a: Ukukhetha kwemvelo
distractor1c: Izici emvelweni ezingathinta intuthuko
question2: Lapho amathole engonyama esilisa eshiya ukuziqhenya kwawo lapho efika ekuvuthweni, iyiphi indlela yokuziphendukela kwemvelo engashintsha amaza e-allele?
answer2: Ukugeleza kwezakhi zofuzo
question3: Yimuphi umphakathi ophula imibandela yokulingana kweHardy-Weinberg?
answer3: Iqembu labantu elikhethwa ngokwemvelo
distractor3b: Isibalo sabantu lapho imvamisa ye-allele ingashintshi khona ngokuhamba kwesikhathi
distractor3c: Inani labantu lapho i-Hardy-Weinberg equation ilingana no-1
question4: Uyini umehluko phakathi kokuguquka kwezinto ezincane kanye nokuguquka kwezinto ezinkulu?
answer4: Ukuguquka kwesimo sezulu okungekuhle kuchaza ukuvela kwezinhlobo zabantu, kuyilapho ukuguquka kwesimo sezulu okungekuhle kuchaza ukuvela kwezinhlobo zezilwane isikhathi eside
distractor4a: Ukuguquka kwesimo sezulu okubangelwa izinto ezincane kuhilela izinto eziphilayo ezincane, kanti ukuguquka kwesimo sezulu okubangelwa izinto ezinkulu kuhilela izinto eziphilayo ezinkulu.
distractor4b: Ukuguquka kwesimo sezulu okungekuhle kuhilela ama-molecule, kanti ukuguquka kwesimo sezulu okungekuhle kuhilela izinto eziphilayo
distractor4c: Ukuguquka kwe-Microevolution kwenzeka ngesikhathi sokuphila kwezinto eziphilayo, kuyilapho ukuguquka kwe-macroevolution kwenzeka ezizukulwaneni ngezizukulwane
question5: Yisiphi isitatimende esingasekelwa yimfundiso kaLamarcks?
answer5: Izingalo eziqinile ze-gorilla ziwumphumela wabazali bayo abakhuphuka njalo, bephakamisa, futhi belwa
distractor5a: Ukukhetha kwemvelo kuholela ezinguqukweni zezinto eziphilayo ngokuhamba kwesikhathi
distractor5b: Ukuntuleka kwezinsiza kuholele ekufeni kwamathole amathathu kwamane empungushe
distractor5c: Umphumela womsunguli uvela lapho abantu abambalwa behlukaniswa nenani labantu bokuqala
question6: Ukwehlukahluka kwabantu kuthonywa yini?
answer6: Konke okungenhla
distractor6c: Ukwakheka kokudla
question7: Kuyini ukuhlukahluka kwezakhi zofuzo?
answer7: Ukuhlukahluka kwama-allele kanye nama-genotype ngaphakathi kwesibalo sabantu
distractor7b: Umphumela wengozi echibini lezakhi zofuzo zabantu
distractor7c: Ukwandiswa kokuguquguquka kwezakhi zofuzo okubangelwa izinhlekelele zemvelo
question8: Kungani inzalo yabantu abahlobene eduze ivame ukungakhuli kahle?
answer8: Ukuzalanisa izinhlobo ezingafani kungaletha izinguquko ezingavamile neziyingozi eziholela ezinhlotsheni eziyingozi
distractor8a: Ukuzalanisa izinhlobo ezingafani kubangela ukuthi kuvele ama-allele athule
distractor8b: I-DNA yezihlobo eziseduze isabela kabi enzalweni
question9: Yini engabangela ukukhukhuleka kwezakhi zofuzo emphakathini?
question10: Iyiphi indlela yokuziphendukela kwemvelo eshintsha amaza e-allele ngengozi?
answer11: Uma abantu behlangana nalabo abafana nabo ngokwe-phenotypically
distractor11a: Lapho abantu behlangana nalabo abangafani nabo ngokwejwayelekile
distractor11b: Uma abantu behlangana nalabo abafaneleka kakhulu emphakathini
distractor11c: Uma abantu behlangana nalabo abangafaneleki kahle emphakathini
answer12: Uhlobo olubekezelela kakhulu ukubanda ezindaweni ezibandayo zohlobo lwalo kunasezindaweni ezifudumele zohlobo lwalo
distractor12b: Uguquko olusakazeka kulo lonke uhlobo lwemvelo
distractor12c: Abesifazane bohlobo oluthile bakhetha abesilisa abanombala ophuzi esikhundleni somhlophe

question14: Yiziphi izinhlobo ze-phenotypes ezithandwa ukukhetha okuncike kumaza angemihle?
question15: I-hypothesis yezakhi zofuzo ezinhle iyi-theory echaza ukuthini?
answer15: Kungani abantu bobulili obubodwa beba nezici zokuhlobisa ezihlaba umxhwele
distractor15a: Kungani abantu abanempilo enhle kakhulu benamathuba amaningi okuthola abantwana abaningi
distractor15b: Kungani ama-allele anikeza izici noma ukuziphatha okuzuzisayo ekhethwa ngokukhetha kwemvelo
distractor15c: Kungani ezinye izinguquko ezimbi zigcinwa kubantu
question16: Yikuphi kokulandelayo okuchaza lapho abesilisa nabesifazane beqembu elithile bebukeka noma benza ngendlela ehlukile?
question17: Chaza ukukhetha kwemvelo bese unikeza isibonelo sokukhetha kwemvelo okusebenza emphakathini
answer17: Inqubo lapho izinto eziphilayo ezikwazi ukuzivumelanisa nezimo kangcono zikwazi ukusinda nokuzala; ubukhulu bomlomo wezinyoni zikaDarwin bushintsha njengoba ukutholakala kwembewu enobukhulu obuhlukahlukene kushintsha
distractor17a: Inqubo lapho izakhi zofuzo zigeleza khona zisuka kwesinye isizwe ziye kwesinye; ubukhulu bomlomo wama-Darwin’s finch bushintsha njengoba ukutholakala kwembewu enobukhulu obuhlukahlukene kushintsha
distractor17b: Inqubo lapho izakhi zofuzo zigeleza khona zisuka kubantu abathile ziye kwabanye; Umphumela Womsunguli owenzeka phakathi kwabantu abathuthela ezweni elisha
distractor17c: Inqubo lapho izinto eziphilayo ezikwazi ukuzivumelanisa kangcono zikwazi ukusinda nokuzala; Umphumela Womsunguli owenzeka phakathi kwabantu abathuthela ezweni elisha
question18: Cabanga uzama ukuhlola ukuthi ngabe inqwaba yezimbali iyavela yini. Usola ukuthi kukhona ukucindezela kokukhetha embaleni wembali: izinyosi zibonakala zihlangana zizungeze izimbali ezibomvu kaningi kunezimbali eziluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka. Kokunye ukuhlola, uthola ukuthi umbala wembali eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka ubaluleke kakhulu kunombala wembali ebomvu. Ensimini, ubala izimbali eziluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka ezingu-600 kanye nezimbali ezibomvu ezingu-200. Ubungalindela ukuthi isakhiwo sezakhi zofuzo zezimbali sibe yini?
answer18: Ungalindela izimbali eziluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka ezingama-200 ezi-homozygous dominant, izimbali eziluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka ezingama-400 ezi-heterozygous, kanye nezimbali ezibomvu ezingama-200 ezi-homozygous recessive.
distractor18a: Ungalindela izimbali eziluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka ezingu-300 ezi-homozygous dominant, izimbali eziluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka ezingu-300 ezi-heterozygous, kanye nezimbali ezibomvu ezingu-200 ezi-homozygous recessive.
distractor18b: Ungalindela izimbali ezibomvu eziyi-100 ezi-homozygous dominant, izimbali ezibomvu eziyi-100 ezi-heterozygous, kanye nezimbali eziluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka eziyi-600 ezi-homozygous recessive.
distractor18c: Ungalindela izimbali ezibomvu eziyi-14 ezi-homozygous dominant, izimbali eziluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka eziyi-186 ezi-heterozygous, kanye nezimbali eziluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka eziyi-600 ezi-homozygous recessive.
question19: Ukuziphendukela kwemvelo kukhiqiza izici ezintsha kubantu ngezinqubo ezaziwayo nezifundwe kahle. Yini okumele yenzeke ukuze isici esisha sivele kubantu bese sifinyelela ukuvama okuqhubekayo, okuphezulu kulowo muntu? Khetha impendulo enikeza isizathu esifanele sokusekela ukukhetha
answer19: Izici ezintsha zivela ngokuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo noma ngokugeleza kwezakhi zofuzo. Ukuze kufinyelelwe ukuvama okuqhubekayo nokuphezulu kwabantu, isici esihlotshaniswa nesakhi sofuzo kumele sithandwe ngokukhetha kwemvelo noma ngokobulili.
distractor19a: Izici ezintsha zivela ngokuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo noma ngokukhukhuleka kwezakhi zofuzo. Ukuze kufinyelelwe ukuvama okuqhubekayo nokuphezulu kwabantu, kumele kube nezinguquko eziningi, njengemisebe ye-UV, endaweni ezungezile ukuze kukhiqizwe izinguquko eziningi.
distractor19b: Izici ezintsha zivela ngokuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo noma ngokukhukhuleka kwezakhi zofuzo. Ukuze kufinyelelwe ukwanda okuqhubekayo nokuphakeme kwabantu, kumele kube nomthombo oqhubekayo wabantu abavela kwamanye amazwe abane-allele
distractor19c: Izici ezintsha zivela ngokuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo noma ngokuziphendukela kwemvelo. Ukuze kufinyelelwe ukuvama okuqhubekayo nokuphezulu kwabantu, i-allele yesici kumele ibhale ukuze kube nokuzivumelanisa okuhle.
question20: Chaza futhi ukhombe isibonelo sokwehlukahluka kwabantu
answer20: Ukwehlukahlukana kwenani labantu kuwukusabalala kwezinhlobo ze-phenotypes kubantu. Isibonelo sokwehlukahlukana kwenani labantu kungaba imibala eminingi ehlukene yoboya kanye namaphethini atholakala ezinjeni zasekhaya.
distractor20a: Ukwehlukahlukana kwabantu kuyincazelo yokwehlukahlukana kwezinhlobo ezahlukene zokuphila. Isibonelo sokwehlukahlukana kwabantu kungaba izinhlobo ezahlukene nemisebenzi yama-prokaryotes uma kuqhathaniswa nama-eukaryotes
distractor20b: Ukwehlukahlukana kwabantu kuwukusabalala kwezindawo kwezinhlobo ezahlukene zezilwane emphakathini. Isibonelo sokwehlukahlukana kwabantu kungaba iqiniso lokuthi izilwane ezincelisayo ezinegazi elifudumele ezihlala eduze kwezinsika zivame ukuba zikhulu kunezilwane eziseningizimu ukuze zilondoloze ukushisa.
distractor20c: Ukwehlukahlukana kwabantu kuwukusabalala kwezinhlobo zofuzo kubantu. Isibonelo sokwehlukahlukana kwabantu kungaba izitshalo zikaMendel ze-pea ezaziyi-homozygous dominant, heterozygous, kanye ne-homozygous recessive ngezici ezahlukahlukene.
question21: Bheka uMfanekiso 19.12. Yini echazwa kulesi sithombe?
question22: Bheka uMfanekiso 19.13. Yenza isibikezelo mayelana nezimpawu zofuzo zabantu ezizokwakheka esiqhingini I
distractor22a: Kungaba ingxube yabantu abavela eziqhingini i-G ne-H
distractor22b: Kungaba ingxube yabantu abavela eziqhingini A, G, kanye ne-H
question23: Chaza ukuthi iyini i-cline bese ukhomba isibonelo
answer23: I-cline uhlobo lokwehluka kwendawo olubonakala ezinhlotsheni zezinhlobo ezithile ezishintsha kancane kancane ngokwezinga lemvelo. Isibonelo, izilwane ezihlala emvelweni zivame ukuba nemizimba emikhulu ezindaweni ezipholile eduze kwezinsika zoMhlaba, okuzivumela ukuthi zilondoloze ukushisa kangcono.
distractor23a: I-cline wushintsho ezimweni zemvelo ebangeni elithile. Isibonelo, i-latitudinal cline ukwehla kwezinga lokushisa kuya ezimpondweni zoMhlaba, kanti i-altitudinal cline ukwehla kwezinga lokushisa ngokwanda kokuphakama.
distractor23b: I-cline iyiqoqo elithile lezimpawu kubantu bezinhlobo ezithile ezithonywe yindawo ezungezile. Isibonelo, iqembu lezilwane ezinegazi elifudumele ezazihlala endaweni epholile eduze neNorth Pole zaziyoba nemizimba emikhulu, okuzivumela ukuthi zilondoloze ukushisa kangcono.
distractor23c: I-cline iyisethi ethile yezimo zemvelo endaweni ethile. Isibonelo, ngaseNorth Pole kuyabanda futhi kunemvula encane. Lokhu kuzothinta izici zezinto eziphilayo ezihlala lapho.
question25: I-large alpha duna elephant seal ihlala ivikela ukushelela kwabesilisa abaphakathi nendawo. Abesilisa abancane bayakwazi ukufihla ubulili nabesifazane futhi badlulisele izakhi zofuzo zabo ngempumelelo. Siyini lesi sibonelo? Chaza
answer25: Lesi yisibonelo sokukhetha okuhlukahlukene, okuwukukhetha okuthanda izimo ezingavamile. Abesilisa abakhohlisayo bayathandwa kulokhu.
distractor25a: Lesi yisibonelo sokukhetha ngokocansi. Abesifazane bakhetha abesilisa abancane kunesilisa esikhulu
distractor25b: Lesi yisibonelo sokuguguleka kwezakhi zofuzo. Ngenxa yokuthi kunezinduna eziningi eziphakathi nendawo ezincintisana nenduna enkulu ye-alpha, izinduna ezincane ziyakwazi ukuhlangana futhi zibangele ukuthi i-gene pool ishintshele kubantu abancane.
distractor25c: Lesi yisibonelo sokukhetha izinkomba. Ngenxa yokuthi yizinduna ezincane kakhulu kuphela ezizalelana, isizukulwane esilandelayo sizoba nenani elikhulu lama-allele ngobukhulu obuncane, okwenza izimbuzi zibe zincane ngokuhamba kwesikhathi.
question26: Xoxa ngendaba yebhayoloji yokuthi ayikho into ephilayo ephelele naphezu kokukhethwa kwemvelo ngokukhetha isizathu esichaza kangcono ukuthi kungani lokhu kuyiqiniso
answer26: Ngoba ukukhethwa kwemvelo kunqunyelwe ukuhlukahluka kwezakhi zofuzo okukhona
distractor26a: Ngoba ukukhetha kwemvelo kusebenza ezingeni lendawo
distractor26b: Ngoba ukukhetha kwemvelo kusebenza ngendlela engahleliwe, njengokuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo
distractor26c: Ngoba ukukhetha kwemvelo kunqunyelwe ku-dimorphism yobulili
question29:

distractor29c: Yebo, ngoba kubonisa ukuthi imvamisa yazo zombili izinhlobo ze-allele iyashintsha ngokuhamba kwesikhathi
question30:
Usosayensi ufunda izinhlobo ezimbili ezinkulu zezinyamazane ezitholakala emahlathini aseduze. Uthatha amasampula egazi kuzo zonke izinyamazane kumuntu ngamunye bese eqopha ukuthi zingaki izinhlobo zabantu azitholayo i-allele A. Ube esebala imvamisa yama-allele kumuntu ngamunye. Imvamisa yama-allele abonwe eminyakeni emihlanu iboniswe ematafuleni anikeziwe. Hlola idatha ukuze uphendule okulandelayo: Yiziphi izinhlobo zokuziphendukela kwemvelo okungenzeka kakhulu ukuthi zenzeke kubantu 1 no-2? Nikeza ubufakazi bokusekela impendulo yakho.

answer30: Kubantu abangu-1, kungenzeka ukuthi ukukhethwa kwemvelo kwenzeka, lapho i-allele A ithandwa kakhulu kune-allele B. Kubantu abangu-2, kubonakala sengathi ukugeleza kwezakhi zofuzo kwenzeka, okuvumela i-allele A ukuthi isungulwe kubantu abangu-2. Kubonakala sengathi i-allele A nayo iyathandwa ngokukhethwa kwabantu abangu-1. Kubantu abangu-2, kungenzeka ukuthi kukhona ukuguguleka kwezakhi zofuzo, okubangela ukuthi i-allele A ivame kakhulu kune-allele B.
distractor30b: Kubantu bokuqala, ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo kubonakala sengathi kwenzeke, kwethula i-allele B kubantu bokuqala. I-Allele A nayo ibonakala ikhula ngenxa yokuguquguquka kwezakhi zofuzo kubantu bokuqala. Kubantu bokuqala, ukukhethwa kwemvelo kungenzeka kwenzeke, lapho i-allele A ithandwa kakhulu kune-allele B.
distractor30c: Kubantu abangu-1, kungenzeka ukuthi kukhona ukuguguleka kwezakhi zofuzo, okubangela ukuthi i-allele A ivame kakhulu kune-allele B. Kubantu abangu-2, kubonakala sengathi kube noguquko, olwethula i-allele A kubantu abangu-2. Kubonakala sengathi i-Allele A nayo iyanda ngenxa yokuguguleka kwezakhi zofuzo kubantu abangu-2.
question31:

answer31: Ukusika utshani kuvimbela utshani ukuthi buzalane, okwenza insimu egundiwe ivumelane nokukhula kwezimbali kusenesikhathi.
distractor31a: Utshani buyajwayela ukucheba, ngakho-ke bungaqhakaza isikhathi eside ngaphambi kokuba buchekwe.
distractor31b: Ukucheba utshani kuqinisa isikhathi sokuqhakaza kwezimbali, okulandela ukuthambekela okuqhubekayo ensimini echekiwe kodwa hhayi ensimini engachekiwe.
distractor31c: Utshani buvame ukuqhakaza kusenesikhathi futhi kusenesikhathi minyaka yonke njengoba bukhula unyaka nonyaka.
question32: Bheka uMfanekiso 19.14. Usosayensi waqaphela inqwaba yezinambuzane ezimbili iminyaka eyi-10. Bathatha idatha ngobude, ngo-mm, bezingxenye zomlomo wezinambuzane. Imininingwane yabo iboniswe kumagrafu angezansi. Leli nani lithuthuka kanjani futhi yiliphi inxusa lokuziphendukela kwemvelo okungenzeka ukuthi lisebenza kakhulu?
answer32: Ukukhetha kwemvelo, njengoba izinambuzane ezinezingxenye zomlomo eziphakathi nendawo zithandwa kakhulu
distractor32a: Ukufuya izilwane ezizalwa ndawonye, ngoba ukusatshalaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo kuya ngokuya kufana kancane phakathi kwabantu
distractor32b: Ukukhukhuleka kwezakhi zofuzo, njengoba ukusatshalaliswa kwezimpawu sekuye kwaba okungahleliwe kakhulu
distractor32c: Ukugeleza kwezakhi zofuzo, njengoba abantu cishe sebethole izici ezintsha zomlomo ngokufuduka
question33: Abacwaningi bakholelwa ukuthi ohlotsheni lwezinhlanzi, abantu abane-genotype ephindaphindayo i-aa bathambekele ezifweni. Abantu abane-homozygous dominant (AA) kanye nabantu abane-heterozygous (Aa) abakholelwa ukuthi basengozini yalesi sifo. Ichibi laligcwele izinhlanzi eziyi-100 ze-genotype ye-AA kanye nezinhlanzi eziyi-100 ze-phenotype ye-aa, futhi izinhlanzi zavunyelwa ukuzala. Esizukulwaneni esilandelayo, amaphesenti angama-35 ezinhlanzi ayene-phenotype evelele (AA). Lo mphumela ubonisani?
answer33: I-phenotype ebusayo ye-homozygous iphakeme kunalokho obekulindelekile, okubonisa ukuthi ukuvela kwemvelo kwenzekile
distractor33a: I-phenotype ebusayo ye-homozygous iphansi kunalokho obekulindelekile, okubonisa ukuthi ukuvela kwemvelo kwenzekile
distractor33b: I-phenotype ebusayo ye-homozygous iphakeme kunalokho obekulindelekile, okubonisa ukuthi ukuvela kwemvelo akwenzekanga
distractor33c: I-homozygous dominant phenotype iphansi kunalokho obekulindelekile, okubonisa ukuthi ukuvela kwemvelo akwenzekanga
question34: Inzuzo ye-Heterozygote yisimo lapho ama-heterozygote kubantu ethandwa khona ngokukhethwa kwemvelo. Qagela ukuthi inani le-2pq lingashintsha kanjani uma abantu bethola inzuzo ye-heterozygote.
answer34: Ngeke kuhlale kufana ngoba inani lika-2pq cishe lizokhuphuka
distractor34a: Kuzohlala kufana ngoba amanani ka-p no-q azohlala efana
distractor34b: Izohlala ilingana ngoba inani lika-2pq lizohlala lifana
distractor34c: Ngeke kuhlale kufana ngoba inani lika-2pq cishe lizokwehla
question35: Bheka uMfanekiso 19.14. Igrafu engezansi ikhombisa ushintsho ekuvameni kwezakhi zofuzo zama-allele amabili esakhi sofuzo: A kanye no-a. Isibalo sabantu esifundiswayo asinakho ukufuduka noma ukufuduka. Yiluphi uhlobo lokuziphendukela kwemvelo okungenzeka lwenzeka lapha futhi ingabe i-allele ikhethelwe yona, ingathathi hlangothi, noma ikhethwe ngokumelene nokukhethwa kwemvelo?
distractor35a: Ukuhlangana okungahleliwe; zombili izinhlobo ze-allele ziyathandwa
distractor35b: Ukugeleza kwezakhi zofuzo; i-allele A iyathandwa
distractor35c: Ukukhukhuleka kwezakhi zofuzo; zombili izinhlayiya azithathi hlangothi
question37: Bheka uMfanekiso 19.15. Igrafu eboniswe esithombeni ikhombisa amaza amanje ezinhlobo ezimbili zezakhi zofuzo ezifanayo: i-AA kanye ne-aa. Hlaziya igrafu ukuze ubikezele ukuthi yikuphi okulandelayo okungenzeka kakhulu ukuthi kwenzeke kumaza ezinhlobo ezimbili zezakhi zofuzo uma abantu abane-heterozygous bethandwa ukukhethwa kwemvelo.
answer37: Kokubili i-AA ne-aa kuzokwehla imvamisa, kodwa i-aa izokwehla kakhulu
distractor37a: Kokubili i-AA ne-aa kuzokwehla ngenani elifanayo
distractor37b: I-AA izokwanda ngemvamisa futhi i-aa izokwehla ngemvamisa
distractor37c: I-aa izokwanda ngemvamisa futhi i-AA izokwehla ngemvamisa
question38: Bheka uMfanekiso 19.16. Umdwebo ongezansi ukhombisa imvamisa yama-allele ezinhlotsheni ezimbili zezitshalo ezitholwe umoya, kanye nesiqondiso somoya esivamile. Lawa maza abelokhu eqinile cishe iminyaka eyi-10. Kodwa-ke, ukuguquka kwesimo sezulu kudale isiqondiso esisha somoya esivamile, njengoba kuboniswe kumdwebo. Lezi zinhlobo ezimbili cishe zizothuthuka kanjani esikhathini esizayo?
answer38: Ukugeleza kwezakhi zofuzo kuzobangela ukuthi imvamisa ka-A no-B yehle kubantu abangu-3
distractor38a: Ukukhetha kwemvelo kuzobangela ukwanda kwenani labantu abangu-B 1
distractor38b: Ukukhukhuleka kwezakhi zofuzo kuzokwenza ukuthi imvamisa ye-A ne-C yande kubantu abangu-1 no-2
distractor38c: Ukuzalanisa izilwane ezizalwa ndawonye kuzonciphisa ukuvama kwe-allele B kubantu abangu-2 no-3
question39: Bheka uMfanekiso 19.17. Umdwebo ongezansi ukhombisa izinhlobo ezimbili zezinto eziphilayo ezihlukaniswe isikhathi eside ngumfula ovimbela ukuzalana. Lezi zinhlobo ezimbili ziyahlukahluka ngemibala, njengoba kuboniswe kumdwebo. Imisebenzi yabantu yamuva nje ibangele ukuthi umfula wome, nokho, okwaholela ekutheni lezi zinhlobo ezimbili eziboniswe kumdwebo ongezansi. Iyiphi incazelo engaba khona yalolu shintsho?
answer39: Ukwanda kokugeleza kwezakhi zofuzo phakathi kwabantu ababili
distractor39a: Ukwehla kokugeleza kwezakhi zofuzo phakathi kwemiphakathi emibili
distractor39b: Ukwanda kokuhlangana okungahleliwe phakathi kwemiphakathi emibili
distractor39c: Ukwehla kokuhlangana okungahleliwe phakathi kwemiphakathi emibili
question40: Bheka uMfanekiso 19.18. Chaza iphethini ebonwe lapha
answer40: Isikhunta sakhula ukumelana nesikhunta ngokuhamba kwesikhathi ngenxa yokukhetha indlela yokusiphatha
distractor40a: Inani lama-fungus alizange lishintshe ngokuhamba kwesikhathi
distractor40b: Isikhunta singaba sengozini enkulu yokutheleleka yisikhunta ngokuhamba kwesikhathi ngenxa yokukhethwa okuzinzile
distractor40c: Isikhunta saba sengozini enkulu yokutheleleka yi-fungicide ngokuhamba kwesikhathi ngenxa yezizathu ezingaziwa

chapterName: 4. Izinqubo Zokuziphendukela Kwemvelo | 20. Izinhlobo Zokuphila Nomlando Wokuphila | 20.0 Isingeniso
chapterNameEnglish: 4. Evolutionary Processes | 20. Phylogenies and the History of Life | 20.0 Introduction
chapterContent:
Le nyosi nembali ye-Echinacea (Isithombe 20.1) azikwazanga ukubukeka zihlukile kakhulu, kodwa zihlobene, njengoba kunjalo nazo zonke izinto eziphilayo eMhlabeni. Ngokulandela izindlela zokufana nezinguquko—ezibonakalayo kanye nezakhi zofuzo—ososayensi bafuna ukudweba umlando wokuziphendukela kwemvelo wokuthi impilo yathuthuka kanjani kusukela ezintweni eziphilayo ezineseli elilodwa kuya ezinhlobonhlobo ezinkulu zezidalwa eziye zahluma, zakhasa, zantanta, zabhukuda, zandiza, futhi zahamba kule planethi.

 Izinhlobo ezintsha zitholakala njalo, kodwa akuvamile kakhulu ukuthola isilwane esisha esikhulu esincelisayo. Kodwa-ke, yilokho ososayensi abakwenza e-Australia lapho beqamba uhlobo olusha lwe-cetacean i-Australian humpback dolphin, i-Souse sahulensis. I-dolphin ekuqaleni yayihlukaniswe njengolunye uhlobo oluhlobene eduze, kodwa ukubheka eduze umbala wayo, isakhiwo samathambo, indawo yokuhlala, kanye ne-DNA kwanquma ukuthi empeleni yayiyinhlobo ehlukile.
question1: Iyini injongo eyinhloko ye-phylogeny?
answer1: Ukukhombisa ubudlelwano bokuziphendukela kwemvelo kanye nozalo olufanayo phakathi kwezinto eziphilayo
distractor1a: Ukuhlukanisa izinto eziphilayo ngokusekelwe kuphela ezindaweni zazo zokuhlala
distractor1c: Ukuqhathanisa kuphela ubukhulu obubonakalayo bezinto eziphilayo
question2: Yiziphi izinhlobo zobufakazi ososayensi abazisebenzisayo ukwakha kabusha ubudlelwano bokuziphendukela kwemvelo?
answer2: Izici zomzimba, izinsalela, izindawo zokuhlala, kanye nokulandelana kwe-DNA
question3: Kungani ihlengethwa lase-Australia eliyi-humpback laqashelwa njengohlobo oluhlukile?
answer3: Ukuqhathaniswa kombala wayo, isakhiwo samathambo, indawo yokuhlala, kanye ne-DNA kubonise ukuthi ihlukile kumahlengethwa ahlobene eduze.
distractor3b: Yayinkulu kakhulu kunawo wonke amanye amahlengethwa
question4: Yini ngezinye izikhathi edinga ososayensi ukuba bayenze uma bethola izinhlobo ezintsha?
answer4: Buyekeza ukuhlukaniswa kwezinto eziphilayo ngokusekelwe ebufakazini obusha
distractor4a: Lahla inkolelo-mbono yokuziphendukela kwemvelo
distractor4b: Qamba kabusha zonke izinhlobo ezaziwa ngaphambilini
distractor4c: Unganaki ubufakazi bama-molecule ukuze uthande ukubukeka komzimba kuphela

chapterName: 4. Izinqubo Zokuziphendukela Kwemvelo | 20. Izinhlobo Zokuphila Nomlando Wokuphila | 20.1 Ukuhlela Ukuphila Emhlabeni | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 4. Evolutionary Processes | 20. Phylogenies and the History of Life | 20.1 Organizing Life on Earth | Connection for AP® Courses
chapterContent:
Ezahlukweni zangaphambilini sihlole ukuthi zonke izinto eziphilayo eMhlabeni, ezikhona neziphelile, zavela kanjani kubazali abafanayo. Okusekela lesi simangalo yizici nezinqubo eziyinhloko, njengekhodi ejwayelekile yezakhi zofuzo kanye nezindlela ze-metabolic, ezavela eminyakeni eyizigidigidi edlule futhi zasakazeka kabanzi phakathi kwezinto eziphilayo eziphila namuhla. Umlando wokuziphendukela kwemvelo kanye nobudlelwano bezinto eziphilayo noma iqembu lezinto eziphilayo kubizwa ngokuthi i-phylogeny. Ososayensi bavame ukwakha izihlahla ze-phylogenetic ngokusekelwe ebufakazini obuthathwe emikhakheni eminingi ukuze kuboniswe izindlela zokuziphendukela kwemvelo kanye nokuxhumana phakathi kwezinto eziphilayo.

 Ososayensi bahlela ngokomlando izigidi zezinhlobo zomhlaba zibe uhlelo lokuhlukaniswa kwe-taxonomic oluhlelekile kusukela esigabeni esihlanganisa kakhulu kuya kwesithize kakhulu: isizinda, umbuso, i-phylum, isigaba, ukuhleleka, umndeni, uhlobo, kanye nezinhlobo. Uhlelo lwendabuko lwemibuso emihlanu okungenzeka ukuthi walufunda esikoleni esiphakathi lwandiswa (futhi lwahlelwa kabusha) ukuze lufake izindawo ezintathu: Amabhaktheriya, ama-Archaea, nama-Eukarya, nama-prokaryotes ahlukaniswe phakathi kwamaBhaktheriya noma ama-Archaea kuye ngemishini yawo yezakhi zofuzo zama-molecule, kanye nama-protists, ama-fungi, izitshalo, nezilwane eziqoqwe ku-Eukarya. Nokho, namuhla, izihlahla ze-phylogenetic zinikeza ulwazi oluqondile mayelana nomlando wokuziphendukela kwemvelo kanye nobudlelwano phakathi kwezinto eziphilayo. (Ngenhloso ye-AP®, akudingeki ukuthi ubambe ngekhanda amazinga e-taxonomic. Kodwa-ke, kubalulekile ukuphinda ukuthi i-taxonomy iyithuluzi lokuhlela izigidi zezinto eziphilayo eMhlabeni, ngendlela izinto esitolo sokudla noma esitolo esikhulu ezihlelwa ngayo ngeminyango ehlukene. Njengemikhiqizo emisha, izinto eziphilayo zivame ukushintshwa phakathi kwamaqembu azo e-taxonomic!)

Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyiswe esigabeni zisekela imiqondo echazwe ku-Big Idea 1 yoHlaka Lwekharikhulamu lwe-AP® Biology. Izinhloso Zokufunda ze-AP® ezibalwe kuHlaka Lwekharikhulamu zinikeza isisekelo esicacile senkambo ye-AP® Biology, ulwazi lwelabhorethri olusekelwe ekuphenyweni, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®. Inhloso yokufunda ihlanganisa okuqukethwe okudingekayo nemikhuba eyodwa noma ngaphezulu kwezesayensi eziyisikhombisa.

 I-Big Idea 1
Inqubo yokuziphendukela kwemvelo iqhuba ukuhlukahluka kanye nobunye bokuphila.
