question1: Kuyini i-phylogeny?
answer1: Umlando wokuziphendukela kwemvelo kanye nobudlelwano bento ephilayo noma iqembu lezinto eziphilayo
distractor1a: Ukusatshalaliswa kwezindawo zezinto eziphilayo
distractor1b: Ukuhlukaniswa kwezinto eziphilayo ngokusekelwe ekubukekeni komzimba kuphela
distractor1c: Ucwaningo lokuxhumana kwemvelo phakathi kwezinhlobo zezilwane
question2: Iyini injongo eyinhloko yesihlahla se-phylogenetic?
answer2: Ukubonisa izindlela zokuziphendukela kwemvelo kanye nobudlelwano phakathi kwezinto eziphilayo
distractor2a: Ukuthola ukuthi yiziphi izinto eziphilayo ezingazalana
distractor2c: Ukuhlukanisa izinto eziphilayo ngokusekelwe kuphela endaweni yazo yokuhlala
question3: Yiziphi izizinda ezintathu eziqashelwa ohlelweni lwesimanje lokuhlukaniswa kwezigaba?
answer3: Amabhaktheriya, i-Archaea, kanye ne-Eukarya
question4: Kungani izihlahla ze-phylogenetic zibhekwa njengezinolwazi kakhulu kune-taxonomy yendabuko?
answer4: Zinikeza ulwazi oluqondile mayelana nomlando wokuziphendukela kwemvelo kanye nobudlelwano phakathi kwezinto eziphilayo
distractor4a: Bahlukanisa izinto eziphilayo kuphela ngezici zomzimba
distractor4c: Zihlanganisa izinto eziphilayo kuphela ngokwezindawo zokuhlala
question5: Yibuphi ubufakazi obusekela isimangalo sokuthi zonke izinto eziphilayo zinemvelaphi efanayo?
answer5: Ikhodi yofuzo eyabiwe kanye nezindlela ezilondoloziwe ze-metabolic
distractor5a: Iqiniso lokuthi zonke izinto eziphilayo zihlala ezindaweni ezifanayo zokuhlala
distractor5b: Zonke izinto eziphilayo zinezakhiwo zomzimba ezifanayo
distractor5c: Zonke izinto eziphilayo zingaphansi kombuso ofanayo
question6: Kungani ososayensi ngezinye izikhathi behlela kabusha ukuhlukaniswa kwe-taxonomic?
answer6: Ngoba ubufakazi obusha mayelana nobudlelwano bokuziphendukela kwemvelo buyatholakala
distractor6a: Ngoba izinto eziphilayo zishintsha imibuso izizukulwane ngezizukulwane
distractor6c: Ngoba amagama esayensi aphelelwa yisikhathi ngokuhamba kwesikhathi

chapterName: 4. Izinqubo Zokuziphendukela Kwemvelo | 20. I-Phylogenies Nomlando Wokuphila | 20.1 Ukuhlela Ukuphila Emhlabeni | Izihlahla Ze-Phylogenetic
chapterNameEnglish: 4. Evolutionary Processes | 20. Phylogenies and the History of Life | 20.1 Organizing Life on Earth | Phylogenetic Trees
chapterContent:
Ososayensi basebenzisa ithuluzi elibizwa ngokuthi umuthi we-phylogenetic ukukhombisa izindlela zokuziphendukela kwemvelo kanye nokuxhumana phakathi kwezinto eziphilayo. Umuthi we-phylogenetic uwumdwebo osetshenziselwa ukukhombisa ubudlelwano bokuziphendukela kwemvelo phakathi kwezinto eziphilayo noma amaqembu ezinto eziphilayo. Ososayensi babheka izihlahla ze-phylogenetic njengombono wesikhathi esidlule sokuziphendukela kwemvelo njengoba umuntu engenakubuyela emuva ukuqinisekisa ubudlelwano obuhlongozwayo. Ngamanye amazwi, umuthi wokuphila” ungakhiwa ukuze kuboniswe ukuthi izinto eziphilayo ezahlukene zavela nini futhi kuboniswe ubudlelwano phakathi kwezinto eziphilayo ezahlukene (Isithombe 20.2).

 Ngokungafani nomdwebo wokuhlukanisa we-taxonomic, umuthi we-phylogenetic ungafundwa njengemephu yomlando wokuziphendukela kwemvelo. Izihlahla eziningi ze-phylogenetic zinohlu olulodwa phansi olumele ukhokho oyedwa. Ososayensi babiza lezo zihlahla ngokuthi zigxilile, okusho ukuthi kukhona uhlu olulodwa lokhokho (ngokuvamile oludwetshwe phansi noma kwesobunxele) lapho zonke izinto eziphilayo ezimelelwe kumdwebo zihlobene khona. Qaphela esihlahleni se-phylogenetic esinezimpande ukuthi izindawo ezintathu—i-Bacteria, i-Archaea, ne-Eukarya—zihlukana endaweni eyodwa futhi zihlukane. Igatsha elincane izitshalo nezilwane (kufaka phakathi abantu) ezihlala kulo mdwebo libonisa ukuthi la maqembu asanda futhi amancane kangakanani uma eqhathaniswa nezinye izinto eziphilayo. Izihlahla ezingakasulwa azibonisi ukhokho ofanayo kodwa zibonisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwezinhlobo.

 Esihlahleni esinezimpande, ukuhluma kwegatsha kubonisa ubudlelwano bokuziphendukela kwemvelo (Isithombe 20.3). Iphuzu lapho ukuhlukana kwenzeka khona, okubizwa ngokuthi igatsha iphuzu, limelela lapho uhlu olulodwa luvela khona lwaba olusha oluhlukile. Uhlu oluvela ekuqaleni empandeni futhi luhlala lungagayelwanga lubizwa ngokuthi i-basal taxon. Lapho uhlu olubili luvela endaweni efanayo yegatsha, lubizwa ngokuthi i-sister taxa. Igatsha elinezinhlobo ezingaphezu kwezimbili libizwa ngokuthi i-polytomy futhi lisebenza ukubonisa lapho ososayensi bengakanqumi khona ngokunembile bonke ubudlelwano. Kubalulekile ukuqaphela ukuthi nakuba i-sister taxa kanye ne-polytomy zihlanganyela ukhokho, akusho ukuthi amaqembu ezinto eziphilayo ahlukana noma aguquka komunye nomunye. Izinto eziphilayo ezinhlotsheni ezimbili kungenzeka ukuthi zahlukana endaweni ethile yegatsha, kodwa akekho kuzo owadala olunye.

 I-dia grams engenhla ingasebenza njengendlela yokuqonda umlando wokuziphendukela kwemvelo. Indlela ingalandelwa kusukela ekuqaleni kokuphila kuya kunoma yiluphi uhlobo ngokuzulazula emagatsheni okuziphendukela kwemvelo phakathi kwamaphuzu amabili. Futhi, ngokuqala ngohlobo olulodwa bese ubuyela emuva esiqwini somuthi, umuntu angathola ukuthi lolo hlobo okhokho, kanye nalapho uhlu oluhlanganyela khona okhokho olufanayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umuthi ungasetshenziswa ukutadisha amaqembu aphelele izinto eziphilayo.

 Elinye iphuzu okufanele lishiwo ngesakhiwo sesihlahla se-phylogenetic ukuthi ukujikeleza ezindaweni zamagatsha akushintshi ulwazi. Isibonelo, uma iphuzu legatsha lijikeleziswa futhi uhlelo lwe-taxon lushintsha, lokhu bekungeke kushintshe ulwazi ngoba ukuvela kwe-taxon ngayinye kusuka endaweni yegatsha bekuzimele kwenye.

 Izifundo eziningi ngaphakathi kocwaningo lwe-biology zinegalelo ekuqondeni ukuthi impilo yangaphambilini neyamanje yavela kanjani ngokuhamba kwesikhathi; lezi zifundo ndawonye zinegalelo ekwakheni, ekuvuseleleni, nasekulondolozeni umuthi wokuphila.” Ulwazi lusetshenziselwa ukuhlela nokuhlukanisa izinto eziphilayo ngokusekelwe ebuhlotsheni bokuziphendukela kwemvelo emkhakheni wesayensi obizwa ngokuthi i-systematics. Idatha ingaqoqwa ezinsaleleni, kusukela ekutadisheni isakhiwo sezingxenye zomzimba noma ama-molecule asetshenziswa yinto eziphilayo, kanye nokuhlaziywa kwe-DNA. Ngokuhlanganisa idatha evela emithonjeni eminingi, ososayensi bangahlanganisa i-phylogeny yento eziphilayo; njengoba izihlahla ze-phylogenetic ziyizinkolelo-mbono, zizoqhubeka nokushintsha njengoba izinhlobo ezintsha zokuphila zitholakala futhi kufundwa ulwazi olusha.
question1: Uyini umuthi we-phylogenetic?
answer1: Umdwebo osetshenziselwa ukukhombisa ubudlelwano bokuziphendukela kwemvelo phakathi kwezinto eziphilayo noma amaqembu ezinto eziphilayo
distractor1a: Ishadi elihlukanisa izinto eziphilayo kuphela ngezici zomzimba
distractor1c: Imephu ebonisa ukuthi izinhlobo zezilwane zihlala kuphi njengamanje
question2: Kungani ososayensi bebheka izihlahla ze-phylogenetic njengezinkolelo-mbono?
answer2: Ngoba ubudlelwano obuhlongozwayo bokuziphendukela kwemvelo abunakuqinisekiswa ngokuqondile ngokubuka okwedlule
question3: Iyini isici esiyinhloko somuthi we-phylogenetic onezimpande?
answer3: Inohlu lozalo olulodwa olumele ukhokho oyedwa
question4: Imeleni iphuzu legatsha esihlahleni se-phylogenetic?
answer4: Iphuzu lapho uhlu lozalo olulodwa luguqukela ezinhlotsheni ezimbili noma ngaphezulu ezihlukene
distractor4a: Ukuphela kohlobo oluthile
distractor4c: Iphuzu lapho izinto eziphilayo ezingahlobene zifana khona
question5: Ziyini i-sister taxa?
answer5: Izizukulwane ezimbili ezivela endaweni efanayo yegatsha futhi zabelana ngokhokho ofanayo muva nje
distractor5a: Izinhlobo ezimbili ezavela ngqo komunye nomunye
distractor5b: Izinto eziphilayo ezimbili ezingahlobene ezihlala endaweni efanayo
question6: Iyini i-polytomy esihlahleni se-phylogenetic?
answer6: Igatsha elinezizukulwane ezingaphezu kwezimbili elibonisa ukuthi ososayensi abakaxazululi ngokugcwele ubudlelwano bokuziphendukela kwemvelo
distractor6c: Igatsha elibonisa ukuvela okuguquguqukayo
question7: Ukujikeleza kwamagatsha azungeze iphuzu legatsha kunamuphi umphumela esihlahleni se-phylogenetic?
answer7: Akushintshi ubudlelwano bokuziphendukela kwemvelo obuboniswa yisihlahla
distractor7a: Kushintsha ukuthi yiluphi uhlobo oluyidlozi elivamile
question8: Yimuphi umkhakha wesayensi ohlanganisa ubufakazi obuvela emafossil, i-anatomy, ama-molecule, kanye ne-DNA ukuze kwakhiwe kabusha ubudlelwano bokuziphendukela kwemvelo?
answer8: Izinhlelo

chapterName: 4. Izinqubo Zokuziphendukela Kwemvelo | 20. I-Phylogenies Nomlando Wokuphila | 20.1 Ukuhlela Ukuphila Emhlabeni | Imikhawulo Yezihlahla Ze-Phylogenetic
chapterNameEnglish: 4. Evolutionary Processes | 20. Phylogenies and the History of Life | 20.1 Organizing Life on Earth | Limitations of Phylogenetic Trees
chapterContent:
Kungaba lula ukucabanga ukuthi izinto eziphilayo ezihlobene kakhulu zibukeka zifana kakhulu, futhi nakuba lokhu kuvame ukuba njalo, akulona iqiniso ngaso sonke isikhathi. Uma izizukulwane ezimbili ezihlobene kakhulu zavela ngaphansi kwezimo ezihlukene kakhulu noma ngemva kokuvela kokuguquguquka okusha okukhulu, kungenzeka ukuthi amaqembu amabili abonakale ehluke kakhulu kunamanye amaqembu angahlobene kakhulu. Isibonelo, umuthi we-phylogenetic ku-Figure 20.4 ukhombisa ukuthi izibankwa nonogwaja bobabili banamaqanda e-amniotic, kanti amaxoxo awanawo; kodwa izibankwa namaxoxo zibonakala zifana kakhulu kunezibankwa nonogwaja.

 Esinye isici sezihlahla ze-phylogenetic ukuthi, ngaphandle kokuthi kuboniswe ngenye indlela, amagatsha awabali ubude besikhathi, kodwa kuphela ukuhleleka kokuziphendukela kwemvelo. Ngamanye amazwi, ubude begatsha abusho isikhathi esiningi esidlulile, futhi igatsha elifushane alisho isikhathi esincane esidlulile— ngaphandle kokuthi kuchazwe kumdwebo. Isibonelo, ku-Figure 20.4, umuthi awubonisi ukuthi kudlule isikhathi esingakanani phakathi kokuvela kwamaqanda e-amniotic nezinwele. Lokho umuthi okubonisayo ukulandelana kwezinto ezenzeka ngakho. Futhi usebenzisa uMfanekiso 20.4, umuthi ukhombisa ukuthi isici esidala kunazo zonke yikholomu yomgogodla, elandelwa imihlathi eboshwe ngentambo, njalo njalo. Khumbula ukuthi noma yimuphi umuthi we-phylogenetic uyingxenye yento enkulu, futhi njengomuthi wangempela, awukhuli ohlangothini olulodwa kuphela ngemva kokuvela kwegatsha elisha. Ngakho-ke, ezintweni eziphilayo kuMfanekiso 20.4, ukuthi nje ikholomu yomgogodla yavela akusho ukuthi ukuvela kwezilwane ezingenamgogodla kwaphela, kusho ukuthi kwakhiwe igatsha elisha. Futhi, amaqembu angahlobene eduze, kodwa aguqukayo ngaphansi kwezimo ezifanayo, angase abonakale efana kakhulu nomunye nomunye kunokuba abe yisihlobo esiseduze.
question1: Kungani izinto eziphilayo ezimbili ezihlobene eduze zingase zibonakale zihluke kakhulu komunye nomunye?
answer1: Kungenzeka ukuthi zavela ngaphansi kwezimo zemvelo ezihluke kakhulu noma ngemva kokuvela kokuguquguquka okusha okukhulu
distractor1a: Abakwazi ukwabelana ngokhokho wabo muva nje
distractor1c: Bahlala bevela kokhokho abahlukene
question2: Ngokusho kwesithombe 20.4, yisiphi isici esavela ngaphambi kwamaqanda e-amniotic?
answer2: Imihlathi enezinsika
question3: Ubude bamagatsha buvame ukumelelani esihlahleni se-phylogenetic?
answer3: Ngokuvamile azimeli isikhathi sokuziphendukela kwemvelo ngaphandle kokuthi kuboniswe ngokuqondile
question4: Yiluphi ulwazi oluhlala luboniswa yisihlahla se-phylogenetic?
answer4: Ukulandelana okwenzeka ngakho izehlakalo zokuziphendukela kwemvelo
distractor4a: Izinsuku eziqondile lapho izici zavela khona
distractor4b: Indawo lapho kwenzeka khona ukuvela kwemvelo
question5: Kungani izinto eziphilayo ezihlobene kude ngezinye izikhathi zingabonakala zifana kakhulu kunezihlobo eziseduze?
answer5: Zavela ngaphansi kwezimo zemvelo ezifanayo, okwaholela ezinhlotsheni ezifanayo ze-phenotypes
distractor5a: Muva nje bazalane
question6: Kusho ukuthini ukuvela kwegatsha elisha esihlahleni se-phylogenetic mayelana nezizukulwane ezindala?
answer6: Izizukulwane ezindala ziyaqhubeka nokuguquka; igatsha elisha alivimbeli ukuvela kwazo
distractor6b: Izizukulwane ezindala ziyayeka ukuvela uma kuvela igatsha elisha
distractor6c: Izizukulwane ezindala zihlala ziba yi-basal taxa

chapterName: 4. Izinqubo Zokuziphendukela Kwemvelo | 20. Izinhlobo Zokuphila Nomlando Wokuphila | 20.1 Ukuhlela Ukuphila Emhlabeni | Amazinga Okuhlukaniswa
chapterNameEnglish: 4. Evolutionary Processes | 20. Phylogenies and the History of Life | 20.1 Organizing Life on Earth | The Levels of Classification
chapterContent:
I-Taxonomy (okusho ukuthi umthetho wokuhlelwa) yisayensi yokuhlukanisa izinto eziphilayo ukuze kwakhiwe izinhlelo zokuhlukanisa ezabiwe emhlabeni wonke lapho into ngayinye ibekwe emaqenjini ahlanganisayo. Cabanga ngendlela isitolo sokudla esihlelwe ngayo. Indawo eyodwa enkulu ihlukaniswe ngeminyango, njengomkhiqizo, ubisi, nenyama. Bese kuthi umnyango ngamunye uhlukaniswe ngezigaba, bese kuba yizigaba nezinhlobo, bese kuba umkhiqizo owodwa. Le nhlangano kusukela kwenkulu kuya kwencane, izigaba ezithile ibizwa ngokuthi uhlelo oluhambisanayo.

 Uhlelo lokuhlukanisa izinto eziphilayo (olubizwa nangokuthi uhlelo lweLinnaean ngemuva komsunguli walo, uCarl Linnaeus, isazi sezitshalo saseSweden, isazi sezilwane, kanye nodokotela) lusebenzisa imodeli ehambisanayo. Ukusuka endaweni lapho luvela khona, amaqembu aba aqondile kakhulu, kuze kube yilapho igatsha elilodwa liphela njengohlobo olulodwa. Isibonelo, ngemuva kokuqala okuvamile kwazo zonke izinto eziphilayo, ososayensi bahlukanisa izinto eziphilayo ngezigaba ezintathu ezinkulu ezibizwa ngokuthi isizinda: Amabhaktheriya, ama-Archaea, kanye nama-Eukarya. Ngaphakathi kwesizinda ngasinye kunesigaba sesibili esibizwa ngokuthi umbuso. Ngemuva kwemibuso, izigaba ezilandelayo zokucacisa okwandayo yilezi: i-phylum, isigaba, ukuhleleka, umndeni, uhlobo, kanye nezinhlobo (Isithombe 20.5).

 Umbuso i-Animalia uvela endaweni ye-Eukarya. Enja evamile, amazinga okuhlukaniswa azoba njengoba kuboniswe kuSithombe 20.5. Ngakho-ke, igama eliphelele lesidalwa ngokwalo linamagama ayisishiyagalombili. Enja, yi-Eukarya, i-Animalia, i-Chordata, i-Mammalia, i-Carnivora, i-Canidae, i-Canis, kanye ne-lupus. Qaphela ukuthi igama ngalinye libhalwe ngosonhlamvukazi ngaphandle kwezinhlobo, futhi uhlobo kanye namagama ezinhlobo abhalwe ngomluki. Ososayensi ngokuvamile babhekisela esidalwa kuphela ngohlobo kanye nezinhlobo zaso, okuyigama laso lesayensi elinamagama amabili, kulokho okubizwa ngokuthi i-binomial nomenclature. Ngakho-ke, igama lesayensi lenja yi-Canis lupus. Igama elisezingeni ngalinye libizwa nangokuthi i-taxon. Ngamanye amazwi, izinja zilandelana ngokuthi i-Carnivora. I-Carnivora igama le-taxon ezingeni lokuhlela; i-Canidae yi-taxon ezingeni lomndeni, njalo njalo. Izinto eziphilayo nazo zinegama elivamile abantu abavame ukulisebenzisa, ku kulokhu, inja. Qaphela ukuthi inja iphinde ibe uhlobo oluthile: i-familias” ku-Canis lupus familiaris. Izinhlobo ezincane zingamalungu ezinhlobo ezifanayo ezikwazi ukuhlangana nokuzala inzalo ephilayo, kodwa zibhekwa njengezinhlobo ezincane ezihlukene ngenxa yokuhlukaniswa kwendawo noma kokuziphatha noma ezinye izici.

 Isithombe 20.6 sibonisa ukuthi amazinga aqhubekela kanjani ekuqondeni ezinye izinto eziphilayo. Qaphela ukuthi inja yabelana kanjani ngesizinda nokuhlukahluka okukhulu kwezinto eziphilayo, okuhlanganisa izitshalo nama-butterflies. Esigabeni ngasinye esingaphansi, izinto eziphilayo ziba zifana kakhulu ngoba zihlobene kakhulu. Ngokomlando, ososayensi bahlukanisa izinto eziphilayo besebenzisa izici, kodwa njengoba ubuchwepheshe be-DNA buthuthuka, kuye kwanqunywa ama-phylogenies anembile kakhulu.

 Ukuhlaziywa kwezakhi zofuzo kwakamuva kanye nokunye ukuthuthuka kuthole ukuthi ezinye izinhlobo zangaphambilini ze-phylogenetic azihambisani nesikhathi esidlule sokuziphendukela kwemvelo; ngakho-ke, izinguquko kanye nezibuyekezo kumele zenziwe njengoba kwenzeka ukutholakala okusha. Khumbula ukuthi izihlahla ze-phylogenetic ziyizinkolelo-mbono futhi ziyashintshwa njengoba idatha itholakala. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuhlukaniswa ngokomlando kuye kwagxila ekuhlukaniseni izinto eziphilayo ngokuyinhloko ngezici ezihlanganyelwe futhi akubonisi ukuthi amaqembu ahlukahlukene ahlobene kanjani ngokombono wokuziphendukela kwemvelo. Isibonelo, naphezu kokuthi imvubu ifana nengulube kakhulu kune-whale, imvubu ingaba yisihlobo esiseduze kakhulu somkhomo.
question1: Kuyini i-taxonomy?
answer1: Isayensi yokuhlukanisa izinto eziphilayo zibe uhlelo lokuhlukanisa oluhambisanayo emhlabeni wonke

distractor1c: Isayensi yokuqamba amagama ezinsalela
question2: Yiluphi uhlu oluchaza kahle amazinga e-taxonomic kusukela kokubandakanya kakhulu kuya kokuqondakala kakhulu?
answer2: Isizinda, Umbuso, I-Phylum, Isigaba, Ukuhleleka, Umndeni, Uhlobo, Uhlobo

distractor2c: Isizinda, Umbuso, Isigaba, I-Phylum, Ukuhleleka, Umndeni, Uhlobo, Uhlobo
question3: Kuyini ukuqanjwa kwamagama okubili?
answer3: Uhlelo lokuqamba amagama lwesayensi olunamagama amabili olusebenzisa uhlobo kanye nohlobo lwezinto eziphilayo
distractor3a: Uhlelo oluqamba izinto eziphilayo ngamagama kusetshenziswa umndeni wazo kanye nohlobo lwazo
distractor3c: Indlela yokuqamba izinto eziphilayo kusetshenziswa amazinga ayisishiyagalombili e-taxonomic
question4: Kungani ezinye izinhlobo zendabuko ziye zashintsha ngokuhamba kwesikhathi?
answer4: Ubufakazi obusha bezakhi zofuzo bunikeze ulwazi olunembile kakhulu mayelana nobudlelwano bokuziphendukela kwemvelo
distractor4a: Ososayensi babefuna amazinga amancane e-taxonomic
distractor4c: Ukuhlaziywa kwe-DNA kwenza amagama ezinhlobo zezilwane angadingeki
question5: Kungani izinto eziphilayo ezibukeka ngendlela efanayo zingase zingabi yizihlobo eziseduze kakhulu?
answer5: Izici zomzimba ezihlanganyelwe azibonisi njalo umlando wokuziphendukela kwemvelo ngokunembile
distractor5a: Izici zomzimba azihlobene nezakhi zofuzo
distractor5c: Izinto eziphilayo ezinesimo esifanayo zihlala zingezamaqembu ahlukene
question6: Bheka uMfanekiso 20.6. Kukuziphi amazinga lapho amakati nezinja kubhekwa khona njengengxenye yeqembu elifanayo?
answer6: Amakati nezinja ziyingxenye yeqembu elifanayo eliqala nge-Order: Izinga le-Carnivora
distractor6a: Amakati nezinja zitholakala ndawonye kuphela ezingeni le-Domain
distractor6b: Amakati nezinja ziseqenjini elifanayo kusukela ezingeni leDomain futhi kufaka phakathi amazinga angaphansi uMbuso, iPhylum, iClass, kanye ne-Order.
distractor6c: Amakati nezinja ziseqenjini elifanayo kusukela ezingeni lomndeni

chapterName: 4. Izinqubo Zokuziphendukela Kwemvelo | 20. Izinhlobo Zokuphila Nomlando Wokuphila | 20.2 Ukunquma Ubudlelwano Bokuziphendukela Kwemvelo | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 4. Evolutionary Processes | 20. Phylogenies and the History of Life | 20.2 Determining Evolutionary Relationships | Connection for AP® Courses
chapterContent:
Ukuze bakhe izihlahla ze-phylogenetic, ososayensi kumele baqoqe ulwazi olunembile olubavumela ukuthi benze ukuxhumana kokuziphendukela kwemvelo phakathi kwezinto eziphilayo. Besebenzisa idatha ye-morphological kanye neye-molecule, ososayensi bakhomba izici kanye nezakhi zofuzo ezifanayo nezifanayo. (Esahlukweni esidlule sihlole umehluko phakathi kwezici ezifanayo nezifanayo nokuthi zihlobene kanjani nokuziphendukela kwemvelo okuhambisanayo nokuhlukene.) Ukufana phakathi kwezinto eziphilayo kuvela emlandweni wokhokho ohlanganyelwe (ama-homologies) noma ezindleleni ezihlukene zokuziphendukela kwemvelo (ama-analogies). I-Clado amagremu yakhiwa ngokusebenzisa izici ezihlanganyelwe ezithathwe ukuze kuhlukaniswe amaqembu ahlukene ezinhlobo komunye nomunye. Isibonelo, izibankwa, onogwaja nabantu bonke bavela kukhokho oyedwa owayeneqanda le-amniotic; ngakho-ke, izibankwa, onogwaja, nabantu bonke bangamalungu eqembu elifanayo. I-Vertebrata iyiqembu elikhulu elihlanganisa nezinhlanzi, i-lamprey, kanye ne-lancelets. Lapho izinhlobo ezimbili noma amaqembu amabili eseduze komunye nomunye esihlahleni se-phylogenetic noma i-cladogram, muva nje babelane ngokhokho ofanayo. Ngokungena kolwazi olusha, ososayensi bangabuyekeza izihlahla ze-phylogenetic; isibonelo, i-computer pro grams, njengaleyo ebizwa ngokuthi i-BLAST, esiza ekunqumeni ukuhlobana kusetshenziswa ukulandelana kwe-DNA. Ngokuvamile, umuthi we-phylogenetic wakhiwe ngencazelo elula yomlando wokuziphendukela kwemvelo (i-parsimony ephezulu) kanye nenani elincane kakhulu lezinyathelo zokuziphendukela kwemvelo.

 Ukuqonda i-phylogeny kudlulela kude kakhulu ekuqondeni umlando wokuziphendukela kwemvelo wezinhlobo zezilwane eMhlabeni. Kwabososayensi bezitshalo, i-phylogeny isebenza njengesiqondiso sokuthola izitshalo ezintsha ezingasetshenziswa ukwenza ukudla, imithi, kanye nezingubo. Kodokotela, i-phylogenies inikeza ulwazi mayelana nemvelaphi yezifo nokuthi zingazelapha kanjani, isibonelo, i-HIV/AIDS.

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyiswe esigabeni zisekela imiqondo echazwe ku-Big Idea 1 yoHlaka Lwezifundo Zebhayoloji lwe-AP®. Izinhloso Zokufunda ze-AP® ezibalwe kuHlaka Lwezifundo zinikeza isisekelo esicacile senkambo ye-AP® Biology, ulwazi lwelabhorethri olusekelwe ekubuzeni, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®. Inhloso yokufunda ihlanganisa okuqukethwe okudingekayo neyodwa noma ngaphezulu kwemikhuba yesayensi eyisikhombisa.

question1: Yiziphi izinhlobo zobufakazi ososayensi abazisebenzisayo ukwakha izihlahla ze-phylogenetic?
answer1: Idatha yesimo semvelo kanye neyama-molecule, kufaka phakathi izici ezifanayo kanye nezakhi zofuzo
distractor1a: Ukuqashelwa kokuziphatha kuphela
distractor1c: Usayizi wabantu kanye nesikhathi sokuphila kuphela
question2: I-cladogram yakhiwe ngani?
answer2: Izici ezitholakala ngokuhlanganyela ezihlukanisa amaqembu ezinhlobo
question3: Kusho ukuthini uma izinhlobo ezimbili zitholakala eduze esihlahleni se-phylogenetic?
answer3: Babenekhokho ofanayo wakamuva
question4: Iyini isimiso sokulinganisela okuphezulu?
answer4: Ukukhetha umlando wokuziphendukela kwemvelo odinga izinguquko ezimbalwa kakhulu zokuziphendukela kwemvelo
distractor4a: Ukukhetha indlela endala kakhulu yokuziphendukela kwemvelo
distractor4c: Uma sicabanga ukuthi zonke izinto eziphilayo zavela ngokuzimela
question5: Uhlelo lwekhompyutha i-BLAST lubasiza kanjani ososayensi?
answer5: Iqhathanisa ukulandelana kwe-DNA ukusiza ekunqumeni ukuhlobana kokuziphendukela kwemvelo
distractor5a: Ibala izinsuku zezinsalela kusetshenziswa ama-isotopes anemisebe
distractor5c: Ibikezela izinguquko zesikhathi esizayo ezintweni eziphilayo
question6: Kungani izihlahla ze-phylogenetic zibuyekezwa ngokuhamba kwesikhathi?
answer6: Ubufakazi obusha kanye nobuchwepheshe obuthuthukisiwe buhlinzeka ngolwazi olunembile mayelana nobudlelwano bokuziphendukela kwemvelo
distractor6a: Izinhlobo zishintsha amaqembu e-taxonomic isizukulwane ngasinye
distractor6b: Ososayensi bavame ukuqamba kabusha zonke izinto eziphilayo
distractor6c: Izihlahla ezindala ze-phylogenetic ziba zingasebenzi ngemva kwesikhathi esinqunyiwe

chapterName: 4. Izinqubo Zokuziphendukela Kwemvelo | 20. Izinhlobo Zokuphila Nomlando Wokuphila | 20.2 Ukunquma Ubudlelwano Bokuziphendukela Kwemvelo | Izinketho Ezimbili Zokufana
chapterNameEnglish: 4. Evolutionary Processes | 20. Phylogenies and the History of Life | 20.2 Determining Evolutionary Relationships | Two Options for Similarities
chapterContent:
Ngokuvamile, izinto eziphilayo ezabelana ngezici ezifanayo zomzimba kanye nama-genome zivame ukuhlobana kakhulu kunalezo ezingenazo. Izici ezinjalo ezihlangana kokubili ngokwesimo (ngesimo) kanye nofuzo zibizwa ngokuthi izakhiwo ezifanayo; zivela ekufaneni kwentuthuko okusekelwe ekuziphendukeleni kwemvelo. Isibonelo, amathambo asemaphikweni amalulwane nezinyoni anezakhiwo ezifanayo. Lesi yisibonelo se-homology yesimo (Isithombe 20.7).

 Qaphela ukuthi akuyona nje ithambo elilodwa, kodwa kunalokho iqoqo lamathambo amaningana ahlelwe ngendlela efanayo. Lapho isici siyinkimbinkimbi kakhulu, kulapho kungenzeka khona ukuthi noma yiluphi uhlobo lokufana lubangelwa yisikhathi esidlule sokuziphendukela kwemvelo esivamile. Cabanga ngabantu ababili abavela emazweni ahlukene abasungula imoto enezingxenye ezifanayo futhi ngendlela efanayo ngaphandle kolwazi lwangaphambilini noma olwabiwe. Lowo mphumela ubungeke ube yinto engenakwenzeka. Kodwa-ke, uma abantu ababili bobabili besungula isando, kungaba nengqondo ukuphetha ngokuthi bobabili bangaba nomqondo wokuqala ngaphandle kosizo lomunye. Ubuhlobo obufanayo phakathi kobunzima nomlando wokuziphendukela kwemvelo ohlanganyelwe buyiqiniso ngezakhiwo ezifanayo ezintweni eziphilayo.
question1: Ziyini izakhiwo ezifanayo?
answer1: Izakhiwo ezifanayo ngoba zazuzwa njengefa kukhokho ovamile
distractor1a: Izakhiwo eziguquke ngokuzimela ukuze zenze umsebenzi ofanayo
distractor1c: Izakhiwo ezingenalo ukubaluleka kokuziphendukela kwemvelo
question2: Kuyini i-homology yesimo semvelo?
answer2: Ukufana ngesimo kanye nokuhleleka kwezakhiwo ngenxa yomlando wokuziphendukela kwemvelo okwabiwe
distractor2a: Ukufana kwendawo yokuhlala phakathi kwezinto eziphilayo ezimbili
distractor2c: Ukufana kwamasu okuzala phakathi kwezinhlobo ezingahlobene
question3: Kungani izinto eziphilayo ezinezici ezifanayo zomzimba kanye nama-genome ngokuvamile zibhekwa njengezihlobene kakhulu?
answer3: Ngoba kungenzeka ukuthi babelana ngokhokho wabo muva nje
question4: Kungani isakhiwo esiyinkimbinkimbi esabiwe siwubufakazi obuqinile bokuthi okhokho babanye bafana kunesilula?
answer4: Ngoba akunakwenzeka ukuthi izingxenye eziningi eziyinkimbinkimbi zavela ngokuzimela ngendlela efanayo.
distractor4a: Ngoba izakhiwo eziyinkimbinkimbi zishintsha ngokushesha kakhulu kunezilula
distractor4c: Ngoba izakhiwo eziyinkimbinkimbi zitholakala kuphela ezilwaneni ezinomgogodla
question5: Yimaphi amabhangqa ezinto eziphilayo anikezwa njengesibonelo se-homology yesimo somzimba?
answer5: Amalulwane nezinyoni
distractor5a: Imikhomo noshaka
question6: Uhlobo luni lobufakazi olunikezwa yizakhiwo ezihambisanayo?
answer6: Ubufakazi bomlando wokuziphendukela kwemvelo ohlanganyelwe kanye nozalo olufanayo
distractor6a: Ubufakazi bokuthi izinhlobo ezimbili zavela ngokuzimela
distractor6b: Ubufakazi bokuthi izinhlobo ezimbili zihlala endaweni efanayo yemvelo
distractor6c: Ubufakazi bokuthi izinhlobo ezimbili zingazalana

chapterName: 4. Izinqubo Zokuziphendukela Kwemvelo | 20. Izinhlobo Zokuphila Nomlando Wokuphila | 20.2 Ukunquma Ubudlelwano Bokuziphendukela Kwemvelo | Izinketho Ezimbili Zokufana | Ukubukeka Okudukisayo
chapterNameEnglish: 4. Evolutionary Processes | 20. Phylogenies and the History of Life | 20.2 Determining Evolutionary Relationships | Two Options for Similarities | Misleading Appearances
chapterContent:
Ezinye izinto eziphilayo zingase zihlobane kakhulu, yize ushintsho oluncane lwezakhi zofuzo lubangele umehluko omkhulu wokwakheka kwazo ukuze zibukeke zihlukile kakhulu. Ngokufanayo, izinto eziphilayo ezingahlobene zingase zihlobane kude, kodwa zibonakale zifana kakhulu. Lokhu kuvame ukwenzeka ngoba zombili izinto eziphilayo zabelana ngokuzivumelanisa okuvamile okwavela ngaphansi kwezimo zemvelo ezifanayo. Lapho izici ezifanayo zenzeka ngenxa yemingcele yemvelo hhayi ngenxa yobuhlobo obuseduze bokuziphendukela kwemvelo, kubizwa ngokuthi isifaniso noma i-homoplasy. Isibonelo, izinambuzane zisebenzisa amaphiko ukundiza njengezintuthwane nezinyoni, kodwa isakhiwo sephiko kanye nomsuka wombungu kuhlukile ngokuphelele. Lokhu kubizwa ngokuthi izakhiwo ezifanayo (Isithombe 20.8).

 Izici ezifanayo zingaba ezifanayo noma ezifanayo. Izakhiwo ezifanayo zinemvelaphi efanayo yombungu; izitho ezifanayo zinomsebenzi ofanayo. Isibonelo, amathambo angaphambili ephikweni lomkhomo afana namathambo angalweni yomuntu. Lezi zakhiwo azifani. Amaphiko evemvane namaphiko enyoni afana kodwa awafani. Ezinye izakhiwo ziyafana futhi ziyafana: amaphiko enyoni kanye namaphiko elulwane ayafana futhi afana. Ososayensi kumele banqume ukuthi yiluphi uhlobo lokufana oluboniswa yisici ukuze baqonde i-phylogeny yezinto eziphilayo ezifundwayo.
question1: Kuyini ukufanisa (i-homoplasy)?
answer1: Ukufana okwavela ngenxa yezimo zemvelo ezifanayo kunokuba kube ngokozalo oluhlanganyelwe
distractor1a: Ukufana okubangelwe ukhokho ofanayo muva nje
distractor1b: Ukufana okutholakala kuphela ezinhlotsheni ezihlobene eduze
distractor1c: Ukufana okubangelwa ukulandelana kwe-DNA okufanayo
question2: Ziyini izakhiwo ezifanayo?
answer2: Izakhiwo ezinemisebenzi efanayo kodwa imvelaphi ehlukile yokuziphendukela kwemvelo kanye neyokuzalwa
question3: Yisiphi isibili esiyisibonelo sezakhiwo ezifanayo kodwa ezingezona ezihambisanayo?
answer3: Amaphiko evemvane namaphiko enyoni
distractor3a: Iphiko langaphambili lomkhomo kanye nengalo yomuntu
question4: Yimaphi ama-pair ezakhiwo afanayo kodwa angafani?
answer4: Amathambo angaphambili kwephiko lomkhomo namathambo angalweni yomuntu
distractor4a: Amaphiko evemvane namaphiko enyoni
question5: Yimaphi ama-pair ezakhiwo afanayo futhi afanayo?
answer5: Amaphiko enyoni namaphiko elulwane
distractor5a: Amaphiko evemvane namaphiko enyoni
distractor5b: Iphiko langaphambili lomkhomo kanye nengalo yomuntu
question6: Kungani ososayensi kufanele bahlukanise phakathi kwezakhiwo ezifanayo nezifanayo?
answer6: Ukunquma ngokunembile ubudlelwano bokuziphendukela kwemvelo phakathi kwezinto eziphilayo
distractor6a: Ukunquma ukuthi yiziphi izinto eziphilayo ezindala kakhulu
distractor6b: Ukuhlukanisa izinto eziphilayo kuphela ngokubukeka kwazo
distractor6c: Ukuthola ukuthi yiziphi izinto eziphilayo ezingazalana

chapterName: 4. Izinqubo Zokuziphendukela Kwemvelo | 20. Izinhlobo Zokuphila Nomlando Wokuphila | 20.2 Ukunquma Ubudlelwano Bokuziphendukela Kwemvelo | Izinketho Ezimbili Zokufana | Ukuqhathaniswa Kwama-Molecular
chapterNameEnglish: 4. Evolutionary Processes | 20. Phylogenies and the History of Life | 20.2 Determining Evolutionary Relationships | Two Options for Similarities | Molecular Comparisons
chapterContent:
Ngokuthuthuka kobuchwepheshe be-DNA, indawo ye-molecular systematics, echaza ukusetshenziswa kolwazi ezingeni lama-molecule kufaka phakathi ukuhlaziywa kwe-DNA, iqhakazile. I-computer pro grams entsha ayigcini nje ngokuqinisekisa izinto eziphilayo eziningi ezihlukaniswe ngaphambili, kodwa futhi iveza amaphutha enziwe ngaphambilini. Njengasezicini zomzimba, ngisho nokulandelana kwe-DNA kungaba nzima ukukufunda kwezinye izimo. Kwezinye izimo, izinto eziphilayo ezimbili ezihlobene kakhulu zingabonakala zingahlobene uma kwenzeka ushintsho olubangele ushintsho kukhodi yezakhi zofuzo. Ukuguqulwa kokufakwa noma kokususwa kungashukumisa isisekelo ngasinye se-nucleotide endaweni eyodwa, okwenza amakhodi amabili afanayo abonakale engahlobene.

 Ngezinye izikhathi izingxenye ezimbili zekhodi ye-DNA ezintweni eziphilayo ezihlobene kude ngokungahleliwe zabelana ngephesenti eliphezulu lezisekelo ezindaweni ezifanayo, okwenza lezi zinto eziphilayo zibonakale zihlobene kakhulu kanti azihlobene. Kuzo zombili lezi zimo, ubuchwepheshe bekhompyutha buthuthukiswe ukusiza ukuhlonza ubudlelwano bangempela, futhi, ekugcineni, ukusetshenziswa okuhlangene kolwazi lwe-morphologic kanye ne-molecule kusebenza kangcono ekunqumeni i-phylogeny.
question1: Kuyini i-molecular systematics?
answer1: Ukusetshenziswa kolwazi lwama-molecule, okuhlanganisa nokuhlaziywa kwe-DNA, ukuze kunqunywe ubudlelwano bokuziphendukela kwemvelo phakathi kwezinto eziphilayo
distractor1a: Ucwaningo lwezinsalela ukuze kuhlukaniswe izinto eziphilayo
distractor1b: Ukuhlukaniswa kwezinto eziphilayo kusetshenziswa izici zomzimba kuphela
distractor1c: Ucwaningo lwezinhlelo zemvelo kusetshenziswa i-molecular biology
question2: Ubuchwepheshe be-DNA buthuthukise kanjani ucwaningo lwe-phylogeny?
answer2: Kuqinisekisile ukuhlukaniswa okuningi kwangaphambilini futhi kwembule amaphutha athile okuhlukaniswa
distractor2b: Ithathe indawo yazo zonke izifundo zesimo semvelo
distractor2c: Kufakazele ukuthi zonke izinhlobo zinezakhi zofuzo ezifanayo
question3: Kungani izinto eziphilayo ezimbili ezihlobene eduze zingase zibonakale zingahlobene ngokusekelwe ochungechungeni lwe-DNA kuphela?
answer3: Ukufakwa noma ukususwa kokuguqulwa kungashintsha ukulandelana kwe-nucleotide, okwenza i-DNA efanayo ibonakale ihlukile
distractor3c: Izakhi zofuzo zazo zibonakaliswa ezicutshini ezahlukene
question4: Kungani izinto eziphilayo ezimbili ezihlobene kude zingase zibonakale zihlobene kakhulu ngokusekelwe ku-DNA kuphela?
answer4: Bangase babelane ngokungahleliwe ngephesenti eliphezulu lezisekelo ze-DNA ezifanayo ezindaweni ezithile
distractor4a: Kumelwe ukuba bavela komunye nomunye
distractor4c: Zinezinguquko ezifanayo kuzo zonke izakhi zofuzo zazo
question5: Uhlobo luni lokuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo olungashintsha yonke i-nucleotide ngemva kwendawo yokuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo ngesikhundla esisodwa?
answer5: Ukuguqulwa kokufakwa noma kokususwa
distractor5a: Ukuguqulwa kokushintshana
question6: Iyiphi indlela ephumelela kakhulu yokunquma i-phylogeny?
answer6: Ukuhlanganisa kokubili ubufakazi be-morphological kanye ne-molecular
distractor6c: Ukusebenzisa ubufakazi bezinsalela kuphela

chapterName: 4. Izinqubo Zokuziphendukela Kwemvelo | 20. Izinhlobo Zokuziphendukela Kwemvelo Nomlando Wokuphila | 20.2 Ukunquma Ubudlelwano Bokuziphendukela Kwemvelo | Izinketho Ezimbili Zokufana | Kungani Izinhlobo Zokuziphendukela Kwemvelo Zibalulekile?
chapterNameEnglish: 4. Evolutionary Processes | 20. Phylogenies and the History of Life | 20.2 Determining Evolutionary Relationships | Two Options for Similarities | Why Does Phylogeny Matter?
chapterContent:
Izazi zezinto eziphilayo zokuziphendukela kwemvelo zingabala izizathu eziningi zokuthi kungani ukuqonda i-phylogeny kubalulekile empilweni yansuku zonke emphakathini wesintu. Kwabezesayensi yezitshalo, i-phylogeny isebenza njengesiqondiso sokuthola izitshalo ezintsha ezingasetshenziswa ukuzuzisa abantu. Cabanga ngazo zonke izindlela abantu abasebenzisa ngazo izitshalo—ukudla, imithi, nezingubo ziyizibonelo ezimbalwa. Uma isitshalo siqukethe inhlanganisela ephumelelayo ekwelapheni izifo, ososayensi bangase bafune ukuhlola zonke izihlobo zaleso sitshalo ukuze bathole eminye imithi ewusizo.

 Ithimba locwaningo eShayina lithole ingxenye ye-DNA okucatshangwa ukuthi ivamile kwezinye izitshalo zokwelapha emndenini i-Fabaceae (umndeni we-legume) (Isithombe 20.9) futhi lasebenza ukuthola ukuthi yiluphi uhlobo olunalesi sigaba. Ngemva kokuhlola izinhlobo zezitshalo kulo mndeni, ithimba lathola uphawu lwe-DNA (indawo eyaziwayo ku-chromosome eyabenza bakwazi ukuthola uhlobo) olukhona. Ngemuva kwalokho, besebenzisa i-DNA ukuthola ubudlelwano be-phylogenetic, ithimba lingabona ukuthi isitshalo esisanda kutholwa sasikulo mndeni futhi lihlole izakhiwo zaso zokwelapha ezingaba khona.
question1: Kungani ukuqonda i-phylogeny kubalulekile kososayensi bezitshalo?
answer1: Kusiza ekuboneni izitshalo ezihlobene ezingase zibe wusizo ekudleni, emithini, noma kwezinye izinto ezisetshenziswa ngabantu
distractor1a: Inquma ukuthi yiziphi izitshalo ezingakhula kunoma iyiphi indawo
distractor1c: Ikhomba izinhlobo zezitshalo eziphilayo ezindala kakhulu
question2: Ubudlelwano be-phylogenetic bungasiza kanjani ekutholakaleni kwemithi emisha?
answer2: Izitshalo ezihlobene eduze zingabelana nge-com enenzuzo amakhilogremu engasetshenziswa njengemithi
distractor2a: Izitshalo ezingahlobene kuphela ezikhiqiza imithi amakhilogremu
distractor2b: I-Phylogeny ibikezela ukwakheka kwamakhemikhali kwesitshalo ngasinye ngqo
distractor2c: Izici zokwelapha azihlobene nobudlelwano bokuziphendukela kwemvelo
question3: Iyini uphawu lwe-DNA?
answer3: Indawo eyaziwayo ku-chromosome engasetshenziswa ukusiza ukuhlonza izinhlobo
question4: Kungani abacwaningi bafunde i-DNA evela ezitshalweni zomndeni wakwaFabaceae?
answer4: Ukuthola izinhlobo ezihlobene ezingaba nezakhiwo zokwelapha eziwusizo
distractor4a: Ukunquma ukuthi yiziphi izitshalo ezizala ngokushesha
distractor4b: Ukususa zonke izitshalo ezingezona ezemithi emndenini
question5: Ukuhlaziywa kwe-DNA kungakuthuthukisa kanjani ukuhlonza izitshalo ezisanda kutholakala?
answer5: Kunganquma ukuthi bangabeqembu elithile eliziphendukela kwemvelo elinezici ezaziwayo
distractor5a: Kuqinisekisa ukuthi isitshalo siqukethe imithi amakhilogremu
distractor5b: Inquma indawo yokuhlala yezitshalo ngaphandle kokubheka
distractor5c: Ithatha indawo yazo zonke ezinye izindlela zokuhlonza izitshalo
question6: Bheka uMfanekiso 20.9.1. Isithombe sibonisa umuthi obanzi we-phylogenetic oqhathanisa izinto eziningi eziphilayo. Yenza isimangalo mayelana nesikhunta ngokusekelwe kulesi sihlahla
answer6: Isikhunta siseduze nezilwane kunezitshalo
distractor6c: Isikhunta siseduze kakhulu nama-bacteria kunezitshalo

chapterName: 4. Izinqubo Zokuziphendukela Kwemvelo | 20. Izinhlobo Zokuphila Nomlando Wokuphila | 20.2 Ukunquma Ubudlelwano Bokuziphendukela Kwemvelo | Ukwakha Izihlahla Zofuzo
chapterNameEnglish: 4. Evolutionary Processes | 20. Phylogenies and the History of Life | 20.2 Determining Evolutionary Relationships | Building Phylogenetic Trees
chapterContent:
Ososayensi bazakha kanjani izihlahla ze-phylogenetic? Ngemva kokuba izici ezifanayo nezifanayo sezihlungiwe, ososayensi bavame ukuhlela izici ezifanayo besebenzisa uhlelo olubizwa ngokuthi i-cladistics. Lolu hlelo luhlela izinto eziphilayo zibe ama-clades: amaqembu ezinto eziphilayo ezivela kukhokho oyedwa. Isibonelo, kuMfanekiso 20.10, zonke izinto eziphilayo esifundeni se-orange zavela kukhokho oyedwa owayenamaqanda e-amniotic. Ngenxa yalokho, zonke lezi zinto eziphilayo zinamaqanda e-amniotic futhi zenza i-clade eyodwa, ebizwa nangokuthi iqembu le-monophyletic. Ama-Clades kumele afake yonke inzalo evela endaweni yegatsha.

 Ama-Clades angahluka ngobukhulu kuye ngokuthi yiliphi iphuzu legatsha elibhekiselwe kulo. Isici esibalulekile ukuthi zonke izinto eziphilayo eqenjini le-clade noma le-monophyletic zivela endaweni eyodwa esihlahleni. Lokhu kungakhunjulwa ngoba i-monophyletic ihlukana ibe yi-mono,” okusho ukuthi eyodwa, kanye ne-phyletic, okusho ubudlelwano bokuziphendukela kwemvelo. Umfanekiso 20.11 ukhombisa izibonelo ezahlukahlukene zama-clades. Qaphela ukuthi i-clade ngayinye ivela kanjani endaweni eyodwa, kanti amaqembu angewona ama-clade abonisa amagatsha angabelani ngephuzu elilodwa
question1: Kuyini i-cladistics?
answer1: Uhlelo lokuhlukanisa izinto eziphilayo zibe yizigaba ngokusekelwe kulokho okwabelwana ngakho
distractor1a: Indlela yokuhlukanisa izinto eziphilayo ngokwezindawo zokuhlala
distractor1c: Inqubo yokuhlonza izakhiwo ezifanayo
question2: Iyini i-clade (iqembu le-monophyletic)?
answer2: Iqembu lezinto eziphilayo elihlanganisa ukhokho ofanayo kanye nayo yonke inzalo yakhe
distractor2a: Iqembu lezinto eziphilayo ezinezimo zomzimba ezifanayo
distractor2b: Iqembu eliqukethe izinto eziphilayo ezivela embusweni ofanayo kuphela
question3: Kungani zonke izizukulwane ezivela endaweni yegatsha kufanele zifakwe ku-clade?
answer3: Ngoba i-clade imelela uhlu lonke lokuziphendukela kwemvelo oluvela kukhokho oyedwa ofanayo
distractor3a: Ngoba yinzalo ephilayo kuphela ehlukaniswa ngezigaba
distractor3b: Ngoba amaphuzu amagatsha amelela izehlakalo zokuphela
distractor3c: Ngoba ama-clades asekelwe kuphela ekufaneni okungokwenyama
question4: Bheka Umfanekiso 20.10. I-mitochondria ye-Eukaryotic iqukethe i-DNA yayo, eyaziwa ngokuthi i-mitochondrial DNA, noma i-mtDNA. I-DNA yenuzi kanye ne-mitochondrial kucatshangwa ukuthi inemvelaphi ehlukile (ehlukile) yokuziphendukela kwemvelo, lapho i-DNA ye-mitochondrial itholakala kuma-chromosome ayindilinga amabhaktheriya ayegcwele amaseli e-prokaryotic asendulo. Ingabe ukuba khona kwe-DNA ye-mitochondrial kusikisela ukuthi izinto eziphilayo zihlanganyela izinqubo eziningi eziyinhloko ezigciniwe kanye nezici ezavela futhi zasakazeka kabanzi phakathi kwezinto eziphilayo namuhla? Kungani noma kungani kungenjalo?
answer4: Yebo, ngoba kusikisela ukuthi ama-eukaryote anezici okungenzeka ukuthi zalondolozwa kokhokho be-prokaryotic.
distractor4a: Yebo, ngoba kubonisa ukuthi ama-prokaryotes nama-eukaryotes asebenzisa ama-organelle afanayo, okungukuthi, i-mitochondria
distractor4b: Cha, ngoba i-DNA ye-mitochondrial ihluke kakhulu ku-DNA engaphakathi kwe-nucleus ye-eukaryote.
distractor4c: Cha, ngoba i-DNA ye-mitochondrial ayisetshenziswa amaseli e-eukaryotic
question5: Bheka uMfanekiso 20.11. I-Glycolysis, noma ukuwohloka kwe-glucose, inqubo esetshenziswa cishe yizo zonke izinto eziphilayo njengendlela yokukhipha amandla agcinwe ngaphakathi kwama-molecule e-glucose. Lawa mandla angagcinwa emaselini njenge-ATP, enika amandla izinqubo zamaseli uma kudingeka. Lokhu kubonisani, ngokomlando wokuziphendukela kwemvelo wamaseli asebenzisa i-glycolysis?
answer5: I-Glycolysis ilondolozwe naphezu kokuvela okuzimele kwezizinda ezintathu zokuphila
distractor5a: Ama-prokaryotes cishe ngeke azuze kumjikelezo we-Krebs noma i-ETC
distractor5b: Ama-prokaryotes kungenzeka ukuthi avele ngemva kwama-eukaryotes
distractor5c: I-Glycolysis yindlela kuphela lapho izinto eziphilayo zingaphula khona ushukela
question6: Yini enquma ubukhulu be-clade?
answer6: Iphuzu legatsha elikhethwe njengokhokho ovamile
distractor6c: Inani lezici ezifanayo ezabelwana ngazo eziphilayo

chapterName: 4. Izinqubo Zokuziphendukela Kwemvelo | 20. Izinhlobo Zokuphila Nomlando Wokuphila | 20.2 Ukunquma Ubudlelwano Bokuziphendukela Kwemvelo | Ukwakha Izihlahla Zofuzo | Izici Ezihlanganyelwe
chapterNameEnglish: 4. Evolutionary Processes | 20. Phylogenies and the History of Life | 20.2 Determining Evolutionary Relationships | Building Phylogenetic Trees | Shared Characteristics
chapterContent:
Izinto eziphilayo ziyavela kokhokho abafanayo bese ziyahlukahluka. Ososayensi basebenzisa inkulumo ethi “ukwehla ngokuguqulwa” ngoba yize izinto eziphilayo ezihlobene zinezimpawu eziningi ezifanayo kanye namakhodi ezakhi zofuzo, izinguquko ziyenzeka. Le ndlela iphindaphinda kaningi njengoba umuntu edlula esihlahleni sokuphila se-phylogenetic:

 Ushintsho ekwakhekeni kwezakhi zofuzo zezinto eziphilayo luholela esimeni esisha esivame kakhulu eqenjini.
Izinto eziphilayo eziningi zivela kuleli phuzu futhi zinalesi sici.
Izinguquko ezintsha ziyaqhubeka nokuvela: ezinye ziyaguquguquka futhi ziyaphikelela, okuholela ezimeni ezintsha.
Ngezimpawu ezintsha, iphuzu elisha legatsha liyanqunywa (buyela emuva esinyathelweni 1 bese uphinda).
Uma kutholakala isici kukhokho weqembu, kubhekwa njengesici sokhokho esabiwe ngoba zonke izinto eziphilayo ku-taxon noma i-clade zinaleso sici. Isilwane esinomgogodla ku-Figure 20.10 siyisici sokhokho esabiwe. Manje cabanga ngesici seqanda le-amniotic esithombeni esifanayo. Ezinye zezinto eziphilayo ku-Figure 20.10 kuphela ezinalesi sici, futhi kulabo abanaso, sibizwa ngokuthi isici esabiwe esithathwe ngoba lesi sici esithathwe ku- iphuzu elithile kodwa alihlanganisi bonke okhokho esihlahleni.

 Isici esiyinkimbinkimbi kubalingiswa abahlanganyelwe okhokho kanye nabahlanganyelwe iqiniso lokuthi la magama ayahlobene. Isici esifanayo singabhekwa njengesinye noma esinye kuye ngomdwebo othize osetshenziswayo. Ukubuyela kuMfanekiso 20.10, qaphela ukuthi iqanda le-amniotic liwuhlamvu oluhlanganyelwe okhokho bezibankwakazi, onogwaja, kanye nabantu, kuyilapho ukuba nezinwele kuyihlamvu elihlanganyelwe elihlanganyelwe kuphela kubantu nakonogwaja. Nokho, kuma-Amniotes njengeqembu, iqanda le-amniotic liwuhlamvu oluhlanganyelwe olungabonakali ezinhlanzini. La magama asiza ososayensi ukuhlukanisa phakathi kwama-clades ekwakheni izihlahla ze-phylogenetic
question1: Kusho ukuthini ngenkulumo ethi ukuhla nokuguqulwa?
answer1: Izinto eziphilayo zizuza izici ezivela kokhokho abafanayo ngenkathi ziqoqa izinguquko ngokuhamba kwesikhathi
distractor1a: Izinto eziphilayo azishintshile ngokwezakhi zofuzo ngenxa yokuziphendukela kwemvelo
distractor1b: Izinguquko ezingenayo imiphumela emihle kuphela ezizuzwa njengefa
distractor1c: Izinhlobo ziyavela ngokuzimela ngaphandle kokhokho abafanayo
question2: Yini evame ukubangela ukuthi kwakheke iphuzu elisha legatsha esihlahleni se-phylogenetic?
answer2: Isici esisha esizuzwa njengefa siyasungulwa ohlwini lozalo
distractor2b: Izinhlobo ezimbili ezingahlobene zakha izakhiwo ezifanayo
distractor2c: Isibalo sabantu silahlekelwa yizo zonke izinhlobo zofuzo
question3: Iyini inhlamvu yokhokho ehlanganyelwe?
answer3: Isici esikhona kukhokho ovamile futhi esabelwana yiwo wonke amalungu eqembu
question4: Iyini inhlamvu ethathwe ngokuhlanganyela?
answer4: Isici esavela ngemva kokhokho ovamile futhi esabelwana yingxenye yozalo kuphela
distractor4a: Isici esitholakala kuzo zonke izinto eziphilayo esihlahleni se-phylogenetic
question5: Kungani lesi sici esifanayo singabhekwa njengokhokho ohlanganyelwe noma umlingiswa ohlanganyelwe osuka kuye?
answer5: Ngoba ukuhlukaniswa kwayo kuncike eqenjini lezinto eziphilayo eziqhathaniswayo
distractor5a: Ngoba izici zihlala zishintsha phakathi kwezinhlobo zokhokho kanye nezinhlobo ezithathwe kuzo
distractor5b: Ngoba izici zama-molecule kuphela ezingahlukaniswa ngokunembile
distractor5c: Ngoba izici ezitholakala ngokufanayo ekugcineni ziyanyamalala ekuziphendukeleni kwemvelo
question6: KuMfanekiso 20.10, eqenjini eliqukethe izibankwa, onogwaja, nabantu, iqanda le-amniotic libhekwa kangcono ngokuthi yini?
answer6: Umlingiswa wokhokho ohlanganyelwe
distractor6c: Umlingiswa ohlangene
question7: KuMfanekiso 20.10, yisiphi isici esiwuhlamvu oluvela konogwaja nabantu?
answer7: Izinwele

chapterName: 4. Izinqubo Zokuziphendukela Kwemvelo | 20. Izinhlobo Zokuphila Nomlando Wokuphila | 20.2 Ukunquma Ubudlelwano Bokuziphendukela Kwemvelo | Ukwakha Izihlahla Ze-Phylogenetic | Ukukhetha Ubudlelwano Obufanele
chapterNameEnglish: 4. Evolutionary Processes | 20. Phylogenies and the History of Life | 20.2 Determining Evolutionary Relationships | Building Phylogenetic Trees | Choosing the Right Relationships
chapterContent:
Cabanga ngokuba ngumuntu onesibopho sokuhlela zonke izinto esitolo esikhulu ngendlela efanele—umsebenzi onzima kakhulu. Ukuhlela ubudlelwano bokuziphendukela kwemvelo kwazo zonke izinto eziphilayo eMhlabeni kuba nzima kakhulu: ososayensi kumele bachithe amabhulokhi amakhulu esikhathi futhi basebenze ngolwazi oluvela ezintweni eziphilayo eseziphelile isikhathi eside. Ukuzama ukuqonda ukuxhumana okufanele, ikakhulukazi uma ubheka ukuba khona kwama-homologies kanye nama-analogies, kwenza umsebenzi wokwakha umuthi wokuphila onembile ube nzima kakhulu. Engeza kulokho intuthuko yobuchwepheshe be-DNA, manje enikeza inani elikhulu lokulandelana kwezakhi zofuzo okufanele kusetshenziswe futhi kuhlaziywe. I-taxonomy iyisifundo esizimele: izinto eziphilayo eziningi zinokuxhumana okungaphezu kokukodwa komunye nomunye, ngakho-ke isazi ngasinye se-taxonom sizonquma ukuhleleka kokuxhumana.

 Ukuze kusizwe emsebenzini omkhulu wokuchaza ama-phylogenies ngokunembile, ososayensi bavame ukusebenzisa umqondo obizwa ngokuthi i-maximum parsimony, okusho ukuthi izenzakalo zenzeke ngendlela elula nesobala kakhulu. Isibonelo, uma iqembu labantu lingena endaweni yokugcina ihlathi ukuze lihambe ngezinyawo, ngokusekelwe esimisweni se-maximum parsimony, umuntu angabikezela ukuthi iningi labantu lizohamba ngezinyawo emizileni emisiwe kunokuba bakhe emisha.

 Kwabososayensi abaqonda izindlela zokuziphendukela kwemvelo, kusetshenziswa umqondo ofanayo: indlela yokuziphendukela kwemvelo cishe ihlanganisa izenzakalo ezimbalwa ezinkulu ezihambisana nobufakazi obukhona. Siqala ngazo zonke izici ezifanayo eqenjini lezinto eziphilayo, ososayensi bafuna ukuhleleka okusobala nokulula kwezenzakalo zokuziphendukela kwemvelo okuholele ekwakhiweni kwalezo zimpawu.

 Lawa mathuluzi kanye nemibono kumane nje kungamasu ambalwa ososayensi abawasebenzisayo ukubhekana nomsebenzi wokwembula umlando wokuziphendukela kwemvelo wokuphila eMhlabeni. Muva nje, ubuchwepheshe obusha buthole izinto ezitholakele ezimangalisayo ngobudlelwano obungalindelekile, njengokuthi abantu babonakala behlobene kakhulu nesikhunta kunesikhunta nezitshalo. Kuzwakala kungakholeki? Njengoba ulwazi mayelana nokulandelana kwe-DNA lukhula, ososayensi bazosondela ekudwebeni umlando wokuziphendukela kwemvelo wazo zonke izinto eziphilayo eMhlabeni.
question1: Kungani ukwakha umuthi onembile we-phylogenetic kuwumsebenzi onzima?
answer1: Ososayensi kumele bahumushe ubufakazi obuvela ezintweni eziphilayo neziphelile ngenkathi behlukanisa izinto ezifanayo nezimpawu ezifanayo
distractor1a: Ngoba izinto eziphilayo azikwazi ukuhlukaniswa ngokusebenzisa ubufakazi be-DNA
distractor1c: Ngoba zonke izinto eziphilayo zinemilando efanayo yokuziphendukela kwemvelo
question2: Kuyini i-parsimony ephezulu?
answer2: Isimiso sokuthi indlela elula yokuziphendukela kwemvelo edinga izinguquko ezimbalwa kakhulu yiyona engenzeka kakhulu
distractor2a: Isimiso sokuthi ukuziphendukela kwemvelo kwenzeka njalo ngesivinini esingaguquki
distractor2b: Isimiso sokuthi indlela ende kakhulu yokuziphendukela kwemvelo inembile kakhulu
distractor2c: Isimiso sokuthi izinto eziphilayo ziyavela ngokuzimela komunye nomunye
question3: Ososayensi basebenzisa kanjani i-parsimony ephezulu lapho bakha izihlahla ze-phylogenetic?
answer3: Bakhetha indlela yokuziphendukela kwemvelo edinga izenzakalo ezimbalwa ezinkulu zokuziphendukela kwemvelo ezifanelana nobufakazi
distractor3a: Bahlala beqoqa izinto eziphilayo ngokubukeka kwazo zodwa
distractor3b: Bayawushaya indiva ubufakazi bezakhi zofuzo bakhetha izinsalela
distractor3c: Bacabanga ukuthi zonke izici zazivelela ngokwazo
question4: Kungani i-taxonomy ibhekwa njengesifundo esizimele?
answer4: Ososayensi abahlukene bangase bachaze ubudlelwano bokuziphendukela kwemvelo ngendlela ehlukile ngokusekelwe ebufakazini obutholakalayo
distractor4a: Ngoba izinto eziphilayo azikwazi ukuhlanganiswa ngezigaba
distractor4b: Ngoba i-taxonomy isekelwe kuphela ekuthandweni komuntu siqu hhayi ebufakazini
distractor4c: Ngoba ubufakazi be-DNA buthathe indawo ye-taxonomy ngokuphelele
question5: Yini eye yaba negalelo ekuthuthukisweni kobuchwepheshe be-DNA ezifundweni ze-phylogenetic?
answer5: Inani elikhulu ledatha yokulandelana kwezakhi zofuzo ethuthukisa ukuqonda kobudlelwano bokuziphendukela kwemvelo
distractor5a: Ukuqedwa kwesidingo sezinsalela
distractor5b: Ubufakazi bokuthi zonke izihlahla ze-phylogenetic zangaphambilini bezingalungile
question6: Ngokusho kobufakazi bamuva nje bezakhi zofuzo, abantu bahlobene kakhulu neliphi iqembu?
answer6: Isikhunta
distractor6c: I-Archaea
question7: Kungani isimiso sokulinganisela okuphezulu siwusizo ku-biology yokuziphendukela kwemvelo?
answer7: Kusiza ososayensi ukuhlonza umlando wokuziphendukela kwemvelo okungenzeka kakhulu ngokusekelwe encazelweni elula kakhulu esekelwa ubufakazi
distractor7a: Kuqinisekisa ukuthi yonke imithi ye-phylogenetic ilungile
distractor7b: Kucabanga ukuthi ukuziphendukela kwemvelo kuhlala kuqhubeka ngendlela eqondile
distractor7c: Kuqeda isidingo sobufakazi bama-molecule kanye nezinsalela

chapterNameEnglish: 4. Evolutionary Processes | 20. Phylogenies and the History of Life | 20.3 Perspectives on the Phylogenetic Tree | Connection for AP® Courses
chapterContent:
Ubuchwepheshe obusha buveze izinto ezitholakele ezimangalisayo ngobudlelwano obungalindelekile phakathi kwezinto eziphilayo, njengokuthi abantu babonakala behlobene kakhulu nesikhunta kunesikhunta nezitshalo. (Cabanga ngalokho ngesikhathi esizayo lapho ubona i-mushroom). Njengoba ulwazi mayelana nokulandelana kwe-DNA lukhula, ososayensi bazosondela ekudwebeni umlando wokuziphendukela kwemvelo onembile kakhulu wazo zonke izinto eziphilayo eMhlabeni.

 Okwenza i-phylogeny ibe nzima, ikakhulukazi phakathi kwama-prokaryotes, ukudluliselwa kwezakhi zofuzo ngokuvundlile (ukudluliselwa kwezakhi zofuzo okuvundlile, noma i-HGT) phakathi kwezinhlobo ezingahlobene. Njengokuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo, i-HGT yethula ukuhlukahluka kwezakhi zofuzo kubantu bamabhaktheriya. Lokhu kudlula kwezakhi zofuzo phakathi kwezinhlobo kunezela ungqimba lobunzima ekuqondeni ukuhlobana.

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyiswe esigabeni zisekela imiqondo echazwe ku-Big Idea 3 yoHlaka Lwekharikhulamu lwe-AP® Biology. Izinhloso Zokufunda ze-AP® ezibalwe kuHlaka Lwekharikhulamu zinikeza isisekelo esicacile senkambo ye-AP® Biology, ulwazi lwelabhorethri olusekelwe ekuphenyweni, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®. Inhloso yokufunda ihlanganisa okuqukethwe okudingekayo neyodwa noma ngaphezulu kwemikhuba yesayensi eyisikhombisa.

 Umqondo Omkhulu 1
Inqubo yokuziphendukela kwemvelo iqhuba ukuhlukahluka kanye nobunye bokuphila.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 1.B
Izinto eziphilayo zixhunyaniswe yimigqa yokuzalwa okuvela kubazali abafanayo.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
1.B.1 Izinto eziphilayo zabelana ngezinqubo eziningi eziyinhloko ezigciniwe kanye nezici ezavela futhi zasakazeka kabanzi phakathi kwezinto eziphilayo namuhla.

 Umkhuba Wesayensi
3.1 Umfundi angabuza imibuzo yesayensi.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
1.14 Umfundi uyakwazi ukubuza imibuzo yesayensi ekhomba ngokufanele izakhiwo ezibalulekile zezinqubo zokuphila ezabiwe, eziyinhloko ezinikeza ukuqonda ngomlando wokuphila eMhlabeni.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
1.B.1 Izinto eziphilayo zabelana ngezinqubo eziningi eziyinhloko ezigciniwe kanye nezici ezavela futhi zasakazeka kabanzi phakathi kwezinto eziphilayo namuhla.

 Umkhuba Wesayensi
7.2 Umfundi angaxhumanisa imiqondo ngaphakathi nangaphandle kwesizinda (izizinda) ukuze ahlanganise noma achaze ukuqonda okuhlala njalo kanye/noma imibono emikhulu.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
1.15 Umfundi uyakwazi ukuchaza izibonelo ezithile zezinqubo zezinto eziphilayo ezigciniwe kanye nezici ezabiwe yizo zonke izizinda noma ngaphakathi kwesizinda esisodwa sokuphila, nokuthi lezi zinqubo kanye nezici ezigciniwe ezabiwe, ezigciniwe zisekela kanjani umqondo wozalo olufanayo lwazo zonke izinto eziphilayo.

 Umqondo Omkhulu 3
Izinhlelo eziphilayo zigcina, zithole, zidlulise futhi ziphendule ulwazi olubalulekile ezinqubweni zokuphila.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 3.C
Ukucutshungulwa kolwazi lwezakhi zofuzo akuphelele futhi kungumthombo wokwehluka kwezakhi zofuzo.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
3.C.2 Izinhlelo zezinto eziphilayo zinezinqubo eziningi ezikhulisa ukwehluka kwezakhi zofuzo.

 Umkhuba Wesayensi
6.2 Umfundi angakha izincazelo zezehlakalo ngokusekelwe ebufakazini obuvezwa ngemikhuba yesayensi.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
3.27 Umfundi uyakwazi ukwakha incazelo yezinqubo ezandisa ukwehluka ngaphakathi kwabantu.

 Imibono yokumodela i-phylogenetic ishintsha njalo. Ingenye yezinkambu zokufunda ezishintshashintshayo kakhulu kuyo yonke i-biology. Emashumini eminyaka ambalwa edlule, ucwaningo olusha luye lwaphonsela inselelo imibono yososayensi mayelana nokuthi izinto eziphilayo zihlobene kanjani. Amamodeli amasha alobu budlelwano aphakanyisiwe ukuze acatshangelwe umphakathi wesayensi.

 Izihlahla eziningi ze-phylogenetic ziboniswe njengezibonelo zobudlelwano bokuziphendukela kwemvelo phakathi kwezinhlobo. Izihlahla ze-phylogenetic zaqala ngoCharles Darwin, owadweba isihlahla sokuqala se-phylogenetic ngo-1837 (Isithombe 20.12a), esasebenza njengephethini yezifundo ezalandela iminyaka engaphezu kwekhulu. Umqondo wesihlahla se-phylogenetic onesiqu esisodwa esimele uhlanganyelo lozalo, namagatsha amele ukwehluka kwezinhlobo ezivela kuloluzalo, uhambisana kahle nesakhiwo sezihlahla eziningi ezivamile, njenge-oki (Isithombe 20.12b). Kodwa-ke, ubufakazi obuvela ekuhlaziyweni kokulandelana kwe-DNA yesimanje kanye nama-algorithms ekhompyutha asanda kuthuthukiswa bubangele ukungabaza mayelana nokuba semthethweni kwemodeli yesihlahla esijwayelekile emphakathini wesayensi.
question1: Kungani ucwaningo lwe-phylogeny lube ngomunye wemikhakha eguquguqukayo kakhulu ku-biology?
answer1: Idatha entsha yokulandelana kwe-DNA kanye nama-algorithms ekhompyutha athuthukisiwe ahlala eveza ubudlelwano obusha bokuziphendukela kwemvelo, okuholela ososayensi ekubuyekezeni amamodeli e-phylogenetic
distractor1a: Ngoba izinsalela zamathambo azisasetshenziswa ukutadisha ukuziphendukela kwemvelo
distractor1b: Ngoba bonke ubudlelwano bokuziphendukela kwemvelo manje sebuxazululiwe ngokuphelele
distractor1c: Ngoba izihlahla ze-phylogenetic zisekelwe kuphela ekubukekeni komzimba
question2: Yikuphi ukutholwa okwabekela inselele imibono yendabuko ngobudlelwano bokuziphendukela kwemvelo?
answer2: Ubufakazi be-DNA busikisela ukuthi abantu bahlobene kakhulu nesikhunta kunokuba isikhunta sihlobene nezitshalo
question3: Kuyini ukudluliswa kwezakhi zofuzo okuvundlile (i-HGT)?
answer3: Ukudluliswa kwezakhi zofuzo phakathi kwezinhlobo ezingahlobene, okwandisa ukuhlukahluka kwezakhi zofuzo kanye nokwenza kube nzima ukuhlaziywa kwe-phylogenetic
distractor3a: Ukudluliselwa kwezakhi zofuzo kuphela kusuka kumzali kuya enzalweni ngesikhathi sokuzala
distractor3c: Ifa le-DNA ye-mitochondrial elivela kumama kuphela
question4: Kungani ukudluliselwa kwezakhi zofuzo okuvundlile kwenza kube nzima ukwakha kabusha ama-phylogenies, ikakhulukazi kuma-prokaryotes?
answer4: Ngoba izakhi zofuzo zingadluliselwa phakathi kwezinhlobo ezingahlobene, okwenza ubudlelwano bokuziphendukela kwemvelo bubonakale bufana kakhulu kunokuba bunjalo ngozalo olufanayo kuphela
distractor4a: Ngoba ama-prokaryotes awakwazi ukuguquka
distractor4b: Ngoba ukudluliselwa kwezakhi zofuzo okuvundlile kwenzeka kuphela kuma-eukaryotes
question5: Ubani owaqala ukudweba umuthi we-phylogenetic omelela ubudlelwano bokuziphendukela kwemvelo?
answer5: UCharles Darwin
distractor5a: UGregor Mendel
question6: Kumodeli wokuqala wesihlahla se-phylogenetic sikaDarwin, isiqu esisodwa simelelani?
answer6: Ukhokho ofanayo ohlanganyelwe lapho izinhlobo zenzalo zahlukana khona
distractor6c: Isidalwa sokuqala esinamangqamuzana amaningi kuphela
question7: Yini eye yabangela ososayensi ukuba bangabaze indlela evamile yokuziphendukela kwemvelo yomuthi owodwa?
answer7: Ubufakazi obuvela ekuhlaziyweni kwe-DNA yesimanje kanye nama-algorithms ekhompyutha asanda kuthuthukiswa
distractor7c: Ukufakwa esikhundleni kwe-DNA nge-RNA ezintweni eziphilayo zanamuhla

chapterName: 4. Izinqubo Zokuziphendukela Kwemvelo | 20. Izinhlobo Zokuphila Nomlando Wokuphila | 20.3 Imibono Ngesihlahla Se-Phylogenetic | Imikhawulo Kumodeli Yakudala
chapterNameEnglish: 4. Evolutionary Processes | 20. Phylogenies and the History of Life | 20.3 Perspectives on the Phylogenetic Tree | Limitations to the Classic Model
chapterContent:
Ukucabanga kwakudala ngokuziphendukela kwemvelo kwe-prokaryotic, okufakiwe kumodeli wesihlahla esivamile, ukuthi izinhlobo ziyashintsha ngokwe-clonal. Okusho ukuthi, zikhiqiza inzalo ngokwazo ngokuguquka okungahleliwe okubangela ukwehlela ezinhlobonhlobo zezinhlobo zanamuhla neziphelile ezaziwa yisayensi. Lo mbono uyinkimbinkimbi kancane kuma-eukaryotes azala ngokocansi, kodwa imithetho yezakhi zofuzo zaseMendelian ichaza ukuthi ukwehluka kwenzalo, futhi, kungumphumela wokuguquka ngaphakathi kwezinhlobo. Umqondo wokudluliselwa kwezakhi zofuzo phakathi kwezinhlobo ezingahlobene awuzange ubhekwe njengento engenzeka kuze kube muva nje. Ukudluliselwa kwezakhi zofuzo okuvundlile (i-HGT), okwaziwa nangokuthi ukudluliselwa kwezakhi zofuzo okusemaceleni, ukudluliselwa kwezakhi zofuzo phakathi kwezinhlobo ezingahlobene. I-HGT iboniswe njengesenzakalo esihlala sikhona, kanti izazi eziningi zokuziphendukela kwemvelo zithi inendima enkulu yale nqubo ekuziphendukeleni kwemvelo, ngaleyo ndlela zenza imodeli yesihlahla elula ibe nzima. Izakhi zofuzo ziboniswe ukuthi zidluliselwa phakathi kwezinhlobo ezihlobene kude kuphela kusetshenziswa i-phylogeny ejwayelekile, ngaleyo ndlela zengeza ungqimba lobunzima ekuqondeni ubudlelwano be-phylogenetic.

 Izindlela ezahlukahlukene i-HGT eyenzeka ngazo kuma-prokaryotes zibalulekile ekuqondeni ama-phylogenies. Nakuba okwamanje i-HGT ingabhekwa njengebalulekile ekuziphendukeleni kwe-eukaryotic, i-HGT iyenzeka nakule ndawo. Okokugcina, njengesibonelo sokudluliswa kofuzo kokugcina, imibono yokuhlanganiswa kwe-genome phakathi kwezinto eziphilayo ezihambisanayo noma ezihambisanayo iye yaphakanyiswa ukuchaza isenzakalo esibaluleke kakhulu—ukuvela kweseli lokuqala le-eukaryotic, ngaphandle kwalo abantu ababengeke babe khona.
question1: Kuyini ukudluliswa kwezakhi zofuzo okuvundlile (i-HGT)?
answer1: Ukudluliswa kwezakhi zofuzo phakathi kwezinhlobo ezingahlobene
distractor1a: Ukudluliselwa kwezakhi zofuzo kusuka kubazali kuya ezinganeni kuphela
distractor1c: Ukuhamba kwezinto eziphilayo phakathi kwabantu
question2: Kungani ukudluliselwa kwezakhi zofuzo okuvundlile kwenza kube nzima imodeli yesihlahla se-phylogenetic yakudala?
answer2: Ngoba izakhi zofuzo zingahamba phakathi kwezinhlobo ezihlobene kude esikhundleni sokuthola ifa kokhokho kuphela
distractor2a: Ngoba kuvimbela ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo ukuthi kungenzeki
distractor2c: Ngoba kwenzeka kuphela ezintweni eziphilayo ezinamaseli amaningi
question3: Ngokwemodeli yakudala yokuziphendukela kwemvelo, izinhlobo ze-prokaryotic zithuthuka kanjani ngokuyinhloko?
answer3: Ngokukhiqiza inzalo ngokwe-clonal, ngokushintshashintsha okuvela ngokuguqulwa okungahleliwe
distractor3a: Ngokudluliswa njalo kwezakhi zofuzo ezivundlile phakathi kwezinhlobo ezingahlobene
distractor3b: Ngokushintshana phakathi kokuzala ngokocansi kanye nokuzala okungenabo ucansi
distractor3c: Ngokuhlangana kwezakhi zofuzo okwenzeka kuzo zonke izizukulwane
question4: Yini eyayichazwa ngokwesiko ukushintshashintsha kokuzalana kwama-eukaryotes ngokocansi ngaphambi kokudluliswa kwezakhi zofuzo ezivundlile?
answer4: Izakhi zofuzo zeMendelian kanye nokuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo ngaphakathi kwezinhlobo
distractor4a: Ukudluliswa kwezakhi zofuzo okuvundlile kuphela
distractor4b: Ukuhlanganiswa kwezakhi zofuzo phakathi kwezinto eziphilayo ezingahlobene
question5: Kukuziphi izizinda zokuphila lapho kubonwe khona ukudluliselwa kwezakhi zofuzo okuvundlile?
answer5: Kuvamile kuma-prokaryotes futhi kwenzeka nakuma-eukaryotes
distractor5a: Kuma-bacteria kuphela
question6: Yisiphi isenzakalo esikhulu sokuziphendukela kwemvelo okungenzeka ukuthi sasihilela ukuhlanganiswa kwezakhi zofuzo phakathi kwezinto eziphilayo ezihambisanayo?
answer6: Ukuvela kweseli lokuqala le-eukaryotic
distractor6c: Ukuthuthukiswa kwefa likaMendelian
question7: Kungani ukudluliselwa kwezakhi zofuzo okuvundlile kubhekwa njengokubalulekile ekuziphendukeleni kwemvelo?
answer7: Kwethula izinto zofuzo kuzo zonke izinhlobo ezingahlobene, okwengeza ubunzima ebudlelwaneni bokuziphendukela kwemvelo
distractor7b: Ithatha indawo yokukhetha kwemvelo njengendlela eyinhloko yokuziphendukela kwemvelo

chapterName: 4. Izinqubo Zokuziphendukela Kwemvelo | 20. Izinhlobo Zokuphila Nomlando Wokuphila | 20.3 Imibono Ngesihlahla Se-Phylogenetic | Ukudluliswa Kwezakhi Zofuzo Ezivundlile
chapterNameEnglish: 4. Evolutionary Processes | 20. Phylogenies and the History of Life | 20.3 Perspectives on the Phylogenetic Tree | Horizontal Gene Transfer
chapterContent:
Ukudluliselwa kwezakhi zofuzo okuvundlile (i-HGT) ukungeniswa kwezinto zofuzo kusuka kolunye uhlobo kuya kolunye uhlobo ngezindlela ezingezona ukudluliselwa okuqondile kusuka kubazali (abazali) kuya enzalweni. Lokhu kudluliselwa kuvumela ngisho nezinhlobo ezihlobene kude ukuthi zabelane ngezakhi zofuzo, kuthonya izinhlobo zazo. Kucatshangwa ukuthi i-HGT ivame kakhulu kuma-prokaryotes, kodwa cishe yi-2% kuphela ye-genome ye-prokaryotic engadluliselwa ngale nqubo. Abanye abacwaningi bakholelwa ukuthi ukulinganisa okunjalo kusenesikhathi: ukubaluleka kwangempela kwe-HGT ezinqubweni zokuziphendukela kwemvelo kumele kubhekwe njengomsebenzi oqhubekayo. Njengoba lesi simo siphenywa kabanzi, kungase kwembulwe ukuthi sivame kakhulu. Ososayensi abaningi bakholelwa ukuthi i-HGT kanye nokuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo kubonakala (ikakhulukazi kuma-prokaryotes) kungumthombo obalulekile wokwehluka kwezakhi zofuzo, okuyizinto zokusetshenziswa zenqubo yokukhetha kwemvelo. Lokhu kudluliselwa kungenzeka phakathi kwanoma yiziphi izinhlobo ezimbili ezihlanganyela ubuhlobo obuseduze (ithebula elingezansi).
