question1: Kuyini ukudluliswa kwezakhi zofuzo okuvundlile (i-HGT)?
answer1: Ukwethulwa kwezinto zofuzo kusuka kolunye uhlobo kuya kolunye ngezindlela ezingezona ifa elivela kumzali kuya enzalweni
distractor1a: Ukudluliselwa kwezakhi zofuzo kuphela kusuka ezintweni eziphilayo ezingumzali kuya enzalweni yazo
distractor1c: Ifa le-DNA ye-mitochondrial kuphela
question2: Ukudluliswa kwezakhi zofuzo okuvundlile kucatshangwa ukuthi kuvame kakhulu kuliphi iqembu lezinto eziphilayo?
answer2: Ama-Prokaryotes
question3: Kungani ukudluliselwa kwezakhi zofuzo okuvundlile kubalulekile ekuziphendukeleni kwemvelo?
answer3: Kwethula ukuhlukahluka okusha kwezakhi zofuzo okungasebenza kukho ukukhetha kwemvelo
distractor3c: Ithatha indawo yokuzala ngokocansi kuzo zonke izinto eziphilayo
question4: Iyiphi indlela yokudlulisa izakhi zofuzo ezivundlile ehilela ukuthathwa kwe-DNA yamahhala endaweni ezungezile?
answer4: Uguquko
distractor4a: Ukuguqulwa
question5: Iyiphi indlela yokudlulisa izakhi zofuzo ezivundlile esebenzisa i-bacteriophage (igciwane) ukudlulisa i-DNA?
answer5: Ukuguqulwa
distractor5a: Uguquko
question6: Yimuphi indlela yokudluliselwa kwezakhi zofuzo ezivundlile eyenzeka nge-pilus exhumanisa amaseli amabili e-prokaryotic?
answer6: Ukuhlanganiswa
distractor6c: Ama-ejenti okudlulisa izakhi zofuzo
question7: Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okuyisibonelo sokudluliselwa kwezakhi zofuzo okuvundlile kuma-eukaryotes?
answer7: Izakhi zofuzo ezigxumayo (ama-transposon) ezitshalweni zerayisi ne-millet

chapterName: 4. Izinqubo Zokuziphendukela Kwemvelo | 20. Izinhlobo Zokuphila Nomlando Wokuphila | 20.3 Imibono Ngesihlahla Se-Phylogenetic | Ukudluliswa Kwezakhi Zofuzo Ezivundlile | I-HGT Kuma-Prokaryotes
chapterNameEnglish: 4. Evolutionary Processes | 20. Phylogenies and the History of Life | 20.3 Perspectives on the Phylogenetic Tree | Horizontal Gene Transfer | HGT in Prokaryotes
chapterContent:
Indlela esebenza ngayo i-HGT ibonakale ivame kakhulu ezindaweni ze-prokaryotic ze-Bacteria kanye ne-Archaea, ishintsha kakhulu indlela ebhekwa ngayo ukuvela kwazo. Iningi lamamodeli okuziphendukela kwemvelo, njengakwi-Endosymbiont Theory, liphakamisa ukuthi ama-eukaryotes avela kuma-prokaryotes amaningi, okwenza i-HGT ibaluleke kakhulu ekuqondeni ubudlelwano be-phylogenetic bazo zonke izinhlobo ezikhona neziphelile.

 Iqiniso lokuthi izakhi zofuzo zidluliselwa phakathi kwamagciwane avamile laziwa kakhulu ngabafundi be-microbiology. Lokhu kudluliswa kwezakhi zofuzo phakathi kwezinhlobo kuyindlela enkulu lapho amabhaktheriya ethola ukumelana nama-antibiotic. Ngokuvamile, lolu hlobo lokudluliselwa lucatshangwa ukuthi lwenzeka ngezindlela ezintathu ezahlukene:

 Ukuguqulwa: i-DNA engenalutho ithathwa yibhaktheriya
Ukudluliselwa: izakhi zofuzo zidluliselwa kusetshenziswa igciwane
Ukuhlanganiswa: ukusebenzisa ithubhu elingenalutho elibizwa ngokuthi i-pilus ukudlulisa izakhi zofuzo phakathi kwezinto eziphilayo
Muva nje, kutholakale indlela yesine yokudluliselwa kwezakhi zofuzo phakathi kwama-prokaryotes. Izinhlayiya ezincane ezifana negciwane ezibizwa ngokuthi ama-gene transfer agents (GTAs) zidlulisela izingxenye ze-genomic ezingahleliwe kusuka kolunye uhlobo lwe-prokaryote ziye kolunye. Ama-GTA aboniswe ukuthi abangela izinguquko zezakhi zofuzo, ngezinye izikhathi ngesivinini esiphezulu kakhulu uma kuqhathaniswa nezinye izinqubo zokuziphendukela kwemvelo. I-GTA yokuqala yachazwa ngo-1974 kusetshenziswa ama-bacterium ansomi, angewona ama-sulfur. Lawa ma-GTA, okucatshangwa ukuthi angama-bacteriophage alahlekelwe ikhono lokuzalela ngokwawo, athwala izingcezu ze-DNA ezingahleliwe kusuka kwesinye isidalwa kuya kwesinye. Amandla ama-GTA okusebenza ngesivinini esiphezulu aboniswe ezifundweni ezilawulwayo kusetshenziswa ama-bacterium asemanzini. Izehlakalo zokudluliswa kwezakhi zofuzo kuma-prokaryotes asemanzini, kungaba ngama-GTA noma ngama-virus, kulinganiselwa ukuthi ziphakeme njenge-1013 ngonyaka eLwandle iMedithera kuphela. Ama-GTA namagciwane kucatshangwa ukuthi ayizimoto ze-HGT ezisebenzayo ezinomthelela omkhulu ekuziphendukeleni kwe-prokaryotic.

 Ngenxa yalokhu kuhlaziywa kwe-DNA yanamuhla, umqondo wokuthi ama-eukaryotes avele ngqo kusuka e-Archaea awusathandwa. Nakuba ama-eukaryotes anezici eziningi ezingekho kubhaktheriya, njengebhokisi le-TATA (elitholakala esifundeni sokukhuthaza izakhi zofuzo eziningi), ukutholakala kokuthi ezinye izakhi zofuzo ze-eukaryotic zazifana kakhulu ne-DNA yebhaktheriya kune-Archaea DNA kwenza lo mbono ungasebenziseki. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuhlanganiswa kwama-genome avela ku-Archaea kanye nama-Bacteria yi-endosymbiosis kuye kwaphakanyiswa njengesenzakalo sokugcina ekuziphendukeleni kwe-eukaryotic.
question1: Iyiphi indlela yokudlulisa izakhi zofuzo ezivundlile ehilela amabhaktheriya athatha i-DNA engenalutho endaweni yawo?
answer1: Uguquko
distractor1a: Ukuguqulwa
distractor1c: Ama-ejenti okudlulisa izakhi zofuzo
question2: Iyiphi indlela yokudlulisa izakhi zofuzo ezivundlile esebenzisa igciwane ukudlulisa izakhi zofuzo phakathi kwamagciwane?
answer2: Ukuguqulwa
question3: Iyiphi indlela yokudlulisa izakhi zofuzo ezivundlile esebenzisa ithubhu elingenalutho elibizwa ngokuthi i-pilus?
answer3: Ukuhlanganiswa
question4: Ziyini izinto zokudlulisa izakhi zofuzo (ama-GTA)?
answer4: Izinhlayiya ezincane ezifana negciwane ezidlulisela i-DNA ye-genomic engahleliwe phakathi kwama-prokaryotes
distractor4a: I-pili ekhethekile esetshenziselwa ukuzala kwamagciwane kuphela
question5: Kungani izehlakalo zokudluliswa kwezakhi zofuzo ezivundlile zibalulekile kubhaktheriya?
answer5: Ziyindlela enkulu amagciwane athola ngayo ukumelana nama-antibiotic
distractor5a: Zivimbela amabhaktheriya ukuthi angaguquguquki
distractor5c: Zithatha indawo ye-binary fission njengendlela eyinhloko yokuzala
question6: Ukuhlaziywa kwe-DNA yanamuhla kuye kwashintsha kanjani imibono mayelana nemvelaphi yama-eukaryotes?
answer6: Kusikisela ukuthi ama-eukaryote kungenzeka ukuthi avele ngokuhlanganiswa kwe-genome okubandakanya i-Archaea kanye ne-Bacteria kunokuba avele ngqo kwi-Archaea kuphela.
distractor6a: Kufakazele ukuthi ama-eukaryotes avele ngqo kumagciwane anamuhla
distractor6c: Kwabonisa ukuthi ukudluliselwa kwezakhi zofuzo okuvundlile akwenzeki kuma-prokaryotes
question7: Kungani ama-ejenti okudlulisa izakhi zofuzo (ama-GTA) ebhekwa njengabalulekile ekuziphendukeleni kwe-prokaryotic?
answer7: Bangakwazi ukudlulisa i-DNA ngezikhathi eziphakeme kakhulu, okwandisa kakhulu ukuhlukahluka kwezakhi zofuzo
distractor7a: Zivimbela ukudluliswa kwezakhi zofuzo okuvundlile ukuthi kungenzeki
distractor7c: Zidlulisela izakhi zofuzo phakathi kwamaseli afanayo ebhaktheriya kuphela

chapterName: 4. Izinqubo Zokuziphendukela Kwemvelo | 20. I-Phylogenies kanye Nomlando Wokuphila | 20.3 Imibono Ngesihlahla Se-Phylogenetic | Ukudluliswa Kwezakhi Zofuzo Ezivundlile | I-HGT Kuma-Eukaryotes
chapterNameEnglish: 4. Evolutionary Processes | 20. Phylogenies and the History of Life | 20.3 Perspectives on the Phylogenetic Tree | Horizontal Gene Transfer | HGT in Eukaryotes
chapterContent:
Nakuba kulula ukubona ukuthi ama-prokaryotes ashintshana kanjani ngezinto zofuzo nge-HGT, ekuqaleni kwakucatshangwa ukuthi le nqubo ayikho kuma-eukaryotes. Phela, ama-prokaryotes angamaseli angawodwa abonakala ngqo endaweni yawo, kanti amangqamuzana obulili ezinto eziphilayo ezinamaseli amaningi avame ukuhlukaniswa ezingxenyeni ezivikelwe zomzimba. Kuvela kulo mbono ukuthi ukudluliselwa kwezakhi zofuzo phakathi kwama-eukaryotes anamangqamuzana amaningi kufanele kube nzima kakhulu. Ngempela, kucatshangwa ukuthi le nqubo ayivamile kuma-eukaryotes futhi inomthelela omncane kakhulu wokuziphendukela kwemvelo kunakuma-prokaryotes. Naphezu kwalokhu, i-HGT phakathi kwezinto eziphilayo ezihlobene kude iboniswe ezinhlotsheni eziningana ze-eukaryotic, futhi kungenzeka ukuthi kuzotholakala izibonelo eziningi esikhathini esizayo.

 Ezitshalweni, ukudluliselwa kwezakhi zofuzo kubonwe ezinhlotsheni ezingakwazi ukuwela impova ngezindlela ezivamile. "Ama-Transposon noma ama-jumping genes"aboniswe ukuthi adlula phakathi kwezinhlobo zelayisi nezitshalo ze-millet. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinhlobo ze-fungus ezidla izihlahla ze-yew, lapho umuthi wokulwa nomdlavuza i-paclitaxel utholakala khona egxolweni, ziye zathola ikhono lokwenza i-paclitaxel ngokwazo, isibonelo esicacile sokudluliswa kwezakhi zofuzo.

 Ezilwaneni, isibonelo esithakazelisayo kakhulu se-HGT senzeka ngaphakathi kwezinhlobo ze-aphid (Isithombe 20.13). Ama-aphid ayizinambuzane ezihluka ngombala ngokusekelwe kokuqukethwe kwe-carotenoid. Ama-carotenoid ayimibala eyenziwe yizitshalo ezahlukahlukene, isikhunta, kanye nama-microbes, futhi asebenza imisebenzi eyahlukahlukene ezilwaneni, ezithola la makhemikhali ekudleni kwazo. Abantu badinga ama-carotenoid ukuze benze i-vitamin A, futhi siwathola ngokudla izithelo nemifino e-orange: izaqathe, ama-apricot, ama-mango, kanye namazambane amnandi. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, ama-aphid athole ikhono lokwenza ama-carotenoid ngokwawo. Ngokusho kokuhlaziywa kwe-DNA, leli khono libangelwa ukudluliselwa kwezakhi ze-fungus ezinambuzaneni yi-HGT, mhlawumbe njengoba isinambuzane sidle isikhunta njengokudla. I-carotenoid I-enzyme ebizwa ngokuthi i-desaturase inesibopho sombala obomvu obonakala kuma-aphid athile, futhi kuye kwaboniswa ukuthi lapho lesi sakhi sofuzo siguquguquka futhi i-enzyme ilahlekelwa umsebenzi, ama-aphid abuyela emuva embala wawo oluhlaza ovamile (Isithombe 20.13)
question1: Kungani ekuqaleni kwakucatshangwa ukuthi ukudluliselwa kwezakhi zofuzo okuvundlile (i-HGT) akukho kuma-eukaryotes amaningi?
answer1: Ngoba amangqamuzana abo obulili avikelwe emzimbeni, okwenza kube nzima kakhulu ukudlulisa izakhi zofuzo phakathi kwezinhlobo
distractor1a: Ngoba ama-eukaryotes awanawo ama-DNA
distractor1b: Ngoba ama-eukaryotes azala kuphela ngendlela engahambisani nobulili
distractor1c: Ngoba izinguquko zofuzo zithatha indawo ye-HGT ngokuphelele kuma-eukaryotes
question2: Uma kuqhathaniswa nama-prokaryotes, ukudluliselwa kwezakhi zofuzo okuvundlile kuma-eukaryotes ngokuvamile kucatshangwa ukuthi:
answer2: Okungavamile futhi kube nomthelela omncane wokuziphendukela kwemvelo
distractor2a: Okuvame kakhulu futhi umthombo oyinhloko wokuhlukahluka kwezakhi zofuzo
question3: Yisiphi isibonelo esibonisa ukudluliswa kwezakhi zofuzo okuvundlile ezitshalweni?
answer3: Ama-Transposon, noma ama-jumping genes, adlula phakathi kwezinhlobo zerayisi ne-millet
question4: Yisiphi isidalwa esithole ikhono lokukhiqiza i-paclitaxel elwa nomdlavuza ngokudluliselwa kwezakhi zofuzo okuvundlile?
answer4: Isikhunta sidla izihlahla ze-yew
distractor4a: Izitshalo zelayisi
question5: Ama-aphid athole kanjani ikhono lokukhiqiza ama-carotenoid?
answer5: Ngokuthola izakhi zofuzo zesikhunta ngokudluliselwa kwezakhi zofuzo okuvundlile
distractor5a: Ngokuhlangana namagciwane
question6: Kwenzekani uma i-carotenoid desaturase gene ishintshashintsha kuma-aphid?
answer6: Ama-aphid alahlekelwa umbala obomvu bese ebuyela embala oluhlaza ovame kakhulu
distractor6c: Ama-aphid alahlekelwa ikhono lokudla izitshalo
question7: Yisiphi isitatimende esichaza kangcono ukudluliswa kwezakhi zofuzo ezivundlile kuma-eukaryotes?
answer7: Kuye kwabonakala ezinhlotsheni eziningana futhi kungase kuvame kakhulu kunalokho obekucatshangwa ngaphambili
distractor7c: Kwenzeka kuphela phakathi kwezinhlobo ezihlobene eduze
question8: Bheka uMfanekiso 20.14. Iyini imbono ye-Eukaryote-first?
answer8: Ukuthi i-nucleus yavela kuma-prokaryotes kuqala kwalandela ukuhlanganiswa kwe-eukaryote entsha namabhaktheriya aba yi-mitochondria
distractor8a: Ukuthi i-mitochondria yaqala ukwakheka ku-host ye-prokaryotic eyathola i-nucleus yaba yiseli lokuqala le-eukaryotic
distractor8b: Ukuthi ama-prokaryotes empeleni aguqukela kuma-eukaryotes ngokulahlekelwa izakhi zofuzo kanye nobunzima
distractor8c: Ukuthi ama-eukaryotes athuthukise i-Golgi ngaphambi kwe-mitochondria

chapterName: 4. Izinqubo Zokuziphendukela Kwemvelo | 20. Ama-Phylogenies Nomlando Wokuphila | 20.3 Imibono Ngesihlahla Se-Phylogenetic | Ukuhlanganiswa Kwama-Genome Nokuziphendukela Kwemvelo Kwama-Eukaryotes
chapterNameEnglish: 4. Evolutionary Processes | 20. Phylogenies and the History of Life | 20.3 Perspectives on the Phylogenetic Tree | Genome Fusion and the Evolution of Eukaryotes
chapterContent:
Ososayensi bakholelwa ukuthi ukuphela kwe-HGT kwenzeka ngokuhlanganiswa kwe-genome phakathi kwezinhlobo ezahlukene zama-prokaryotes lapho izinto eziphilayo ezimbili ezihambisanayo ziba yi-endosymbiotic. Lokhu kwenzeka lapho uhlobo olulodwa luthathwa ngaphakathi kwe-cytoplasm yolunye uhlobo, okuholela ku-genome equkethe izakhi zofuzo ezivela ku-endosymbiont kanye nomnikazi. Le ndlela yokusebenza iyisici se-Endosymbiont Theory, eyamukelwa iningi lezazi zezinto eziphilayo njengendlela lapho amangqamuzana e-eukaryotic athola khona i-mitochondria nama-chloroplast awo. Kodwa-ke, indima ye-endosymbiosis ekuthuthukisweni kwe-nucleus iphikisana kakhulu. I-DNA ye-nuclear kanye ne-mitochondrial kucatshangwa ukuthi inemvelaphi ehlukile (ehlukene) yokuziphendukela kwemvelo, lapho i-DNA ye-mitochondrial itholakala kuma-genome ayindilinga yamabhaktheriya ayegcwele amangqamuzana e-prokaryotic asendulo. I-DNA ye-Mitochondrial ingabhekwa njenge-chromosome encane kakhulu. Ngokuthakazelisayo, i-DNA ye-mitochondrial izuzwe njengefa kumama kuphela. I-DNA ye-mitochondrial iyawohloka esidoda lapho isidoda sonakala eqandeni elivundisiwe noma kwezinye izimo lapho i-mitochondria etholakala ku-flagellum yesidoda ihluleka ukungena eqandeni.

 Phakathi neminyaka eyishumi edlule, inqubo yokuhlanganiswa kwe-genome yi-endosymbiosis iphakanyiswe nguJames Lake we-UCLA/NASA Astrobiology Institute ukuthi ibe nesibopho sokuvela kwamaseli okuqala e-eukaryotic (Isithombe 20.15a). Esebenzisa ukuhlaziywa kwe-DNA kanye ne-algorithm entsha yezibalo ebizwa ngokuthi i-conditioned reconstruction (CR), ilabhorethri yakhe iphakanyise ukuthi amaseli e-eukaryotic athuthuke kusukela ekuhlanganisweni kwezakhi zofuzo ze-endosymbiotic phakathi kwezinhlobo ezimbili, enye i-Archaea kanti enye i-Bacteria. Njengoba kushiwo, ezinye izakhi zofuzo ze-eukaryotic zifana neze-Archaea, kanti ezinye zifana nezakhi zofuzo ze-Bacteria. Umcimbi wokuhlanganiswa kwe-endosymbiotic, njengoba uLake ewuphakamisile, ungachaza ngokucacile lokhu okubonwayo. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, lo msebenzi musha futhi i-algorithm ye-CR ayinabufakazi, okwenza ososayensi abaningi bamelane nalo mbono.

 Umsebenzi wakamuva kaLake (Isithombe 20.15b) uphakamisa ukuthi amabhaktheriya angenawo amagremu, ahlukile ngaphakathi kwendawo yawo ngoba aqukethe ama-membrane amabili e-lipid bilayer, empeleni avela ekuhlanganisweni kwe-endosymbiotic kwezinhlobo ze-archaeal kanye ne-bacterial. I-membrane ephindwe kabili ingaba umphumela oqondile we-endosymbiosis, lapho i-endosymbiont ithatha i-membrane yesibili kumuntu ophethe njengoba yayifakwa ngaphakathi. Le ndlela iphinde yasetshenziswa ukuchaza ama-membrane aphindwe kabili atholakala kuma-mitochondria kanye nama-chloroplast. Abanye bayangabaza umsebenzi kaLake, futhi umphakathi wesayensi yezinto eziphilayo usaphikisana ngemibono yakhe. Ngaphezu kombono kaLake, kunezinye izinkolelo eziningana eziphikisanayo mayelana nemvelaphi yama-eukaryotes. I-nucleus ye-eukaryotic yavela kanjani? Enye inkolelo-mbono ukuthi amaseli e-prokaryotic akhiqize i-membrane eyengeziwe ezungeze i-chromosome yebhaktheriya. Amanye amabhaktheriya ane-DNA evalwe ama-membrane amabili; noma kunjalo, abukho ubufakazi be-nucleolus noma ama-pores enuclear. Amanye ama-proteobacteria nawo anama-chromosome aboshwe yi-membrane. Uma i-nucleus ye-eukaryotic yavela ngale ndlela, besingalindela ukuthi enye yezinhlobo ezimbili zama-prokaryotes ihlobene kakhulu nama-eukaryotes.

 I-hypothesis ye-nucleus-first iphakamisa ukuthi i-nucleus yavela kuma-prokaryotes kuqala (Isithombe 20.16a), kulandele ukuhlanganiswa kamuva kwe-eukaryote entsha namabhaktheriya aba yi-mitochondria. I-hypothesis ye-mitochondria-first iphakamisa ukuthi i-mitochondria yasungulwa okokuqala ku-host ye-prokaryotic (Isithombe 20.16b), kamuva eyathola i-nucleus, ngokuhlanganiswa noma ezinye izindlela, ukuba ibe yiseli lokuqala le-eukaryotic. Okuthakazelisa kakhulu, i-hypothesis ye-eukaryote-first iphakamisa ukuthi ama-prokaryotes empeleni avele kuma-eukaryotes ngokulahlekelwa izakhi zofuzo kanye nobunzima (Isithombe 20.16c). Zonke lezi zicabango zingahlolwa. Isikhathi kanye nokuhlolwa okwengeziwe kuphela okuzonquma ukuthi iyiphi i-hypothesis esekelwa kangcono yidatha
question1: Ngokusho kwe-Endosymbiont Theory, amangqamuzana e-eukaryotic athola kanjani ama-mitochondria nama-chloroplast awo?
answer1: Ngokuhlangana kwe-genome ngemva kokuba iseli elilodwa le-prokaryotic ligubungele elinye futhi lakha ubudlelwano be-endosymbiotic
distractor1a: Zavela ngokuzimela kusukela ku-nucleus
distractor1c: Zavela kumagciwane athelela ama-eukaryotes asendulo
question2: Iyini imvelaphi yokuziphendukela kwemvelo ye-DNA ye-mitochondrial?
answer2: Itholakala kuma-genome ayindilinga amabhaktheriya agcwele amaseli e-prokaryotic asendulo
question3: I-DNA ye-mitochondrial ivame ukutholwa kanjani njengefa kubantu?
answer3: Kusuka kumama kuphela
question4: Yikuphi ukuqaphela okusekela umbono kaJames Lakes wokuthi ama-eukaryotes avele ngokuhlanganiswa kwe-genome?
answer4: Amanye ama-gene e-eukaryotic afana nama-gene asendulo, kanti amanye afana nama-gene amagciwane.
distractor4a: Zonke izakhi zofuzo ze-eukaryotic zifana nezakhi zofuzo zebhaktheriya
distractor4b: Izakhi zofuzo ze-Eukaryotic azihlobene nhlobo nezakhi zofuzo ze-prokaryotic
distractor4c: I-DNA ye-chloroplast kuphela efana ne-DNA yebhaktheriya
question5: Ngokusho kwe-Lakes hypothesis, yimaphi amaqembu amabili ezinto eziphilayo ahlangana ukuze kuvele amaseli okuqala e-eukaryotic?
answer5: Uhlobo lwe-archaeal kanye nohlobo lwebhaktheriya
distractor5a: Izinhlobo ezimbili zamagciwane
question6: Yimuphi umbono ophakamisa ukuthi i-mitochondria yasungulwa ngaphambi kokuba i-nucleus ivele?
answer6: I-hypothesis ye-mitochondria-first
distractor6c: I-hypothesis ye-phylogenetic yakudala
question7: Yimuphi umbono osikisela ukuthi ama-prokaryotes ashintsha kusuka kuma-eukaryotes ngokulahlekelwa izakhi zofuzo kanye nobunzima?
answer7: I-hypothesis ye-eukaryote-first

chapterContent: Ukuqashelwa kokubaluleka kwe-HGT, ikakhulukazi ekuziphendukeleni kwama-prokaryotes, kubangele abanye ukuba baphakamise ukushiya imodeli yesihlahla sokuphila esivamile. Ngo-1999, uW. Ford Doolittle waphakamisa imodeli ye-phylogenetic efana ne-web noma inethiwekhi ngaphezu kwesihlahla. Inkolelo-mbono iwukuthi ama-eukaryotes awavelanga kukhokho oyedwa we-prokaryotic, kodwa avela echibini lezinhlobo eziningi ezabelana ngezakhi zofuzo ngezindlela ze-HGT. Njengoba kuboniswe kuMfanekiso 20.17a, amanye ama-prokaryotes ngamanye ayenesibopho sokudlulisela amabhaktheriya abangela ukuthuthukiswa kwe-mitochondrial kuma-eukaryotes amasha, kanti amanye amabhaktheriya adlulisela amabhaktheriya adala ama-chloroplast. Lo modeli uvame ukubizwa ngokuthi i-web yokuphila.” Emzamweni wokusindisa umfanekiso wesihlahla, abanye baye baphakamisa ukusebenzisa umuthi we-Ficus (Isithombe 20.17b) oneziqu zawo eziningi njenge-phylogenetic ukumela indima yokuguquguquka enciphile ye-HGT.
question1: Kungani abanye ososayensi bephakamise ukuthi kuthathelwe indawo umuthi wokuphila ojwayelekile?

distractor1a: Ngoba izihlahla ze-phylogenetic azikwazi ukumela izinhlobo eziphelile
distractor1c: Ngoba zonke izinto eziphilayo zavela ngokuzimela
question2: Ubani owaphakamisa inethiwekhi ye-phylogenetic yemodeli yokuphila ngo-1999?
answer2: UW. Ford Doolittle
question3: Ngokusho kwe-net of life hypothesis, ama-eukaryotes aqala kusuka ku:
answer3: Iqoqo lezinhlobo eziningi ze-prokaryotic ezishintshana ngezakhi zofuzo ngokudluliswa kwezakhi zofuzo okuvundlile
distractor3a: Ukhokho oyedwa webhaktheriya ngaphandle kokudluliswa kwezakhi zofuzo

answer4: Ama-Mitochondria nama-chloroplast
distractor4a: I-nucleus kuphela

answer5: Ukubaluleka kokudluliswa kwezakhi zofuzo ezivundlile ekuziphendukeleni kwemvelo

distractor5b: Ukuthi konke ukuvela kwemvelo kubangelwa ukukhetha kwemvelo kuphela

answer6: Umuthi we-Ficus oneziqu eziningi

distractor7c: Kusebenza kuphela ezintweni eziphilayo ezinamaseli amaningi

chapterName: 4. Izinqubo Zokuziphendukela Kwemvelo | 20. I-Phylogenies kanye Nomlando Wokuphila | 20.3 Imibono Ngesihlahla Se-Phylogenetic | Amamodeli Endandatho Yokuphila
chapterNameEnglish: 4. Evolutionary Processes | 20. Phylogenies and the History of Life | 20.3 Perspectives on the Phylogenetic Tree | Ring of Life Models
chapterContent:
Abanye baphakamise ukushiya noma yimuphi imodeli efana nomuthi ye-phylogeny esikhundleni sesakhiwo sendandatho, okuthiwa indandatho yokuphila” (Isithombe 20.18); imodeli ye-phylogenetic lapho zonke izizinda ezintathu zokuphila zavela echibini lama-prokaryotes asendulo. ULake, esebenzisa futhi i-algorithm yokwakha kabusha enesimo, uphakamisa imodeli efana nendandatho lapho izinhlobo zazo zonke izizinda ezintathu—i-Archaea, i-Bacteria, ne-Eukarya—zavela echibini elilodwa lama-prokaryotes ashintshana ngezakhi zofuzo. Ilabhorethri yakhe iphakamisa ukuthi lesi sakhiwo silungele kangcono idatha evela ekuhlaziyweni okubanzi kwe-DNA okwenziwe elabhorethri yakhe, nokuthi imodeli yendandatho iyona kuphela ecabangela ngokwanele i-HGT kanye nokuhlanganiswa kwezakhi zofuzo. Kodwa-ke, abanye ososayensi be-phylogenetic basalokhu bengabaza kakhulu le modeli.

 Ngamafuphi, imodeli yomuthi wokuphila” ephakanyiswe nguDarwin kumele ishintshwe ukuze ifake i-HGT. Ingabe lokhu kusho ukushiya ngokuphelele imodeli yomuthi? Ngisho noLake uthi kufanele kwenziwe yonke imizamo yokuthola ukuguqulwa kwemodeli yesihlahla ukuze ivumelane kahle nedatha yakhe, futhi ukungakwazi ukwenza lokho kuphela okuzodonsela abantu esicelweni sakhe sendandatho.

 Lokhu akusho ukuthi isihlahla, iwebhu, noma indandatho kuzohlobana ngokuphelele nencazelo enembile yobudlelwano be-phylogenetic bokuphila. Umphumela wokucabanga okusha ngamamodeli e-phylogenetic umqondo wokuthi umbono kaDarwin wokuqala ngesihlahla se-phylogenetic ulula kakhulu, kodwa unengqondo ngokusekelwe kulokho okwakwaziwa ngaleso sikhathi. Kodwa-ke, ukusesha imodeli ewusizo kakhulu kuyaqhubeka: imodeli ngayinye isebenza njengemibono ukuze ihlolwe ngamathuba okuthuthukisa amamodeli amasha. Yile ndlela isayensi ethuthuka ngayo. Lawa mamodeli asetshenziswa njengemibono ukusiza ukwakha ubudlelwano bokuziphendukela kwemvelo obucatshangelwayo nokuqonda inani elikhulu ledatha ehlaziywayo.
question1: Yini ehlongozwayo yi-ring of life model?
answer1: Ukuthi zonke izizinda ezintathu zokuphila zavela echibini lama-prokaryotes ashintsha izakhi zofuzo zasendulo
distractor1a: Ukuthi konke ukuphila kwavela ngokuzimela ngaphandle kozalo olufanayo
distractor1b: Ukuthi ama-eukaryote kuphela ashintshana ngezakhi zofuzo ngokudluliselwa kwezakhi zofuzo okuvundlile
distractor1c: Ukuthi amabhaktheriya avele ngqo kuma-eukaryotes anamuhla
question2: Yiziphi izizinda ezintathu zokuphila ezifakiwe ku-ring of life model?
answer2: I-Archaea, Amabhaktheriya, kanye ne-Eukarya
question3: Kungani kwaphakanyiswa indandatho yemodeli yokuphila?
answer3: Ukuze kulandiswe kangcono ukudluliswa kwezakhi zofuzo okuvundlile kanye nokuhlanganiswa kwezakhi zofuzo emlandweni wokuziphendukela kwemvelo
distractor3b: Ukushintsha ukukhetha kwemvelo ngokuzulazula kwezakhi zofuzo
distractor3c: Ukukhombisa ukuthi konke ukuvela kwemvelo kwenzeka ngesivinini esifanayo
question4: Yimuphi usosayensi ophakamise indandatho yemodeli yokuphila esebenzisa i-algorithm yokwakha kabusha enesimo esimisiwe?
answer4: Ichibi laseJames
distractor4a: UCharles Darwin
question5: Ososayensi abaningi be-phylogenetics babheka kanjani indandatho yemodeli yokuphila njengamanje?
answer5: Basalokhu bengabaza ngakho
distractor5a: Kuye kwamukelwa emhlabeni wonke njengokuphela kwemodeli efanele
distractor5b: Ithathe indawo yazo zonke izihlahla ze-phylogenetic ngokuphelele
question6: Ngokusho kwesahluko, uyini umbono wamanje ngomuthi wokuqala wokuphila kaDarwin?
answer6: Kulula kakhulu futhi kufanele kushintshwe ukuze kubhekwe ukudluliswa kwezakhi zofuzo okuvundlile
distractor6b: Ichaza ngokunembile yonke imikhuba yokuziphendukela kwemvelo ngaphandle kokuguqulwa
distractor6c: Kusebenza kuphela ezintweni eziphilayo ezinamaseli amaningi
question7: Iyiphi indima eyenziwa amamodeli ezihlahla, ewebhu, kanye nendandatho ku-biology yokuziphendukela kwemvelo?
answer7: Ziyimibono esetshenziswa ukubona ngeso lengqondo nokuhlola ubudlelwano bokuziphendukela kwemvelo njengoba ubufakazi obusha butholakala
distractor7c: Ziyimodeli zezibalo ezisetshenziselwa kuphela izakhi zofuzo zabantu

20.1 Ukuhlela Ukuphila Emhlabeni
Ososayensi bahlala bethola ulwazi olusha olusiza ukuqonda umlando wokuziphendukela kwemvelo wokuphila eMhlabeni. Iqembu ngalinye lezinto eziphilayo ladlula ohambweni lwalo lokuziphendukela kwemvelo, olubizwa ngokuthi i-phylogeny yalo. Into ngayinye ephilayo yabelana ngokuhlobana nezinye, futhi ngokusekelwe ebufakazini be-morphological kanye nezakhi zofuzo, ososayensi bazama ukumaka izindlela zokuziphendukela kwemvelo zazo zonke izinto eziphilayo eMhlabeni. Ngokomlando, izinto eziphilayo zahlelwa zaba uhlelo lokuhlukaniswa kwe-taxonomic. Kodwa-ke, namuhla ososayensi abaningi bakha izihlahla ze-phylogenetic ukuze babonise ubudlelwano bokuziphendukela kwemvelo.

 20.2 Ukunquma Ubudlelwano Bokuziphendukela Kwemvelo
Ukuze bakhe izihlahla ze-phylogenetic, ososayensi kumele baqoqe ulwazi olunembile olubavumela ukuthi benze ukuxhumana kokuziphendukela kwemvelo phakathi kwezinto eziphilayo. Besebenzisa idatha ye-morphological kanye ne-molecular, ososayensi basebenza ukuhlonza izici kanye nezakhi zofuzo ezifanayo. Ukufana phakathi kwezinto eziphilayo kungavela emlandweni wokuziphendukela kwemvelo ohlanganyelwe (ama-homologia) noma ezindleleni ezihlukene zokuziphendukela kwemvelo (ama-analogies). Ubuchwepheshe obusha bungasetshenziswa ukusiza ukuhlukanisa ama-homologia kuma-analogies. Ngemva kokuba ulwazi olufana nolwakho selutholakele, ososayensi basebenzisa ama-cladistic ukuhlela lezi zenzakalo njengendlela yokunquma umugqa wesikhathi wokuziphendukela kwemvelo. Ososayensi basebenzisa umqondo we-parsimony ephezulu, othi ukuhleleka kwezenzakalo kungenzeka kwenzeke ngendlela esobala kakhulu nelula ngezinyathelo ezincane kakhulu. Ngezehlakalo zokuziphendukela kwemvelo, lena kungaba yindlela enenani elincane kakhulu lokuhlukana okukhulu okuhambisana nobufakazi.

 20.3 Imibono Ngesihlahla Se-Phylogenetic
Isihlahla se-phylogenetic, esasetshenziswa okokuqala nguDarwin, siyimodeli yesihlahla sokuphila esidala echaza ubudlelwano be-phylogenetic phakathi kwezinhlobo, futhi imodeli evame kakhulu esetshenziswa namuhla. Imibono emisha mayelana ne-HGT kanye nokuhlanganiswa kwe-genome ibangele abanye ukuthi basikisele ukuthi imodeli ifane nama-webs noma ama-rings

question9: Bheka uMfanekiso 20.9 kanye noMfanekiso 20.9.1. I-Phylogeny ibalulekile empilweni yansuku zonke emphakathini wesintu. Ithimba locwaningo eShayina liyisebenzise kanjani i-phylogeny njengesiqondiso sokuthola izitshalo ezintsha ezingasetshenziswa ukuzuzisa abantu?
